sum: This study introduces a physics-informed neural network (PINN) solver designed for a coupled spring-slider system that integrates rate-and-state friction with dynamic pore-pressure and porosity evolution. To address the stiff and strongly coupled nature of these hydromechanical models, the authors implement adaptive inverse-residual weighting and a two-stage optimization workflow (Adam followed by L-BFGS). In forward simulations, the PINN predictions match Runge-Kutta reference solutions for steady sliding and slow-slip transients with high accuracy. In inverse experiments, the framework successfully recovers the applied normal stress from noisy shear-stress observations, demonstrating its potential as a differentiable alternative for parameter inversion in complex fault models.
本研究针对速率-状态摩擦与孔隙压/孔隙度演化耦合的弹簧-滑块系统，开发了一种物理信息神经网络（PINN）求解器。为解决该多物理场耦合模型的刚性与强耦合难题，采用了自适应逆残差权重和两阶段优化策略（Adam后接L-BFGS）。正演模拟中，PINN预测结果与Runge-Kutta参考解高度吻合；反演实验……

Synthetic time-series data of block velocity, shear stress, and pore pressure generated from a coupled spring-slider system, used for forward validation and noisy inverse testing.

PINN forward predictions achieved a normalized mean squared error below 0.08, and inverse experiments recovered normal stress within 1% deviation under high noise levels.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution 3-D P-wave attenuation tomography model of the northern Chilean subduction zone (21°–22°S) using the coda-normalization approach in the MuRAT algorithm. Utilizing 147,639 high-quality waveforms from 42,460 local earthquakes recorded by 76 broadband stations (2007–2021), the authors image two prominent low-Q (high attenuation) anomalies. The first anomaly lies along the top of the subducting Nazca slab (50–90 km depth), indicating fluid release from slab dehydration. The second anomaly ascends from the mantle wedge toward the lower crust beneath the volcanic arc, tracing fluid migration pathways. These low-Q zones correlate with high-Vp/Vs regions and sit above high-seismicity zones, confirming that intraslab earthquakes are closely linked to dehydration processes.

sum: The July 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence ruptured two nearly orthogonal structures: the left-lateral Salt Wells Valley fault (Mw 6.4) and the right-lateral Paxton Ranch fault (Mw 7.1). To test whether such conjugate ruptures recur systematically, the authors excavated five paleoseismic trenches and dated faulted deposits using single-grain K-feldspar post-IR IRSL luminescence and OxCal Bayesian modeling. Salt Wells Valley exposures record only one pre-2019 rupture at 17.7–27.2 ka, yielding a low slip rate of 0.01–0.09 mm/yr. Conversely, the Paxton Ranch fault preserves two well-constrained Holocene events (4.4–8.7 ka and 10.6–14.5 ka) and up to three late Pleistocene events, with a slip rate of 0.2–1.3 mm/yr. The contrasting recurrence intervals and lack of overlapping event ages demonstrate that the Paxton Ranch fault usually ruptures independently, highlighting that seismic hazard in the Walker Lane reflects time-dependent fault network interactions.
2019年Ridgecrest地震序列先后破裂了近正交的左旋Salt Wells Valley断层（Mw 6.4）和右旋Paxton Ranch断层（Mw 7.1）。为检验此类共轭破裂是否周期性重现，本研究开挖了5个古地震探槽，并利用单颗粒钾长石光释光（pIRIR）测年及OxCal贝叶斯建模约束了古……

sum: This study investigates the physical mechanisms driving back-propagating earthquake rupture (BPR) fronts. Using numerical simulations of dynamic rupture, the authors demonstrate that a low ratio of initial shear stress to effective normal stress (τ0/σeff) promotes pulse-like ruptures. Hydraulic heterogeneity within the fault zone induces BPR through complex interactions among slip rate, shear stress, and fault healing. The back-propagating fronts are sustained by residual stress and are initiated when the local stress drop exceeds the analytical critical threshold required for re-rupture. This work provides key theoretical insights into complex rupture styles on heterogeneous faults.
本研究探讨了地震后向传播破裂（BPR）前锋的物理机制。通过动力学破裂数值模拟，研究表明较低的初始剪应力与有效正应力比（τ0/σeff）有利于促进脉冲状破裂。断层带内的流体动力学非均匀性通过滑动速率、剪应力和断层愈合之间的相互作用诱发了BPR。后向传播前锋由残余应力维持，并在局部应力降超过重新破裂的解……

sum: This study evaluates the 3-D velocity model adopted for CyberShake Study 24.8 (CS24.8 VM) in the San Francisco Bay Area by comparing 0–5 Hz finite-difference (SW4) simulations against recorded waveforms from 18 small-to-moderate earthquakes (Mw 3.64–4.5) across 415 stations. Using event-specific corner frequencies derived via Bayesian spectral decomposition, the authors assess Fourier amplitude spectra (FAS) and 5–95% Arias intensity durations. The CS24.8 VM underpredicts horizontal FAS by 0.1–0.5 LN-units (0.3–1 Hz) and up to 0.7 LN-units (at 5 Hz), and underpredicts waveform duration by a factor of two. This bias stems from capping the minimum shear-wave velocity at 400 m/s in soft Bay Area sediments and overly smooth 3-D structure. Nevertheless, for source-site path effects, the 3-D simulations outperform ergodic ground-motion models below 0.7 Hz and match them up to 1 Hz, while spatial Gaussian process regressions guide future multi-scale model refinements.
本研究通过对比18个中小型地震（Mw 3.64–4.5）在415个台站的记录波形与0–5 Hz有限差分（SW4）模拟结果，评估了旧金山湾区CyberShake 24.8采用的三维速度模型（CS24.8 VM）。作者利用贝叶斯谱分解估算震源拐角频率，定量分析了傅里叶振幅谱（FAS）和波形持时。结果显示……

kc: Quantified wave-propagation uncertainties of the CyberShake 24.8 velocity model (0–5 Hz) using 3,303 three-component waveform pairs from 18 local earthquakes.
Demonstrated that capping minimum Vs at 400 m/s causes systematic FAS underprediction (0.1–0.7 LN-units) and 50% shorter durations in soft Bay Area sediments.
Showed that 3-D physics-based simulations improve source-site wave propagation accuracy over ergodic GMMs below 0.7 Hz and perform comparably up to 1 Hz.
Mapped spatially correlated site and path residuals using Gaussian process regression (SKI/SKIP) and quantified point-source approximation errors above 1 Hz.
利用18个地方地震的3303对三分量波形，量化了CyberShake 24.8速度模型在0–5 Hz频段的波传播不确定性。
证明将最小剪切波速限制在400 m/s会导致湾区软土沉积层出现系统性的FAS低估（0.1–0.7 LN单位）及波形持时缩短50%。
表明在0.7 Hz以下，基于物理的三维模拟对特定震源-台站路径效应的预测精度优于遍历地面运动模型（GMM），且在1 Hz内精度相当。
利用高斯过程回归（SKI/SKIP）绘制了空间相关的场地与路径残差分布图，并量化了1 Hz以上点源近似引入的误差。
me: 3-D viscoelastic finite-difference wave propagation modeling up to 5 Hz using SW4 with depth-dependent mesh refinement.
Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo (PyMC) spectral decomposition to estimate event-specific corner frequencies after PhaseNet S-wave picking.
K-means++ clustering of top 8 km shear-wave velocity profiles to classify major geological units in the velocity model.
Gaussian process regression with SKI/SKIP decomposition and source-site vectorization kernels to partition site-to-site and path-to-path residual variance.
使用具有深度自适应网格加密的SW4程序进行高达5 Hz的三维粘弹性有限差分波传播模拟。
结合PhaseNet拾取S波到时，利用贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（PyMC）谱分解方法估算特定地震的拐角频率。
对浅表8 km内的剪切波速剖面应用K-means++聚类算法，以划分速度模型中的主要地质单元。
采用结合SKI/SKIP分解与震源-台站矢量化核函数的高斯过程回归，分离并量化场地间与路径间的残差方差。
de: 3,303 pairs of recorded and simulated 3-component broadband waveforms across 415 NCEDC stations for 18 earthquakes (Mw 3.64–4.5) in the San Francisco Bay Area.
Modified USGS Northern California Velocity Model for CyberShake 24.8 (280 km × 115 km × 30 km subdomain, Vs_min = 400 m/s).
Kinematic finite-fault simulations (Graves & Pitarka generator up to 10 Hz on SCEC BBP) for Mw 4.0 events in a 1-D model to bound point-source variability.
旧金山湾区18个中小型地震（Mw 3.64–4.5）在415个NCEDC台站记录与模拟的3303对三分量宽频带波形。
用于CyberShake 24.8的修正版USGS北加州速度模型（280 km × 115 km × 30 km子区域，最小剪切波速400 m/s）。
基于SCEC宽频带平台（BBP）在一维模型中开展的高达10 Hz的Mw 4.0有限断层运动学模拟，用于约束点源近似的变异性。
li: Adopting a minimum shear-wave velocity of 400 m/s truncates soft Quaternary marine sediments (actual Vs down to 80 m/s), causing amplitude and duration underprediction.
Point-source double-couple representations neglect finite-fault directivity and high-frequency non-double-couple radiation, introducing up to 0.5 LN-units of between-event variability above 1 Hz.
The 3-D velocity model lacks small-scale crustal heterogeneities and sharp bimaterial fault interfaces, reducing high-frequency scattering and spatial ground-motion variability.
采用400 m/s的最小剪切波速截断了软第四纪海相沉积物（实际低至80 m/s），导致振幅和持时的系统性低估。
双力偶点源表示忽略了有限断层方向性效应和高频非双力偶辐射，在1 Hz以上引入了高达0.5 LN单位的事件间变异性。
三维速度模型缺乏小尺度地壳非均质性和尖锐的双材料断层界面，降低了高频散射和地面运动的空间变异性。

tm.why: The paper evaluates a 3-D regional velocity model used in CyberShake 24.8 for physics-based ground-motion simulations and seismic hazard estimates in the San Francisco Bay Area.
The study performs 3-D viscoelastic finite-difference wave propagation simulations up to 5 Hz using the SW4 code on the Frontier supercomputer.

The paper evaluates and characterizes the 3-D crustal velocity structure of Northern California, including sedimentary basins and geological units like the Franciscan Complex and Great Valley Formation.

sum: Reconstructing high-resolution subsurface velocity models from sparse well-log measurements is a severely ill-posed inverse problem. This paper introduces a diffusion-guided framework that integrates structurally preconditioned Tikhonov inversion, plane-wave partial differential equation (PDE) regularization, and measurement-guided diffusion posterior sampling. A denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) is pre-trained on 5000 pairs of velocity models and local slope fields computed via plane-wave destruction (PWD) filters, learning a coupled two-channel velocity-slope prior. During Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) reverse sampling, Gauss-Newton velocity updates honoring well constraints and plane-wave PDE regularity are injected into the clean velocity estimate, while the slope channel evolves consistently via the joint prior. Tested on the Volve synthetic model and the Mobil AVO Viking Graben field dataset (including RTM-derived slope initialization), the approach significantly improves lateral continuity, reflector sharpness, and blind-well agreement while keeping inference computationally practical.
从稀疏测井构建高分辨率速度模型是严重不适定反问题。本文提出一种扩散引导框架，将结构预条件Tikhonov反演、平面波偏微分方程（PDE）正则化与测量引导的扩散后验采样相结合。研究利用平面波破坏（PWD）算子计算的5000组速度与局部倾角对预训练双通道扩散模型，学习速度-倾角联合先验。在DDIM逆向采……

t: Combines structurally preconditioned Tikhonov inversion and plane-wave PDE regularization with a two-channel joint velocity-slope DDIM diffusion prior, injecting Gauss-Newton well-log updates into the clean velocity estimate during reverse sampling.
结合结构预条件Tikhonov反演、平面波PDE正则化与双通道速度-倾角DDIM扩散先验，在逆向采样中注入测井更新。
Pre-trained on 5000 velocity-slope pairs from SEAM, Otway, and Volve models; evaluated on the Volve synthetic model and the North Sea Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 field dataset with two wells.
使用SEAM、Otway和Volve等5000组速度-倾角对预训练，在Volve合成模型和Viking Graben实测…

Using 12 effective DDIM steps (20 LSQR iterations/step), the method recovers sharper interfaces, stronger lateral reflector continuity, coherent modeled reflections, and superior blind-well (Well 5) agreement compared to deterministic preconditioned inversion.
仅用12个有效DDIM步即恢复出更清晰的界面、横向连续反射同相轴，并在盲井（Well 5）处取得更优吻合度。

PW-PDE regularization is sensitive to initial slope accuracy, diffusion priors require ~2 GPU days to train and risk training-distribution bias, and slope adaptation remains partially constrained by the initial slope estimate.
高度依赖初始倾角精度，扩散先验训练耗时（约2天）且受训练集分布限制，倾角演化仍部分受限于初始估计。

Integrates explicit plane-wave PDE regularization and a two-channel joint velocity-slope diffusion prior into structurally preconditioned well-log inversion without requiring RTM-based imaging terms in every scenario.
将显式平面波PDE正则化与双通道速度-倾角联合扩散先验引入结构预条件测井反演中。

kc: Introduces plane-wave PDE regularization into structurally preconditioned well-log inversion to explicitly enforce alignment between velocity gradients and local geological dip.
Proposes a measurement-guided diffusion framework that combines physics-based structural preconditioning with learned generative priors during DDIM reverse sampling.
Develops a two-channel joint velocity-slope diffusion prior trained on velocity models and their PWD slope fields to maintain structural coherence during inference.
Demonstrates improved structural continuity and blind-well accuracy on the Volve synthetic model and Viking Graben field data, showing the benefit of RTM-derived slope initialization.
在结构预条件测井反演中引入平面波PDE正则化，显式约束速度梯度与局部地质倾角对齐。
提出测量引导的扩散反演框架，在DDIM逆向采样中结合物理结构预条件与生成式先验。
开发了双通道速度-倾角联合扩散先验，利用速度模型及其PWD倾角场训练以保持推理中的结构一致性。
在Volve合成模型和Viking Graben实际数据上验证了横向连续性和盲井精度的提升，并展示了RTM衍生倾角初始化的优势。
me: Two-channel DDPM/DDIM generative prior trained jointly on high-resolution P-wave velocity models and local slope fields derived via plane-wave destruction (PWD).
Structurally preconditioned Tikhonov least-squares inversion using plane-wave spray (painting) operators aligned with local slopes.
Explicit plane-wave PDE regularization penalizing velocity variations orthogonal to local structural dips, solved via LSQR iterations.
Velocity-only measurement guidance injected at the clean-sample estimate level during final DDIM reverse steps, with warm-start initialization.
基于高分辨率纵波速度模型及平面波破坏（PWD）局部倾角场联合训练的双通道DDPM/DDIM生成先验。
利用沿局部倾角方向的平面波喷涂算子构建结构预条件Tikhonov最小二乘反演。
引入惩罚垂直于局部构造倾角速度变化的显式平面波PDE正则化项，并通过LSQR迭代求解。
采用热启动初始化，在DDIM逆向采样后期仅对干净速度估计注入测量引导更新。
de: Diffusion prior training on 5000 2D velocity-slope pairs (256x512 patches) from SEAM Arid, SEAM Arid Barrett, SEAM Phase I, Otway, and Volve.
Unconditional generation and warm-started unguided sampling tests to verify the learned statistical coupling between velocity and PWD slopes.
Guided velocity reconstruction on the Volve synthetic dataset using sparse well control and synthetic seismic wavefield forward modeling comparisons.

Field data application on Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 (1001 shots, 120 receivers) conditioned on Well-log 4 and blind-validated on Well-log 5, comparing initial-velocity vs. RTM-derived PWD slopes.
使用来自SEAM Arid、SEAM Phase I、Otway和Volve的5000组二维速度-倾角对（256x512切片）训练扩散先验。
进行无条件生成和热启动无引导采样测试，验证速度与PWD倾角之间的统计耦合。
在Volve合成模型上进行稀疏测井约束下的引导速度重构，并对比合成地震波场正演响应。
在Mobil AVO Viking Graben第12测线（1001炮，120道）上进行实际数据测试，以Well 4约束、Well 5盲井验证，对比初始速度与RTM图像提取的PWD倾角效果。
li: Regularization effectiveness depends strongly on the quality of the initial slope field; slopes from linearly interpolated well logs can be unreliable without an RTM image.
Diffusion reconstructions can be biased if the training velocity dataset is insufficiently diverse or unrepresentative of unseen geological structures.
Training the diffusion prior is computationally expensive (~2 days on an NVIDIA V100 GPU), and slope evolution during inference remains partially constrained by the initial slope estimate.
正则化效果高度依赖初始倾角场质量，直接从线性插值测井模型估计的倾角在缺乏RTM图像时不够可靠。
若训练数据集多样性不足或无法代表未知地质构造，扩散重构结果可能产生偏差。
扩散先验训练计算成本高（V100 GPU约需2天），且推理时倾角演化仍部分受限于初始倾角估计。

tm.why: The paper trains a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) with a UNet backbone to learn a joint prior over velocity models and local structural slopes.

It formulates velocity model reconstruction from sparse well logs as an ill-posed inverse problem combining Tikhonov regularization, structural preconditioning, plane-wave PDE constraints, and diffusion posterior sampling.
The work directly targets high-resolution velocity model building and uses reverse-time migration (RTM) images for structural guidance in exploration seismic settings.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF analyzed, including equations in Section 2, synthetic and field experiments in Section 3, all 8 figures, and runtime/limitation discussions in Section 4.

sum: Traditional microseismic monitoring relies on sequential phase picking and association, which frequently fails under low signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) where phase onsets are emergent or obscured. This paper introduces the Quake Neural Operator (QNO), an end-to-end multi-task deep learning framework that builds earthquake catalogs directly from continuous multi-station waveforms without explicit phase picking. By interleaving Fourier Neural Operators (for temporal feature extraction) and Graph Neural Operators (for spatial message passing across arbitrary network geometries), QNO simultaneously classifies station-level signal probabilities and regresses event-level locations and origin times. Trained on 30 years of Northern California earthquake data (M <= 2), QNO outperforms SeismicGNN in horizontal location accuracy and surpasses PhaseNO in low-SNR detection. Applied to 10 days of continuous recordings at the Geysers geothermal field, QNO identifies up to 10,167 raw detections (8,346 after deduplication), nearly an order of magnitude more than the 874 events in the routine NCEDC catalog.
传统微震监测依赖依次进行的震相拾取与关联，在低信噪比下常因初至不清而失效。本文提出地震神经算子（QNO），一种无需显式震相拾取即可从连续多台站波形直接构建地震目录的端到端多任务深度学习框架。通过交替结合傅里叶神经算子（提取时间特征）和图神经算子（在任意台网几何间传递空间信息），QNO同步进行台站级信……

t: QNO is a multi-task neural operator combining Fourier Neural Operators (temporal extraction) and Graph Neural Operators (spatial communication) to jointly classify station signal probabilities and regress earthquake location and origin time.
结合傅里叶神经算子与图神经算子的多任务框架，同步进行台站信号分类及震源位置和发震时刻回归。

Trained and evaluated on 30 years of NCEDC 3-component waveforms (M <= 2, >= 8 stations) split chronologically (7,972 train, 1,402 validation, 1,019 test), and applied to 10-day continuous recordings at the Geysers.
使用NCEDC 30年微震波形（7972训练/1402验证/1019测试）及盖瑟斯地热田10天连续波形。
On the NCEDC test set, QNO achieves location MAEs of 3.46 km (x), 3.19 km (y), 3.05 km (z), and 0.94 s (time). At the Geysers, QNO detects 10,167 events (threshold 0.6) versus 874 in NCEDC.
测试集定位平均绝对误差约3.1-3.5 km；在盖瑟斯地热田检出10,167个事件，比常规目录多近十倍。
QNO outputs one location per 15-s window, missing secondary events within 10 s, and can generate duplicate detections (~18%) for long-duration events across consecutive windows.
单窗口仅定位单个事件，密集余震易漏检，且长周期事件在滑动窗口下会产生约18%重复检测。

End-to-end multi-task neural operator that builds earthquake catalogs directly from continuous multi-station waveforms across arbitrary network geometries without explicit phase picking or phase association.
首个无需震相拾取与关联、直接从任意台网几何连续波形构建地震目录的端到端多任务神经算子。

kc: Develops the Quake Neural Operator (QNO), an end-to-end multi-task framework combining Fourier and Graph Neural Operators for simultaneous event detection and source localization without phase picking.
Demonstrates zero-shot generalization across arbitrary seismic network geometries (8 to 32+ stations) and varying temporal sampling rates (100 Hz to 200 Hz).
Outperforms state-of-the-art baselines: achieves lower horizontal location errors than SeismicGNN and maintains reliable detection at 0 dB SNR where PhaseNO fails.
Constructs a high-resolution catalog for the Geysers geothermal field over 10 days, detecting nearly an order of magnitude more microearthquakes than the routine NCEDC catalog.
开发了地震神经算子（QNO），结合傅里叶和图神经算子的端到端多任务框架，无需震相拾取即可同步实现事件检测与震源定位。
验证了模型在任意地震台网几何结构（8至32+个台站）和不同时间采样率（100 Hz至200 Hz）下的零样本泛化能力。
性能超越现有主流基线：水平定位误差低于SeismicGNN，且在PhaseNO失效的0 dB低信噪比下仍能保持可靠检测。
构建了盖瑟斯地热田10天连续数据的高分辨率微震目录，检测到的微震数量比常规NCEDC目录高出近一个数量级。
me: Multi-task operator learning combining a station-level classification branch (earthquake vs. noise probability via softmax) and an event-level regression branch (latitude, longitude, depth, origin time via mean pooling).

Shared spatiotemporal feature extractor alternating Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) layers for 1D spectral convolution in time and Graph Neural Operator (GNO) layers for spatial message passing across stations within distance threshold D.
Data augmentation adding up to 16 virtual noise-only stations with STEAD real noise waveforms and relative coordinate normalization within a 1.2-degree local computational domain.
多任务算子学习，结合台站级分类分支（通过softmax输出地震与噪声概率）和事件级回归分支（通过均值池化预测经纬度、深度和发震时刻）。
共享时空特征提取器，交替使用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）进行时间维一维谱卷积，以及图神经算子（GNO）在距离阈值D内的台站间进行空间消息传递。
数据增强策略，在1.2度局部计算域内进行相对坐标归一化，并随机添加多达16个加载STEAD真实噪声波形的虚拟纯噪声台站。
de: NCEDC catalog and 3-component waveform dataset (30 years, M <= 2, >= 8 stations), temporally split into 7,972 training (pre-2016), 1,402 validation (2016), and 1,019 test (2017-2021) events.
Noise robustness benchmark on test event nc73384250 with real noise and Gaussian noise added at SNRs ranging from 20 dB down to -8 dB.
Continuous 10-day raw seismic waveforms (June 8-18, 2024, including an Mw 4.5 mainshock) from the Geysers geothermal field processed in 15-s windows with 5-s overlap.
NCEDC目录与三分量波形数据集（跨度30年，震级<=2，至少8个台站记录），按时间划分为7,972个训练事件（2016年前）、1,402个验证事件（2016年）和1,019个测试事件（2017-2021年）。
抗噪鲁棒性基准测试：在测试事件nc73384250中叠加信噪比从20 dB降至-8 dB的真实噪声和高斯噪声。
盖瑟斯地热田2024年6月8日至18日（含一次Mw 4.5主震）的10天连续原始地震波形，以15秒窗口、5秒重叠进行滑动处理。
li: Designed to locate a single event per 15-s window; when multiple events occur in the same window (e.g., early aftershocks), it typically locates only the earlier event.

Long-duration seismic events or codas exceeding the window length can trigger duplicate detections across consecutive overlapping windows (~18% within 5 s at the Geysers), requiring post-processing clustering.
Unlike regional-agnostic phase pickers, direct waveform location requires training on local catalog events to implicitly account for regional velocity structures.
设计上每个15秒窗口仅定位单个事件；当同一窗口内发生多个事件（如早期余震）时，通常只能定位较早发生的事件。
持续时间较长的地震事件或尾波超出窗口长度时，会在连续重叠窗口中触发重复检测（盖瑟斯数据中约18%间隔小于5秒），需后处理聚类去重。
与跨区域泛化性强的震相拾取器不同，直接波形定位需要使用研究区本地历史地震目录进行训练，以隐式学习区域速度结构。

tm.why: The paper introduces a novel multi-task deep learning architecture combining Fourier and Graph Neural Operators for seismic monitoring.
The core objective is automated end-to-end earthquake detection, localization, and catalog construction directly from continuous waveform data.
The algorithm is specifically targeted at microseismic monitoring and evaluated on a 10-day continuous dataset at the Geysers geothermal field.

ev.notes: Full 16-page Nature Communications PDF (including all 9 figures, Table 1, and Methods section) was analyzed.

sum: We introduce MABLE (Masked Autoencoding with Bi-Lipschitz Decoding for Embeddings and Graph Metric Learning), a self-supervised framework for learning node and graph representations from large, heterogeneous geospatial graphs. MABLE splits node embeddings into a reconstruction slice decoded by a singular-value-clamped bi-Lipschitz linear decoder and a contextual slice regularized by cross-view matched-node correspondence. Graph-level embeddings are aggregated via Lipschitz-controlled softmax attention pooling and trained with fixed cosine-similarity alignment and uniformity surrogates, avoiding learned discriminators, hard-negative mining, and global coordinate shortcuts. Using a Reformer-style LSH self-attention backbone (GeoReformer) on edge-free node sets, we evaluate MABLE on a 145k-graph multi-modal dataset over the Arabian Shield (incorporating surface geochemistry, Sentinel-2 optics, magnetics, and regional seismic Vs to 10 km depth) and a dense 100 m prospect-scale grid over Suwaj. The resulting embeddings recover coherent terrane-scale zonation, multi-scale spectral structure, and GIS-ready exploration layers.
本文提出MABLE自监督框架，用于从大规模异构地理空间图中学习节点和图级嵌入。方法将节点嵌入分为经双Lipschitz线性解码器重构的特征切片和由跨视图节点一致性约束的上下文切片，并通过Lipschitz控制的注意力池化与固定余弦相似度损失训练图表示，无需判别器或绝对坐标输入。基于GeoReform……

t: MABLE splits node embeddings into a reconstruction slice decoded by a singular-value-clamped bi-Lipschitz decoder and a contextual slice aligned across views, pooled via Lipschitz softmax attention and trained with fixed-cosine contrastive losses.
将节点嵌入分为双Lipschitz解码的重构切片与跨视图对齐的上下文切片，结合注意力池化与余弦对比损失训练。

Evaluated on ~145k circular 200 m patches (~951M nodes, 71 features) across the Arabian Shield combining surface geochemistry, Sentinel-2 optics, magnetics, and KSA seismic Vs data down to 10 km depth, plus a 1.25M-point 100 m grid over Suwaj.
阿拉伯地盾约14.5万个多模态图（含地球化学、光学、磁法及10km内地震Vs）及Suwaj矿区125万点网格。

The 256-D embeddings show low anisotropy (mean random-pair cosine similarity ~0.054), non-linear manifold structure (top 3 PCs explain ~17% variance), a ~300 km spatial correlation zero-crossing, and 1/f^0.75 power-law spectral decay.
256维嵌入呈低各向异性（随机对余弦均值约0.054），前三主成分占17%方差，空间相关在300km过零。

Standalone embeddings struggle under strict geographic extrapolation without coordinate baselines, rely on edge-free graphs, and require quantitative validation against mapped geology and mineral systems.
强地理外推时需结合基线特征，采用无边图结构，且矿区图层尚需与实测地质图定量验证。

Introduces SVD-clamped bi-Lipschitz decoding and fixed-cosine Spectral Contrastive Loss surrogates within a masked graph autoencoder, avoiding learned discriminators, hard-negative mining, and global coordinate shortcuts.
在掩码图自编码器中引入SVD奇异值截断的双Lipschitz解码器与固定余弦对比损失，无需判别器或全局坐标。

kc: Unifies masked feature autoencoding and fixed-cosine graph metric learning without learned discriminators or hard-negative selection.
Proves node feature similarity preservation under a bi-Lipschitz decoder enforced via SVD singular-value clamping.
Establishes bounded-domain Lipschitz stability and separation preservation for clipped softmax attention graph pooling.
Demonstrates regional-to-prospect scale transfer across the Arabian Shield using seismic Vs, magnetic, geochemical, and optical data without global coordinate inputs.

sum: This study proposes a self-supervised deep-learning-based denoising method integrating LSTM and auto-encoder architectures. By leveraging ultra-low-background seismic data from the Huainan Deep Underground Laboratory and synchronous surface observations, the model learns clean wavefield features to adaptively denoise heavily contaminated surface data. For ambient noise, it suppresses high-frequency noise above 1 Hz with a suppression ratio of 0.986. For seismic events, it improves the signal-to-noise ratio by up to 8.21 dB. Single-component processing preserves low-frequency fidelity better, whereas three-component joint processing yields superior high-frequency attenuation.

sum: This study applies three deep-learning phase pickers (EQTransformer, GPD, and PhaseNet) alongside PyOcto association and Hypoinverse/hypoDD relocation to continuous seismic data (2014–2023) in Hispaniola. The resulting aggregated catalog contains over 47,000 earthquakes, tripling the size of local network catalogs. This high-resolution dataset illuminates low-magnitude seismicity along major fault zones (e.g., Enriquillo–Plantain Garden and Septentrional–Oriente) and resolves the complex subducting slab geometries. The relocated seismicity supports double-slab interaction models east of ~70° W, where the north-dipping Caribbean slab meets the south-dipping North American slab, demonstrating the power of ML workflows in complex tectonic settings.

sum: This study applies the horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) method to ambient noise data collected from five three-component nodal seismometers over one year (2023) to monitor the Huangtupo Linjiang Number 1 landslide in the Three Gorges Reservoir area. The authors analyze temporal variations in peak frequencies and amplification factors to identify distinct hydrological responses in shallow versus deep sliding zones. Reservoir water-level rise decreases peak frequencies and amplification factors in shallow zones due to increased pore-water pressure and reduced shear-wave velocity, whereas deep zones show weaker sensitivity. Modal decomposition highlights the dominant control of reservoir water-level fluctuations over transient rainfall, and spatial analysis reveals stronger hydrological influences on the landslide's frontal zone.

sum: This paper introduces a novel workflow that utilizes Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro large language model (LLM) to automate the extraction and structuring of macroseismic observations from unstructured legacy reports. The authors apply this method to the 1957 M 5.3 Daly City and 1971 ML 6.7 Sylmar earthquakes in California. By extracting addresses, original Modified Mercalli intensity values, and descriptions, and geocoding them via Google's Geocoding API, they successfully generated over 2300 geocoded intensity reports for the Daly City event. The resulting shaking intensity maps rival modern 'Did You Feel It?' maps, demonstrating that LLMs offer a highly scalable and reliable solution for digitizing historical seismological archives to improve seismic hazard models and site-effect studies.

sum: Reconstructing past mantle thermal states by reversing convection is computationally expensive and mathematically ill-posed. This study replaces traditional numerical PDE solvers with Tensorized Fourier Neural Operators (TFNOs) for 2-D isoviscous Rayleigh-Benard mantle convection. The authors develop three operators: a purely physics-informed Stokes neural operator mapping temperature to velocity and pressure without training data, and data-driven forward and reverse convection operators that leapfrog the Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) condition by up to 300 times. This achieves 5,000x to 20,000x speedups and enables exact gradient calculations via automatic differentiation instead of adjoint solvers. Comparing four reconstruction methods on synthetic Underworld datasets, they show that while direct reverse operators fail under 5% pink observational noise, a joint inversion combining the terminal thermal state and chronological surface horizontal velocities remains highly robust, successfully recovering mantle thermal history back to one transit time (~50 Myr) at a total workflow cost comparable to a single traditional inversion.
重建地幔过去热状态计算昂贵且具有不适定性。本研究利用张量化傅里叶神经算子（TFNO）替代传统数值求解器，模拟二维等黏度地幔热对流。作者构建了无数据纯物理驱动的Stokes神经算子，以及时间步长超越CFL条件约300倍的数据驱动正、反向对流算子，实现了5000至20000倍的计算加速，并通过自动微分替……

t: Replaces PDE solvers with Tensorized Fourier Neural Operators: a physics-informed Stokes operator and data-driven forward/reverse convection operators that bypass CFL limits and enable auto-differentiation for gradient-based joint thermal reconstructions.
用张量化傅里叶神经算子替代PDE求解器，突破CFL限制并利用自动微分实现地幔对流联合反演。
2-D Cartesian basally heated isoviscous thermal convection sequences generated by the FEM code Underworld at Ra = 10^5, 10^6, and 10^7 on up to 257x257 grids, using ~10^4.5 training pairs.
使用Underworld生成Ra=10^5至10^7的二维笛卡尔等黏度热对流合成数据，含约10^4.5对训练样本。

Physics-informed Stokes operator achieves 3-5% L2 velocity error; forward convection operators achieve <0.1% velocity error, 0.13-5.25% temperature error, and 5,000x-20,000x speedups; joint inversion reconstructs states back to 0.86-1.03 transit times.
Stokes算子误差3-5%；正向对流算子加速5000-20000倍；联合反演可稳健恢复约1个渡越时间前的热状态。
Restricted to 2-D Cartesian isoviscous convection; physics-informed Stokes has 3-5% error unsuitable for geoid calculations; direct reverse operators fail under 5% observational noise.
局限于二维等黏度模型；直接反向算子对噪声敏感；物理驱动Stokes算子难以满足大地水准面精度。

First application of Fourier neural operators to discover long-time-step forward and ill-posed reverse mantle convection mappings and perform auto-differentiation-based joint inverse thermal reconstructions.
首次利用傅里叶神经算子发现长步长正反向地幔对流算子，并结合自动微分实现高效联合热状态重建。

kc: Formulated a purely physics-informed Stokes neural operator (S_phi) trained without labeled data, achieving 3-5% relative L2 velocity error and zero-shot super-resolution.
Developed data-driven forward and reverse convection neural operators that take time steps up to 300x larger than the CFL limit, accelerating forward simulations by 5,000x-20,000x.

Demonstrated that joint inversion of terminal thermal states and surface velocity histories via auto-differentiation overcomes observational noise and recovers mantle states up to one transit time backward.
构建了纯物理驱动的无数据Stokes神经算子，速度预测相对L2误差仅3-5%，并具备零样本超分辨率泛化能力。
开发了时间步长超CFL限制约300倍的数据驱动正反向对流神经算子，将正演模拟加速5000至20000倍。
证明了基于自动微分的终端热状态与地表速度历史联合反演能有效克服观测噪声，稳健恢复1个渡越时间前的地幔结构。
me: Tensorized Fourier Neural Operator (TFNO) architecture for mapping between function spaces on regular grids.
Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) training for the 2-D Stokes system using staggered-grid finite-difference PDE residuals and exponential covariance random fields.
Data-driven operator discovery for forward (+n*dt) and ill-posed reverse (-n*dt) thermal convection, plus a Rayleigh-number-conditioned operator.
Gradient-based iterative thermal state inversion using Adam and automatic differentiation through recursive neural operator rollouts.
采用张量化傅里叶神经算子（TFNO）架构学习规则网格函数空间之间的映射。
基于交错网格有限差分PDE残差和指数协方差随机场，进行二维Stokes系统的物理信息神经算子（PINO）无数据训练。
开展数据驱动的正向与不适定反向热对流算子发现，并训练以瑞利数为条件的连续参数神经算子。
利用自动微分穿透递归神经算子计算梯度，结合Adam算法进行地幔初始热状态的迭代反演。
de: 2-D Cartesian isoviscous basally heated thermal convection simulations generated using the finite-element solver Underworld at Ra = 10^5, 10^6, and 10^7 on meshes up to 257 x 257.
Benchmark validation against Blankenbach et al. (1989) steady-state convection metrics and boundary layer theory Nu-Ra scaling over Ra in [10^4, 10^8].

Synthetic thermal state reconstruction experiments comparing four methods (reverse buoyancy, reverse convection operator, terminal-state inversion, and joint inversion) under clean and 5% pink-noise conditions.
利用有限元程序Underworld生成二维笛卡尔坐标下底部加热等黏度地幔对流数据（Ra = 10^5、10^6、10^7，最高网格分辨率257×257）。
与Blankenbach等（1989）稳态对流基准测试对比，并在Ra ∈ [10^4, 10^8]范围内测试Nu-Ra边界层标度律。
开展无噪声及添加5%粉红噪声条件下的合成数据重建实验，对比反向浮力、反向对流算子、仅终端状态反演和联合反演四种方法。
li: Restricted to 2-D Cartesian geometry with constant (isoviscous) rheology and periodic lateral boundaries, lacking spherical geometry and nonlinear plate-like rheology.
The purely physics-informed Stokes operator has higher velocity error (3-5%) and spurious high-wavenumber energy compared to data-driven operators (<0.1%).

The direct reverse convection neural operator is highly unstable when observations contain 5% pink noise, and the variable-Ra operator fails to extrapolate across the critical Rayleigh number bifurcation.
局限于二维笛卡尔几何、常数黏度（等黏度）及周期性侧边界，尚未包含球壳几何与非线性板块流变学。
纯物理驱动Stokes算子的速度误差（3-5%）和高波数伪影高于数据驱动算子（<0.1%）。
直接反向对流算子在5%粉红噪声下极不稳定，且变瑞利数算子无法跨临界瑞利数分岔点进行零样本外推。

tm.why: The paper develops forward and inverse modeling frameworks for reconstructing past thermal states of mantle convection.
The study uses Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) as surrogate models to solve Stokes flow and time-dependent mantle convection.
It formulates the ill-posed thermal state reconstruction as an optimization problem solved via automatic differentiation through neural operators.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 25-page GJI paper PDF, including main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

sum: This theoretical and computational study investigates the scaling relationships between the breakdown zone (cohesive zone) and heterogeneous frictional properties during dynamic earthquake ruptures. By modeling ruptures propagating along faults with spatially variable frictional parameters, the authors analyze how heterogeneity influences the spatial and temporal evolution of the breakdown zone. The work provides critical insights into earthquake source physics, showing how small-scale frictional variations map onto macroscopic rupture parameters, which has implications for understanding earthquake nucleation, propagation, and arrest.
本研究通过理论与数值模拟，探讨了动力学地震破裂过程中破裂区（内聚力区）与非均匀摩擦性质之间的比例关系。通过模拟破裂在具有空间可变摩擦参数的断层上的传播，作者分析了非均匀性如何影响破裂区的时空演化。该工作为地震源物理学提供了关键见解，展示了微观摩擦变化如何映射到宏观破裂参数上，对理解地震成核、传播和停……

t: Numerical modeling of dynamic earthquake ruptures on faults with heterogeneous frictional properties to analyze cohesive zone scaling.
在具有非均匀摩擦性质的断层上进行动力学地震破裂数值模拟，以分析内聚区比例关系。
Synthetic datasets generated from dynamic rupture simulations with spatially variable frictional parameters.
通过具有空间可变摩擦参数的动力学破裂模拟生成的合成数据集。
Establishes a scaling relationship showing how heterogeneous frictional barriers control the size and evolution of the rupture breakdown zone.
建立了比例关系，展示了非均匀摩擦障壁如何控制破裂区的尺寸和演化。
Relies on idealized numerical friction laws and simplified fault geometries rather than direct observational data.
依赖于理想化的数值摩擦定律和简化的断层几何结构，而非直接的观测数据。
Quantifies the direct scaling between localized frictional heterogeneity and the macroscopic breakdown zone in dynamic ruptures.
定量化了动力学破裂中局部摩擦非均匀性与宏观破裂区之间的直接比例关系。

kc: Establishes scaling relationships between the rupture breakdown zone and heterogeneous fault frictional properties.
Demonstrates how spatial variations in friction influence the dynamic propagation and stability of earthquake ruptures.
建立了破裂区与非均匀断层摩擦性质之间的比例关系。
展示了摩擦的空间变化如何影响地震破裂的动力学传播和稳定性。

Theoretical scaling analysis of the cohesive/breakdown zone during propagation.

It focuses on frictional properties and breakdown zone scaling, which are core concepts in fault mechanics.

sum: This study presents fluid dynamically consistent numerical simulations of the plume-lithosphere system to investigate the origin of precursory carbonatite eruptions associated with Large Igneous Provinces (LIPs). By tracking millions of passive tracers, the authors model the 3-D trajectories and ascent velocities of carbonate melts originating from the plume rather than the lithosphere. For carbonatite melts produced at 200 km depth, the precursory carbon flux can reach up to 6e11 mol/yr for ~2 Myr before anhydrous silicate melting begins. This mechanism explains precursory carbonatite complexes in the Paraná and Deccan provinces, and suggests that early plume-derived carbon emissions could have driven environmental perturbations and mass extinctions, such as during the end-Triassic CAMP event.
本研究通过地幔柱-岩石圈系统的流体力学数值模拟，探讨了大火成岩省（LIP）伴随的早期碳酸岩喷发成因。研究表明地幔柱（而非岩石圈）是碳的来源。通过追踪数百万个被动示踪剂的流体动力学三维轨迹，计算出碳酸盐熔体的上升速度。在200千米深处产生的碳酸岩熔体，在无水硅酸盐熔融开始前约2百万年内，其碳通量可达每……

t: Fluid dynamically consistent 3-D numerical simulations of the plume-lithosphere system combined with passive tracer advection to track carbonate melt trajectories and calculate ascent velocities.
地幔柱-岩石圈系统的三维流体力学数值模拟，结合数百万被动示踪剂追踪熔体轨迹。
Synthetic modeling exploring plume carbon concentrations from 196 to 440 ppm and deep melting depths (up to 200 km) of carbonate-bearing peridotite.
探索地幔柱源碳浓度（196-440 ppm）及含碳酸盐橄榄岩深部熔融的合成模拟。
Precursory carbon flux can reach 6e11 mol/yr for ~2 Myr prior to silicate melting, yielding up to 2e16 kg of carbon to explain pre-LIP carbonatites.
主喷发前2百万年内早期碳通量可达每年6e11摩尔，释放总碳量达2e16千克。
The model's applicability depends heavily on assumed mantle redox states and simplified sub-lithospheric melt transport physics.
模型高度依赖于所假设的地幔氧化还原状态及简化的亚岩石圈熔体运移物理机制。
Demonstrates that early carbonatites originate directly from the ascending plume rather than lithospheric heating, explaining the short precursory timescales.
提出早期碳酸岩直接源自上升的地幔柱而非岩石圈加热，解释了极短的喷发前置时间。

kc: Demonstrated that the mantle plume, rather than a metasomatized lithosphere, is the primary source of precursory carbonatite magmas.
Quantified the precursory carbon flux (up to 6e11 mol/yr) and total mass (up to 2e16 kg) released during the ~2 Myr preceding main-phase LIP eruptions.
Linked early plume-derived carbon emissions to environmental perturbations and mass extinctions, such as the end-Triassic extinction associated with CAMP.
证明了地幔柱（而非交代岩石圈）是早期碳酸岩岩浆的主要来源。
定量估算了在大火成岩省主喷发前约2百万年内释放的早期碳通量（高达每年6e11摩尔）和总碳质量（高达2e16千克）。
将早期地幔柱源碳排放与环境扰动及生物大灭绝（如与CAMP相关的三叠纪末大灭绝）联系起来。
me: Fluid dynamically consistent numerical simulations of the plume-lithosphere system.
Advection of millions of passive tracers to track 3-D trajectories and calculate ascent velocities of carbonate melts.
Thermodynamic modeling of carbonate-bearing peridotite melting depths based on mantle redox states.
地幔柱-岩石圈系统的流体力学一致性数值模拟。

基于地幔氧化还原状态，对含碳酸盐橄榄岩熔融深度的热力学模拟。

Tested various melting depths of carbonate-bearing peridotite (e.g., 200 km depth).
Applied model results to case studies of the Paraná province, Deccan Traps, and Central Atlantic Magmatic Province (CAMP).
探索了地幔柱源中一系列碳浓度（196至440 ppm）。
测试了含碳酸盐橄榄岩的不同熔融深度（例如200千米深度）。
将模型结果应用于巴拉那省、德干地盾和中大西洋岩浆省（CAMP）的案例研究。

Ascent velocities and melt trajectories are subject to uncertainties in the rheological and permeability parameters of the lithosphere.
该模型依赖于关于地幔氧化还原状态及其对熔融深度控制的简化假设。

sum: This study investigates the evolution of the magma plumbing system beneath the Puyehue-Cordón Caulle volcanic complex in the Andean Southern Volcanic Zone. It focuses on how the loading and subsequent post-glacial unloading of the Patagonian ice sheet influenced magma storage, transport, and eruption dynamics. By linking glacial history with magmatic processes, the paper highlights the mechanical feedback between surface cryospheric changes and deep crustal magmatic systems.
本研究探讨了安第斯南部火山带普耶韦-科登·考列火山群下方的岩浆管道系统演化。重点分析了巴塔哥尼亚冰盖的加载及随后的冰消期卸载如何影响岩浆的储存、运移和喷发动力学。通过将冰川历史与岩浆活动过程联系起来，揭示了地表冰冻圈变化与深部地壳岩浆系统之间的力学反馈机制。

t: Analysis of magmatic evolution combined with mechanical modeling of lithospheric stress changes induced by ice sheet loading and unloading.
结合冰盖加载与卸载引起的岩石圈应力变化力学模拟，分析岩浆演化特征。
Geological, geochronological, and petrological data from the Puyehue-Cordón Caulle volcanic complex, integrated with Patagonian ice sheet models.
普耶韦-科登·考列火山群的地质、年代学和岩石学数据，并结合巴塔哥尼亚冰盖模型。
Demonstrates that glacial loading suppressed eruptions and altered storage depths, while post-glacial unloading promoted magma ascent and eruption.
表明冰川加载抑制了喷发并改变了储存深度，而冰消期卸载促进了岩浆上升和喷发。
Potential uncertainties in matching precise timing of magmatic events with rapid glacial retreat phases.

Directly links the structural and temporal evolution of an active Andean magma plumbing system to regional ice sheet mass fluctuations.

深入揭示了地表载荷引起的应力变化如何调制岩浆储存深度和喷发通道。

sum: This study evaluates the feasibility of integrating borehole distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) with surface geophone nodes for shallow subsurface characterization at a complex urban archaeological site. Using active and passive seismic methods, the authors reconstruct P-wave velocity models from first-arrival travel times and S-wave velocity models from Rayleigh wave dispersion curves. Additionally, they demonstrate the potential of interwell ambient noise interferometry using passive DAS data. The results show that integrated DAS and node acquisition provides a flexible, non-invasive, and highly effective approach for small-scale civil engineering and archaeological investigations, especially in logistically challenging urban environments where active sources may be restricted.
本研究评估了在复杂的城市考古遗址中，将井中分布式声波传感（DAS）与地表检波器节点相结合进行浅地表特征表征的可行性。利用主动和被动地震方法，研究人员通过初至波走时重建了P波速度模型，并通过瑞雷面波频散曲线重建了S波速度模型。此外，还展示了利用被动DAS数据进行井间背景噪声干涉测量的潜力。结果表明，集……
