sum: Following the 2015 Mw 7.8 Gorkha earthquake, the EW-trending Yarlung Zangbo suture (YZS) in southern Tibet remained seismically quiet while adjacent rifts experienced heightened seismicity. Combining Sentinel-1 InSAR (2015–2019) and GNSS velocities, the authors derived a 3D post-Gorkha crustal deformation field and inverted fault kinematics using screw dislocation modeling with MCMC sampling. They discovered a transient dextral creep of ~3 mm/yr with a shallow locking depth (<5 km) along the central Sangsang section of the YZS. Pre-Gorkha Envisat (2003–2010) and interseismic GNSS data showed negligible slip, confirming that the motion was triggered by Gorkha coseismic and postseismic Coulomb failure stress increases (peaking at ~0.05 MPa). This represents the first geodetic capture of transient aseismic creep on the YZS, demonstrating that this controversial suture is active and accommodates partial dextral shear strain in southern Tibet.
2015年尼泊尔Mw 7.8地震后，藏南近南北向裂谷地震活动增强，而东西向雅鲁藏布江缝合带（YZS）却保持地震平静。本研究结合Sentinel-1 InSAR（2015–2019）与GNSS数据构建三维形变场，并利用螺旋位错模型和MCMC反演断层运动学特征。结果显示YZS中段桑桑段发生了速率约3 m……

t: Combined ascending/descending Sentinel-1 InSAR (processed via GMTSAR SBAS) and GNSS velocities to reconstruct a 3D deformation field, then inverted fault slip rate and locking depth using a screw dislocation model with DRAM-MCMC.
结合Sentinel-1升降轨InSAR与GNSS重建三维形变场，利用螺旋位错模型和DRAM-MCMC反演滑移率与闭锁深…
Sentinel-1 IW TOPS SAR data (ascending T12, descending T121) from May 2015 to end of 2019, Envisat descending T33 data (2003–2010), and regional GNSS velocity datasets.
2015–2019年Sentinel-1升降轨SAR数据、2003–2010年Envisat降轨数据及区域GNSS速度场…

The central YZS experienced transient aseismic dextral creep at ~3 mm/yr with a shallow locking depth (<5 km, approaching zero at profile D), driven by a ~0.05 MPa Coulomb stress increase from the Gorkha earthquake.
YZS中段发生约3 mm/yr的无震右旋蠕滑，闭锁深度小于5 km，受尼泊尔地震约0.05 MPa库仑应力增量驱动。
Insufficient ascending Envisat data prevented reconstructing a pre-Gorkha 3D deformation field, and a SAR observation gap exists between 2010 and 2014.
缺乏Envisat升轨数据无法重建震前三维形变场，且2010–2014年存在SAR数据空白。
First geodetic capture of transient aseismic creep on the Yarlung Zangbo suture, proving the suture is active and accommodates partial dextral shear strain in southern Tibet.
首次通过大地测量捕捉到雅鲁藏布江缝合带的瞬态无震蠕滑，证实其活动性及剪切应变调节作用。

kc: Derived a 1-km-resolution 3D post-Gorkha deformation field across the central Yarlung Zangbo suture (YZS) by combining Sentinel-1 InSAR and GNSS data.
Identified transient aseismic dextral creep at ~3 mm/yr with shallow locking depth (<5 km) along the Sangsang section of the YZS.
Demonstrated via pre-Gorkha Envisat data and Coulomb stress modeling (~0.05 MPa peak increase) that the creep was triggered by the 2015 Gorkha earthquake.
Provided geodetic evidence that the YZS is active and plays a secondary role in accommodating dextral shear strain in southern Tibet.
结合Sentinel-1 InSAR与GNSS数据，获取了雅鲁藏布江缝合带（YZS）中段1 km分辨率的震后三维地壳形变场。
发现YZS桑桑段存在速率约3 mm/yr、闭锁深度小于5 km的瞬态无震右旋蠕滑。
利用震前Envisat数据和库仑应力建模（峰值增加~0.05 MPa），证实该蠕滑由2015年尼泊尔地震触发。
提供了YZS活动的空间大地测量证据，表明其在调节藏南右旋剪切应变中发挥次要作用。
me: SBAS time-series InSAR analysis using GMTSAR with GACOS atmospheric corrections and SNAPHU phase unwrapping.
3D deformation field reconstruction by combining ascending/descending InSAR LOS velocities with interpolated GNSS north-south constraints.
Screw dislocation modeling inverted via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) with the Delayed Rejection Adaptive Metropolis (DRAM) algorithm.
Coulomb failure stress change (ΔCFS) modeling using PSOKINV 5.0 based on coseismic and afterslip models.
使用GMTSAR软件进行基于相干性的SBAS时序InSAR分析，结合GACOS大气校正和SNAPHU相位解缠。
结合升降轨InSAR视线向速度与插值的GNSS南北向速度约束，重建三维地壳形变场。
基于螺旋位错理论，采用融合延迟拒绝自适应Metropolis（DRAM）算法的MCMC方法反演走滑速率和闭锁深度。
利用PSOKINV 5.0软件，基于同震和震后余滑模型计算YZS上的库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS）。
de: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR data (ascending track T12 and descending track T121) from May 2015 to the end of 2019.
Envisat descending track 33 SAR data (~30 acquisitions, frames 2961–3033) from 2003 to 2010 for pre-Gorkha baseline comparison.
Published interseismic and postseismic GNSS velocity datasets in southern Tibet.
Published coseismic and afterslip models of the 2015 Mw 7.8 Gorkha earthquake sequence.
2015年5月至2019年底的Sentinel-1 C波段SAR数据（升轨T12和降轨T121）。
2003年至2010年的Envisat降轨33轨道SAR数据（约30景，图幅2961–3033），用于震前基线对比。
藏南地区已发表的震间和震后GNSS速度场数据集。
2015年Mw 7.8尼泊尔地震序列的已发表同震和震后余滑模型。
li: A data gap exists between the decommissioning of Envisat in 2010 and the launch of Sentinel-1 in 2014.
Pre-Gorkha 3D deformation field could not be reconstructed due to insufficient ascending Envisat SAR data.
The underlying physical mechanism governing whether the YZS creep is rate-strengthening friction or slow slip on weakly locked patches remains uncertain.
2010年Envisat退役与2014年Sentinel-1发射之间存在SAR数据空白期。
由于缺乏足够的Envisat升轨数据，无法重建尼泊尔地震前的三维形变场。
控制YZS无震蠕滑的物理机制（速度强化摩擦响应或弱闭锁凹凸体慢滑移）仍存在不确定性。

tm.why: The paper investigates transient aseismic creep (~3 mm/yr) on the Yarlung Zangbo suture triggered by stress loading from the 2015 Gorkha earthquake.
The study explores how the Yarlung Zangbo suture accommodates partial elastic dextral shear strain in southern Tibet within the India-Asia collision zone.
The authors apply a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method with the DRAM algorithm to invert for fault slip rate and locking depth.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF examined, including main text, equations, and all three main figures.

sum: Field event detectors for induced seismicity and DAS monitoring must tolerate both missing sensor channels and low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), two failure modes often conflated and credited to complex architectures. This study constructs a unified 8-channel, 256-sample binary event-detection benchmark spanning Hi-net seismic waveforms, Utah FORGE 2024 borehole DAS, and MAFAULDA industrial vibrations (28,462 windows total). It compares a bio-inspired redundant architecture (CEPHALON) against standard baselines (1D CNN, TCN, TinyTransformer) trained with an identical per-sample sensor-dropout recipe (p = 0.2). While all models achieve ~0.999 AUC on clean data and simple baselines match CEPHALON under progressive sensor loss, CEPHALON degrades far more gracefully under additive noise (0.939 AUC at -2.5 dB vs. 0.532–0.572 for CNN/TCN). Same-architecture ablations reveal that removing sensor-dropout collapses low-SNR performance (-0.30 AUC at -5 dB), whereas disabling internal parallel redundancy has a minor effect (-0.05 AUC).
针对诱发地震与DAS监测中的通道缺失和低信噪比（SNR）问题，本文构建了涵盖Hi-net地震波形、Utah FORGE钻孔DAS及MAFAULDA工业振动的8通道×256采样点统一事件检测基准（共28,462个窗口）。研究对比了冗余架构CEPHALON与采用相同传感器随机丢弃（p=0.2）训练的1D……

t: Evaluates a redundant multi-domain detector (CEPHALON: C-MoE + adaptive GCN trunk, 8 parallel arms, 3 heads, DANN branch) against 1D-CNN, TCN, and Transformer baselines trained with per-sample channel sensor-dropout (p=0.2).
对比冗余多域检测器CEPHALON与采用逐样本传感器丢弃（p=0.2）训练的CNN、TCN和Transformer基线。

A unified 28,462-window binary detection benchmark at (C=8, T=256) combining NIED Hi-net seismic (8,332 windows), Utah FORGE 2024 well 16B borehole DAS (994 windows), and MAFAULDA industrial vibration (19,136 windows).
构建包含Hi-net地震、Utah FORGE钻孔DAS及工业振动的28,462个窗口（C=8, T=256）统一基准。

Under sensor loss, simple baselines match CEPHALON. Under low SNR (-2.5 dB), CEPHALON achieves 0.939 AUC vs 0.532–0.572 for CNN/TCN. Removing sensor-dropout drops -5 dB AUC from 0.899 to 0.603; disabling redundancy drops it to 0.853.
-2.5 dB下CEPHALON的AUC达0.939（CNN/TCN仅0.532–0.572）；移除丢弃训练使-5 dB…
Clean-data detection is trivially easy, the DAS test set is small (150 windows), and low-SNR tests use synthetic white/pink noise rather than recorded field DAS noise.
干净数据任务过易，DAS测试集较小（150窗口），且低SNR测试采用合成噪声而非实测DAS噪声。

Causally disentangles sensor-loss fault tolerance from low-SNR robustness on real multi-domain data, proving via same-architecture ablations that training recipe (sensor-dropout), not parallel redundancy, drives both.
在真实多域数据上因果解耦了通道缺失容错性与低信噪比鲁棒性，证明训练策略而非架构冗余是核心驱动力。

kc: Assembled a unified, leak-free, multi-domain benchmark (28,462 windows) across Hi-net seismic, Utah FORGE 2024 borehole DAS, and MAFAULDA industrial vibration data at a common (C=8, T=256) representation.
Demonstrated that sensor-loss robustness is entirely driven by the per-sample sensor-dropout training recipe and is equally achieved by lightweight CNN and TCN baselines.

Proved via same-architecture ablations that low-SNR robustness is primarily caused by sensor-dropout training interacting with an expressive trunk (-0.30 AUC drop when removed at -5 dB) rather than parallel architectural redundancy (-0.05 AUC drop).
Showed that zero-shot cross-domain transfer fails across physically distinct domains (AUC 0.241 on DAS), whereas few-shot co-training rapidly adapts with just 5 labeled examples per class (AUC 0.93).
构建了涵盖Hi-net地震、Utah FORGE 2024钻孔DAS和MAFAULDA工业振动的统一无泄漏多域基准数据集（共28,462个窗口，统一为C=8, T=256表征）。
证明了传感器缺失鲁棒性完全由逐样本传感器丢弃训练策略驱动，轻量级CNN和TCN基线即可达到同等效果。
通过同架构消融实验证实，低信噪比鲁棒性主要源于传感器丢弃训练与高表达力主干网络的结合（移除训练策略在-5 dB下AUC下降0.30），而非并行架构冗余（移除冗余仅下降0.05）。
揭示了跨物理域的零样本迁移完全失效（DAS上AUC仅0.241），但少样本协同训练仅需每类5个标注样本即可快速适应（AUC达0.93）。
me: CEPHALON v2 architecture combining a shared trunk (sparsely gated channel mixture-of-experts and adaptive-topology graph convolutional network), 8 parallel OAN arms, 3 redundant classification heads, and a gradient-reversal domain-adversarial branch.
Per-sample sensor-dropout training augmentation that independently zeros each input channel with probability p = 0.2 while guaranteeing at least one surviving channel.

Two-axis stress testing across progressive sensor loss (0 to 7 dropped channels), internal component loss, and additive white/pink noise (-15 to +20 dB SNR) against identically trained PlainCNN1D, TCN, and TinyTransformer baselines.
Same-architecture mechanism ablations comparing full CEPHALON against inference-time redundancy-off (1 arm, 1 heart) and training-time recipe-off (no sensor-dropout) variants.
设计CEPHALON v2架构，结合共享主干（稀疏门控通道混合专家C-MoE与自适应拓扑图卷积网络）、8个并行OAN分支、3个冗余分类头以及梯度反转域对抗分支。
采用逐样本传感器丢弃（sensor-dropout）训练增强，以p=0.2的概率独立置零各输入通道，同时确保至少保留一个有效通道。
在渐进式传感器缺失（丢弃0至7个通道）、内部组件缺失以及加性白噪声/粉红噪声（-15至+20 dB SNR）下进行双轴压力测试，并与相同策略训练的PlainCNN1D、TCN和TinyTransformer基线对比。
开展同架构机制消融实验，对比完整CEPHALON与推理阶段关闭冗余（仅1个分支、1个分类头）及训练阶段移除传感器丢弃策略的变体。
de: Seismic domain: 8,332 class-balanced waveform windows from the NIED Hi-net network in Japan.

Borehole DAS domain: 994 windows (497 microseismic events, Mw 0.27–1.35, plus paired quiet noise windows) from Utah FORGE April 2024 stimulation in monitoring well 16B, depth-stacked into 8 zones over channels 1116–1493, bandpass filtered 5–120 Hz, and decimated to 500 Hz.
Industrial domain: 19,136 vibration windows from the MAFAULDA rotating-machinery fault database used as a statistically distant third pole.
Leave-one-domain-out (LODO) zero-shot and few-shot (K = 5 to 100 labeled examples per class) transfer learning experiments to the held-out DAS domain.
地震域数据：来自日本NIED Hi-net台网的8,332个类别平衡波形窗口。
钻孔DAS域数据：来自Utah FORGE 2024年4月16B监测井压裂期间的994个窗口（497个微震事件，Mw 0.27–1.35，及配对背景噪声窗口），对1116–1493通道按深度叠加为8个区域，经5–120 Hz带通滤波并降采样至500 Hz。
工业域数据：来自MAFAULDA旋转机械故障数据库的19,136个振动窗口，作为统计特性迥异的第三极数据。
留一域法（LODO）零样本迁移实验与少样本（每类K=5至100个标注样本）向保留DAS域迁移的实验。
li: The binary event detection task is intrinsically easy on clean data (all models achieve ~0.99–1.00 AUC), confining all performance contrasts to extreme sensor-loss and low-SNR tails.
The borehole DAS dataset is relatively small (994 total windows, 150 test windows), causing higher variance in its low-SNR evaluation curves.
Low-SNR stress tests rely on synthetic additive white and pink (1/f) noise rather than real recorded non-stationary field DAS noise.
The most extreme sensor-loss test condition (7 of 8 channels dropped) is near-degenerate for all architectures.
干净数据上的二分类事件检测任务过于简单（所有模型AUC均达0.99–1.00），使得所有性能差异仅体现在极端的传感器缺失和低信噪比尾部区间。
钻孔DAS数据集规模较小（共994个窗口，测试集仅150个窗口），导致其低信噪比评估曲线方差较大。
低信噪比压力测试依赖合成的加性白噪声和粉红（1/f）噪声，而非真实记录的非平稳野外DAS背景噪声。
最极端的传感器缺失条件（8个通道丢弃7个）对所有模型而言均接近退化状态。

tm.why: The paper evaluates deep-learning event detectors (CEPHALON, CNN, TCN, Transformer) and training augmentation recipes on seismic and borehole DAS datasets.
A core benchmark component is the Utah FORGE 2024 borehole DAS dataset from monitoring well 16B, where low-SNR robustness shows the largest margin.
The study focuses on binary seismic and microseismic event detection under sensor dropout and low signal-to-noise conditions relevant to induced-seismicity monitoring.

ev.notes: Full 19-page manuscript PDF including all 7 main figures, 2 appendix figures, and 7 tables was analyzed directly.

sum: Fluid injection in fractured reservoirs requires accurate upscaling of small-scale fractures into equivalent continuum hydro-mechanical properties. This paper introduces an analytical framework to quantify the equivalent Biot effective stress coefficient tensor of fractured rock masses based on an equivalent volumetric strain method, combining intact porous matrix properties and fracture network geometry and stiffness. Using synthetic analytical calculations for rocks with parallel fracture sets, the author demonstrates that the equivalent Biot tensor is strongly anisotropic, with larger values perpendicular to fractures than parallel to them. Under fluid pressurization, this anisotropy modifies both effective normal and shear stresses, generating deviatoric stress variations and rotating the effective stress tensor. Consequently, for fractures oriented at 20°–40° to the maximum principal stress, failure potential (Coulomb Failure Stress) increases significantly and shifts the critical failure orientation from 30° to ~20°, promoting earlier fault reactivation at lower overpressures than predicted by isotropic Biot models.
本研究提出了一种基于等效体积应变法的理论框架，结合完整多孔基质与裂隙网络属性，量化裂隙岩体的等效各向异性Biot有效应力系数张量。通过对含平行裂隙组的理想储层进行解析计算，研究表明等效Biot张量具有显著各向异性，垂直于裂隙方向的值大于平行方向。在注水加压下，这种各向异性引起偏应力变化并导致有效应力……

t: An equivalent strain method derives each component of the orthotropic Biot coefficient tensor by equating uniaxial stress-induced volumetric deformations of the intact matrix and fractures under dry and pressurized conditions.
采用等效应变法，通过平衡干燥和加压下基质与裂隙的单轴应力体积变形推导正交各向异性Biot张量。

Analytical calculations use an idealized deep fractured reservoir setting with parallel fractures (volumetric intensity 100 m^-1, stiffness 10^3 GPa/m) embedded in a stiff low-porosity matrix (E = 10 GPa, α_r = 0.4).
采用理想化深部裂隙储层参数（裂隙密度100 m^-1，刚度10^3 GPa/m，基质杨氏模量10 GPa）进行解析计算。

The Biot coefficient is larger perpendicular to fractures than parallel to them; under pressurization, this anisotropy rotates the effective stress tensor and shifts the critical failure orientation from 30° to ~20°.
垂直裂隙方向的Biot系数大于平行方向；加压时引起有效应力旋转，使最危险破裂角从30°移至约20°。
The theoretical derivation assumes a system free to deform without mechanical constraints and neglects stress fluctuations from mechanical interactions between fractures and intact rock.
假设系统无边界约束自由变形，且忽略裂隙间及裂隙与基质间的力学相互作用。

Extends prior scalar Biot coefficient formulations for fractured rocks to an orthotropic tensor, revealing how small-scale fracture anisotropy drives deviatoric stress changes and premature fault failure.
将裂隙岩体标量Biot模型扩展为张量形式，揭示裂隙各向异性诱发偏应力变化与断层提前失稳的机制。

kc: Derives a closed-form analytical expression for the equivalent orthotropic Biot coefficient tensor of fractured rocks based on volumetric deformation.
Demonstrates that dominant fracture sets yield a larger Biot coefficient perpendicular to fractures than parallel to them, sensitive to fracture density and stiffness.

Shows that Biot anisotropy induces deviatoric effective stress changes and stress tensor rotation during pressurization, shifting critical failure orientations from ~30° to ~20° and lowering critical overpressure.
基于体积变形推导了裂隙岩石等效正交各向异性Biot系数张量的解析表达式。
证明优势裂隙组导致垂直于裂隙方向的Biot系数大于平行方向，且受裂隙密度和法向刚度控制。
揭示Biot各向异性在加压时引起有效偏应力变化和应力张量旋转，将临界破裂方向从约30°移至约20°并降低临界超压。
me: Equivalent strain method equating volumetric deformation of the fractured rock mass under uniaxial stress in pressurized and dry conditions.
Linear elastic superposition of intact isotropic porous matrix deformation and normal closure of planar fractures.
2D Mohr-Coulomb and Coulomb Failure Stress (CFS) stability analysis under hydrostatic and pressurized states.
等效应变法：将加压与干燥条件下单轴应力引起的裂隙岩体体积变形进行等效。
线性弹性叠加法：叠加完整各向同性多孔基质变形与平面裂隙的法向闭合变形。
二维莫尔-库仑与库仑破裂应力（CFS）分析：评估静水压力与注水加压状态下的断层稳定性。
de: Idealized analytical parameterization representing a deep fractured crystalline reservoir (intact rock E = 10 GPa, ν = 0.3, α_r = 0.4; fracture intensity p32 = 100 m^-1, normal stiffness κ_N = 10^3 GPa/m).
Sensitivity analyses varying fracture orientation (0° to 90°), fracture stiffness, matrix stiffness, and friction angle.
代表深部裂隙结晶岩储层的理想化解析参数设置（完整岩石 E = 10 GPa，ν = 0.3，α_r = 0.4；裂隙密度 p32 = 100 m^-1，法向刚度 κ_N = 10^3 GPa/m）。
改变裂隙倾角（0°至90°）、裂隙刚度、基质刚度和摩擦角的参数敏感性分析。
li: Neglects mechanical interactions and stress fluctuations between fractures and between intact rock and fractures.
Assumes homogeneous total stress variations, free deformation without mechanical boundary constraints, and linear fracture closure for small stress changes.
Disregards loading-unloading hysteresis of fracture stiffness and shear dilation effects on volumetric deformation.
忽略了裂隙之间以及完整岩石与裂隙之间的力学相互作用和应力波动。
假设总应力变化在空间上均匀、系统无机械边界约束自由变形，且小应力变化下裂隙闭合呈线性。
忽略了加卸载过程中裂隙刚度的滞回效应以及剪切剪胀对体积变形的影响。

tm.why: The paper develops a theoretical framework for the equivalent Biot coefficient tensor of fractured rocks to assess failure potential, fault reactivation, and induced seismicity during fluid injection in subsurface reservoirs.
The study analyzes hydro-mechanical coupling, effective stress tensor rotation, deviatoric stress changes, and Coulomb Failure Stress variations on pre-existing fracture and fault planes.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including equations, theoretical derivations, and all three main figures.

sum: This paper presents a self-consistent analytical model for mobilizing trapped non-wetting oil droplets in narrow capillary tubes using non-resonant, second-order acoustic streaming (acoustic wind) assisted by static pressure gradients. By expanding the hydrodynamic equations to second order and time-averaging over an acoustic period, the author derives the bulk acoustic force density generated by attenuated longitudinal sound waves. Incorporating both oscillatory Stokes boundary-layer wall friction and bulk core thermo-viscous dissipation reveals a non-monotonic U-shaped activation threshold across frequency. The required source pressure amplitude is minimized when the spatial absorption coefficient equals half the inverse transmission distance to the droplet (alpha = 1/(2x0)). Evaluated for a representative sandstone reservoir at x0 = 0.02 m, tuning the transducer from a 20 kHz commercial baseline (36.24 MPa) to the 44.7 kHz optimum lowers the unpinning threshold to 34.97 MPa and enhances steady Poiseuille-constrained drift velocity.
本文建立了非共振二阶声流（声风）结合静态压力梯度解卡微细毛细管中受困非润湿油滴的解析模型。通过将流体动力学方程展开至二阶并进行时间平均，推导了衰减纵波产生的体积声辐射力密度及稳态运移速度。结合管壁Stokes边界层粘滞损耗与流体核心热粘滞耗散，发现临界声源压力阈值随频率呈U型非单调变化，并在空间吸收……

t: Perturbation expansion of hydrodynamic equations up to second order with time-averaging over an acoustic period to isolate steady acoustic streaming force density, incorporating boundary-layer and bulk thermo-viscous attenuation.
将流体动力学方程微扰展开至二阶并进行周期时间平均，结合边界层与体积热粘滞衰减推导稳态声流力密度。

Analytical model parameterized for a representative sandstone reservoir containing a 50-micrometer oil droplet in a 10-micrometer radius throat, 0.02 m from a 20 kHz acoustic source under a 4500 Pa static drive.
采用典型砂岩储层参数建模：孔喉半径10微米，油滴长50微米，声源距离0.02米，基准频率20 kHz，静压差4500 P…

Optimal unpinning occurs when alpha(omega_opt) = 1/(2x0). For the sandstone model, shifting from 20 kHz to the 44.7 kHz optimum reduces the critical source amplitude from 36.24 MPa to 34.97 MPa, driving droplet drift at ~3.65e-5 m/s.
最优解卡条件为α=1/(2x0)；频率从20 kHz调至最优44.7 kHz时，临界声压从36.24 MPa降至34.9…
Assumes an inviscid hyperbolic first-order core fluid without parabolic damping, rigid non-compliant capillary tube walls, and strict no-slip wall boundary conditions.
一阶方程忽略了流体核心粘滞扩散阻尼，假设毛细管壁完全刚性且采用严格无滑移边界条件。
Demonstrates non-resonant droplet unpinning via bulk second-order acoustic wind rather than capillary resonance or wall peristalsis, identifying the exact spatial attenuation optimum alpha = 1/(2x0).
利用非共振体积声风取代毛细管共振或管壁蠕动来解卡液滴，并发现α=1/(2x0)的自然数学最优条件。

kc: Derived an analytical model for unpinning trapped capillary droplets via non-resonant second-order bulk acoustic streaming coupled with static pressure drives.
Established an exact mathematical optimization condition (alpha = 1/(2x0)) that minimizes the acoustic source amplitude required for droplet mobilization.
Formulated the steady-state droplet drift velocity balanced against Poiseuille-like viscous wall drag and validated the framework using sandstone reservoir parameters.
建立了非共振二阶体积声流结合静态压力梯度解卡毛细管受困液滴的解析模型。
推导出使液滴解卡所需声源振幅最小化的精确数学最优条件（α = 1/(2x0)）。
给出了与Poiseuille型管壁粘滞阻力平衡的稳态液滴漂移速度公式，并利用典型砂岩储层参数进行了数值验证。
me: Second-order perturbation expansion and time-averaging of 1D compressible hydrodynamic equations in a narrow capillary tube (a/L << 1).
Frequency-domain optimization combining Kirchhoff-Stokes boundary layer wall attenuation and bulk thermo-viscous sound absorption.
窄毛细管（a/L << 1）中一维可压缩流体动力学方程的二阶微扰展开与时间平均。
结合Kirchhoff-Stokes边界层管壁衰减与体积热粘滞声吸收的频域优化分析。
de: Analytical evaluation and numerical parameterization using representative sandstone reservoir and fluid properties (10 micrometer pore radius, 2 cm source distance, 20 kHz baseline frequency).
采用代表性砂岩储层及流体物性参数（10微米孔喉半径、2厘米声源距离、20 kHz基准频率）进行解析评估与数值计算。
li: Neglects bulk shear and volume viscosities in the first-order hyperbolic wave equations, omitting continuous internal parabolic wave damping.
Assumes rigid capillary walls without elastic radial compliance or cross-sectional breathing losses.
Applies a strict no-slip boundary condition at the tube wall rather than allowing microscopic boundary slip.
一阶双曲波方程忽略了流体核心的剪切和体积粘度，未包含连续的内部抛物线型扩散阻尼。
假设毛细管壁完全刚性，未考虑管壁弹性径向顺应性及截面呼吸效应带来的能量损耗。
在管壁处采用了严格的无滑移边界条件，未引入微观边界滑移速度。

tm.why: The analytical model explicitly relies on balancing acoustic wave attenuation from viscous Stokes boundary layers and bulk thermo-viscous dissipation in pore channels.

ev.notes: Full 6-page arXiv manuscript PDF was read and analyzed, including equations, figures, and parameter tables.

sum: This study investigates potential spatiotemporal links between episodic tremor and slip (ETS) and regular seismicity in northern Cascadia over an 18-year period (2006–2024). The authors apply DBSCAN clustering to PNSN tremor epicenters to define 37 major ETS episodes and merge six cross-border earthquake catalogs into a unified dataset of 12,846 forearc crust and in-slab events. Using Gutenberg-Richter (GR) frequency-magnitude fitting and Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) tests across regional and proximal spatial-temporal windows, they find no statistically significant variations in daily earthquake occurrence rates before, during, after, or between ETS episodes. However, a novel finding is that while background seismicity between/before ETS exhibits a deficit (tapering) of M > 2.5 earthquakes relative to the GR law, M > 2.5 earthquakes become slightly more numerous during and up to 28 days after ETS, matching the standard GR distribution (p < 0.05), despite a low overall rate of 0.8 events per ETS.
本研究分析了2006至2024年间北卡斯卡迪亚幕式震颤与慢滑移（ETS）与常规地震的时空关系。作者利用DBSCAN聚类划分出37次主要ETS事件，并融合6个跨国地震目录获得12,846次弧前地壳和板内地震。通过Gutenberg-Richter（GR）定律拟合和KS检验，研究发现ETS前后及期间的日……

t: The authors cluster tremor epicenters into ETS episodes using DBSCAN, merge six cross-border earthquake catalogs, and apply Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests and Gutenberg-Richter fits to compare daily seismicity rates and magnitude distributions across spatial-temporal windows relative to ETS.
利用DBSCAN聚类震颤定义ETS，融合六个地震目录，通过GR定律拟合和KS检验对比各时空窗口的日地震率与震级分布。

An 18-year dataset (January 2006 to March 2024) in northern Cascadia comprising 37 major ETS tremor episodes (>=1,500 tremor events) from PNSN and a merged, deduplicated catalog of 12,846 earthquakes from six regional and relocated catalogs.
2006至2024年北卡斯卡迪亚37次主要ETS震颤事件，以及融合六个目录去重后的12,846次地震事件。

Daily earthquake occurrence rates show no statistically significant variation with ETS (KS p-values 0.32–0.99). However, earthquake magnitude distributions before ETS are tapered for M > 2.5 and differ significantly from distributions during and after ETS (p = 0.02, 0.03).
日地震率与ETS无显著统计关联（p=0.32–0.99），但ETS前M>2.5震级分布存在衰减，与ETS期间及之后显著不…

Low seismicity rates (~1 earthquake/day proximal to ETS) create a small-numbers problem, where the M >= 2.5 variation reflects only 8–11 earthquakes over 18 years, alongside uncertainties linking tremor to slip.
低地震率（约1次/天）造成小样本问题（18年仅差8-11次M>=2.5地震），且震颤与滑移关系存在不确定性。

First comprehensive 18-year statistical test of cross-border northern Cascadia seismicity and ETS, revealing that ETS temporarily restores tapered M > 2.5 earthquake distributions to follow the Gutenberg-Richter law without increasing daily rates.
首次对北卡斯卡迪亚跨国界18年数据进行统计检验，发现ETS期间M>2.5地震恢复至符合GR定律，但日发生率不变。

kc: Merged six US and Canadian earthquake catalogs (12,846 events) and updated an 18-year tremor episode catalog (37 major ETS events) for northern Cascadia between 2006 and 2024.
Demonstrated via Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests that daily earthquake occurrence rates (both regional and proximal to ETS) show no statistically significant variation associated with ETS.

Discovered a statistically significant shift in earthquake magnitude distributions: M > 2.5 earthquakes are tapered below the Gutenberg-Richter law before/between ETS, but follow the GR law during and shortly after ETS.
Identified specific candidate case studies for future investigation, including a 2019 M1.8 earthquake potentially on the megathrust and a 2013 ETS episode with 13 concurrent M >= 2.5 earthquakes.
整合了美加六个地震目录（12,846次地震），并更新了2006至2024年北卡斯卡迪亚18年的震颤目录（识别出37次主要ETS事件）。
通过KS检验证明，区域及ETS近场的日地震发生率在ETS前后及期间没有统计学上的显著变化。
发现了地震震级分布的显著统计差异：M>2.5地震在ETS前及间期低于GR定律预测，但在ETS期间及随后短期内符合GR定律。
筛选出值得深入研究的典型案例，包括2019年可能发生在主逆冲断层上的M1.8地震和2013年伴随13次M>=2.5地震的ETS事件。
me: Density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (DBSCAN) in the along-strike and time domain to define ETS episodes from tremor epicenters.
Hierarchical merging and deduplication (within 3 s and 15 km) of six regional, OBS, and tomographically relocated earthquake catalogs.
Gutenberg-Richter (GR) law fitting using goodness-of-fit for magnitude of completeness (Mc) and maximum-likelihood estimation for b-values.
Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) statistical testing on daily earthquake occurrence (DEO) rates and magnitude distributions across before, during, after, and inter-ETS windows.
在沿走向-时间域应用DBSCAN密度聚类算法，从震颤震中定义ETS事件。
按优先级合并六个区域、海底地震仪（OBS）及层析成像重定位地震目录，并以3秒和15公里为阈值去重。
利用拟合优度检验估计完备震级（Mc），并用最大似然法估计GR定律的b值。
对ETS前、中、后及间期时空窗口内的日地震发生率（DEO）和震级分布进行双样本KS统计检验。
de: PNSN continuous tectonic tremor catalog (January 2006 to March 2024), clustered into 993 tremor episodes, from which 37 major ETS episodes (>= 1,500 tremor events) were selected.
Combined earthquake catalog of 12,846 events (2006–2024) within 60 km of the northern Cascadia transect and between 10 km depth and 25 km below the subducting plate interface.

Source earthquake catalogs from PNSN, NRCan (NEDB/SHEEF), Morton et al. (2023) OBS detections, Schneider et al. (2023) declustered metadata, and Savard et al. (2018) and Merrill et al. (2020) tomographic relocations.
2006年1月至2024年3月的PNSN连续构造震颤目录，聚类为993个震颤片段，并从中筛选出37个包含>=1,500次震颤的主要ETS事件。
2006至2024年间北卡斯卡迪亚剖面60公里范围内、深度在海平面下10公里至俯冲板片顶面下25公里之间的12,846次综合地震目录。
融合了PNSN、NRCan、Morton等(2023)海底地震仪目录、Schneider等(2023)余震元数据，以及Savard等(2018)和Merrill等(2020)层析成像重定位目录。
li: Low background seismicity rates (~1–2 earthquakes/day) create a small-numbers problem, where the statistically significant M >= 2.5 difference corresponds to only 8–11 earthquakes over 18 years.
Tremor is an imperfect proxy for slow slip at short timescales (hours to days), and tremor counts may not linearly scale with cumulative aseismic slip magnitude.
Aftershocks after 2018 were not removed due to the time limit of the Schneider et al. (2023) metadata catalog, and three geometric bend zones along the transect (< 2% of events) were excluded.
背景地震率极低（约每天1-2次）导致小样本问题，18年间M>=2.5地震的显著统计差异仅对应8至11次地震。
震颤在短时间尺度（数小时至数天）上不能完美代表慢滑移，且震颤数量与累积无震滑移量之间的关系尚不明确。
受限于Schneider等(2023)目录的时间范围，2018年后的余震未被剔除；此外剖面转折处的三个区域（占比<2%）因投影原因被排除。

tm.why: The study investigates the spatiotemporal relationship between episodic tremor and slip (ETS), a type of slow earthquake, and regular seismicity in the northern Cascadia subduction zone.
The paper constructs a merged regional earthquake catalog from six authoritative sources and clusters an 18-year tremor catalog using DBSCAN to analyze seismicity rates and magnitude distributions.

ev.notes: Full 13-page article PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, 10 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This study reconstructs the 200-million-year metallogenic history of the Delamerian convergent margin in mainland Australia, a key segment of the East Gondwana paleo-Pacific margin. By integrating geological, geochemical, geochronological, and sulphur isotope evidence, the authors identify four distinct mineralization events spanning from Neoproterozoic orthomagmatic Ni-Cu to Siluro-Devonian intrusion-related Au. The region's diverse mineral potential, described as a 'general store' of strategic resources, was governed by sequential tectonic switching and specific magmatic priming (high hydration, deep-seated fractionation, and elevated oxidation states). This work demonstrates how supercontinent-accretionary orogen interactions control lithospheric architecture and mineral endowment.
本研究重建了澳大利亚大陆Delamerian汇聚边缘2亿年的成矿历史。通过整合地质、地球化学、年代学和硫同位素证据，作者识别出从新元古代正岩浆型镍铜矿到志留-泥盆纪侵入岩相关金矿的四个不同成矿事件。该地区多样化的矿产潜力（被称为战略资源的“杂货铺”）受控于连续的构造转换和特定的岩浆准备作用（高含水量……

t: Integration of geological, geochemical, geochronological, and sulphur isotope analyses to reconstruct tectonic and metallogenic history.
整合地质、地球化学、年代学和硫同位素分析，重建构造与成矿历史。
Geochemical, geochronological, and isotopic data from the Delamerian convergent margin in mainland Australia.
来自澳大利亚大陆Delamerian汇聚边缘的地质、地球化学、年代学和同位素数据。
Identification of four distinct mineralization events from Neoproterozoic Ni-Cu to Siluro-Devonian intrusion-related Au, driven by tectonic switching.
识别出受构造转换驱动的、从新元古代到志留-泥盆纪的四个独立成矿事件。
The mineral systems are preserved beneath widespread post-mineralization sedimentary cover, complicating direct exploration.
成矿系统保存在广泛的成矿后沉积盖层之下，增加了直接勘探的难度。
Characterizing the Delamerian margin as a diverse 'general store' of strategic minerals rather than a specialized single-metal system.
将Delamerian边缘定性为多样化战略矿产的“杂货铺”，而非单一的特化成矿系统。

kc: Reconstructed a 200-million-year metallogenic and tectonic history of the Delamerian convergent margin in Australia.
Identified four temporally distinct mineralization events ranging from Neoproterozoic Ni-Cu to Siluro-Devonian intrusion-related Au.
Demonstrated how sequential tectonic switching and sediment recycling drive magmatic fertility and diverse mineral endowment.
重建了澳大利亚Delamerian汇聚边缘2亿年的成矿与构造演化历史。
识别出从新元古代镍铜矿到志留-泥盆纪侵入岩相关金矿的四个时间上独立的成矿事件。
论证了连续的构造转换和沉积物循环如何驱动岩浆丰度及多样化的矿产赋存。
me: Integrated geological mapping and structural analysis.
Geochemical and geochronological analysis of magmatic suites.
Sulphur isotope analysis to trace source materials and mineralization processes.
综合地质填图与构造分析。
岩浆岩套的地球化学和年代学分析。
利用硫同位素分析追踪源区物质与成矿作用过程。
de: Geological, geochemical, geochronological, and sulphur isotope datasets from the Delamerian convergent margin, mainland Australia.
来自澳大利亚大陆Delamerian汇聚边缘的地质、地球化学、年代学和硫同位素数据集。
li: The study area is preserved beneath widespread post-mineralization sedimentary cover, which limits direct surface observations.
研究区被广泛的成矿后沉积盖层覆盖，限制了直接的地表观测。

tm.why: The paper investigates the lithospheric architecture, supercontinent assembly, and tectonic evolution of the Delamerian convergent margin.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the metadata and abstract.

sum: This study conducts hydrogen and oxygen isotope and dissolved ion analyses of hot springs, river waters, fumarolic vapor, and hydrothermal waters at Kussharo Caldera, Japan. Strong linear correlations among δ2H, δ18O, Cl−, and SO42− in the Kawayu hot springs indicate mixing between meteoric water and a magmatic end-member. Crucially, the isotopic composition of this magmatic end-member matches simulated values for water derived from the subducting Pacific Plate. This provides direct, compelling evidence that magmatic water originates from the slab, demonstrating that large fluxes of slab-derived water can preserve their original isotopic signatures despite potential rock-water interactions.
本研究对日本屈斜路破火山口及周边的温泉、河水、喷气孔蒸气和热液进行了氢氧同位素及溶解离子分析。川汤温泉中δ2H、δ18O、Cl−和SO42−之间的强线性相关性表明，大气降水与岩浆端元发生了混合。关键是，该岩浆端元的同位素组成与俯冲太平洋板块释放水分的模拟值高度吻合。这提供了岩浆水直接源自俯冲板块的有……

t: Stable isotope (δ2H, δ18O) and dissolved ion (Cl−, SO42−) analyses of spring, river, and hydrothermal fluids.
对泉水、河水和热液流体进行稳定同位素（δ2H、δ18O）和溶解离子（Cl−、SO42−）分析。
Water and vapor samples collected from hot/cold springs, rivers, fumaroles, and hydrothermal systems around Kussharo Caldera, Japan.
采集自日本屈斜路破火山口及周边的冷热温泉、河流、喷气孔和热液系统的水与蒸汽样品。
Strong linear correlations in Kawayu hot springs reveal a magmatic end-member matching simulated Pacific slab-derived water.
川汤温泉的强线性相关性揭示了与模拟的太平洋俯冲板块源水分相吻合的岩浆端元。
Fumarolic vapor and hydrothermal water isotopic compositions were partially modified by vapor-liquid separation processes.
喷气孔蒸气和热液的同位素组成受到汽液分离过程的部分改造。
Directly links hot spring magmatic water to simulated slab-derived fluid compositions, proving preservation of slab isotopic signatures.
直接将温泉岩浆水与模拟的板块源流体成分联系起来，证明了板块同位素特征的保留。

kc: Provided direct isotopic evidence linking magmatic water in hot springs to the subducting Pacific Plate.
Identified mixing trends between meteoric water and a slab-derived magmatic end-member in Kawayu hot springs.
Demonstrated that large fluxes of slab-derived water can preserve their original isotopic signatures against rock-water exchange.
提供了将温泉中的岩浆水与俯冲太平洋板块联系起来的直接同位素证据。
识别了川汤温泉中大气降水与板块源岩浆端元之间的混合趋势。
证明了大规模的板块源水分流在岩浆-岩石相互作用中仍能保留其原始同位素特征。
me: Hydrogen and oxygen stable isotope analysis (δ2H and δ18O) of water and vapor samples.
Dissolved ion concentration analysis (specifically Cl− and SO42−) to trace fluid mixing.
Comparison of geochemical data with simulated isotopic values for slab-derived fluids.
水和蒸汽样品的氢氧稳定同位素分析（δ2H 和 δ18O）。
溶解离子浓度分析（特别是 Cl− 和 SO42−）以追踪流体混合。
将地球化学数据与俯冲板块源流体的同位素模拟值进行对比。
de: Geochemical and isotopic measurements of hot and cold spring waters, river waters, fumarolic vapor, and hydrothermal waters at and around Kussharo Caldera, Japan.
日本屈斜路破火山口及其周边的冷热温泉水、河水、喷气孔蒸气和热液的地球化学与同位素测量数据。
li: Isotopic compositions of fumarolic vapor and some hydrothermal waters were partially affected by vapor-liquid separation, complicating direct end-member identification in those specific samples.
喷气孔蒸气和部分热液的同位素组成受到汽液分离作用的部分干扰，使这些特定样品中的直接端元识别变得复杂。

tm.why: The paper investigates magmatic water and hydrothermal systems beneath the Kussharo Caldera using isotopic and chemical analyses.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and publisher metadata.

sum: Large earthquakes can excite translational oscillations of Earth's solid inner core (Slichter modes), split by rotation into one polar and two equatorial modes. However, their damping mechanisms remain poorly constrained. Using magnetohydrodynamic simulations with the finite-difference pseudospectral code XSHELLS, this study quantifies viscous and Ohmic dissipation in a rotating spherical shell across diffusive, skin-layer, and Alfvén-wave radiation regimes. The authors derive universal scaling laws for quality factors (Q) incorporating spherical confinement and rotational effects, which were overlooked in classic unbounded models. Applied to Earth's core conditions, viscous dissipation is confined to a thin boundary layer and is negligible (decay times >500 years). Ohmic dissipation dominates, yielding quality factors of 2.8×10^4 to 10^5 and decay times of 4–16 years, with equatorial modes damping over twice as fast as the polar mode. Thus, Slichter mode non-detection likely reflects weak excitation rather than rapid core damping.
大地震可激发地球固态内核的平动振荡（Slichter简正模），受自转分裂为一个极向模和两个赤道模。本研究利用有限差分伪谱磁流体代码XSHELLS，模拟了旋转球壳内的粘性和欧姆耗散。作者针对扩散、趋肤层和阿尔芬波辐射三种机制推导了品质因子（Q）的标度律，创新性地引入了球壳几何限制与自转效应。结果表明，……

t: The authors integrate incompressible magnetohydrodynamic equations in a rotating spherical shell using the finite-difference and spherical harmonic pseudospectral code XSHELLS, prescribing inner boundary velocities to model polar and equatorial translational oscillations.
利用有限差分与球谐伪谱代码XSHELLS求解旋转球壳内不可压缩MHD方程，通过内边界速度条件模拟极向与赤道平动模。

Numerical simulations span Ekman numbers down to 10^-9, Lehnert numbers 2×10^-5 to 10^-1, and skin-depth Lundquist numbers 10^-7 to 20, extrapolated to Earth's core conditions assuming a 5 mm Valdivia earthquake displacement.
模拟覆盖低至10^-9的Ekman数及10^-7至20的Lundquist数，并结合5毫米内核位移外推至地球核心参数。

In Earth's core, viscous damping is negligible (Q_v ~ 3.4–7.5×10^6, decay times 570–1100 years), whereas Ohmic dissipation dominates with Q_eta ~ 2.8×10^4–10^5, giving decay times of 16 years (polar) and 4–4.8 years (equatorial).
粘性阻尼可忽略（衰减逾570年）；欧姆耗散占主导（Q为2.8×10^4至10^5），极向模衰减时间为16年，赤道模为4至…

Ohmic decay time estimates are only order-of-magnitude due to large uncertainties in magnetic field intensity and electrical conductivity at the inner core boundary, and solid inner core anelasticity is neglected.
内核边界磁场强度和电导率不确定性大，且未考虑固态内核的非弹性耗散。

First comprehensive magnetohydrodynamic simulation study establishing scaling laws for both polar and equatorial Slichter modes across three magnetic regimes while accounting for spherical shell confinement and rotation.
首次通过MHD模拟建立涵盖极向和赤道Slichter模在三种磁体制下的耗散标度律，并计入球壳限制与自转效应。

kc: Derived universal scaling laws for viscous and Ohmic dissipation and quality factors of Slichter modes across diffusive, skin-layer, and Alfvén-wave regimes.
Quantified the effects of spherical shell confinement and rotation on both polar and prograde/retrograde equatorial translational modes.
Demonstrated that Ohmic dissipation dominates over viscous damping in Earth's outer core, yielding decay times of 4 to 16 years.
推导了涵盖扩散、趋肤层和阿尔芬波机制的Slichter模粘性与欧姆耗散及品质因子的普适标度律。
量化了球壳几何限制和自转效应对极向模以及顺行/逆行赤道平动模的影响。
证明在地球外核中欧姆耗散远大于粘性阻尼，对应衰减时间为4至16年。
me: 3D magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) numerical simulations in a rotating spherical shell using the hybrid finite-difference and spherical harmonic pseudospectral code XSHELLS.

Imposed time-varying velocity boundary conditions at the inner core boundary to mimic polar (l=1, m=0) and equatorial (l=1, m=±1) translational modes, benchmarked against COMSOL arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian finite-element models.
Analytical boundary-layer theory and asymptotic scaling analysis across 7+ orders of magnitude in Ekman and Lundquist numbers.
使用混合有限差分与球谐伪谱代码XSHELLS，在旋转球壳中进行三维磁流体动力学（MHD）数值模拟。
在内核边界施加时变速度边界条件以模拟极向（l=1, m=0）和赤道（l=1, m=±1）平动模，并与COMSOL任意拉格朗日-欧拉有限元模型进行基准对比。
跨越7个数量级以上的Ekman数和Lundquist数，结合解析边界层理论与渐近标度分析推导耗散规律。
de: Extensive parametric survey of MHD simulations spanning Ekman numbers down to 10^-9, Lehnert numbers from 2×10^-5 to 10^-1, and skin-depth Lundquist numbers from 10^-7 to 20.
Extrapolation to Earth's core physical parameters based on PREM density values and 1960 Valdivia M9.6 earthquake inner core displacement estimates (5 mm).
开展大规模MHD参数空间数值实验，涵盖低至10^-9的Ekman数、2×10^-5至10^-1的Lehnert数以及10^-7至20的趋肤深度Lundquist数。
结合PREM地球模型密度参数及1960年智利9.6级大地震的内核位移估计值（5毫米），将标度律外推至地球真实核心条件。
li: Neglects viscous and anelastic deformation inside the solid inner core and mantle, which could provide a faster damping mechanism (~420 days).
Assumes a well-mixed homogeneous outer core, neglecting stable stratification, thermosolutal buoyancy, and full dynamo magnetic field complexities.
Large uncertainties in the radial magnetic field strength and electrical conductivity at the inner core boundary limit decay time estimates to order-of-magnitude accuracy.
忽略了固态内核和地幔内部的粘弹性与非弹性形变，而该机制可能导致更快的衰减（约420天）。
假设外核为均匀混合流体，忽略了稳定分层、热盐浮力效应以及复杂地球发电机磁场结构。
内核边界处磁场强度和电导率存在较大不确定性，使得衰减时间估计仅具数量级参考意义。

tm.why: The paper models magnetohydrodynamic dissipation of inner core translational oscillations (Slichter modes) in the liquid outer core of Earth and other planetary interiors.
The primary focus is quantifying the quality factor (Q) and decay times of Slichter normal modes due to viscous and Ohmic damping mechanisms.
The authors use high-performance spherical harmonic finite-difference pseudospectral magnetohydrodynamic simulations (XSHELLS) on HPC clusters to model core oscillations and Alfvén wave radiation.

sum: Applying the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to seismic interpretation usually requires costly task-specific fine-tuning on labeled datasets, which reduces model generalizability. This study introduces a fully zero-shot adaptation framework that avoids retraining by combining domain-guided input transformations with a two-step hybrid prompting strategy. Specifically, the authors match geological targets with appropriate seismic attributes—instantaneous frequency for salt bodies, coherence for channels, and relative acoustic impedance for stratigraphic facies—alongside colormap transformations (Seismic and RdBu). They also feed SAM's initial pre-sigmoid segmentation logits back into the mask decoder as dense prompts paired with sparse user point prompts. Tested on synthetic (SEAM Phase I) and field 3D seismic volumes (Dutch F-3 Block and New Zealand Waka-3D), the framework boosts F1-scores up to 0.927 for salt, 0.84 for channels, and 0.91 for facies, establishing a scalable, label-free assistant for interactive seismic interpretation.
本研究提出了一种无需微调的分割一切模型（SAM）零样本地震解释框架。该方法包含两个核心组件：一是根据地质目标优选地震属性（盐体采用瞬时频率、河道采用相干属性、岩相采用相对波阻抗）及色标渲染；二是采用两步混合提示策略，将稀疏用户点提示与SAM内部预测logits生成的稠密掩码提示相结合。在SEAM合成……

t: A two-step zero-shot SAM prompting strategy feeds initial pre-sigmoid segmentation logits back as a dense mask prompt alongside sparse user point prompts, combined with target-specific seismic attributes and colormap transformations.

Evaluated on three 3D seismic volumes: SEAM Phase I synthetic Gulf of Mexico dataset (salt bodies), Dutch North Sea F-3 Block (facies), and offshore New Zealand Waka-3D survey (mud- and sand-filled channels).
在三个三维地震数据集上进行评估：SEAM一期合成盐体数据、荷兰北海F-3区块岩相数据，以及新西兰Waka-3D浊积水道数…

Hybrid prompting with domain attributes achieved zero-shot F1-scores of 0.91 for salt (0.927 with RdBu colormap), 0.84 for channels, and 0.91 for facies, substantially outperforming box and point prompts alone.
混合提示结合地震属性在零样本下使盐体、河道和岩相的F1分数分别达到0.91（RdBu色标达0.927）、0.84和0.9…
SAM lacks geological context, operating purely on 2D contrast and texture; performance saturates around 12 prompts and degrades in low-contrast thin beds or noisy regions.

Achieves competitive seismic segmentation in a fully zero-shot setting without retraining SAM by pairing target-matched seismic attributes/colormaps with self-refining hybrid logit-mask prompts.
无需对SAM进行领域微调，仅通过地质目标感知的属性/色标匹配与自反馈混合掩码提示即可实现高精度零样本地震分割。

Establishes a domain-guided alignment of seismic attributes (instantaneous frequency, multi-spectral coherence, relative acoustic impedance) with specific geological targets.

提出了两步混合提示策略，将稀疏用户点提示与SAM初始预测logits生成的稠密掩码提示相结合。

Two-step iterative prompting feeding initial decoder pre-sigmoid logits back as dense mask guidance alongside sparse foreground/background points.
Seismic attribute computation in AASPI (gradient structure tensor dip, energy-ratio multi-spectral coherence, instantaneous frequency, and relative acoustic impedance).
Colormap rendering transformations (Matplotlib 'Seismic' and 'RdBu' colormaps) rescaled to three-channel RGB inputs.
基于视觉Transformer（ViT）架构的SAM模型零样本图像分割。
两步迭代提示机制：将首次解码输出的pre-sigmoid logits作为稠密掩码与前景/背景点提示共同输入解码器。

Prompt density sensitivity experiments across 2 to 24 prompts with 20 stochastic repetitions per dataset.

Segmentation accuracy degrades in visually ambiguous regions such as low-contrast thin beds or weak reflectivity zones, saturating after ~12 prompts.

sum: Through the 2016–2024 ATTAC project, operational public earthquake early warning (EEW) systems were established in Guatemala, El Salvador, Nicaragua, and Costa Rica. These represent the first end-to-end public EEW deployments across multiple low- and middle-income countries. Built on national seismic networks sharing real-time data and augmented by 72 new EEW-ready strong-motion stations, each agency operates the ETHZ-SED SeisComP EEW software implementing the Virtual Seismologist (VS) and FinDer algorithms. Evaluating performance from installation through mid-2024, VS achieved an overall accuracy of 89%, whereas including FinDer reduced accuracy to 77% due to early false positives on noisy stations. For shallow onshore earthquakes, first alerts are typically generated 10 s after origin time with location errors <30 km and magnitude errors <0.5 units. Alerts are primarily disseminated via mobile apps to over one million users with 2–8 s messaging latency, demonstrating a cost-effective framework for regional seismic risk mitigation.
2016至2024年ATTAC项目在危地马拉、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加建成了运行的公众地震预警（EEW）系统。这是首次在多个中低收入国家部署端到端公众预警系统。系统基于共享实时数据的国家地震台网，增设了72个强震台，采用集成虚拟地震学家（VS）和FinDer算法的SeisComP软件。评估显示……

The VS algorithm achieved 89% overall accuracy (77% when combined with FinDer). Shallow onshore alerts are issued ~10 s after origin time with errors <30 km and <0.5 magnitude units, reaching mobile users in 2–8 s.

sum: The paper presents Inunda, a GPU-native, differentiable flood inundation solver that solves the 2D shallow water equations using a mass-conservative local-inertial scheme. By leveraging autograd-compatible operators, Inunda enables gradient-based parameter estimation (such as spatially explicit hydraulic conductivity) via reverse-mode automatic differentiation. Tested on Hurricane Harvey, the July 2025 Central Texas flash flood, and a post-fire flash flood in New Mexico, the solver demonstrates high computational efficiency, competitive accuracy against established models, and robust probabilistic forecasting and calibration capabilities.

sum: Recent subduction zone observations link pore-fluid pressure fluctuations with slow slip events (SSEs). This study investigates whether periodic pore-pressure perturbations can induce realistic SSEs on mildly velocity-weakening faults using 3D rate-and-state elastodynamic simulations with one-way coupling via effective normal stress. Fluids are periodically injected at the fault center and diffuse radially according to an axisymmetric diffusion equation. The perturbations produce a wide spectrum of slip behaviors: repeating SSEs, non-repeating SSEs (instantaneous and delayed-onset), mixed SSE-earthquake sequences, and earthquakes. Induced repeating SSEs exhibit durations of ~3 months to over a year, magnitudes of Mw 5.5–7.5, and stress drops of 10–100 kPa. However, compared to velocity-strengthening fault models, velocity-weakening faults yield a narrower range of SSE properties and fail to reproduce short-duration (<1 month), large-magnitude (>Mw 6.5) shallow Hikurangi SSEs, suggesting velocity-strengthening faults under pore-pressure cycling more consistently explain natural SSEs.
本研究利用三维速率-状态摩擦弹性动力学数值模拟，探究周期性孔隙流体压力扰动（通过有效正应力单向耦合及轴对称扩散方程建模）能否在弱速度弱化断层上诱发慢滑移事件（SSEs）。模拟重现了重复SSEs、非重复SSEs、慢滑移与地震混合序列及常规地震等行为。诱发的重复SSEs持续约3个月至1年以上，震级Mw……

t: 3D elastodynamic simulations of a planar dip-slip fault with rate-and-state friction and normal stress coupling, imposing periodic pore-pressure perturbations via axisymmetric radial fluid diffusion.
采用含正应力耦合的速率-状态摩擦三维弹性动力学模型，通过轴对称流体扩散施加周期性孔隙压力扰动。

Synthetic simulations exploring a/b (0.81–0.94), patch radius R (15–60 km), hydraulic diffusivity D (1–100 m²/s), and injection times (30 days to 1 year), compared against Hikurangi SSE geodetic data.
探索a/b、半径R、水力扩散率D及注入时间等参数的合成模拟，并与Hikurangi大地测量SSE数据对比。
Induced repeating SSEs have magnitudes of Mw 5.5–7.5, durations of ~3 months to >1 year, and stress drops of 10–100 kPa, requiring high hydraulic diffusivities of 1–100 m²/s.
诱发的重复SSEs震级Mw 5.5–7.5、历时3个月至1年以上、应力降10–100 kPa，需1–100 m²/s的高…
The model uses one-way hydromechanical coupling and fails to reproduce short-duration (<1 month), large-magnitude (>Mw 6.5) shallow Hikurangi SSEs.
采用单向水力-力学耦合，且无法复现短历时（<1个月）、大震级（>Mw 6.5）的浅部SSEs。
Extends 3D periodic pore-pressure perturbation modeling to mildly velocity-weakening faults, demonstrating that velocity-strengthening faults better capture the full range of natural SSE properties.
将三维周期性孔隙压力扰动模型拓展至弱速度弱化断层，证实速度强化断层能更全面复现自然SSE特征。

kc: Demonstrates that periodic pore-pressure perturbations on mildly velocity-weakening faults induce five distinct slip regimes, including repeating SSEs, delayed-onset SSEs, and mixed SSE-earthquake cycles.
Shows that induced repeating SSEs span Mw 5.5–7.5 and durations of 3 months to >1 year with stress drops of 10–100 kPa, requiring high fault hydraulic diffusivities (1–100 m²/s).

Establishes that velocity-weakening faults subject to pore-pressure cycles reproduce a narrower range of SSE source properties than velocity-strengthening faults, failing to match short-duration shallow Hikurangi SSEs.
证明弱速度弱化断层上的周期性孔隙压力扰动可诱发五种不同滑移模式，包括重复SSEs、延迟触发SSEs以及SSE与地震混合序列。
揭示诱发的重复SSEs震级达Mw 5.5–7.5、持续时间3个月至1年以上、应力降10–100 kPa，且要求断层具备高水力扩散率（1–100 m²/s）。
证实受孔隙压力周期作用的弱速度弱化断层所生成的SSE震源属性范围比速度强化断层更窄，无法复现短历时的Hikurangi浅部SSEs。
me: 3D boundary integral elastodynamic fault slip modeling governed by rate-and-state friction with the aging law and Linker-Dieterich normal stress coupling.
One-way hydromechanical coupling where periodic pore-pressure perturbations are modeled via radial axisymmetric fluid diffusion along a circular velocity-weakening fault patch.
Parametric exploration of frictional ratio (a/b), patch radius (R), hydraulic diffusivity (D), injection duration (t_inj), perturbation period (T_per), and normalized pressure amplitude.
采用基于老化律和Linker-Dieterich正应力耦合项的速率-状态摩擦定律，开展三维边界积分弹性动力学断层滑移模拟。
通过单向水力-力学耦合，利用轴对称径向流体扩散方程在圆形速度弱化断层斑块中心施加周期性孔隙压力扰动。
系统探索摩擦参数比（a/b）、斑块半径（R）、水力扩散率（D）、注入时长（t_inj）、扰动周期（T_per）及归一化压力幅值等参数空间。
de: Synthetic 3D numerical simulations on a planar dip-slip fault with a circular velocity-weakening patch (R = 15–60 km, a/b = 0.81–0.94).
Comparison of simulated SSE source properties (duration, moment magnitude, stress drop) against geodetically inferred catalogs of shallow and deep SSEs at the Hikurangi subduction margin.
在包含圆形速度弱化斑块（R = 15–60 km，a/b = 0.81–0.94）的平面倾向滑移断层上开展三维合成数值模拟实验。
将模拟所得SSE震源属性（持续时间、矩震级、应力降）与Hikurangi俯冲带浅部和深部的大地测量观测SSE目录进行对比。
li: Assumes one-way coupling between pore-fluid pressure and fault slip, neglecting two-way hydromechanical feedbacks such as dilatancy, compaction, and dynamic permeability evolution.
Fails to reproduce short-duration (<1 month) and large-magnitude (>Mw 6.5) shallow Hikurangi SSEs due to the narrow parameter space for repeating SSEs.
假设孔隙流体压力与断层滑移之间为单向耦合，忽略了剪胀、压实及动态渗透率演化等双向水力-力学反馈机制。
受限于重复SSEs狭窄的参数空间，模型无法复现持续时间短（<1个月）且震级大（>Mw 6.5）的Hikurangi浅部慢滑移事件。

tm.why: The paper models slow slip event (SSE) generation on mildly velocity-weakening faults driven by periodic pore-fluid pressure perturbations.
The study uses 3D boundary integral elastodynamic rate-and-state friction simulations to examine slip fronts, crack expansion, and transitions between SSEs and earthquakes.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF provided and analyzed, including all equations, Table 1, Figures 1–7, and section texts.

sum: This study investigates lowermost mantle (D") anisotropy beneath Australia using a novel approach that combines array processing and shear-wave splitting measurements of core-traversing seismic phases (SKS, S2KS, and S3KS). By analyzing splitting discrepancies between phase pairs that share similar upper mantle paths but sample different D" regions, the authors detect strong anisotropy at the southwestern edge of the Pacific Large Low-Velocity Province (LLVP), which they attribute to upwelling flow and a potential deep mantle plume. They also identify anisotropy south of Australia associated with high-velocity slab remnants, while finding isotropic or weakly anisotropic D" beneath the Australian continent itself. This highlights diverse geodynamic environments in the deep mantle.
本研究利用结合台阵处理与剪切波分裂测量的新方法，分析了穿过地核并在核幔边界下方反射的地震波（SKS、S2KS和S3KS），以研究澳大利亚下方最下地幔（D"层）的各向异性。通过对比具有相似上地幔路径但采样不同D"区域的波相分裂差异，研究在太平洋大低速省（LLVP）西南边缘检测到强各向异性，并将其归因于……

t: Combining array processing and shear-wave splitting discrepancy measurements applied to core-traversing phases (SKS, S2KS, S3KS) to isolate lowermost mantle anisotropy.
结合台阵处理与剪切波分裂差异测量，利用核心穿透相（SKS、S2KS、S3KS）隔离最下地幔各向异性。
Core-traversing seismic phases (SKS, S2KS, and S3KS) reflecting off the underside of the core-mantle boundary, recorded by seismic arrays in Australia.
由澳大利亚地震台阵记录的、在核幔边界下方反射的核穿透地震波相（SKS、S2KS、S3KS）数据。
Detected strong anisotropy at the southwestern edge of the Pacific LLVP and south of Australia, with isotropic or weakly anisotropic D″ beneath the continent.
在太平洋LLVP西南边缘和澳大利亚以南检测到强各向异性，而大陆下方D″层表现为各向同性或弱各向异性。
The interpretation relies on splitting discrepancies between specific phase pairs, which depend on favorable ray path geometries and coverage.
该方法依赖于特定波相对应分裂差异的识别，这受到射线路径几何形状和覆盖范围的限制。
A novel array-processing and shear-wave splitting discrepancy workflow applied to SKS, S2KS, and S3KS phases to map diverse geodynamic environments in D″.
提出了一种结合台阵处理与SKS、S2KS、S3KS波相分裂差异分析的新工作流，用于精细刻画D″层动力学环境。

kc: Detected strong lowermost mantle anisotropy at the southwestern edge of the Pacific LLVP, indicating a transition to upwelling flow.
Identified seismic anisotropy south of Australia associated with high-velocity anomalies and potential remnant slab material.
Mapped isotropic or weakly anisotropic D" regions beneath the core of the Australian continent.
Demonstrated a novel array-based shear-wave splitting discrepancy method using SKS, S2KS, and S3KS phases.
在太平洋LLVP西南边缘检测到强烈的最下地幔各向异性，指示了向地幔上升流的过渡。
在澳大利亚以南识别出与高速异常及潜在板块残留相关的最下地幔各向异性。
绘制了澳大利亚大陆核心下方表现为各向同性或弱各向异性的D"层区域。
展示了一种利用SKS、S2KS和S3KS波相的、基于台阵的剪切波分裂差异分析新方法。
me: Array processing of core-traversing seismic phases (SKS, S2KS, and S3KS).
Shear-wave splitting measurements and discrepancy analysis between phase pairs sampling different D" regions.
对穿过地核的地震波相（SKS、S2KS和S3KS）进行台阵处理。
剪切波分裂测量，并对采样不同D"区域的波相进行分裂差异分析。
de: Teleseismic waveforms of core-reflected and core-traversing phases (SKS, S2KS, S3KS) recorded by seismic arrays in and around Australia.
由澳大利亚及其周边地震台阵记录的、穿过地核及在核幔边界反射的远震波相（SKS、S2KS、S3KS）波形数据。
li: Resolution of localized anisotropy is limited by the spatial distribution and coverage of SKS, S2KS, and S3KS ray paths.
局部各向异性的分辨率受限于SKS、S2KS和S3KS射线路径的空间分布和覆盖范围。

tm.why: The paper investigates lowermost mantle (D") deformation and flow beneath Australia using shear-wave splitting measurements of core-traversing phases to detect seismic anisotropy.
The study links seismic anisotropy to deep mantle upwellings, the Pacific LLVP edge, and putative remnant slab material in the lowermost mantle.
The authors use a novel approach combining array processing and shear-wave splitting measurements on core-traversing phases.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from Crossref, as the full PDF was not available.

sum: This dataset presents a reconstructed X-ray computed microtomography (XRT) image stack of a water-saturated pumice clast from the 1650 CE submarine eruption of Kolumbo volcano, Greece. The sample was recovered during IODP Expedition 398. The imaging was performed at the Advanced Light Source (LBNL) using 24 keV monochromatic X-rays, achieving a voxel resolution of 0.635 µm. By saturating the connected pore space with water under vacuum, the dataset allows researchers to distinguish between connected (water-filled) and isolated (gas-filled) pore spaces, providing critical microstructural data for volcanic rock physics and eruption dynamics.
该数据集包含1650年希腊Kolumbo海底火山喷发浮石样品的X射线显微断层扫描（XRT）三维重建图像。样品由IODP 398航次获取。实验在劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室先进光源（ALS）进行，空间分辨率达0.635微米。通过在真空下将连通孔隙饱和注水，该数据能够清晰区分连通孔隙（充水）与孤立孔隙（充气）……

t: X-ray computed microtomography (XRT) imaging using 24 keV monochromatic X-rays with a 10x lens to achieve 0.635 µm voxel resolution.
利用24 keV单色X射线和10倍物镜进行显微断层扫描，实现0.635微米体素分辨率。
A reconstructed 3D image stack of a water-saturated pumice clast from the 1650 CE submarine eruption of Kolumbo, Greece.
1650年希腊Kolumbo海底火山喷发中获取的饱和水浮石碎屑三维重建图像堆栈。
High-resolution 3D imaging enabling the distinction between water-filled connected pores and gas-filled isolated pores at 0.635 µm resolution.
获得了高分辨率三维图像，可在0.635微米尺度上区分充水连通孔隙与充气孤立孔隙。
The dataset represents a single sample under static laboratory conditions onshore, rather than in-situ submarine conditions.
该数据集仅代表陆上静态实验室条件下的单一样品，而非原位海底环境。
First sub-micron resolution 3D X-ray microtomography dataset of Kolumbo 1650 CE pumice distinguishing connected and isolated pore spaces via water saturation.
首次通过真空注水区分连通/孤立孔隙，获取了Kolumbo火山浮石的亚微米级三维XRT数据集。

kc: Provides a high-resolution (0.635 µm voxel size) 3D X-ray microtomography dataset of submarine volcanic pumice.
Enables clear differentiation between connected and isolated pore networks by using a water-saturation technique under vacuum.
提供了海底火山浮石的高分辨率（0.635微米体素大小）三维X射线显微断层扫描数据集。
通过真空饱和注水技术，实现了连通孔隙网络与孤立孔隙网络的清晰区分。
me: X-ray computed microtomography (XRT) using 24 keV monochromatic X-rays at the Advanced Light Source (beamline 8.3.2).
Vacuum water-saturation for 24 hours to fill connected pore spaces with liquid water while leaving isolated pores gas-filled.
在先进光源（ALS，线站8.3.2）使用24 keV单色X射线进行显微断层扫描（XRT）。
进行24小时真空饱和注水，使连通孔隙充满液体水，而孤立孔隙保持充气状态。
de: Reconstructed image stack based on 1969 projections collected over 180 degrees of rotation with a 10x lens.
Pumice sample recovered by International Ocean Discovery Program (IODP) Expedition 398 from the 1650 CE Kolumbo eruption.
基于在180度旋转内采集的1969张投影图像（使用10倍物镜）重建的图像堆栈。
由国际大洋发现计划（IODP）398航次获取的1650年Kolumbo火山喷发浮石样品。
li: The dataset is limited to a single pumice clast sample, which may not represent the full heterogeneity of the eruption products.
数据集仅限于单个浮石碎屑样品，可能无法代表喷发产物的完整非均匀性。

tm.why: The dataset contains microtomography images of pumice from the submarine Kolumbo volcano eruption, which is crucial for understanding volcanic processes and physical properties.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the detailed metadata and abstract provided by Zenodo/OpenAlex, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study derives moment magnitudes (M) and stress drops (Δσ) for 318 well-recorded Australian earthquakes (3.1≤M≤6.6) to investigate their impact on local magnitude (ML) conversions and ground-motion variability. High stress-drop events are shown to yield higher ML values. To reduce between-event ground-motion residuals (τ) relative to ergodic continental-scale models, the author applies k-means unsupervised clustering to group earthquakes by location and stress-drop similarities. This partially nonergodic approach achieves regionalized reductions in τ. Statistical testing validates that differences in stress-drop populations between clusters are often significant, justifying regional ground-motion logic trees that reduce epistemic uncertainty in seismic-hazard models.
本研究推导了澳大利亚大陆318个地震（3.1≤M≤6.6）的矩震级（M）和应力降（Δσ），探讨了其对地方性震级（ML）转换及地震动变率的影响。结果表明高应力降地震具有更高的ML值。为降低相对于遍历性衰减模型的事件间地震动残差（τ），研究采用k-means无监督机器学习算法，基于空间位置和应力降相似性……

t: Fourier spectral analysis is used to resolve source parameters, combined with k-means unsupervised clustering to group earthquakes by location and stress-drop similarities.
利用傅里叶谱分析解析震源参数，并结合k-means无监督聚类算法按位置和应力降相似性进行地震分组。
An updated dataset of 318 well-recorded earthquakes (3.1≤M≤6.6) occurring within the Australian continental crust since 1994.
使用更新后的数据集，包含1994年以来澳大利亚大陆地壳内318个记录良好的地震（3.1≤M≤6.6）。
Stress drop is a first-order variable; incorporating cluster-based corrections yields regionalized reductions in between-event ground-motion residuals (τ).
应力降是首要影响变量；引入基于聚类的校正项可显著降低区域化事件间地震动残差（τ）。
In some regional clusters, differences between stress-drop population means are not statistically significant, indicating overlapping source characteristics.
在某些聚类中，应力降样本均值之间的差异在统计上并不显著，表明存在特征重叠。
Using unsupervised k-means clustering of spatial and source attributes (stress drop) to construct partially nonergodic ground-motion models and logic trees.
首次利用空间与震源属性（应力降）的无监督k-means聚类来构建部分非遍历性地震动模型。

kc: Systematically estimated moment magnitudes and stress drops for 318 continental Australian earthquakes.
Demonstrated that high stress-drop earthquakes possess systematically higher local magnitudes (ML) relative to moment magnitude (M).
Introduced a k-means clustering approach based on location and stress drop to develop regionalized, partially nonergodic ground-motion models.
Provided a statistical framework to group regions for seismic-hazard logic trees, reducing epistemic uncertainty.
系统评估了澳大利亚大陆318次地震的矩震级和应力降。
证实了高应力降地震相对于矩震级（M）具有系统性偏高的本地方震级（ML）值。
引入了基于位置和应力降的k-means聚类方法，建立了区域化、部分非遍历性的地震动模型。
提供了一个统计框架来对不同区域进行归类，用于构建地震危险性逻辑树，从而降低认知不确定性。
me: Fourier spectral analysis to resolve earthquake source parameters (M and Δσ).
Unsupervised machine learning (k-means clustering) to group earthquakes by geographical coordinates and stress-drop attributes.
Statistical hypothesis testing to evaluate the significance of differences between cluster-based stress-drop populations.
Between-event residual analysis of Fourier amplitude spectra relative to ergodic attenuation models.
傅里叶谱分析方法，用于解析地震源参数（M和Δσ）。
无监督机器学习（k-means聚类），根据地理坐标和应力降属性对地震进行分组。
统计假设检验，用于评估不同聚类间应力降样本群差异的显著性。
相对于遍历性衰减模型的傅里叶振幅谱事件间残差分析。
de: Seismic waveform dataset of 318 well-recorded earthquakes in continental Australia from 1994 onwards, with magnitudes ranging from 3.1 to 6.6.
1994年以来澳大利亚大陆318个记录良好的地震波形数据集，震级范围为3.1至6.6。
li: In some cases, the differences between the means of cluster-based stress-drop populations were not statistically significant, requiring manual grouping decisions.
在某些情况下，基于聚类的应力降总体均值之间的差异在统计上并不显著，需要人工决策进行归并。

tm.why: The paper derives moment magnitudes and stress drops for 318 Australian earthquakes to explore source characteristics.
The study evaluates ground-motion variability, between-event residuals, and regionalized corrections to reduce seismic-hazard uncertainty.
The paper utilizes k-means unsupervised machine learning clustering to group earthquakes by location and stress drop.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: Greenfield mineral exploration at province scale relies on sparse geophysical data where single datasets allow multiple interpretations and regularized inversions smooth away compact targets. This paper presents a five-stage prototype that converts a written tectonic history into a falsifiable multiphysics prior. A language model restricted to constraint extraction compiles geological text into provenance-tagged probability distributions. A coarse lithospheric generator builds 3D density, shear-velocity, and resistivity fields, which benchmarked forward solvers map to gravity, magnetic, Rayleigh-wave dispersion, and magnetotelluric (MT) observables. Candidate scenarios are tested via calibrated robust-Mahalanobis falsification rather than inversion. Applied to the Al Amar suture and Najd fault system (Arabian Shield), synthetic ablations and out-of-model tests demonstrate that no single dataset separates a fertile deep corridor from barren rivals (e.g., lower-crustal graphite mimics fertile MT conductance), whereas all four datasets jointly reject every rival and close the loop against public regional observations.
针对绿地矿产勘探中地球物理数据稀疏及常规反演易平滑掉窄高导目标的问题，本文提出将书面构造演化史转化为可证伪多物理场先验的五阶段原型方法。利用受限语言模型提取带溯源标签的参数先验分布，通过岩石圈生成器构建密度、横波速度和电阻率场，经正演计算重力、磁法、面波频散和大地电磁（MT）响应，并采用校准的稳健马……

t: A five-stage pipeline compiles written tectonic histories into provenance-tagged priors, generates 3D density, Vs, and resistivity fields, runs gravity, magnetic, dispersion, and MT forwards, and falsifies scenarios via calibrated robust-Mahalanobis distances.
通过五阶段流程将书面构造史编译为带溯源先验，生成三维岩石物理场并正演重磁震电响应，利用校准稳健马氏距离证伪。

Synthetic ensembles for five competing tectonic scenarios in the Ar Rayn terrane, validated against public EMAG2v3 magnetics, WGM2012 gravity, a Middle East Vs model, and 122 measured Harrat Rahat MT soundings.
Ar Rayn地体五种竞争情景的合成集合，结合EMAG2v3磁法、WGM2012重力、中东Vs模型及122个MT测深点验…
A fertile corridor lowers Vs by 3–6% and raises deep conductance sixfold (~500 to ~3100 S). Joint falsification rejects all barren rivals at 98–100% and survives out-of-model truth at 96%.
成矿走廊使Vs降低3–6%、深部电导提高6倍；四数据联合以98–100%拒绝所有无矿模型，模型外真值总体正确率达96%。
Forward models are coarse, the MT solver is 2D TE-mode only (omitting TM/anisotropy for graphite separation), and the target corridor's actual MT response remains unmeasured.
正演网格较粗，MT仅限二维TE模式（未含区分石墨的TM与各向异性），且目标走廊缺乏实测MT剖面。

Translates written geological histories via a constraint-extracting LLM into auditable maximum-entropy priors and screens province-scale multiphysics hypotheses via calibrated joint falsification rather than regularized inversion.
利用受限语言模型将文字地质史转化为可审计最大熵先验，以校准的联合证伪替代正则化反演来筛选成矿省假说。

kc: Developed a five-stage pipeline translating written tectonic narratives via a constraint-extracting language model into provenance-tagged, executable multiphysics priors.
Formulated a calibrated robust-Mahalanobis falsification test using held-out empirical thresholds to handle non-Gaussian features caused by marginalized magnetic remanence.
Demonstrated via synthetic ablation on the Arabian Shield that only joint gravity, magnetic, surface-wave dispersion, and MT data reject all barren rivals including lower-crustal graphite.

Closed the falsification and refinement loop on four real public datasets (EMAG2v3, WGM2012, Middle East Vs model, and Harrat Rahat MT soundings) and derived clause-level sensitivity for survey design.
开发了五阶段工作流，利用受限语言模型将文字构造史转化为带溯源标签的可执行多物理场先验分布。
提出了基于保留集经验阈值的校准稳健马氏距离证伪检验，有效处理了剩磁方向边缘化导致的非高斯特征分布。
通过阿拉伯地盾合成消融实验证明，唯有联合重、磁、面波频散和MT四种数据才能排除包括下地壳石墨在内的所有无矿竞争假说。
在四类真实公开数据集上闭合了证伪与模型修正环路，并通过语句级敏感度分析指导下一步靶向勘探设计。

Coarse 3D voxel lithospheric generator populating correlated petrophysical priors (e.g., serpentinisation anti-correlation between density and susceptibility).
Benchmarked forward solvers: exact rectangular-prism summation (gravity/magnetics), propagator-matrix Rayleigh dispersion, and 2D TE-mode finite-difference MT.
Calibrated robust-Mahalanobis distance (RMD) hypothesis falsification and drop-one clause sensitivity analysis.
结合语言模型约束提取与确定性最大熵规则，将地质文本子句映射为带类型的概率分布。
粗网格三维体素岩石圈生成器，赋予相关岩石物理先验（如蛇纹石化过程中密度与磁化率的反相关）。
经基准验证的正演求解器：精确矩形棱柱求和（重磁）、传播矩阵瑞利波频散、以及二维TE模式有限差分MT。
校准的稳健马氏距离（RMD）假设证伪检验与留一法文本子句敏感度分析。

Public EMAG2v3 satellite-airborne magnetic grid and WGM2012 complete Bouguer gravity anomaly grid over the Al Amar corridor at 2-arcmin resolution.
Corridor-average shear-wave velocity column from the published Middle East surface-wave tomography model of Kaviani et al. (2020).
122 measured magnetotelluric impedance soundings from the USGS northern Harrat Rahat release (Bedrosian et al. 2024).
涵盖五种情景（成矿真模型对无矿高阻孪生、石墨、高密高磁及弧内断层模型）的合成数据消融实验与模型外结构噪声鲁棒性测试。

提取自Kaviani等（2020）中东面波层析成像模型的走廊平均横波速度柱。
来自美国地质调查局Harrat Rahat北部公开数据集的122个实测大地电磁阻抗测深点（Bedrosian et al. 2024）。

Real-data checks for velocity rely on a smoothed published inversion rather than raw dispersion measurements, and the real MT data lie hundreds of kilometers away from the target corridor.
Forward models and lithospheric generator operate on a coarse reconnaissance grid with illustrative intrusive body positions rather than a pixel-level spatial fit.

速度通道的真实数据检验依赖于已发表的平滑反演模型而非原始频散观测，且实测MT测深点距离目标走廊数百年公里。
正演模型与岩石圈生成器基于粗分辨率区域侦察网格，侵入体位置仅具示意性而非像素级空间拟合。

tm.why: The core methodology converts geological narratives into distributional priors and uses prior-predictive ensembles with calibrated robust-Mahalanobis distances for hypothesis falsification and uncertainty reduction.
The method models lithospheric-scale structures including sutures, shear zones, arc roots, and Moho depth across the Al Amar-Halaban suture and Najd fault system in the Arabian Shield.
The paper contrasts deterministic regularized multiphysics joint inversion against Popperian-Bayesian prior falsification for sparse reconnaissance-scale geophysical datasets.

sum: Understanding meltwater-driven ice dynamics in the Greenland Ice Sheet requires high-resolution observations. This study presents the first multi-season dense seismic array and Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) experiment in the ablation zone of Isunnguata Sermia, West Greenland. Across spring 2023, summer 2024, and fall 2024, 82–117 three-component seismic nodes were deployed over 2.5 km2, complemented by two 1-km surface DAS cables and GNSS stations. Rigorous quality control addressed melt-induced geophone tilt via Power Spectral Density (PSD) thresholds and GNSS clock drift via ambient noise cross-correlations. Results show that 4–6 Hz seismic power strongly correlates with GNSS-derived surface ice velocity, demonstrating subglacial hydrological control on ice dynamics. High-SNR noise correlation functions retrieve clear Rayleigh, Love, and P waves suitable for dispersion and structural analysis. Matched Field Processing (MFP) locates over 100,000 icequakes with meter-scale resolution, revealing a seasonal transition from shallow spring crevassing to deeper melt-driven fracturing in summer and fall.
本研究在格陵兰西部Isunnguata Sermia冰川消融区开展了首个多季节密集地震台阵与分布式声学传感（DAS）联合观测试验。2023年春季及2024年夏秋季共布设82-117个三分量节点（覆盖2.5 km²）、两条1公里表面DAS光缆及GNSS站。通过功率谱密度剔除融冰导致的仪器倾斜数据，并利……

t: The authors evaluate data quality via Welch Power Spectral Densities, resynchronize clocks using hourly ambient noise cross-correlations, extract dispersion curves via slant-stacking, and locate 3D seismic sources using Matched Field Processing optimized with the Nelder–Mead algorithm.
通过Welch功率谱评估数据质量，利用每小时噪声互相关校正钟差，倾斜叠加提取频散，并采用匹配场处理进行三维震源定位。

Three 1-month passive seismic deployments of 82–117 3C nodes covering ~2.5 km2 in spring 2023, summer 2024, and fall 2024 on Isunnguata Sermia, complemented by two 1-km surface DAS cables, active sledgehammer shots, and continuous GNSS.
2023年春和2024年夏秋季在格陵兰冰川布设的82-117台节点（2.5 km²）、两条1 km表面DAS光缆、人工锤…

Seismic power in the 4–6 Hz band correlates strongly with GNSS ice velocity; noise correlations recover P, Rayleigh, and Love waves; and MFP locates >100,000 events with 1–18 m horizontal and 6–52 m vertical resolution inside the array.
4-6 Hz地震能量与冰流速高度相关；噪声互相关提取了P波和面波；MFP以水平1-18米、垂直6-52米精度定位逾十万次…

Strong surface melt caused severe geophone tilt (reducing summer horizontal data availability to 36%), GNSS signal losses induced clock drifts, and surface irregularities and streams degraded DAS cable coupling.
强烈冰表消融导致检波器倾斜（夏季水平分量可用率仅36%）、GNSS失锁引起钟差，且冰面不平降低了DAS耦合质量。
First multi-season dense nodal and surface DAS experiment in the ablation zone of the Greenland Ice Sheet resolving hydrological and fracture processes at meter-scale resolution across melt seasons.
格陵兰冰盖消融区首个跨融化季的密集节点与表面DAS联合实验，以米级精度解析了冰下水文与冰裂隙演化。

kc: Conducted a pioneering multi-season dense seismic array (82–117 nodes over 2.5 km2) and surface DAS (two 1-km cables) experiment in the ablation zone of Isunnguata Sermia, West Greenland.
Developed systematic quality control protocols to detect melt-induced sensor tilt from PSD drops and correct GNSS clock desynchronizations using hourly ambient noise cross-correlations.
Demonstrated a strong correlation between 4–6 Hz glaciohydraulic seismic tremor power and GNSS-derived glacier surface velocity across seasonal melt regimes.
Retrieved high-SNR Rayleigh, Love, and high-frequency P wave arrivals from ambient noise correlation functions and extracted seasonal frequency–phase velocity dispersion curves.
Located over a hundred thousand seismic events down to meter-scale resolution using Matched Field Processing (MFP), revealing seasonal deepening of fracturing from spring to summer/fall.
在西格陵兰Isunnguata Sermia冰川消融区开展了开创性的多季节密集地震台阵（82-117个节点，覆盖2.5 km²）与表面DAS（两条1 km光缆）联合实验。
建立了系统的质量控制流程，利用功率谱密度下降识别融冰引起的传感器倾斜，并通过每小时背景噪声互相关校正GNSS时钟失步。
证实了不同融化季节下4-6 Hz冰川水力颤动地震能量与GNSS反演的冰川表面流速之间存在强相关性。
从背景噪声互相关函数中提取了高信噪比的瑞利波、勒夫波及高频P波震相，并获取了季节性频率-相速度频散曲线。
利用匹配场处理（MFP）以米级分辨率定位了十万余次冰震事件，揭示了从春季到夏秋季冰裂缝破裂深度加深的季节性特征。
me: Time-dependent Power Spectral Density (PSD) calculation (Welch method) to monitor glaciohydraulic noise and identify sensor tilt exceeding threshold angles (30° vertical, 8° horizontal).
Ambient noise cross-correlation (10–20 Hz and 40–80 Hz) for clock drift assessment/resynchronization and extraction of ballistic Rayleigh, Love, and P waves.
Frequency–phase velocity dispersion analysis using the slant-stack method on noise correlation functions and unaveraged MFP Bartlett outputs.
Matched Field Processing (MFP) in the 4–6 Hz band optimized via the Nelder–Mead algorithm to locate 3D seismic sources and estimate phase velocities.
Synthetic resolution and sensitivity testing to evaluate the effects of array geometry, sensor tilt, and seasonal background noise levels on MFP Bartlett output and location uncertainties.
利用Welch方法计算时变功率谱密度（PSD），以监测冰川水力噪声并识别超过阈值角度（垂直30°，水平8°）的传感器倾斜。
计算背景噪声互相关函数（10-20 Hz和40-80 Hz），用于评估和重新同步时钟漂移，并提取瑞利波、勒夫波和P波。
对噪声互相关函数和未平均的MFP巴特利特输出应用倾斜叠加（slant-stack）方法，开展频率-相速度频散分析。
在4-6 Hz频段内结合Nelder-Mead优化算法应用匹配场处理（MFP），进行三维震源定位与相速度估计。
开展合成分辨率与敏感性测试，评估台阵几何构型、传感器倾斜和季节性背景噪声水平对MFP巴特利特输出及定位不确定性的影响。
de: Three 1-month passive seismic nodal campaigns: Spring 2023 (82 Fairfield ZL 3C nodes at 250 Hz), Summer 2024 (117 Geospace GSB-3/GS-ONE LF 5 Hz 3C nodes at 1000 Hz), and Fall 2024 (115 Geospace nodes).

Multi-week surface Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) acquisitions in July, September, and October 2024 using a FEBUS A1 interrogator along two orthogonal ~1-km LightMax Flatdrop cables (1000 Hz, 10 m gauge length, 4.8 m spacing).
Active-source sledgehammer shots (~10 blows at 5 m offset from 95 nodes) to compare node and DAS waveform fidelity, coupling, and timing.
Continuous dual-frequency kinematic GNSS measurements at two on-ice stations (F and G) and two long-term 3C seismic stations (on-ice F station and bedrock outlet station).
Meteorological forcing from the PROMICE KAN_L weather station and ERA5-Land reanalysis, used to model surface melt via the COSIPY snowpack/mass-balance model.
三期为期一个月的被动源密集节点观测：2023年春季（82台Fairfield ZL三分量节点，250 Hz采样）、2024年夏季（117台Geospace 5 Hz三分量节点，1000 Hz采样）和2024年秋季（115台Geospace节点）。
2024年7月、9月和10月使用FEBUS A1解调仪沿两条正交~1 km光缆开展的多周表面分布式声学传感（DAS）采集（1000 Hz采样率，10 m标距，4.8 m道间距）。
在95个节点旁5米处进行的系列人工大锤震源激发实验，用于对比节点与DAS的波形保真度、耦合效果及时间同步性。
两个冰上站点（F和G）的连续双频动态GNSS冰流速观测，以及两个长期三分量地震台站（冰上F站与冰川出口基岩站）记录。
结合PROMICE KAN_L气象站数据与ERA5-Land再分析降水数据，利用COSIPY能量与物质平衡模型模拟的冰表融化数据。
li: Strong summer surface ablation (1–2 m w.e./month) caused significant geophone tilt, degrading horizontal component data availability to 36% in summer 2024 and 55% in fall 2024.
GNSS signal dropouts caused clock desynchronizations and variable time offsets in both seismic nodes (up to 5% of summer 2024 data) and the DAS interrogator.
Surface DAS cables suffered from variable ice coupling, solar-induced melt trenches, and high localized noise where cables crossed surface meltwater streams or were suspended.
Different spatial footprints between the 2023 and 2024 node arrays complicate disentangling temporal changes in glacier seismic velocity from spatial heterogeneity.
夏季强烈的冰表消融（每月1-2米水当量）导致检波器严重倾斜，使2024年夏季和秋季水平分量数据的可用率分别降至36%和55%。
GNSS信号丢失导致地震节点（2024年夏季达5%）和DAS解调仪出现时钟失步及可变的时间偏移。
表面布设的DAS光缆受冰面耦合不均、阳光吸热融沟以及跨越表面融水溪流或悬空处的高局部噪声影响，信噪比低于节点。
2023年与2024年台阵空间覆盖范围存在差异，增加了区分冰川波速的时间演化与空间非均匀性的难度。

tm.why: The paper focuses on dense seismic array and DAS monitoring of the ablation zone of a West Greenland glacier (Isunnguata Sermia) to study subglacial hydrology, ice dynamics, and crevassing.
Hourly ambient noise correlation functions are computed to correct clock drifts, extract Rayleigh, Love, and P waves, and measure phase velocity dispersion across seasons.
The node array is complemented by multi-week surface Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) acquisitions along two 1-km optical fiber cables on the glacier.

sum: This paper introduces a cumulative maximum tensor shear attribute (\gamma_{p,max}) derived from Continuum-Discrete Element Method (CDEM) simulations to model fault zones as finite-width deformation structures rather than discontinuous lines. The attribute is defined from incremental plastic strain and accumulated as a non-decreasing shear-path-length measure. In two dimensions, instantaneous maximum tensor shear corresponds to the radius of the in-plane strain Mohr circle. CDEM examples demonstrate high cumulative shear along modeled fault cores and tips, and lower values across distributed deformation zones. This workflow produces registered mechanical targets and structural models suitable for subsequent synthetic-seismic and machine-learning experiments, though it remains subject to small-strain, constitutive, and spatial-resolution limitations.

利用连续-非连续单元法（CDEM）模拟，从增量塑性应变中推导累积最大张量剪切属性。
Synthetic numerical experiments of fault deformation using CDEM to simulate fault cores, tips, and distributed deformation zones.

将断层带视为有限宽度结构，并使用累积非递减剪切路径长度度量来生成注册的机械靶区。

Derived the component and principal-strain forms of the attribute, clarifying its factor-of-two relation to engineering shear.
Demonstrated the application of CDEM to image high cumulative shear along modeled fault cores and tips.

CDEM synthetic models simulating fault cores, tips, and distributed deformation zones.
