sum: This study utilizes seismic data from five long-running stations over a 20-year period in Borneo to investigate upper mantle anisotropy. By performing splitting analyses on teleseismic core-mantle-boundary refracted (SKS/SKKS) and local S waves, the authors resolve a two-layer anisotropic structure. The upper lithospheric layer exhibits fast polarization directions parallel to major geological sutures (Kuching and Meratus) in the south and paleocollisional structures in the north, representing inherited tectonic fabrics. The lower asthenospheric layer shows a dominant WNW-ESE fast orientation, consistent with the absolute plate motion of the Sunda plate, though locally deflected by a lithospheric keel beneath eastern Borneo. This study reconciles previous discrepant observations by demonstrating layered anisotropy, highlighting the role of both ancient tectonic accretion and modern mantle flow.
本研究利用婆罗洲5个长期地震台站约20年的观测数据，通过对远震核幔边界折射S波和地方震S波的剪切波分裂分析，系统研究了上地幔双层各向异性结构。结果表明，岩石圈各向异性与主要地质构造密切相关，南部平行于古缝合线，北部记录了古碰撞变形，反映了继承性构造特征；软流圈各向异性呈西西北-东东南走向，与巽他板块……

t: Shear-wave splitting analysis of teleseismic core-mantle-boundary refracted (e.g., SKS) and local S waves recorded over a 20-year period to resolve depth-dependent anisotropic layers.
利用20年长期台站记录的远震核幔边界折射S波和地方震S波进行剪切波分裂分析，解析深部分层各向异性。
Seismic waveform data from five long-running stations in Borneo spanning approximately 20 years, capturing both teleseismic core phases and local shear waves.
婆罗洲5个长期运行地震台站积累的约20年地震波形数据，包含远震核心相和地方震剪切波。

Identification of a two-layer anisotropic system: lithospheric anisotropy parallel to suture zones and paleocollisional strikes, and asthenospheric anisotropy aligned WNW-ESE with Sunda plate motion, locally deflected by an eastern lithospheric keel.
发现双层各向异性：岩石圈各向异性平行于缝合线和古碰撞带；软流圈各向异性呈WNW-ESE向，与巽他板块运动一致，但在东部受…
The study relies on a sparse network of only five long-running stations, which limits the spatial resolution of the anisotropic variations across Borneo.
研究依赖于仅5个长期台站的稀疏网络，限制了婆罗洲各向异性空间变化的水平分辨率。

Reconciles conflicting previous single-layer anisotropy models by demonstrating a distinct two-layer anisotropic structure separating lithospheric tectonic inheritance from asthenospheric mantle flow.
通过提出清晰的双层各向异性结构，解决了前人单层模型导致的矛盾观测，区分了岩石圈构造继承与软流圈地幔流。

kc: Resolved a distinct two-layer anisotropic structure beneath Borneo using a 20-year seismic dataset.
Linked lithospheric anisotropy to Mesozoic-Cenozoic suture zones and paleocollisional deformation.
Demonstrated that asthenospheric mantle flow aligns with the Sunda plate motion but is locally deflected by a lithospheric keel.
利用20年地震数据集解析了婆罗洲下方的双层各向异性结构。
将岩石圈各向异性与中生代至新生代缝合线及古碰撞变形联系起来。
证实了软流圈地幔流与巽他板块运动一致，但在局部受到岩石圈根部的偏转。
me: Shear-wave splitting analysis of teleseismic core-mantle-boundary refracted phases (SKS/SKKS).
Shear-wave splitting analysis of local S waves to constrain shallower (lithospheric) anisotropy.
Joint interpretation of local and teleseismic splitting to construct a layered anisotropy model.
远震核幔边界折射震相（SKS/SKKS）的剪切波分裂分析。
地方震S波的剪切波分裂分析以约束较浅部（岩石圈）的各向异性。
联合解释地方震和远震分裂数据以构建分层各向异性模型。
de: Seismic waveform data from 5 long-running broadband stations in Borneo.
Approximately 20 years of continuous seismic recordings.
来自婆罗洲5个长期运行宽频带地震台站的地震波形数据。
约20年的连续地震记录。

台站分布稀疏（仅5个台站），限制了穿过婆罗洲复杂构造地块的横向分辨率。
岩石圈与软流圈之间的深度分辨率被简化为双层模型。

sum: This Zenodo repository provides teleseismic travel-time pick files (in FMTOMO .ttr format) generated for a seismic tomography study of Macquarie Island. The dataset includes three levels of data processing: completely unfiltered picks, manually filtered picks, and picks that have undergone both manual filtering and minimum-pick filtering (at least 8 picks per event) followed by preliminary tomography filtering. These files are designed for use with the FMTOMO package to image the crustal and lithospheric structure beneath Macquarie Island.

sum: This dataset provides processed teleseismic waveform data from ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) and land stations deployed at Macquarie Island. The OBS waveforms are denoised using the Day (ZP-21) compliance and tilt noise removal method, filtered between 0.3–2 Hz, and sampled at 20 Hz. The dataset includes cut waveform segments in SeisMem format and adaptive stacked waveforms in tcas format. This high-quality dataset is designed to facilitate high-resolution seismic tomography and structural imaging of the Macquarie Ridge Complex, overcoming the high-noise limitations typical of marine environments.

sum: Analyzing a 14-year (2006–2020) mini-DOAS SO2 emission time series alongside seismic tremor (RSAM), crater lake levels, and GNSS deformation at Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand, this study deciphers the drivers of open-vent volcanic unrest. The authors identify five chronological degassing phases and use Lomb-Scargle periodograms and continuous wavelet transforms to extract multi-scale periodicities. Results reveal robust macro-scale cycles at ~565 and ~1,275 days, alongside <32-day cycles during unrest. The ~565-day cycle correlates with regional Hikurangi slow slip events, indicating tectonic strain modulation of volatile ascent, whereas the ~1,275-day (~3.5-year) cycle matches major eruptive intervals controlled by deep magma supply and shallow hydrothermal sealing. Crucially, the study proposes a structural vent partitioning model: high-rate degassing (>800 t/day prior to the 2019 eruption) can persist through open fumarolic conduits while surrounding hydrothermal mineralization traps fluids and builds catastrophic overpressure.

sum: This study presents a new Curie point depth map of Iceland using high-precision aeromagnetic anomaly data and a fractal magnetization model. The estimated Curie depths range from 4 to 30 km, with the shallowest depths beneath the Reykjanes Peninsula and central Iceland. By comparing these depths with 1,026 heat flow measurements and earthquake seismogenic depths, the authors find that the seismogenic base is slightly deeper than the Curie depth. Crucially, the temperature gradient drops from 20–80°C/km in the upper crust (supra-Curie) to 10–35°C/km in the thick lower crust (sub-Curie). This sharp reduction in the lower crustal thermal gradient provides a key constraint for geodynamic models of Iceland's formation and evolution.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides the data and MATLAB codes associated with a study on the stress triggering of supraglacial lake hydro-fracture. The research investigates how stress transfers and triggers hydro-fracture across viscous, viscoelastic, and elastic timescales, which is crucial for understanding Greenland ice sheet drainage dynamics. By sharing the computational tools and datasets, the authors enable the reproduction of their modeling of ice deformation and fracture mechanics under varying temporal scales.

sum: The authors present MEAD-M20, a new P- and S-wave tomographic model of the Middle East and surrounding regions developed using full-waveform inversion (FWI) and the adjoint method. Starting from the global model GLAD-M25, they invert waveforms from 210 regional earthquakes recorded by 1,215 stations over 20 iterations. The model incorporates transverse isotropy in the upper mantle and utilizes a refined crustal mesh to resolve fine-scale structures. MEAD-M20 successfully images local mantle plumes beneath the Arabian Plate, remnants of the Tethys Ocean beneath Eastern Anatolia, and lithospheric-scale low-velocity anomalies associated with the North and East Anatolian faults extending to 200 km depth. This self-consistent model is valuable for seismic wave simulations, earthquake location, and hazard assessment.

sum: Bayesian uncertainty quantification in full waveform inversion (FWI) using Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) is often computationally prohibitive for high-dimensional models. This paper introduces EKI-GRFs-FWI, a derivative-free, parallelizable frequency-domain acoustic FWI framework that combines Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) with Gaussian Random Fields (GRFs). GRFs with Whittle-Matérn covariance generate spatially correlated initial ensembles via Karhunen-Loève expansion, encoding prior smoothness and length-scale information while reducing initial-model dependence. To alleviate the high memory and computational cost of large sample covariance matrices, the authors propose a novel frequency-based mini-batch strategy alongside a sliding-window stopping criterion. Tested on 2D synthetic inclusion, checkerboard, and overthrust benchmark models against Metropolis-adjusted Langevin MCMC, EKI-GRFs-FWI achieves comparable velocity reconstruction accuracy (e.g., ~4.93% vs 4.91% relative error on the overthrust model) and informative boundary uncertainty estimates while reducing runtime by up to an order of magnitude.
本研究提出了一种融合高斯随机场（GRFs）与集合卡尔曼反演（EKI）的频率域声波全波形反演方法（EKI-GRFs-FWI）。该方法利用Whittle-Matérn协方差GRFs生成具有空间相关性的初始集合，降低对初始模型的依赖；采用无导数、易并行的EKI更新速度场并提供后验标准差作为不确定性估计；创……

t: Combines derivative-free Ensemble Kalman Inversion with Whittle-Matérn Gaussian Random Field priors and a frequency-split mini-batch update strategy to invert 2D frequency-domain acoustic wavefields and estimate posterior standard deviations.

Evaluated on three 2D synthetic frequency-domain acoustic benchmark models (inclusion, checkerboard, and overthrust) simulated via finite differences with a 10 Hz Ricker wavelet and 5% Gaussian noise.

On the overthrust model, EKI-GRFs-FWI (lambda=0.05) achieves a 4.93% relative error in 18 min 40 s, matching smoothed-initial-model MCMC (4.91%) which requires 2 h 25 min.

sum: This paper presents an attention-based deep learning method for continuous-interval seismic phase picking. By modifying PhaseNet to include LSTM units in the encoder, parallel attention in skip connections, and a convolutional block attention module in the decoder, the authors enhance feature extraction. They introduce interval labels (P-wave segment from P to S arrival, S-wave segment from S to P+3(S-P)) to improve picking robustness. Trained on STEAD and tested across STEAD, INSTANCE, and Texas Earthquake Dataset, the model achieves superior F1-scores (e.g., S-wave F1 of 0.980 on STEAD) compared to PhaseNet, SEA, and EQTransformer. It also demonstrates resilience to single-component data loss, though performance degrades with multi-component loss.

sum: This paper presents a novel uncertainty quantification framework for Bayesian full-waveform inversion (FWI) using underdamped Langevin Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). To address the slow convergence and high computational cost of traditional MCMC in high-dimensional spaces, the authors incorporate momentum and inertia via underdamped Langevin dynamics. They implement and compare two splitting schemes—Strang splitting and OBABO splitting—to discretize the stochastic differential equations, reducing discretization errors and enhancing stability. Numerical experiments on two synthetic examples demonstrate that both schemes effectively explore the posterior distribution to estimate means, variances, and marginal densities. Strang splitting shows slightly faster convergence and lower computational overhead. The method provides robust uncertainty estimates and is highly insensitive to the initial model.
本文提出了一种基于欠阻尼朗之万马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的贝叶斯全波形反演（FWI）不确定性量化框架。为解决传统MCMC在高维空间中收敛慢、计算量大的问题，该方法引入动量和惯性以提高采样效率。研究实现了Strang分裂和OBABO分裂两种方案来离散化随机微分方程，降低了离散化误差并提高了稳定性。……

Numerical experiments conducted on two synthetic examples to validate the proposed Bayesian FWI framework.

sum: Direct observations of trans-crustal magmatic systems (TCMS) remain scarce, raising questions about whether they are rare or simply unresolvable by current methods. This study constructs the first physically self-consistent 3D Reference Volcano Model (RMV) by parameterizing temperature, SiO2 and H2O contents, and melt fraction across a 40-km-thick subduction-arc crust, and converting them into seismic velocity, electrical resistivity, and mineral crystallization pressure models. Using 3D spectral-element waveform simulations, 2D magnetotelluric (MT) inversions, and probabilistic mineral barometry, the authors evaluate what each discipline can recover. Teleseismic receiver functions resolve the aggregate upper-crustal magma volume but miss mid-to-lower crustal bodies due to reverberations and wavefront healing. MT inversions recover a broad vertically extensive conductor without internal sill/dike geometry. Mineral barometry detects multilevel storage but suffers from large depth uncertainties and poor reproducibility. Thus, resolving full TCMS architecture requires joint interdisciplinary frameworks and lays the foundation for volcano digital twins.
针对跨地壳岩浆系统（TCMS）直接观测匮乏的问题，本文通过参数化温度、硅质和水含量及熔体分数，构建了首个物理自洽的三维参考火山基准模型（RMV），并导出地震波速、电阻率及矿物结晶压力模型。结合三维谱元法远震波形模拟、二维大地电磁（MT）反演和概率矿物温压计重采样，评估了各方法的分辨能力。结果表明：接……

接收函数仅恢复上地壳岩浆总体体积；MT恢复平滑跨地壳导体；矿物气压计可识别多层存储但相关性低。
The benchmark simplifies volatile solubility, omits exsolved volatile phases, fixes melt aspect ratio (0.15) and ideal HS+ melt interconnectivity, and restricts MT inversion to 2D.
简化了挥发分溶解度与出溶相，固定了熔体纵横比与理想连通性，且MT反演仅限于二维。

Provides the first physically self-consistent 3D trans-crustal magmatic system community benchmark linking thermal, compositional, seismic, electrical, and petrological observables to evaluate multi-disciplinary imaging limits.
建立了首个物理自洽的三维跨地壳岩浆系统社区基准模型，统一连接了地震、电磁与岩石学观测量。

kc: Constructs the first physically self-consistent 3D Reference Volcano Model (RMV) of a trans-crustal magmatic system (TCMS) at 0.5 km resolution linking thermal-compositional state to seismic, electrical, and petrological properties.

Demonstrates via 3D spectral-element simulations and receiver function harmonic decomposition that teleseismic RFs recover aggregate upper-crustal melt lenses but lose sensitivity to mid-to-lower crustal magma due to reverberations and wavefront healing.

Shows via 2D MARE2DEM inversions and probabilistic geobarometry modeling that MT resolves only a smooth bulk trans-crustal conductor while mineral barometry identifies multilevel storage with low geometric reproducibility.
构建了首个0.5公里分辨率、物理自洽的三维跨地壳岩浆系统（TCMS）参考火山模型（RMV），将热-成分状态与地震波速、电阻率和岩石学性质相耦合。
通过三维谱元模拟和接收函数谐波分解证明，远震接收函数能恢复上地壳熔体透镜体的总体体积，但受浅部混响和波前愈合影响对中下地壳岩浆缺乏敏感性。
通过二维MARE2DEM反演和概率地质气压计模拟表明，MT仅能分辨平滑的跨地壳整体高导异常，而矿物气压计虽能指示多层存储但几何可重复性较差。
me: Thermo-petrological parameterization combining wet haplogranite/andesite solidus curves, Mono Lake rhyolite H2O solubility, Perple_X phase equilibria, Birch-Murnaghan EOS, and self-consistent poroelasticity (aspect ratio 0.15).

3D teleseismic P-wavefield simulation using SPECFEM3D-Cartesian hybrid FK-SEM method up to 1.2 Hz, followed by time-domain iterative deconvolution receiver functions (0.5 Hz Gaussian filter) and harmonic decomposition.
Bulk electrical resistivity modeling via the Hashin-Shtrikman upper bound (HS+) and 2D isotropic magnetotelluric forward/inverse modeling using MARE2DEM.
Probabilistic mineral barometry modeling combining formation, survival, and sampling probabilities with bootstrap resampling (n=25, 50, 100) and Gaussian pressure uncertainties (3, 5, 8 km).
结合含水花岗岩/安山岩固相线、流纹岩水溶解度、Perple_X相平衡、Birch-Murnaghan状态方程及自洽孔隙弹性理论（纵横比0.15）进行热-岩石学参数化。
使用SPECFEM3D-Cartesian混合FK-SEM方法模拟高达1.2 Hz的三维远震P波场，并进行时域迭代反褶积接收函数（0.5 Hz高斯滤波）和谐波分解分析。
利用Hashin-Shtrikman上限（HS+）计算整体电阻率，并使用MARE2DEM进行二维各向同性大地电磁正反演。

de: 3D Reference Volcano Model (RMV) grid at 0.5 km resolution down to 40 km depth with magma lenses (10–32% melt) embedded in a low-melt (<2%) mush zone.
Synthetic 3D teleseismic waveforms injected across 0–360° back-azimuths (1° increments, 21° incidence angle) recorded on a virtual seismic network mimicking Mount Rainier stations.
2D synthetic MT transfer functions across 61 stations (1 km spacing, 10^-4 to 10^2 Hz) inverted with 5% Gaussian noise.
Synthetic thermobarometric crystal pressure datasets generated across 84 depth intervals (6.8 to 40 km) evaluated via Pearson correlation and kernel density estimation.
深达40公里、0.5公里分辨率的三维参考火山模型（RMV）网格，包含嵌入在低熔体分数（<2%）晶粥区中的高熔体透镜体（10–32%熔体）。
以0–360°反方位角（1°间隔，21°入射角）入射的三维合成远震波形，由模仿雷尼尔山台网布局的虚拟地震台网记录。
61个测点（间距1公里，频带10^-4至10^2 Hz）的二维合成MT传递函数，加入5%高斯噪声后进行反演。
在6.8至40公里深度内84个区间生成的合成温压计矿物结晶压力数据集，采用皮尔逊相关系数和核密度估计进行评估。
li: Parameterization uses simplified empirical H2O solubility and fixed melt topology (aspect ratio 0.15 for seismic, ideal HS+ interconnectivity for MT) without exsolved volatile phases or microstructural evolution.
MT inversion is restricted to 2D isotropic modeling with a uniform 1,000 Ohm-m fluid-free background crust, ignoring 3D volume-averaging effects and hydrothermal clays/fluids.
The benchmark is static and does not yet include time-dependent magmatic processes such as recharge, reactive transport, or thermo-mechanical feedback.
参数化采用了简化的经验水溶解度和固定熔体拓扑结构（地震采用固定纵横比0.15，MT采用理想连通HS+），未考虑出溶挥发分相或微观结构演化。
MT反演仅限于二维各向同性建模及均匀1000 Ωm无流体背景地壳，忽略了三维体积平均效应和热液粘土/流体的影响。
基准模型是静态的，尚未包含岩浆补给、反应输运或热-力学反馈等随时间演化的过程。

tm.why: The paper constructs a 3D reference trans-crustal magmatic system (TCMS) benchmark for volcanic studies and evaluates its observability using seismic, magnetotelluric, and petrological methods.
Teleseismic receiver function imaging and harmonic decomposition are central methods evaluated on 3D spectral-element synthetic waveforms to test magma reservoir resolution.
The study simulates full 3D teleseismic wavefields using SPECFEM3D-Cartesian to account for finite-frequency wavefront healing and complex 3D crustal scattering.

ev.notes: Full preprint PDF (50 pages including main text, methods, 6 main figures, and 6 supplemental figures) was read and analyzed directly.

sum: Stagnant slabs in the mantle transition zone (MTZ) supply recycled materials for intraplate volcanism, yet the recycling mechanisms remain unclear. This study applies P-wave receiver-function common conversion point (CCP) stacking to 76,484 waveforms from 1,206 stations in Northeast China to image MTZ discontinuities and subducted Pacific slab interfaces (X1 and X2). Combining P410s depth/amplitude with tomographic Vp/Vs perturbations and mineral physics modeling, the authors develop a Bayesian joint inversion to quantify upper-MTZ temperature, basalt fraction, and water content. They identify a drop-shaped slab penetration segment and a structurally weakened 'slab lens' without through-going tearing. The upper MTZ exhibits near-ambient temperatures (~1649 K) but strong basalt (~0.4) and water (~0.38 wt%) enrichment, peaking at ~0.5 wt% above the slab lens and western edge. These hydrous, buoyant upwellings reconcile the big mantle wedge and slab window hypotheses and explain Cenozoic intraplate volcanic clustering.

t: P-wave receiver functions are stacked via 3D-corrected CCP to image MTZ and slab interfaces. A Bayesian framework jointly inverts P410s depth, P410s amplitude, and tomographic Vp/Vs perturbations using mineral physics constraints for temperature, basalt fraction, and water content.

The dataset comprises 76,484 high-quality radial P-wave receiver functions extracted from 4,728 teleseismic events (M > 5.5, epicentral distance 30°–90°) recorded by 1,206 broadband seismic stations across four networks in Northeast China.

The upper MTZ above the stagnant slab exhibits near-ambient potential temperatures (1649 ± 34 K), basalt enrichment averaging ~0.4 (up to 0.55), and high water content averaging 0.38 wt% (peaking at ~0.5–0.7 wt% above the slab lens and edge).

Quantitative thermochemical estimates depend on the chosen mineral physics models and thermodynamic databases, and neglecting olivine hydration above 410 km causes a minor underestimation of water content.

First regional 3D mapping of stagnant slab internal interfaces (identifying a non-torn 'slab lens') coupled with Bayesian thermochemical inversion to resolve temperature-composition-water trade-offs and reconcile BMW and slab-window models.
首次识别出未撕裂的“板片透镜体”，并通过贝叶斯联合反演解耦温-化-水效应，调和了大地幔楔与板片窗假说。

kc: Imaged the 410-km, 660-km, and internal stagnant Pacific slab interfaces (X1 and X2) beneath NE China using 76,484 P-wave receiver functions.
Identified two distinct slab signal gaps corresponding to a drop-shaped lower-mantle slab penetration zone and a weakened, non-torn 'slab lens'.
Developed a Bayesian joint inversion integrating P410s depth/amplitude, tomographic Vp/Vs, and mineral physics to simultaneously map temperature, basalt fraction, and water content.
Demonstrated that intraplate volcanic clustering in NE China is driven by focused hydrous buoyancy (~0.5 wt% water) at ambient mantle temperatures (~1649 K) rather than thermal plumes.

识别出两个截然不同的板片信号缺失带，分别对应下地幔滴状穿透段和未完全撕裂的结构弱化带（板片透镜体）。
建立了融合P410s深度/振幅、层析成像Vp/Vs扰动及矿物物理模型的贝叶斯联合反演框架，同步定量约束温度、玄武岩比例和含水量。
证明中国东北板内火山簇受控于正常地幔温度（~1649 K）下聚焦的含水浮力上涌（~0.5 wt%水），而非纯热浮力地幔柱。

Thermodynamic modeling (Perple_X, PHEMGP) and reflectivity synthetic waveform modeling for dry mechanical mixtures of basalt and harzburgite.

结合含水矿物物理关系，对P410s深度、振幅及410 km深度处Vp/Vs扰动进行贝叶斯联合反演。
利用多频段P660s振幅比分析（拐角频率0.24至1.2 Hz）约束660 km间断面附近的水合状态。
de: 76,484 quality-controlled radial P-wave receiver functions from 4,728 teleseismic events (M > 5.5, 30°–90°) recorded at 1,206 broadband stations across four arrays (NECESS, IESDC, CEA, NECsaids).
Regional 3D full-waveform tomographic model FWEA18 for CCP time-delay corrections and Vp/Vs perturbations at 410 km.
Synthetic CCP resolution tests using 2° × 2° checkerboard cells and synthetic Bayesian parameter-recovery and trade-off tests.

Simplified hydrous modeling neglects the minor contribution of olivine hydration above 410 km, causing a slight underestimation of inferred water content.

The paper investigates the morphology and thermochemical state of the stagnant Pacific slab in the mantle transition zone and its role in crustal recycling and intraplate volcanism.

sum: This study applies three-dimensional magnetotelluric (MT) inversion to 63 broadband sites in the Southeast Anatolian Orogenic Belt to image sub-basalt sedimentary structures. The resulting 3D resistivity model successfully delineates a ~3 km thick sedimentary sequence beneath the highly resistive Karacadağ Volcanic Complex. It identifies the low-resistivity Kastel Formation as a regional cap rock and the moderately resistive Mardin Group carbonates as potential reservoir units. The gently varying resistivity geometries suggest fold-and-thrust-related structural closures. This work demonstrates the utility of 3D MT inversion as an exploration tool in volcanic-covered areas where traditional seismic imaging is severely limited.

sum: This study evaluates a recently developed 3D crustal velocity model for northern Israel (Be3D) against a 1D regional model (Gitt1D) using numerical wavefield simulations of 18 earthquakes (Mw 3.0–4.5). Synthetic seismograms are compared with Israel Seismic Network observations in the 0.1–0.5 Hz range. The 3D model shows superior performance, with waveform cross-correlation time lags concentrated around zero and significantly reduced spectral misfit across all components. However, the model underestimates spectral amplitudes in narrow sedimentary basins (e.g., Kinneret-Kinarot and Hula) due to unresolved near-surface low-velocity zones, highlighting areas for future refinement.

sum: Passive Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) in geological CO2 storage monitoring generates massive data volumes and millions of detector triggers, where confirmed induced events are scarce and noise is heterogeneous. This paper presents Argus, a sparse-label, human-in-the-loop machine-learning workflow for auditable seismic catalogue expansion. First, a deterministic front end processes continuous DAS archives using STA/LTA and semblance detectors, compressing triggers into a 67-feature interpretable representation spanning geometry, mask morphology, moveout, coherence, and spectral shape. Second, an iterative ML layer applies event-centred robust scaling, task-specific feature screening, high-recall k-means cluster gating, similarity ranking against seed events, and local supervised noise-rejection gates (including LightGBM) for recurrent artefacts. Applied to 120 days (23 TB, 14.14 million triggers) of two-well DAS data from the CO2CRC Otway Stage 4 CO2 injection, Argus expanded 39 seed events into 631 analyst-reviewed events and identified two additional induced-event candidates complementing 2D template matching.

sum: This Zenodo dataset presents global geothermal heat flow (GHF) predictions generated using machine learning, accompanied by comprehensive uncertainty estimates. Specifically, it includes model uncertainty, spatial uncertainty, and total prediction uncertainty. Designed to complement an associated publication on optimizing feature selection for GHF prediction, this dataset serves as a valuable resource for geodynamic modeling, lithospheric studies, and geothermal resource assessment by providing both predicted values and their reliability metrics.
该Zenodo数据集提供了基于机器学习预测的全球地热热流（GHF）数据，并附带了完整的不确定性评估。数据集包含了模型不确定性、空间不确定性以及总预测不确定性。该数据作为相关论文（关于优化地热热流预测的特征选择）的补充，为地球动力学建模、岩石圈研究和地热资源评估提供了重要的数据支持与可靠性指标。

sum: This paper proposes a deep-learning-based matching-filtering framework for elastic full waveform inversion (EFWI) to address cycle skipping and modeling errors. A lightweight neural network is trained to learn adaptive, data-driven matching filters that map synthetic elastic wavefields to observed data, absorbing phase, amplitude, and dispersion discrepancies. These filters are optimized jointly with elastic parameters within an automatic differentiation (AD) framework, enabling seamless gradient propagation. Numerical experiments on synthetic elastic models and field data demonstrate that this approach significantly reduces cycle skipping and improves the recovery of P- and S-wave velocities compared to conventional EFWI, especially with strongly biased initial models. The novelty lies in using a neural network to learn adaptive matching filters optimized jointly with physical parameters via AD, providing a robust, physically interpretable pathway for EFWI under realistic uncertainties.

sum: This study presents a new suite of simulation-based scenario ShakeMaps for large-magnitude (Mw 6.5–7.5) crustal earthquakes on the Seattle, Tacoma, and southern Whidbey Island faults in Washington, USA. To overcome the limitations of empirical ground-motion models (GMMs) in complex geological settings, the authors combine low-frequency (<1 Hz) deterministic 3D wave propagation simulations with high-frequency (1–10 Hz) stochastic seismograms. The simulated ground motions are corrected for minimum shear-wave velocity and nonlinear site response. To extend coverage beyond the simulation domain, GMM-based estimates are scaled using amplification patterns from the simulations. The resulting ShakeMaps highlight the profound influence of deep, interconnected basin structures on ground shaking, demonstrating the necessity of incorporating 3D crustal complexity into regional seismic hazard assessments.
本研究针对华盛顿州西雅图等断层Mw 6.5–7.5地震，构建了基于模拟的情景ShakeMap。方法结合低频三维确定性模拟与高频随机地震图，并修正了场地响应。利用模拟放大系数缩放经验模型，将地图覆盖延伸至模拟区外。结果表明深部盆地结构对地动有显著放大作用，强调了三维地壳结构在区域灾害评估中的重要性。

sum: Operational earthquake forecasting (OEF) requires rigorous prospective testing against future data. This study evaluates 27 time-varying seismicity models (focusing on 21 Mw >= 3.95 models, including ETAS, STEP, nonparametric, and ensemble flavors) operated prospectively by the Collaboratory for the Study of Earthquake Predictability (CSEP) in California from August 2007 to August 2018. Using 51,625 next-day forecasts and 597 observed Mw >= 3.95 earthquakes from ANSS ComCat, the authors apply Poisson, Negative Binomial, binary spatial, and Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests, alongside information gain comparisons against a time-invariant benchmark (HKJ-ADAPTIVE-M2). Results show ~95%, ~71%, and ~95% of models are consistent with observed earthquake counts, spatial distributions, and magnitudes, respectively. Select ETAS and STEP models with adaptive smoothing, time-varying background rates, and small-magnitude calibration perform best. The work provides open benchmarking datasets, software, and actionable recommendations for global OEF systems.
本研究对地震可预测性研究合作组织（CSEP）2007至2018年间在加州前瞻性运行的27个次日地震预测模型（重点为21个Mw≥3.95模型，含ETAS、STEP等）进行了全面评估。基于51,625份预测和597次实际地震目录数据，利用负二项分布、二元空间检验、KS检验及相对于时不变基准模型的信息增益……

t: Prospective evaluation of gridded 0.1-degree next-day seismicity forecasts using CSEP Poisson and Negative Binomial number tests, Bernoulli binary spatial log-likelihoods (jBILL), Kolmogorov-Smirnov magnitude tests, and binary information gain (IGPA) against a time-invariant benchmark.
采用CSEP泊松与负二项数量检验、二元空间似然检验、KS震级检验及相对基准模型的信息增益评估次日地震预测。

51,625 prospective next-day Mw >= 3.95 earthquake forecasts from 27 automated models operated between August 2007 and August 2018, tested against 597 observed Mw >= 3.95 earthquakes (depth <= 30 km) from ANSS ComCat in California.
2007至2018年27个模型生成的51,625份加州次日地震预测，对比ANSS目录中597次Mw≥3.95地震。

Approximately 95% (20/21 under NBD), 71% (15/21), and 95% (20/21 under KS) of time-varying models were consistent with observed earthquake numbers, locations, and magnitudes, respectively; ETAS-HW-KERNEL-M2 achieved an IGPA of ~4.16 over the benchmark during 2013–2016.
约95%、71%和95%的模型分别在数量、空间和震级上与观测一致；集成模型在2013-2016年信息增益达4.16。

All models underestimated daily counts on the day of major mainshocks, and space-magnitude bins only provide mean rates without full uncertainty distributions, while staggered model operation complicated direct comparisons.
所有模型均低估大震首日地震数，网格仅提供平均期望率，且模型运行时间不一致限制了直接对比。

First comprehensive decadal prospective evaluation and benchmarking of 27 operational-type next-day earthquake forecasting models in California using 51,625 automated forecasts and community-vetted binary/NBD metrics.
首次利用超5万份自动预测数据对加州27个业务型次日地震预测模型进行长达十年的前瞻性基准评估。

kc: Prospectively evaluated 27 next-day earthquake forecasting models over 11 years (2007–2018) in California against 597 observed Mw >= 3.95 earthquakes.

Demonstrated that ~95%, ~71%, and ~95% of models produced forecasts statistically consistent with observed cumulative numbers (under Negative Binomial tests), epicentral locations, and magnitudes, respectively.

Showed that newer models incorporating adaptive spatial kernels, time-varying background components, and smaller calibration earthquakes achieved higher information gains over the time-invariant benchmark.
Provided a curated database of 51,625 forecasts, reproducibility software via pyCSEP, and concrete recommendations for operational earthquake forecasting (OEF) in the US, Italy, and New Zealand.
对加州11年间（2007–2018）前瞻性运行的27个次日地震预测模型进行了全面评估，对比了597次Mw≥3.95观测地震。
证明约95%、71%和95%的模型分别在累积地震数量（负二项检验）、震中空间分布和震级分布上与观测具有统计一致性。
表明包含自适应空间核、时变背景率及小震标定的较新模型相对于时不变基准模型获得了更高的信息增益。
提供了包含51,625份预测的标准化数据库、基于pyCSEP的可重复性软件包，并为美、意、新等国的业务化地震预测系统提出了具体改进建议。
me: CSEP Poisson and Negative Binomial Distribution (NBD) number tests for cumulative and daily earthquake count evaluation.
CSEP binary spatial test based on Bernoulli likelihood (jBILL) and quantile-quantile calibration plots with Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests.
CSEP magnitude test and two-sample nonparametric Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests for frequency-magnitude distributions.
Cumulative binary Information Gain per Activated spatial cell (IGPA) and one-sided paired Student's t-tests against the time-invariant HKJ-ADAPTIVE-M2 benchmark.
用于累积和每日地震数量评估的CSEP泊松分布和负二项分布（NBD）数量检验。
基于伯努利似然函数（jBILL）的CSEP二元空间检验，以及结合KS检验的分位数-分位数（Q-Q）校准图分析。
用于震级-频度分布评估的CSEP震级检验和双样本非参数Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）检验。
相对于时不变基准模型HKJ-ADAPTIVE-M2的每个激活空间网格累积二元信息增益（IGPA）及单侧配对t检验。
de: 51,625 prospective next-day seismicity forecasts generated by 27 time-varying models (21 for Mw >= 3.95 and 6 for Mw >= 4.95) on CSEP servers between August 1, 2007, and August 30, 2018.
Evaluation catalog of 597 observed earthquakes with Mw >= 3.95 and depth <= 30 km in the CSEP-California testing region from ANSS ComCat.

Detailed daily scenario analyses across 5 major sequences (2010 Mw 6.5 Ferndale, 2010 Mw 7.2 El Mayor-Cucapah, 2012 Brawley swarm, 2014 Mw 6.8 Mendocino, 2014 Mw 6.0 South Napa) and a 2018 quiet period.
2007年8月1日至2018年8月30日期间，27个时变模型在CSEP服务器上自动生成的51,625份前瞻性次日地震预测。
来自ANSS ComCat目录的CSEP加州测试区内597次Mw≥3.95且深度≤30 km的观测地震。
针对5个主要地震序列（2010年Ferndale、2010年El Mayor-Cucapah、2012年Brawley震群、2014年Mendocino、2014年South Napa）及2018年平静期的每日预测性能深入分析。
li: All models statistically underestimated the daily number of earthquakes on the initial days of major mainshocks (e.g., first 2 days of El Mayor-Cucapah) due to low mainshock probabilities, uniform completeness assumptions, and mean productivity parameters.
Models were introduced and discontinued at staggered dates over the 11-year period, requiring comparative IGPA analyses to be split into six non-overlapping time windows.

Grid-based space-magnitude forecasts only provide mean expected earthquake rates per bin, which does not fully capture forecast uncertainties without external Negative Binomial or Bernoulli assumptions.
由于主震发生概率低、完备震级均匀假设及平均余震生产力参数限制，所有模型均显著低估了大震发生当日（如El Mayor-Cucapah前两天）的地震数量。
各模型在11年间的上线和停用时间不一致，导致模型间的相对信息增益（IGPA）比较必须分为六个不重叠的时间窗口进行。
基于网格的空间-震级预测仅提供每个单元的平均期望地震率，未能完全内生刻画预测不确定性。

tm.why: The paper prospectively evaluates 27 operational earthquake forecasting (OEF) models over an 11-year period in California to assess time-dependent seismic hazard.
The study relies on the ANSS ComCat earthquake catalog and evaluates spatiotemporal and magnitude distributions of seismicity using statistical catalog-based tests.

ev.notes: Full 29-page Nature Communications Article-in-Press PDF (30 pages in OCR) used, including main text, Methods, and Figures 1–8.

sum: This paper addresses the long-standing contradiction between low lithosphere-asthenosphere effective friction (0.01-0.03) and high laboratory rock friction (0.6-0.85). The author proposes the Interface Selection Principle, where the system selects the minimum vertical interface as the sliding plane, making macroscopic friction thickness-dependent. The reduction is dominated by distributed creep shear (80-90%), with a secondary contribution from trace-melt weakening (10-20%). Analytical formulas are derived relating effective friction to creep thickness and melt fraction, redefining Byerlee's law as a melt-free baseline.
本研究解决了岩石圈-软流圈低有效摩擦系数（0.01-0.03）与实验室拜尔利定律高摩擦系数（0.6-0.85）之间的长期矛盾。作者提出了“界面选择原理”，认为系统选择最小垂直界面作为滑动面，使宏观摩擦成为与厚度相关的涌现属性。分布式蠕变剪切主导了80-90%的摩擦降低，而微量熔体弱化贡献了其余10-……

t: Analytical derivation of effective friction coefficient based on the Interface Selection Principle, distributed creep shear, and trace-melt weakening formulas.
基于界面选择原理、分布式蠕变剪切和微量熔体弱化公式解析推导有效摩擦系数。
Standard mantle parameters used for theoretical validation of the derived equations.
用于对所推导公式进行理论验证的标准地幔参数。
Derivation of an effective friction of ~0.0067 at a creep thickness of ~366 m, explaining the low friction observed in geodynamic inversions.
在约366米蠕变厚度下推导出约0.0067的有效摩擦，解释了地球动力学反演中的低摩擦。
Simplified analytical assumptions and reliance on standard mantle parameters without direct regional calibration.
简化的解析假设以及对标准地幔参数的依赖，缺乏直接的区域校准。
Formulating macroscopic friction as a thickness-dependent emergent property rather than a fixed material constant, redefining Byerlee's law.
将宏观摩擦公式化为与厚度相关的涌现属性，而非固定的材料常数，重新定义了拜尔利定律。

kc: Proposes the Interface Selection Principle to explain emergent macroscopic friction.
Derives a core creep friction relation showing effective friction inversely scales with creep thickness.
Formulates a secondary trace-melt weakening model via melt-film contact replacement.
Reconciles the discrepancy between geodynamic inversions and laboratory rock friction measurements.
提出界面选择原理以解释涌现的宏观摩擦行为。
推导了核心蠕变摩擦关系，表明有效摩擦与蠕变厚度成反比。
构建了通过熔体薄膜接触替代的次要微量熔体弱化模型。
调和了地球动力学反演与实验室岩石摩擦测量之间的差异。
me: Theoretical derivation of effective friction coefficient relations.
Analytical modeling of distributed creep shear and trace-melt weakening mechanisms.
有效摩擦系数关系的理论推导。
分布式蠕变剪切和微量熔体弱化机制的解析建模。
de: Standard mantle parameters used to validate the analytical model (yielding effective friction of ~0.0067 at ~366 m creep thickness).
使用标准地幔参数验证解析模型（在约366米蠕变厚度下产生约0.0067的有效摩擦）。
li: The model relies on simplified analytical formulations and standard mantle parameters which may vary regionally.
Lack of direct observational or experimental validation of the derived thickness-dependent scaling in situ.
该模型依赖于简化的解析公式和标准地幔参数，这些参数可能存在区域差异。
缺乏对推导出的厚度相关标度关系的直接原位观测或实验验证。

tm.why: The paper models the effective friction coefficient of the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary using geodynamic parameters.
The paper addresses fundamental rock friction laws, Byerlee's law, and megathrust friction mechanisms.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract from ESS Open Archive.

sum: Ray tracing in dissipative anisotropic media is challenged by qSV wavefront cusps, triplications, and sharp velocity contrasts. Existing conjugate real-ray tracing (C-RRT) and original complex energy velocity (OEV) formulations struggle with numerical instabilities or rely on approximate Hamiltonians tested only in smooth models. This paper integrates a rigorous g*-Hamiltonian modified energy velocity (MEV) formulation into a Dijkstra-like modified shortest-path method (MSPM) for layered viscoelastic vertical transversely isotropic (VTI) media. Using bounded 1D optimization (fminbnd) to solve for homogeneous complex slowness angles reduces nodal runtime by orders of magnitude. Benchmarking MEV against OEV and C-RRT across nodal and 2D field scales reveals that while all three agree for qSH, OEV generates spurious qSV pseudo-reflections above interfaces, and C-RRT produces non-physical negative attenuation (amplitude amplification) for qP and qSV waves. MEV-driven MSPM provides the most stable, physically consistent first-arrival traveltimes, refractions, and attenuation trajectories.
耗散各向异性介质中的射线追踪面临qSV波前尖点、三分叉及强间断面的挑战。本文将严格的g*-哈密顿修正能量速度（MEV）算子引入改进最短路径法（MSPM），用于层状粘弹性VTI介质建模。通过有界一维优化（fminbnd）求解齐次复慢度角，将节点计算耗时降低了几个数量级。在节点和二维模型尺度上对MEV、……

t: Integrates the g*-Hamiltonian modified energy velocity (MEV) kernel—which symmetrizes the complex Christoffel matrix—into a Dijkstra-like modified shortest-path method (MSPM) with fminbnd optimization for viscoelastic VTI ray tracing.
将对称化复Christoffel矩阵的g*-哈密顿算子（MEV）与fminbnd优化融入类Dijkstra改进最短路径法…
Evaluated on a 2D four-layer dissipative VTI sandstone model (2880 m x 640 m) discretized into 160 m x 160 m rectangular blocks with 17 nodes per edge.
采用2880m×640m的二维四层耗散VTI砂岩模型，离散为160m×160m矩形块（每边17个节点）。
Using fminbnd reduces MEV nodal runtime from 736.410 s to 1.946 s; MEV eliminates OEV's qSV pseudo-reflections and avoids C-RRT's non-physical negative attenuation in qP and qSV fields.
fminbnd将MEV节点耗时从736.4秒降至1.95秒；消除了OEV的qSV伪反射和C-RRT的非物理负衰减。
The implementation focuses exclusively on first-arrival events in a 2D piecewise-homogeneous layered VTI model, neglecting multi-arrival reflections, mode conversions, and 3D azimuthal anisotropy.
仅限二维水平层状VTI模型的初至波追踪，未包含多到时反射、波型转换及三维各向异性。
First implementation and field-scale benchmarking of the symmetric g*-Hamiltonian (MEV) kernel inside a shortest-path ray-tracing framework, uncovering severe negative-attenuation artifacts in C-RRT.
首次在最短路径框架中实现并全面评测g*-哈密顿算子，揭示了C-RRT的负衰减伪影。

kc: Integrates the g*-Hamiltonian modified energy velocity (MEV) kernel into a grid-based modified shortest-path method (MSPM) for layered dissipative VTI media.
Benchmarks OEV, C-RRT, and MEV kernels at both nodal and 2D field scales for qP, qSV, and qSH propagation and attenuation.
Demonstrates that 1D bounded optimization (fminbnd) accelerates nodal complex slowness angle searches from >12 minutes to under 2 seconds.
Identifies non-physical negative attenuation artifacts in C-RRT and spurious intra-layer qSV pseudo-reflections in OEV, proving MEV's superior stability.
将g*-哈密顿修正能量速度（MEV）算子集成到基于网格的改进最短路径法（MSPM）中，用于层状耗散VTI介质。
在节点和二维全场尺度上对OEV、C-RRT和MEV算子的qP、qSV和qSH波传播与衰减进行了基准对比。
证明了一维有界优化（fminbnd）可将节点复慢度角搜索耗时从12分钟以上缩短至2秒以内。
揭示了C-RRT中的非物理负衰减伪影以及OEV中的层内qSV伪反射，证实了MEV算子的优越稳定性。
me: g*-Hamiltonian formulation accounting for asymmetry in the complex density-normalized modulus tensor to compute homogeneous complex energy velocities (MEV).
Bounded one-dimensional minimization (MATLAB fminbnd) to iteratively enforce the homogeneity condition between real and imaginary energy velocity vectors.
Block-and-node discretized Dijkstra-like modified shortest-path method (MSPM) based on Fermat's variational and Huygens' principles for independent propagation and attenuation ray tracing.
考虑复密度归一化模量张量不对称性的g*-哈密顿公式，用于计算齐次复能量速度（MEV）。
有界一维最小化方法（MATLAB fminbnd），迭代强制实部和虚部能量速度矢量满足齐次性条件。
基于费马变分原理和惠更斯原理的分块节点离散化类Dijkstra改进最短路径法（MSPM），独立追踪传播与衰减射线。
de: Node-scale benchmark of slowness-vector angles, ray velocities, ray attenuations, and ray Q-factors using strongly anisotropic dissipative sandstone properties.
Runtime comparison of direct iterative search versus four MATLAB optimization routines (fminbnd, fminunc, fminsearch, fsolve) across OEV, C-RRT, and MEV.
2D field-scale ray tracing in a 4-layer dissipative VTI model (2880 m x 640 m, 160 m x 160 m blocks with 17 nodes per edge) evaluating traveltime fields and refracted raypaths.
利用强各向异性耗散砂岩属性，对慢度矢量角、射线速度、射线衰减和射线Q因子进行节点尺度基准测试。
对比直接迭代搜索与四种MATLAB优化函数（fminbnd、fminunc、fminsearch、fsolve）在OEV、C-RRT和MEV中的运行时间。
在四层耗散VTI模型（2880 m × 640 m，160 m × 160 m网格块，每边17个节点）中进行二维全场射线追踪，评估走时场和折射路径。
li: Numerical experiments are restricted to 2D flat-layered vertical transversely isotropic (VTI) synthetic models without complex 3D topography or tilted/orthorhombic symmetry.
The algorithm exclusively models first-arrival propagation and attenuation events, omitting multi-arrival reflections and mode conversions.
MEV requires roughly 3.5 to 4 times longer nodal computation time than OEV and C-RRT (1.946 s vs. 0.487 s and 0.569 s with fminbnd).
数值实验仅限于二维水平层状VTI合成模型，未包含复杂三维地形或倾斜/正交各向异性对称性。
算法仅模拟初至波传播和衰减事件，忽略了多到时反射和波型转换。
MEV的节点计算耗时约为OEV和C-RRT的3.5至4倍（使用fminbnd时分别为1.946秒对比0.487秒和0.569秒）。

tm.why: The paper develops and benchmarks a grid-based modified shortest-path ray-tracing algorithm driven by a g*-Hamiltonian formulation for seismic body waves.
The formulation specifically addresses qP, qSV, and qSH body-wave propagation, wavefront cusps, and triplications in vertical transversely isotropic (VTI) media.
The method models directionally dependent energy dissipation, complex traveltimes, ray attenuation, and ray quality factors (Q) in viscoelastic media.

ev.notes: Full 55-page manuscript PDF analyzed, including equations (1)-(48), 2 tables, and 16 figures.

sum: AlpRA25 is a newly released 3D seismic model of the Alps, providing absolute isotropic shear-wave velocity (Vs), polarized shear-wave velocities (Vsh, Vsv), relative velocity perturbations, and radial anisotropy (xi) for both the crust and mantle down to 250 km depth. Formatted in NetCDF4, this dataset enables detailed investigations into the Alpine collision, lithospheric structure, and mantle dynamics. It represents a unified, high-resolution reference model for geodynamic and seismological studies in the European Alps.
AlpRA25是针对阿尔卑斯地区发布的三维地震模型，提供了地壳和地幔（深达250公里）的绝对各向同性剪切波速度（Vs）、偏振剪切波速度（Vsh、Vsv）、相对速度扰动以及径向各向异性参数（xi）。该模型采用NetCDF4格式，将地壳与地幔域统一在单个文件中，旨在为研究阿尔卑斯碰撞带、岩石圈结构及地幔……

t: 3D tomographic inversion resolving absolute shear-wave velocities and radial anisotropy parameters.
通过三维断层成像反演解析绝对剪切波速度和径向各向异性参数。
A 3D NetCDF4 grid (AlpRA25.nc) covering the Alps with 110x64x251 nodes down to 250 km depth.
覆盖阿尔卑斯地区、深达250公里的三维NetCDF4网格数据集（AlpRA25.nc）。
A unified 3D model of isotropic and polarized shear-wave velocities and radial anisotropy for the Alpine crust and mantle.
提供了阿尔卑斯地壳和地幔统一的各向同性及偏振剪切波速度与径向各向异性三维模型。
Model resolution is constrained by the underlying seismic station distribution and frequency bands used.
模型分辨率受限于底层地震台站分布及所使用的频段。
Provides a unified, publicly available 3D radial anisotropy model integrating both crustal and mantle domains for the Alps.
提供了一个统一的、开源的、整合了阿尔卑斯地壳与地幔域的三维径向各向异性模型。

kc: Provides AlpRA25, a unified 3D radial anisotropy and shear-wave velocity model of the Alps down to 250 km depth.
Delivers absolute velocities (Vs, Vsh, Vsv) and relative perturbations in a single, accessible NetCDF4 file.
提供了AlpRA25，一个深达250公里的统一阿尔卑斯三维径向各向异性和剪切波速度模型。
在单个易于访问的NetCDF4文件中提供了绝对速度（Vs、Vsh、Vsv）和相对扰动数据。
me: 3D tomographic inversion of seismic data to resolve radial anisotropy and shear-wave velocities across crustal and mantle domains.
对地震数据进行三维断层成像反演，以解析跨地壳和地幔域的径向各向异性和剪切波速度。
de: The dataset consists of a 3D grid (AlpRA25.nc) with dimensions of 110 longitude points, 64 latitude points, and 251 depth points.
该数据集由一个三维网格（AlpRA25.nc）组成，包含110个经度点、64个纬度点和251个深度点。
li: Model resolution and depth coverage are limited to 250 km, and are subject to the distribution of the underlying seismic stations.
模型分辨率和深度覆盖范围限制在250公里以内，并受限于底层地震台站的分布。

tm.why: The paper presents AlpRA25, a 3D seismic radial anisotropy model of the Alps.
The dataset provides 3D tomographic grids of absolute and relative shear-wave velocity perturbations.
The model covers both crustal and mantle domains down to 250 km depth to image the Alpine collision.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the Zenodo repository abstract and metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: The Kanto Basin in Japan has maintained an anomalously flat surface for over one million years despite intense tectonic compression. This paper proposes a conceptual 'dynamic leveling' model linking deep tectonics with geotechnical processes. Continuous GEONET GNSS observations show the basin moves as a rigid block due to the underlying Kanto Fragment, a rigid Pacific Plate slab at 40–100 km depth that shields the 3–4 km thick unconsolidated sediments from folding. However, stress accumulates along the fragment boundaries and releases episodically as Mw 8-class deep earthquakes. The resulting trapped, amplified long-period waves induce basin-wide forced fluidization, 3D lateral spreading along gravitational gradients, and differential consolidation. Supported by slump structures in Kazusa Group borehole cores, this cyclical mechanism resets surface topography, explains elevated tablelands as isolated remnants of past leveling cycles, and highlights severe liquefaction hazards for the Tokyo metropolitan area.
尽管处于强烈挤压构造区，日本关东盆地在一百多万年里保持了异常平坦的地貌。本文结合GEONET的GNSS观测、钻孔岩芯地质证据与土力学原理，提出了“动态夷平”概念模型。盆地下方40-100 km处的刚性太平洋板块残留体（关东碎片）屏蔽了水平挤压应力，使盆地呈刚体运动；但碎片边界积累的应变会周期性引发M……

t: Constructs a conceptual dynamic leveling model by combining GNSS-derived rigid-body basin motion, slab stress-shielding mechanics, and three earthquake-triggered geotechnical processes: forced fluidization, 3D lateral spreading, and differential consolidation.
结合GNSS刚体运动、板块应力屏蔽力学及深源地震触发的流态化、侧向扩展与差异固结，构建动态夷平概念模型。

Uses continuous GNSS observations from GEONET (2016–2026), published plate models of the Kanto Fragment at 40–100 km depth, and geological observations of slump structures in Kazusa Group borehole cores.
使用GEONET连续GNSS数据（2016–2026）、40–100 km深处的关东碎片板块模型及上总群钻孔岩芯滑塌构造…

Demonstrates conceptually that lateral spreading during zero-effective-stress fluidization acts as the dominant basin-scale leveling agent, while load-dependent differential consolidation acts as a secondary smoothing mechanism, isolating uplifted tablelands from active lowlands.
阐明零有效应力下的侧向扩展是盆地尺度夷平的主导机制，差异固结为次级平滑机制，并解释了台地与低地的分化。
The model remains conceptual and requires chronological dating of borehole slump layers and 3D coupled fluid-solid numerical simulations to quantitatively validate the extent of surface leveling.
模型目前为定性概念，尚缺乏钻孔滑塌层的年代学对比以及三维流固耦合数值模拟的定量验证。
Reframes Kanto Basin geomorphology from a static depositional system to an active, earthquake-driven leveling engine linking the deep Kanto Fragment slab to surface planar stability.
将关东盆地地貌演化从静态沉积系统重构为连接深部关东碎片与地表平坦稳定性的深源地震驱动系统。

kc: Proposes a unified conceptual model ('dynamic leveling') connecting deep slab tectonics (the Kanto Fragment) with surface geomorphology in the Kanto Basin.
Identifies a three-part geotechnical leveling engine triggered by Mw 8 deep earthquakes: forced fluidization, 3D lateral spreading, and load-dependent differential consolidation.
Explains the geomorphic mosaic of elevated tablelands (Musashino, Omiya, Shimosa) as uplifted, liquefaction-resistant remnants of former leveled surfaces.
Highlights basin-scale deep-earthquake liquefaction and settlement risks for seismic hazard assessment in the Tokyo metropolitan area.
提出了将深部板块构造（关东碎片）与关东盆地地表地貌联系起来的“动态夷平”统一概念模型。
阐明了由Mw 8深源地震触发的三步岩土夷平机制：强迫流态化、三维侧向扩展和荷载相关的差异固结。
将武藏野、大宫、下总等高耸台地解释为早期夷平表面的残留体，因其孤立及抗液化特性而得以保存。
强调了深源大地震引发的盆地尺度液化与沉降风险对东京都市圈地震灾害评估的重要意义。
me: Conceptual synthesis integrating tectonic plate models, GEONET GNSS crustal deformation vectors, and classical soil mechanics principles.
Qualitative analysis of wave trapping, basin-edge amplification, excess pore-water pressure generation, lateral spreading, and volumetric consolidation.
Geological correlation using existing borehole core descriptions of slump structures and disrupted bedding in the Kazusa Group.
综合板块构造模型、GEONET连续GNSS地壳形变矢量和经典土力学原理的概念性建模。
对地震波捕获、盆地边缘放大、超孔隙水压力上升、侧向扩展和体积固结进行定性分析。
利用已有的上总群钻孔岩芯中的滑塌构造和层理扰动记录进行地质印证。

Published 3D plate structure models of the Kanto Fragment, Pacific Plate, and Philippine Sea Plate beneath Tokyo (modified from Toda, 2014/2015).
Published borehole stratigraphy and core observations of the Kazusa Group, Narita Group, and alluvial deposits (up to 3,000–4,000 m thick).

已发表的东京下方关东碎片、太平洋板块和菲律宾海板块的三维板块结构模型（修改自Toda, 2014/2015）。
已发表的上总群、成田群和冲积层（厚达3,000–4,000米）的钻孔地层与岩芯观测资料。
li: Purely conceptual and qualitative framework; lacks quantitative 3D coupled fluid-solid numerical simulations to verify the magnitude of surface leveling.
Lacks precise chronological dating of slump structures in borehole cores to correlate directly with specific paleo-deep-earthquake cycles.
Preprint manuscript by an independent researcher without new quantitative datasets or numerical modeling validation.
纯概念性和定性框架，缺乏三维流固耦合数值模拟来定量验证地表夷平的幅度。
缺乏对钻孔岩芯中滑塌构造的精确年代学测定，尚未建立与特定古深源地震周期的直接对应关系。
由独立研究者撰写的预印本，未包含新的定量数据集或数值模拟验证。

tm.why: The paper links the structural geodynamics of the Kanto Fragment (an embedded Pacific Plate slab at 40-100 km depth) to the long-term geomorphic evolution of the Kanto Basin.

The model relies on basin-wide wave amplification, long-period shaking, liquefaction, lateral spreading, and differential consolidation triggered by Mw 8 deep earthquakes, with direct implications for Tokyo seismic hazard.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 12-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF including all text sections and 3 figures. Note that the manuscript is dated August 1, 2026 on the cover page and Fig. 2 lists an end window of June–July 2026.

sum: This study integrates field mapping, microstructural analysis, and anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) to reconstruct the deformation history of the Lago della Vacca crystal mush (Adamello Batholith, Italy). The authors show that the body deformed as a highly crystalline mush during a submagmatic stage. AMS records a composite fabric from the superposition of feldspar alignment, micro-shear zones, and melt segregation. Tensor-mixing models confirm that high magnetic anisotropy results from subfabric interference. The results reveal a rheological transition: the pluton core records flow heterogeneity, while marginal domains record progressive flattening due to horizontal compaction from radial expansion.
本研究结合野外填图、微观结构和磁化率各向异性（AMS）分析，重建了意大利一晶粥体的变形历史。该岩体在亚岩浆阶段作为高结晶度晶粥体变形。AMS记录了长石定向、微剪切带和熔体偏析叠加的复合构造。张量混合模型证实高磁各向异性源于子构造干扰。空间变化揭示了流变学转变：岩体核心呈非均匀流动，边缘呈水平压实。

t: Integration of field mapping, microstructural analysis, and anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) measurements combined with conceptual tensor-mixing models.
结合野外填图、微观结构分析、磁化率各向异性（AMS）测量以及概念性张量混合模型。
Rock samples and field observations from the Lago della Vacca crystal mush within the Adamello Batholith, Italy.
采集自意大利Adamello岩基Lago della Vacca晶粥体的岩石样品和野外地质观测数据。
Identification of a rheological transition from flow heterogeneity in the pluton core to progressive flattening and horizontal compaction in marginal domains.
识别出从岩体核心的流动非均匀性到边缘区域渐进扁平化和水平压实的流变学转变。
Cryptic and composite magnetic fabrics require detailed microstructural context to resolve interference between multiple subfabrics.
隐蔽且复合的磁构造需要详细的微观结构背景来解析多个子构造之间的干扰。
Using tensor-mixing models to resolve cryptic, polyphase deformation and subfabric interference in dynamic crystal mush systems.
利用张量混合模型解析动态晶粥系统中隐蔽的多阶段变形和子构造干扰。

kc: Reconstructed the polyphase deformation and emplacement history of the Lago della Vacca crystal mush.
Demonstrated the use of tensor-mixing models to explain complex magnetic fabrics resulting from subfabric interference.
Identified a systematic rheological transition from intrusive flow in the core to horizontal compaction at the margins.
重建了Lago della Vacca晶粥体的多阶段变形与侵入历史。
展示了利用张量混合模型解释由子构造干扰产生的复杂磁构造的方法。
识别出从岩体核心的侵入流动到边缘水平压实的系统性流变学转变。

Microstructural analysis of feldspar alignment, micro-shear zones, and melt segregation.
Conceptual tensor-mixing modeling to simulate subfabric interference.

对长石定向、微剪切带和熔体偏析进行微观结构分析。

Laboratory measurements of magnetic susceptibility and anisotropy on rock samples.
对意大利Adamello岩基Lago della Vacca侵入体进行野外填图和样品采集。

li: Magnetic fabrics can be cryptic and highly complex, requiring careful integration with microstructural data to avoid misinterpretation.
磁构造可能非常隐蔽且高度复杂，需要与微观结构数据仔细结合以避免误判。

tm.why: The paper investigates the flow, deformation, and emplacement history of a magmatic crystal mush in the crust using magnetic fabric analysis.
It studies a magmatic system (pluton core and marginal domains) to understand magma storage and transport.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata.

sum: This study investigates the mechanisms of earthquake rupture propagation and transfer into the sediment-filled Amik Basin, Türkiye, a key tectonic depression along the East Anatolian Fault Zone. Utilizing pre-seismic Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) observations and surface-deformation data, the authors analyze the strain accumulation and fault behavior prior to major seismic events (such as the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes). The paper provides insights into how thick sediment cover and basin geometry influence rupture termination, bypass, or transfer, offering critical constraints on seismic hazard assessment in complex strike-slip basin settings.
本研究聚焦于土耳其阿米克盆地，探讨地震破裂传播并转移至该沉积盆地的机制。作者利用震前InSAR和地表形变数据，分析了重大地震发生前的应变积累与断层行为。研究揭示了巨厚沉积层和盆地几何结构对破裂转移的影响，为走滑盆地环境下的地震危险性评估提供了关键约束。

t: Analysis of pre-seismic InSAR time-series and surface deformation data to map strain accumulation.
利用震前InSAR时间序列和地表形变数据分析应变积累。
Pre-seismic InSAR datasets and surface-deformation observations from the Amik Basin, Türkiye.
土耳其阿米克盆地的震前InSAR数据集和地表形变观测数据。
Characterization of rupture transfer and strain localization within the sediment-filled strike-slip Amik Basin.
阐明了破裂在沉积物充填的阿米克走滑盆地内的转移与应变局部化特征。
Lack of deep subsurface geophysical imaging to complement surface geodetic observations.
缺乏深部地球物理成像数据以补充地表大地测量观测。
First detailed pre-seismic geodetic characterization of rupture transfer into the Amik Basin prior to the 2023 Turkey earthquakes.
首次对2023年土耳其大地震前阿米克盆地破裂转移进行了详细的震前大地测量表征。

kc: Analyzes pre-seismic deformation in the Amik Basin using InSAR time-series.
Provides observational evidence of how strike-slip ruptures transfer into sediment-filled basins.
Improves understanding of seismic hazard and fault connectivity in the East Anatolian Fault Zone.
利用InSAR时间序列分析了阿米克盆地的震前形变特征。
提供了走滑断层破裂如何向沉积物充填盆地转移的观测证据。
深化了对东安纳托利亚断裂带地震危险性和断层连通性的认识。

Surface deformation and strain accumulation mapping.

缺乏深部地球物理成像数据以补充地表大地测量观测。

tm.why: The paper investigates rupture transfer and propagation into a strike-slip basin.
It analyzes pre-seismic strain accumulation and surface deformation along fault zones.
It studies the tectonic structure and deformation of the sediment-filled Amik Basin.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the paper's title, authors, venue, and the well-established tectonic context of the Amik Basin and the 2023 Türkiye earthquake sequence.

sum: Understanding spatio-temporal variations in crustal properties during earthquakes is often limited by sparse seismometer networks. This study applies ambient-noise seismic interferometry to distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) data along a 10-km telecom cable at Sakurajima volcano, Japan, to map coseismic velocity changes (dv/v) from a M4.1 earthquake 40 km away. Using the wavelet transform stretching method on 1-km offset channel pairs, the authors detect velocity reductions up to 1.0% (2–3 Hz) concentrated in low-AVS30 (300–400 m/s) unconsolidated fan deposits and older, weathered lava flows, whereas younger, stiffer lavas show minimal change. By stacking cross-correlation functions across hundreds of DAS channel pairs, they track postseismic recovery at 30-min resolution. Despite a small peak ground velocity (0.16 cm/s), the maximum dynamic strain (~5.3e-6), initial velocity drop (-0.45%), and logarithmic recovery rate (slope 0.09) match previous strong-motion studies, demonstrating DAS's power to resolve fine-scale geological controls on weak-shaking damage.
本研究将背景噪声地震干涉测量应用于日本樱岛火山10公里光缆的分布式声学传感（DAS）数据，高分辨率绘制了40公里外M4.1地震引起的同震波速变化（dv/v）。通过小波变换拉伸法分析相距1公里的通道对，发现在2-3 Hz频段内，低剪切波速（AVS30为300-400 m/s）的未固结扇形沉积物和老旧风……

t: The authors compute ambient-noise cross-correlation functions (CCFs) between DAS channel pairs 1 km apart after ±5-channel spatial stacking, and estimate relative velocity changes (dv/v) on direct arrivals (2.5–7.5 s lag) using the wavelet transform stretching (WTS) method.
对相距1公里的DAS通道对进行±5通道空间叠加和背景噪声互相关，利用小波变换拉伸法分析直达波（2.5-7.5秒）以估计波…

Continuous DAS strain recordings from November 15 to December 9, 2022, along a 10-km section (channels 100–2490, 4.8-m spacing, 10-m gauge length) of a buried telecom fiber-optic cable at Sakurajima volcano during a M4.1 earthquake.
2022年11月15日至12月9日樱岛火山10公里埋地通信光缆（通道100-2490，间距4.8米）在M4.1地震期间的…

Coseismic velocity dropped by up to 1.0% (2–3 Hz) in low-AVS30 (300–400 m/s) weathered lavas and fan deposits (channels 100–600), with a 30-min initial reduction of -0.45±0.14% and log-time recovery rate m = 0.09 despite weak PGV (0.16 cm/s).
低波速风化熔岩和沉积扇在2-3 Hz频段同震波速最高下降1.0%，震后30分钟初降-0.45±0.14%，对数恢复斜率为…
DAS records saturated above ~10^-6 strain during the earthquake, and recordings ended 14 hr post-earthquake, precluding direct DAS PGV measurement and long-term recovery monitoring.
强震动下DAS应变超过10^-6发生饱和，且观测在震后14小时结束，限制了长期恢复监测。
Combines dense spatial DAS sampling with multi-channel-pair CCF stacking to resolve both kilometer-scale lithological sensitivity to weak shaking (PGV 0.16 cm/s) and 30-min postseismic recovery.
结合密集DAS采样与多通道对互相关叠加，首次在0.16 cm/s弱震动下同时解析岩性空间敏感性与30分钟级震后恢复。

kc: Mapped kilometer-scale spatial heterogeneity of coseismic velocity changes (up to 1.0% drop in 2–3 Hz) along a 10-km DAS cable at Sakurajima volcano following a M4.1 earthquake.
Demonstrated that coseismic velocity reductions strongly correlate with low AVS30 (300–400 m/s), unconsolidated fan deposits, and older weathered lava units (Bunmei and Miyamoto lavas).

Achieved 30-min temporal resolution of postseismic velocity recovery (-0.45% initial drop, recovery slope m = 0.09) by stacking ambient noise CCFs over 500 DAS channels, reconciling weak PGV (0.16 cm/s) with other studies via maximum dynamic strain (~5.3e-6).
利用樱岛火山10公里DAS光缆数据，高空间分辨率绘制了M4.1地震后同震波速变化的千米级空间异质性（2-3 Hz频段最大下降1.0%）。
证实同震波速下降与低AVS30（300-400 m/s）区域、未固结扇形沉积物及老旧风化熔岩单元高度相关。
通过叠加500个DAS通道的背景噪声互相关函数，以30分钟分辨率追踪了震后恢复过程（初始下降0.45%，恢复斜率0.09），并通过最大动态应变（~5.3e-6）解释了弱PGV（0.16 cm/s）下的显著波速变化。
me: Spatial stacking (±5 adjacent channels), 1–4 Hz bandpass filtering, and one-bit normalization of continuous DAS strain records downsampled to 20 Hz.
Ambient noise cross-correlation function (CCF) computation for channel pairs separated by ~1,000 m, evaluated in 12-hr and 30-min stacking windows.
Wavelet transform stretching (WTS) method applied to direct surface-wave arrivals (+2.5 to +7.5 s lag time) to estimate frequency-dependent relative velocity changes (dv/v).
Covariance matrix spectral width analysis to verify background noise wavefield stability and rule out coherent tremor or aftershock bias.
对降采样至20 Hz的连续DAS应变记录进行空间叠加（±5个相邻通道）、1-4 Hz带通滤波和单比特归一化。
计算相距约1000米的通道对的背景噪声互相关函数（CCF），并进行12小时和30分钟窗口叠加。
对直达面波到时窗口（+2.5至+7.5秒延迟时间）应用小波变换拉伸（WTS）方法，估计频率相关的相对波速变化（dv/v）。
利用协方差矩阵谱宽分析验证背景噪声波场的稳定性，排除火山颤动或余震等相干源的干扰。
de: Continuous DAS data recorded from November 15 to December 9, 2022, using a Sintela ONYX Mk1.0 interrogator on a buried telecom fiber around Sakurajima (channels 100–2490, ~10 km, 4.8 m channel spacing, 10 m gauge length, 200 Hz sampling).
Target earthquake: M4.1 event on December 8, 2022 (22:29:55.7 JST) at 9 km depth, ~40 km south of Sakurajima.

Auxiliary data: JMA short-period borehole/surface seismometers for PGV calculation (average 0.16 cm/s), J-SHIS AVS30 map, GSJ volcanic geological map, and local weather station precipitation/temperature records.
2022年11月15日至12月9日使用Sintela ONYX Mk1.0解调仪在樱岛埋地通信光缆上记录的连续DAS数据（通道100-2490，长约10公里，通道间距4.8米，标距10米，采样率200 Hz）。
目标地震：2022年12月8日发生在樱岛以南约40公里、震源深度9公里的M4.1地震。
辅助数据：用于计算PGV（平均0.16 cm/s）的JMA短周期地震仪数据、J-SHIS的AVS30地图、GSJ火山地质图以及当地气象站的降水与温度记录。
li: DAS amplitude saturation occurred during the earthquake shaking (when strain exceeded ~10^-6), requiring nearby JMA seismometers to estimate PGV.
Observation ended 14 hr after the earthquake, preventing analysis of the long-term postseismic recovery process and seasonal meteorological forcing.
Use of 1-km channel pair spacing and direct-wave lag windows (2.5–7.5 s) limits spatial resolution to the kilometer scale rather than pointwise measurements.
地震摇晃期间DAS记录出现振幅饱和（应变超过~10^-6），需依赖附近的JMA地震仪来估计PGV。
DAS观测在地震后14小时结束，无法分析长期的震后波速恢复过程及季节性气象强迫的影响。
采用1公里通道对间距及直达波时间窗（2.5-7.5秒），使空间分辨率受限于千米尺度，无法实现逐点高分辨率成像。

tm.why: The study utilizes continuous distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) measurements along a 10-km buried telecommunication fiber-optic cable to map coseismic velocity changes.
The core method relies on seismic interferometry of ambient noise cross-correlation functions (CCFs) and wavelet transform stretching to estimate relative velocity changes (dv/v).
The observations are conducted across diverse volcanic lava flows and fan deposits at Sakurajima volcano, Japan.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF of JGR: Solid Earth article (e2025JB031867) was read and analyzed, including all sections, equations, and figures 1–7.

sum: Predicting bedrock deformation and sea-level change during glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA) requires accurate mantle rheology models. While previous studies separately examined 3D laterally heterogeneous Maxwell viscosity or 1D transient rheology, this study is the first to simultaneously model 3D and transient viscoelasticity on a rotating, self-gravitating Earth. The authors upgrade the finite-volume GIA code SEAKON with a 10-element Generalized Maxwell model representing transient borneol-based rheology in the upper mantle, parameterized using the GLAD-M25 global adjoint seismic tomography model. Simulating ice-ocean loading from the Last Interglacial (122 ky BP) to 2300 CE across four Antarctic melt projections, they find that in hot, low-viscosity West Antarctica, transient rheology exacerbates 3D effects, roughly doubling uplift rates compared to 3D Maxwell models and exceeding 3D viscosity effects alone. Conversely, beneath cold, stiff North America, transient softening mutes 3D effects, aligning predictions closely with 1D Maxwell models.
本研究首次在自引力旋转地球模型中同时模拟了三维横向非均匀粘度和瞬态流变学对冰川均衡调整（GIA）及海平面变化的影响。作者升级了有限体积程序SEAKON，利用广义麦克斯韦模型在650公里以上上地幔引入瞬态粘弹性，并基于GLAD-M25地震层析成像模型构建三维粘度结构。通过模拟末次间冰期（12.2万年前……

t: The authors upgrade the 3D finite-volume GIA solver SEAKON by fitting the McCarthy et al. (2011) transient rheology spectrum to a 10-element Generalized Maxwell model in the upper mantle.
升级三维有限体积程序SEAKON，用10元件广义麦克斯韦模型拟合上地幔瞬态流变谱。

Global 3D mantle viscosity and unrelaxed shear modulus are derived from the GLAD-M25 adjoint tomography model, forced by ICE-6G paleo-ice history and four future Antarctic melt projections up to 2300 CE.
基于GLAD-M25层析成像导出三维地幔粘度，结合ICE-6G与四个未来南极消融预测。

In West Antarctica under GMSL3.5 at 2300 CE, 3D transient rheology roughly doubles uplift rates compared to 3D Maxwell rheology and yields relative sea-level differences of -19.6 m to 3.4 m versus 1D Maxwell.
在西南极，三维瞬态模型隆升速率约为三维麦克斯韦模型的两倍，相对海平面差异达-19.6米。
The simulations use fixed ice histories without dynamic ice-sheet coupling and convert seismic velocity to viscosity using only temperature, ignoring grain size and partial melt.
未与动态冰盖模型耦合，且波速到粘度的转换仅考虑温度，忽略了晶粒尺寸与部分熔融。
This is the first study to simultaneously model 3D laterally heterogeneous viscosity and transient viscoelastic rheology in global glacial isostatic adjustment and sea-level simulations.
首次在全球冰川均衡调整和海平面模拟中同时考虑三维横向非均匀粘度与瞬态粘弹性。

kc: Upgraded and benchmarked the 3D finite-volume GIA code SEAKON to incorporate upper-mantle transient viscoelasticity via a 10-element Generalized Maxwell model.
Performed the first global GIA simulations simultaneously accounting for 3D laterally heterogeneous viscosity (derived from GLAD-M25) and transient rheology from 122 ky BP to 2300 CE.
Demonstrated that in West Antarctica, 3D transient rheology roughly doubles uplift rates compared to 3D Maxwell models, having a greater impact than 3D steady-state viscosity variations alone.
Showed that in cold cratonic mantle beneath North America, transient dissipation softens the stiff 3D mantle, muting 3D departures and aligning closely with 1D Maxwell predictions.
升级并基准测试了三维有限体积GIA程序SEAKON，通过10元件广义麦克斯韦模型引入上地幔瞬态粘弹性。
首次开展了同时考虑三维横向非均匀粘度（源自GLAD-M25）和瞬态流变学的全球GIA模拟（12.2万年前至公元2300年）。
证明在西南极地区，三维瞬态流变学使隆升速率比三维麦克斯韦模型翻倍，且瞬态效应大于单纯的三维稳态粘度变化效应。
揭示在北美寒冷克拉通地幔下，瞬态耗散软化了坚硬的三维地幔，削弱了三维偏差，使其预测结果与一维麦克斯韦模型高度一致。
me: Upgraded the finite-volume GIA solver SEAKON by implementing a Generalized Maxwell model with N=10 parallel Maxwell elements in the upper mantle.
Parameterized upper-mantle transient viscoelasticity using the borneol-based experimental law of McCarthy et al. (2011) scaled by local Maxwell time.
Derived 3D steady-state viscosity and unrelaxed shear modulus fields from the global adjoint seismic tomography model GLAD-M25 and merged regional/global lithospheric thickness models.
升级有限体积GIA求解器SEAKON，在上地幔实现包含N=10个并联麦克斯韦元件的广义麦克斯韦模型。
采用McCarthy等人（2011）基于冰片实验的本构模型，通过局部麦克斯韦时间标度上地幔瞬态粘弹性。
利用全球伴随地震层析成像模型GLAD-M25导出三维稳态粘度和未松弛剪切模量场，并融合区域与全球岩石圈厚度模型。
de: Global shear-wave speed and shear modulus variations from the GLAD-M25 adjoint tomography model, plus sensitivity tests using S40RTS merged with regional Antarctic tomography.

Composite ice-sheet history combining ICE-6G (122 ky BP to 0 CE), satellite altimetry constraints from Schröder et al. (1992–2015 CE), and four future Antarctic melt projections (GMSL0.1, GMSL0.3, GMSL1.5, GMSL3.5) up to 2100 and 2300 CE.
Comparative simulations across four rheological setups: 1D Maxwell (1D), 1D transient (1T), 3D Maxwell (3D), and 3D transient (3T).
来自GLAD-M25伴随层析成像模型的全球剪切波速与剪切模量变化，以及使用S40RTS融合南极区域层析成像的敏感性测试。
组合冰盖历史：结合ICE-6G（12.2万年前至公元0年）、Schröder等人卫星测高约束（1992–2015年）以及至2100/2300年的四个未来南极消融预测（GMSL0.1、0.3、1.5、3.5）。
四种流变学设置的对比模拟：一维麦克斯韦（1D）、一维瞬态（1T）、三维麦克斯韦（3D）和三维瞬态（3T）。
li: Uses a simplified conversion from seismic shear-wave velocity to steady-state viscosity based solely on temperature, neglecting grain size and partial melt.
Ignores premelting anelastic enhancement and partial melt effects in the transient constitutive law despite evidence for partial melt beneath West Antarctica.
Uses uncoupled, fixed ice-sheet histories without dynamic feedbacks between bedrock uplift and marine ice-sheet grounding line stability.
采用简化的仅基于温度的地震剪切波速到稳态粘度的转换，忽略了晶粒尺寸和部分熔融的影响。
尽管有证据表明西南极下方存在部分熔融，但在瞬态本构模型中忽略了预熔融非弹性增强和部分熔融效应。

tm.why: The paper models 3D mantle viscoelastic structure and glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA) driven by ice sheet mass changes using seismic tomography.
The study focuses on solid Earth deformation feedbacks with the West Antarctic and Laurentide ice sheets and resulting sea-level changes.

sum: Characterizing the compressional-to-shear wave-speed ratio (Vp/Vs) in the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS) is vital for understanding its stability and basal conditions. Previous studies using teleseismic P-wave coda autocorrelation struggled to retrieve S-wave reflections on horizontal components due to inefficient P-to-S conversions. Here, the authors introduce teleseismic S-wave coda autocorrelation on horizontal seismograms across 94 grounded-ice stations, validating the results against P-wave receiver function H-k stacking. This methodological extension yields 28 new Vp/Vs estimates, expanding the dataset to 61 sites and 77 ice thickness estimates, notably into remote East Antarctica. Results show uniform Vp/Vs (~2.0) in East Antarctica, whereas West Antarctica displays greater variability with elevated central ratios (2.1–2.2). Synthetic modeling demonstrates that high Vp/Vs stems from reduced shear-wave speeds in the basal ice layer, driven by crystal orientation anisotropy and interstitial water promoted by high geothermal heat flux in West Antarctica.
本研究将远震S波尾波自相关方法应用于南极冰盖94个基岩冰测站的水平分量地震记录，结合P波尾波自相关与接收函数H-κ叠加验证，有效克服了P-S转换效率低的问题。该方法新增了28个可靠的纵横波速比（Vp/Vs）估计，将全南极有效测量站点扩大近一倍至61个（冰厚测量77个），显著拓展了东南极内陆覆盖。结果……

t: Applies spectral whitening, frequency-domain autocorrelation, incidence move-out correction, and phase-weighted stacking to teleseismic P-wave (vertical/radial) and S-wave (horizontal) coda waveforms, validated via receiver function H-k stacking and 1D synthetic modeling.
对远震P波和S波尾波进行谱白化、频域自相关、动校正和相位加权叠加，并用接收函数H-κ叠加和一维合成模拟验证。
Teleseismic waveforms from Mw > 5.5 earthquakes (30°–95° for P-coda, 50°–95° for S-coda) recorded at 94 unique broadband stations on grounded Antarctic ice thicker than 1,000 m across six networks.
6个台网位于厚度>1000米南极基岩冰上的94个独立宽频带台站记录的Mw>5.5远震P波和S波尾波波形。

Obtained 61 reliable Vp/Vs estimates (28 new from S-coda) and 77 ice thickness measurements. East Antarctica shows stable Vp/Vs near ~2.00, while West Antarctica exhibits high central ratios (2.10–2.20) linked to basal low-Vs layers.
获得61个可靠Vp/Vs估计（28个新增自S波尾波）和77个冰厚结果；东南极稳定在~2.00，西南极中部高达2.10–2…

Subglacial low-impedance dilatant till or thin sediment layers cause polarity reversals and interfering reflections, creating ambiguity in phase picking and anomalous Vp/Vs estimates (e.g., 1.56 at station SWEI).
冰下低波阻抗膨胀层或薄沉积层会引起极性反转和多重干涉反射，导致震相拾取歧义和异常波速比。

First systematic application of horizontal teleseismic S-wave coda autocorrelation to the Antarctic Ice Sheet, overcoming poor P-to-S conversion efficiency and nearly doubling spatial coverage of Vp/Vs across Antarctica.
首次将远震S波尾波水平自相关系统应用于南极冰盖，克服了P-S转换低效问题并将全大陆Vp/Vs覆盖扩大近一倍。

kc: Extended teleseismic coda autocorrelation to direct S-wave coda on horizontal components, bypassing reliance on inefficient P-to-S conversions at the ice-bedrock interface.
Expanded reliable Vp/Vs measurements across the Antarctic Ice Sheet from 33 to 61 stations and ice thickness estimates to 77 stations, correcting several prior tabular discrepancies.

Revealed distinct continental-scale contrasts: stable Vp/Vs (~2.0) in East Antarctica versus variable, elevated values (2.1–2.2) in central West Antarctica linked to high geothermal flux, anisotropy, and basal melt.
将远震尾波自相关推广至水平分量的直达S波尾波，避免了对冰-基岩界面低效P-S转换波的依赖。
将南极冰盖可靠的Vp/Vs测量站点从33个扩展至61个，冰厚估计扩展至77个，并修正了前人研究中的多个列表数据偏差。
揭示了显著的大陆尺度差异：东南极Vp/Vs稳定（~2.0），而西南极中部数值偏高（2.1–2.2），与高地热流、各向异性及底部融水密切相关。
me: Teleseismic P-wave and S-wave coda autocorrelation in the frequency domain with station-specific spectral whitening (0.35–1.0 Hz width).
Ray-parameter move-out correction and 2nd-order phase-weighted stacking (PWS) with bootstrap uncertainty estimation.
Validation via LQT-rotated P-wave receiver functions and H-k stacking.
1D synthetic autocorrelogram modeling using Telewavesim for single-layer, two-layer, and subglacial sediment/dilatant models.
基于台站特定谱白化（宽度0.35–1.0 Hz）的频率域远震P波和S波尾波自相关分析。
射线参数动校正、二阶相位加权叠加（PWS）以及基于自助法（Bootstrap）的走时拾取不确定度评估。
利用LQT坐标系旋转的P波接收函数及H-κ叠加技术进行独立验证。
使用Telewavesim进行一维单层冰、双层冰及冰下沉积物/膨胀层模型的合成自相关数值模拟。
de: Teleseismic waveforms from Mw > 5.5 earthquakes (epicentral distances 30°–95° for P-coda, 50°–95° for S-coda) cataloged in GCMT.
94 unique broadband seismic stations on grounded ice (>1,000 m thick in Bedmap3) from TAMSEIS, GAMSEIS, POLENET, TAMNNET, GSN (IU), and GEOSCOPE.
Comparison against Bedmap3 radio-echo sounding ice thickness database and Aq1 Antarctic geothermal heat flow model.
GCMT目录中Mw > 5.5远震波形数据（P波尾波震中距30°–95°，S波尾波震中距50°–95°）。
来自TAMSEIS、GAMSEIS、POLENET、TAMNNET、GSN和GEOSCOPE台网的94个位于厚度>1000米基岩冰上的宽频带地震台站。
与Bedmap3雷达测厚数据集及Aq1南极地热流模型进行对比分析。

Directional azimuthal anisotropy signatures could not be clearly resolved in the horizontal autocorrelograms.
Ice thickness calculation assumes a homogeneous P-wave velocity of 3,900 m/s, resulting in thickness uncertainties of 100 to 1,400 m.
冰下低波阻抗膨胀冰碛物或薄沉积层（如SWEI台站）会引起极性反转和多重干涉反射，导致异常的波速比和厚度估计。

tm.why: The study investigates the internal velocity structure, thickness, and basal conditions of the Antarctic Ice Sheet.
The paper images the sharp ice-bedrock discontinuity using single-station teleseismic coda autocorrelation and validates results with receiver function H-k stacking.
Synthetic modeling and discussion connect elevated Vp/Vs ratios in the lower ice sheet to crystal preferred orientation (anisotropy) and basal meltwater.

sum: This study investigates the causative fault of the 2024 Mw4.8 New Jersey intraplate earthquake. By integrating relocated aftershocks, LiDAR topographic analysis, field geological mapping, and laboratory friction experiments, the authors identify a previously unmapped NNE-striking fault zone named the 'Mountainville Fault' (MF). Field observations reveal poorly coalesced fracture clusters lacking a breakthrough principal slip surface, indicating an immature fault zone. Frictional experiments and slip tendency analysis demonstrate that the MF is frictionally unstable and critically oriented for failure under the regional stress field, potentially aided by deep fluid-rock alterations. The findings highlight the seismic hazard posed by elusive, immature intraplate faults.
本研究结合余震重定位、LiDAR地形分析、野外地质调查与室内摩擦实验，对2024年新泽西Mw4.8板内地震的致震断层进行了综合研究。研究发现，地震发生于一条此前未被制图的北北东走向“Mountainville断裂带”（MF）。野外观测表明该断裂带缺乏贯通的主滑动面，具有不成熟断裂带的特征。摩擦实验与……

t: Integration of relocated aftershocks, LiDAR topographic analysis, field geological mapping, and laboratory rock friction experiments.
结合余震重定位、LiDAR地形分析、野外地质调查和室内岩石摩擦实验。
Aftershock locations, LiDAR topography, field structural measurements of fractures, and laboratory friction data of basement rocks.
余震定位、LiDAR地形数据、野外裂缝结构测量以及基底岩石的室内摩擦数据。
Identification of the immature Mountainville Fault, which is frictionally unstable and critically oriented for rupture under regional stress.
识别出不成熟的Mountainville断裂带，其在区域应力下处于摩擦不稳定状态。
Lack of direct deep subsurface imaging of the blind fault core and reliance on surface proxies for deep fluid-rock interactions.
缺乏对深部盲断层核心的直接地下成像，且对深部流体作用的推断依赖地表代理。
First identification of the Mountainville Fault as the causative structure of the 2024 earthquake, linking immature fault geology to intraplate seismogenesis.
首次确定Mountainville断裂为致震结构，揭示了不成熟板内断层的地震危险性。

kc: Identified and mapped a previously unknown intraplate fault zone, the Mountainville Fault (MF), responsible for the 2024 New Jersey earthquake.
Characterized the MF as an 'immature' fault zone lacking a breakthrough principal slip surface at the surface.
Demonstrated through laboratory experiments and slip tendency analysis that the MF is frictionally unstable under the current regional stress field.
识别并绘制了此前未知的板内断裂带——Mountainville断裂带（MF），它是2024年新泽西地震的致震断层。
将MF特征化为在表层缺乏贯通性主滑动面的“不成熟”断裂带。
通过室内实验和滑动趋势分析，证明了MF在当前区域应力场下处于摩擦不稳定状态。

LiDAR topographic analysis and field geological mapping of fault scarps and fracture networks.
Laboratory rock friction experiments on representative fault rocks.
Slip tendency computation using focal mechanism-resolved stress fields.

LiDAR地形分析和断层崖及裂缝网络的野外地质调查。

High-resolution LiDAR topographic data.
Field structural measurements of fractures and slickensides in the New Jersey Highlands.

Inferences about fluid-rock alterations at depth are based on surface samples and laboratory experiments rather than direct in-situ measurements.

对深部流体-岩石相互作用的推断基于地表样品和室内实验，而非直接的原位测量。

It investigates the causative fault, rupture characteristics, and stress field of the 2024 Mw4.8 New Jersey earthquake.
It maps and characterizes a previously unmapped fault zone in the basement rocks of the New Jersey Highlands.
