sum: Determining focal mechanisms for small-to-moderate earthquakes is vital for seismotectonics but limited by time-consuming manual polarity picking. This study presents an automated workflow integrating a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for P-wave first-motion polarity classification with the SKHASH inversion algorithm across Italy. Retrained on 483,597 vertical-component traces from the Italian INSTANCE dataset (augmented to ~2.42 million), the CNN is evaluated on an independent 2021–2025 Italian test set of 240,335 waveforms from 15,420 events. Applying a domain-tailored softmax probability threshold of 0.85 yields ~98% precision while retaining over 80% of polarities and recovering 44,315 previously unlabeled picks. Validated against 300 expert-reviewed Time Domain Moment Tensor (TDMT) solutions, 253 events pass quality criteria with a median Kagan angle of 28.7°, outperforming the California-trained baseline and proving effective for routine regional seismic monitoring.
针对中小地震震源机制测定耗时且易受主观影响的问题，本文提出结合卷积神经网络（CNN）P波初动极性分类与SKHASH反演的自动化流程。利用意大利INSTANCE数据集48.3万条波形重训练CNN，并在2021–2025年15,420个独立地震事件（24万条波形）上测试。引入0.85的概率阈值后，极性分……

t: Retrains a CNN (based on Ross et al., 2018) on Italian waveforms to classify P-wave first-motion polarities ('up', 'down', 'unknown'), filters predictions using a 0.85 softmax probability threshold, and inverts for focal mechanisms via SKHASH.
基于意大利波形重训练CNN分类P波初动极性，利用0.85概率阈值筛选高置信度极性，并通过SKHASH反演震源机制。

Trained on 483,597 balanced vertical traces (augmented to 2,417,985) from 39,507 INSTANCE events (2005–2020); tested on 240,335 traces from 15,420 Italian events (2021–2025); benchmarked against 300 TDMT focal mechanism solutions.
训练集为INSTANCE的48.3万条波形（增强至241.8万），测试集为15,420个事件的24万条波形，并与300个…

With a 0.85 probability threshold, polarity precision reaches 98.4% ('up') and 97.9% ('down'), recovering 44,315 unlabeled polarities. Against 253 valid TDMT events, SKHASH achieves a median Kagan angle of 28.7°, with 165 events below 40°.
0.85阈值下正负极性精度达98.4%和97.9%，恢复44,315个未标注极性；与TDMT对比的Kagan角中位数为2…

The workflow still requires analyst-reviewed earthquake locations and manual P-wave arrival picks, and focal mechanism accuracy remains limited by station geometry, takeoff-angle spread, and polarity imbalance.
目前仍依赖人工审阅的震源位置和手动拾取的P波到时，且解的稳定性受限于台站几何与极性失衡。

Demonstrates that region-specific CNN retraining combined with an inversion-tailored probability threshold recovers over 44,000 unlabeled polarities and enables robust automated focal mechanism catalogs across diverse Italian tectonic settings.
结合区域重训练CNN与面向反演需求的概率阈值策略，成功恢复超4.4万个未标注极性并验证了全意大利尺度的自动反演。

kc: Retrained the Ross et al. (2018) CNN architecture on the Italian INSTANCE dataset (CNN_INSTANCE), achieving ~98% polarity precision after thresholding and outperforming the California-trained baseline in recall.

Established a domain-driven operational probability threshold (p >= 0.85) that balances classification precision (~98%) with station azimuthal coverage (>80% retention), recovering 44,315 unlabeled polarities.
Integrated the CNN polarity classifier with the 3D-capable SKHASH focal mechanism inversion code and validated results against 300 TDMT solutions, achieving a median Kagan angle of 28.7°.
在意大利INSTANCE数据集上重训练了Ross等(2018)的CNN架构(CNN_INSTANCE)，阈值筛选后极性精度达~98%，召回率显著优于加州训练集模型。
建立了面向震源机制反演需求的操作概率阈值(p >= 0.85)，在保证~98%精度的同时保留超80%的数据覆盖，并从人工未标记波形中恢复了44,315个可靠极性。
将CNN极性分类器与支持3D震源变化的SKHASH反演算法结合，与300个TDMT矩张量解进行对比验证，获得28.7°的Kagan角中位数。
me: Adapted the CNN architecture of Ross et al. (2018) by simplifying the last two fully connected layers to 20 neurons each, training with batch size 50 and learning rate 0.001 for 50 epochs.
Balanced training classes ('up', 'down', 'unknown' with SNR < 3) via polarity flipping and 5x random time-window shifting (±0.5 s around P-arrival) on 6-second 1–20 Hz filtered vertical waveforms.
Filtered predicted polarities using a Softmax confidence threshold of 0.85 rather than maximizing F1-score, preserving azimuthal coverage for focal sphere constraint.
Computed focal mechanisms using SKHASH with the CIA1D velocity model, grid-searching depth (±2 km) and requiring >=10 polarities, takeoff angle <=90°, and azimuthal gap <=150°.
改进Ross等(2018)的CNN架构，将最后两个全连接层简化为各20个神经元，以批量大小50、学习率0.001训练50个周期。
对6秒长、1–20 Hz滤波的垂直分量波形采用极性翻转和5次随机时窗偏移(P波到时±0.5秒)进行数据增强，平衡正、负及未知(SNR<3)三类样本。
采用0.85的Softmax置信度概率阈值筛选极性，而非最大化F1分数，以保证震源球约束所需的台站方位角覆盖。
使用SKHASH算法和CIA1D速度模型计算震源机制，进行深度网格搜索(±2 km)，并施加至少10个极性、离源角<=90°及最大方位角空隙<=150°的质量约束。
de: Training set: 483,597 vertical-component traces (augmented to 2,417,985) from 39,507 Italian earthquakes (2005–2020) extracted from the INSTANCE dataset via SeisBench.
Testing set (ItalyTest): 240,335 vertical waveforms (epicentral distance <=200 km) from 15,420 earthquakes (ML 0–4.4, Jan 2021–Jan 2025) from the Italian Seismic Bulletin (BSI).
Benchmark validation: 300 inland Italian earthquakes (2014–2024, Mw <=4.5, depth <=20 km) with high-quality Time Domain Moment Tensor (TDMT) solutions.
训练集：通过SeisBench从INSTANCE数据集中提取的2005–2020年间39,507个意大利地震的483,597条垂直分量波形（增强后达2,417,985条）。
测试集(ItalyTest)：来自意大利地震公报(BSI)2021年1月至2025年1月间15,420个地震(ML 0–4.4)的240,335条垂直分量波形(震中距<=200 km)。
基准验证集：2014–2024年间300个具有高质量时间域矩张量(TDMT)解的意大利内陆地震(Mw <=4.5，深度<=20 km)。

The CNN does not distinguish between impulsive and emergent arrivals, forcing uniform weighting (1.0) in SKHASH.
Focal mechanism accuracy degrades when station geometry yields low takeoff-angle spread, fewer polarities, or high polarity class imbalance (>85%).
当前流程仍依赖人工审阅的地震震源位置和手动拾取的P波到时，尚未实现全流程端到端自动化。
CNN模型目前无法区分脉冲型(impulsive)和缓始型(emergent)初动，导致SKHASH反演中只能赋予统一权重(1.0)。
当台站几何分布导致离源角展布过小、可用极性数量较少或极性类别严重失衡(>85%)时，震源机制解的稳定性会下降。

tm.why: The study retrains and applies a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to automatically classify P-wave first-motion polarities from raw seismic waveforms.
The primary goal is automated determination of earthquake focal mechanisms using the SKHASH algorithm and comparing them against Time Domain Moment Tensor solutions.
The workflow aims to build automated, scalable focal mechanism catalogs for routine regional seismic monitoring in Italy.

ev.notes: Full 53-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF (including main text and Supplementary Material S1–S3) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study evaluates how tectonic geodetic strain accommodates earthquakes by comparing geodetic, geologic, and seismologic moment rates across the western United States (WUS). Utilizing datasets from the 2023 U.S. National Seismic Hazard Model (NSHM23-WUS), the authors implement a 'floating footprint' approach to calculate 'moment rate deviation' (MRD), representing the surplus or deficit of geodetic moment rate relative to geologic and seismologic rates. They find that high-strain plate boundary regions exhibit low MRD, indicating geodetic strain closely reflects the historical earthquake record. Conversely, low-strain intraplate regions show high MRD, where geodetic rates exceed geologic and seismologic estimates. This suggests geodetic data can reliably inform earthquake budgets and off-fault deformation in well-characterized interplate regions, but caution is required in intraplate settings.
本研究对比美西大地测量、地质和地震矩释放率以评估地震预算。利用NSHM23-WUS数据，通过滑动窗口方法计算矩释放率偏差。结果表明，高应变率的板块边界区域偏差较小，大地测量形变能很好反映地震记录；而低应变率的板内区域偏差较高。该成果为在地震危险性分析中引入大地测量形变提供了定量依据。

t: Comparing geodetic, geologic, and seismologic moment rates using a floating footprint approach and defining a 'moment rate deviation' (MRD) metric.

sum: This study investigates the mechanism of seismic rupture nucleation in semi-brittle oceanic shear zones, focusing on melt-mediated pore evolution. By analyzing the microstructures of deformed rocks from oceanic settings, the authors demonstrate how the interaction between melt migration and pore development facilitates localized damage and ductile fracturing. This melt-pore feedback lowers the shear strength of the shear zone, enabling seismic ruptures to nucleate and propagate under semi-brittle conditions near the brittle-ductile transition. The findings provide a new physical mechanism for microearthquakes observed along mid-ocean ridges and oceanic transform faults, highlighting the critical role of transient melt-rock interactions in governing deep seismicity.
本研究探讨了半脆性海洋剪切带中地震破裂成核的机制，重点关注熔体介导的孔隙演化。通过对海洋变形岩石的微观结构分析，研究阐明了熔体运移与孔隙发育之间的相互作用如何促进局部损伤和塑性破裂。这种熔体-孔隙反馈降低了剪切带的剪切强度，使地震破裂能够在脆韧性过渡带附近的半脆性条件下成核和传播。该研究为洋中脊和海……

sum: This study investigates the decadal-scale acceleration of aseismic slip along the northern Japan Trench prior to the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-oki earthquake. By inverting GNSS velocity fields from 1998 and 2009 using a mechanically motivated model, the authors show that this transient acceleration can be explained by creep-front propagation that progressively erodes heterogeneously locked asperities. The model results indicate that inferred asperities shrank from occupying 66% of their historical rupture areas in 1998 to 37% in 2009, representing a substantial expansion of aseismic creep. These shrinkage rates align with fracture-mechanics predictions for plausible coseismic stress drops, demonstrating that megathrust locking can evolve significantly over decadal timescales.

sum: This paper introduces GeoDMB, a contribution-aware dynamic multi-modal balance framework designed for natural-hazard detection and epicenter localization. Traditional multi-modal fusion methods use static weights, which fail when individual data streams degrade. GeoDMB addresses this by dynamically estimating per-modality reliability and cross-modal consistency to compute time-varying fusion weights, backed by a gating mechanism for graceful degradation. The authors also present GeoHazard-MM, a new multi-modal dataset aligning IRIS seismic, Sentinel-1 InSAR, and IMS infrasound data for 3,200 global events (2018–2024). Evaluated on this dataset, GeoDMB achieves an 88.9% detection F1 score and an 8.6 km localization error, demonstrating superior robustness against modality dropout compared to conventional fusion baselines.

sum: Procuring seismic waveforms and metadata across multiple heterogeneous datacenters requires domain expertise and repetitive effort. This paper presents TREMORS (Text Referenced Event Mapping and Output Renderer for Seismographs), an agentic framework that uses large language model (LLM) semantic parsing within a constrained LangGraph execution graph to automate seismic data acquisition. Using a 120-billion-parameter open-source LLM (gpt-oss:120b), TREMORS translates natural language prompts into a 28-field JSON schema that deterministically routes execution via ObsPy and FDSN web services. The system supports two primary branches: event-based acquisition (which cascades across regional and global datacenters, deduplicates catalogs, flattens nested FDSN metadata into NNSA kbcore-style Parquet tables, and downloads MiniSEED traces) and continuous waveform retrieval (which downloads bulk ambient noise streams and instrument responses from station manifests). TREMORS establishes a reproducible, modular blueprint for connecting scientific intent with distributed seismic archives.
针对跨多个异构数据中心获取地震波形和元数据繁琐且难以复现的问题，本文提出了TREMORS智能体框架。该方法结合大语言模型（gpt-oss:120b）语义解析与受约束的LangGraph执行图，将自然语言查询转化为包含28个字段的固定JSON模式，并调用ObsPy和FDSN接口执行确定性工作流。系统支……

sum: This paper presents a generalized matched filtering (GMF) workflow to enhance seismic data resolution and reflector clarity. The method approximates the source wavelet using Wiener inverse filtering, applies blue reflectivity modifications (3 dB/octave amplitude compensation and +pi/4 phase correction), and introduces a +pi/2 phase correction for alignment. Crucially, GMF modifies the conventional matched-filter equation to explicitly incorporate thin-layer responses, accounting for seismic wavelet differential effects. To prevent noise amplification, frequency-based regularization differentiation is integrated. Validated on synthetic and field datasets, GMF achieves wavelet compression and phase correction within the existing bandwidth, improving thin-bed resolution and reflector coherence without artificial spectral broadening.
本文提出了一种广义匹配滤波（GMF）工作流，用于提高地震数据分辨率和反射界面清晰度。该方法首先利用维纳逆滤波近似震源子波，进行蓝色反射率修正（3 dB/octave幅度补偿和+pi/4相位校正），并引入+pi/2相位校正以确保相位对齐。与传统针对孤立反射界面的匹配滤波不同，GMF通过修改滤波方程显式……

t: A generalized matched filtering (GMF) method that modifies the conventional matched-filter equation to explicitly incorporate thin-layer responses, combined with Wiener inverse filtering and frequency-based regularization.
一种修改传统匹配滤波方程以显式引入薄层响应的广义匹配滤波方法，结合了维纳逆滤波和频率正则化。
Stationary and non-stationary synthetic seismic datasets, along with a field seismic reflection dataset, used to evaluate resolution and coherence enhancement.
用于评估分辨率和相干性提升的平稳与非平稳合成地震数据集，以及一套实际野外反射地震数据集。
GMF successfully compresses wavelets and corrects phases, improving thin-bed resolution and reflector coherence within the available frequency bandwidth without artificial spectral broadening.
GMF成功压缩了子波并校正了相位，在现有带宽内提高了薄层分辨率和反射轴连续性，且无需人工谱拓宽。
The method relies on accurate source wavelet estimation and careful tuning of frequency-based regularization parameters to avoid noise amplification.
该方法依赖于准确的震源子波估算以及对频率正则化参数的仔细调节，以避免噪声放大。
Explicitly incorporating the thin-layer response into the matched-filter equation to account for differential seismic wavelet effects, stabilized by frequency-based regularization.
在匹配滤波方程中显式引入薄层响应以考虑子波差分效应，并通过频率正则化进行稳定。

Integrated frequency-based regularization to stabilize the filter and suppress noise amplification.
Demonstrated improved thin-bed resolution and reflector coherence on both synthetic and field seismic datasets without artificial spectral broadening.

Blue reflectivity modifications (3 dB/octave amplitude compensation and +pi/4 phase correction).
Generalized matched filtering (GMF) with thin-layer response modification.

Performance depends on the selection of regularization parameters to balance noise suppression and resolution enhancement.
需要准确估算震源子波，这在复杂介质中可能具有挑战性。
方法性能取决于正则化参数的选择，以平衡噪声抑制与分辨率提升。

sum: Crystalline shield basement is typically assumed to have low porosity and permeability, yet some fault zones sustain kilometer-scale fluid circulation. This study quantifies multiscale fault-zone connectivity at Kivetty, central Finland, by integrating legacy deep-borehole packer tests, geophysical logs, and a 27-day multi-borehole pumping test with new core logging, laboratory petrophysics, automated mineralogy (μ-XRF/AMICS), and X-ray computed tomography (XCT). Results show that the highest transmissivity occurs inside the fault core within breccia–open and altered–leached granitic rocks characterized by quartz depletion and biotite alteration. Core-plug porosity reaches 30% with up to 94% XCT pore connectivity, and permeability remains around 10^-13 m^2 even at 50 MPa confining pressure (~2 km depth). Pumping interference responses up to ~1 km away confirm kilometer-scale hydraulic connectivity. The novelty lies in directly linking pore-scale hydrothermal dissolution textures to reservoir-scale hydraulic connectivity, demonstrating that crystalline fault cores can act as transmissive conduits rather than seals.
结晶基底通常被认为孔渗性极低，但部分断层带能维持千米级流体循环。本研究综合芬兰中部Kivetty场址的历史深钻孔封隔器测试、地球物理测井、27天多钻孔抽水试验，以及新的岩心编录、实验室岩石物理测量、微区XRF矿物填图和X射线CT扫描（XCT），量化了多尺度断层连通性。结果表明，最高导水性位于断层核内……

t: Integrates legacy packer hydraulic tests, downhole geophysical logs, and a 27-day multi-borehole pumping test with new core petrofacies logging, laboratory petrophysics (including permeability up to 50 MPa), μ-XRF/AMICS mineralogy, and 3D X-ray computed tomography.
整合历史钻孔水力测试、测井、27天多井抽水试验与岩心重编录、岩石物理（含50 MPa渗透率）、微区矿物学及3D XCT。

294 interval hydraulic conductivity tests across six boreholes (KR1, KR3, KR4, KR5, KR12, KR13), KR5 geophysical logs and 27-day pumping interference records, plus 131 core specimens analyzed for petrophysics, mineralogy, and 3D XCT pore geometry.
6口钻孔294个区段水力测试、KR5测井与27天抽水干扰记录，以及131个岩心样品的岩石物理、矿物学与XCT数据。

Altered–leached fault-core granites show quartz depletion (down to ~2%), porosities up to 30%, XCT pore connectivity up to 94%, matrix permeability of ~10^-13 m^2 at 50 MPa, and kilometer-scale pumping responses (k ~ 10^-13 to 10^-12 m^2).
断层核蚀变淋滤岩石英降至~2%，孔隙度达30%，XCT连通率达94%，50 MPa下渗透率~10^-13 m^2，且具千…

Microstructural analyses (XCT, μ-XRF/AMICS) deliberately targeted altered/porous samples rather than statistically sampling the whole fault zone, and 11 μm XCT resolution under-resolves fine microporosity.
微观分析针对高孔蚀变样而非全断层统计抽样，且11 μm XCT分辨率低估了微孔隙。

Directly bridges micron-scale hydrothermal dissolution textures and pressure-insensitive 3D matrix pore networks to borehole permeability profiles and kilometer-scale hydraulic connectivity in crystalline shield basement.
将微米级热液溶蚀孔隙网络与钻孔渗透率剖面及结晶基底千米级水力连通直接跨尺度关联。

kc: Links pore-scale mineral dissolution textures and 3D XCT pore networks directly to borehole permeability profiles and kilometer-scale pumping interference in crystalline basement.

Demonstrates that altered–leached and breccia–open rocks within the fault core achieve porosities up to 30%, 94% pore connectivity, and permeabilities of ~10^-13 m^2 that persist at 50 MPa confining pressure.
Shows that coupled brittle fracturing and hydrothermal quartz leaching (episyenitization) transform crystalline fault cores into localized transmissive domains rather than hydraulic barriers.
Establishes petrophysical trends showing systematic decreases in bulk density, P-wave velocity, thermal conductivity, and electrical resistivity with increasing alteration and porosity.
将结晶基底中微米级矿物溶蚀结构及3D XCT孔隙网络与钻孔渗透率剖面和千米级抽水干扰响应直接关联。
证明断层核内的蚀变淋滤岩和张开角砾岩孔隙度高达30%，孔隙连通率达94%，且在50 MPa围压下仍保持约10^-13 m^2的高渗透率。
揭示脆性破裂与热液石英淋滤（去石英化）耦合可将结晶断层核转化为局部高导水域而非水力屏障。
建立了岩石物理规律，表明随着蚀变和孔隙度增加，体积密度、纵波速度、热导率和电阻率呈系统性下降。
me: Compilation and conversion of legacy double-packer constant-head and difference-flow hydraulic conductivity tests (294 intervals across 6 boreholes) and reanalysis of a 27-day pumping test using Thiem, Theis, and Cooper-Jacob solutions.
Macroscopic core re-logging into fault architecture domains (host block, damage zone, fault core) and seven rock textural classes.

Laboratory petrophysical measurements on 131 core specimens (density, helium/Archimedes porosity, ultrasonic P-wave velocity, electrical resistivity, thermal conductivity, magnetic susceptibility, and gas permeability at 1 to 50 MPa confining pressure).
High-resolution micro-XRF elemental mapping, AMICS automated mineralogy, optical thin-section petrography, and 3D X-ray micro-computed tomography (XCT) at 11 μm voxel size.
汇编并转换6个钻孔294个测试段的双封隔器定水头与差分流量水力传导测试数据，利用Thiem、Theis和Cooper-Jacob解析解重新分析27天抽水试验。
通过宏观岩心重新编录划分断层结构域（围岩、破碎带、断层核）及七类岩石结构相。
对131个岩心样品开展实验室岩石物理测量（密度、孔隙度、超声波纵波速度、电阻率、热导率、磁化率及1–50 MPa围压下的气体渗透率）。
利用微区XRF元素填图、AMICS自动矿物识别、薄片显微岩相学及11 μm体素分辨率的3D X射线显微CT（XCT）表征微观孔隙结构。
de: Legacy borehole dataset from Kivetty, Finland (1987–2000), including 294 interval hydraulic tests across boreholes KR1, KR3, KR4, KR5, KR12, and KR13, downhole logs in KR5, and a 27-day pumping test in KR5 (681.3–852.3 m MD) monitored in nearby boreholes up to 1 km away.

New laboratory dataset (2024–2025) of 131 cylindrical core specimens (103 cores and 28 plugs) tested for petrophysical properties, 4 plugs tested for permeability up to 50 MPa, 5 samples mapped with μ-XRF/AMICS, 6 thin sections, and 4 plugs scanned with 3D XCT.
芬兰Kivetty场址（1987–2000年）历史钻孔数据集，涵盖6口钻孔294个区段的水力测试、KR5综合测井，以及KR5下部（681.3–852.3 m）为期27天、在远达1 km邻孔进行水位监测的抽水干扰试验。
2024–2025年新采集的131个圆柱形岩心样品岩石物理数据集，包括4个岩心柱在1–50 MPa围压下的渗透率测试、5个样品的μ-XRF/AMICS填图、6个岩石薄片及4个岩心柱的3D XCT扫描。
li: Laboratory microstructural analyses (XCT, μ-XRF/AMICS, thin sections) were intentionally targeted at the most altered and porous samples rather than statistically representative of the entire fault zone.
XCT voxel resolution (11 μm) systematically under-resolves fine microporosity compared to helium pycnometry.
KR2 interval 5 showed a weak drawdown response (0.2–0.3 m) and relied on a methodologically different flow-difference transmissivity estimate, making its constraint at 1 km distance more uncertain.
实验室微观结构分析（XCT、μ-XRF/AMICS、薄片）有针对性地选择了蚀变和孔隙最发育的样品，不代表整个断层带的统计平均特征。
受限于11 μm的体素分辨率，XCT测得的孔隙度系统性低于氦气比重计测得的包含微孔的总连通孔隙度。
距离1 km处的KR2钻孔第5监测段水位降深响应较弱（0.2–0.3 m）且历史导水系数计算方法不同，其约束存在较大不确定性。

tm.why: The paper investigates fault-zone architecture (host block, damage zone, fault core), brittle deformation, hydrothermal alteration, and multiscale hydraulic permeability and connectivity in crystalline fault systems.
It characterizes the petrophysical, mineralogical, and hydraulic properties of Paleoproterozoic crystalline shield basement in Finland across core, borehole, and kilometer scales.

sum: Conventional wave function expansion methods struggle with non-closed, variable-elevation free boundaries and high-frequency series divergence when modeling stepped slopes. This study develops a path-based semi-analytical solution using the Uniform Theory of Diffraction (UTD) for plane SH-wave scattering by step-like rock slopes. By partitioning the slope into two semi-infinite ideal wedges (crest and toe), the model reconstructs the wavefield via global ray tracing, incorporating multiple reflections, first-order corner diffraction, and second-order coupled diffraction with a slope-diffraction correction. Validated against classical wedge/canyon solutions and LS-DYNA finite-element simulations, the method reveals strong frequency-selective interference and angle-dependent amplification. Grazing incidence focuses energy on the slope face (amplification factor up to 2.25 times the free field) while creating a leeward high-frequency shadow zone, whereas critical oblique incidence traps waves into sustained local resonance. Notably, maximum amplification shifts with incidence angle and does not always occur at the slope crest.
传统波函数展开法难以处理非闭合变高程自由边界及高频发散问题。本文基于一致性绕射理论（UTD）提出了阶梯状岩质边坡平面SH波散射的半解析解。通过将边坡分解为共享坡面的坡顶和坡脚两个半无限理想楔形域，结合广义镜像法、全局射线追踪及含斜率绕射修正的二阶耦合绕射项，重构了连续波场。经解析退化解、LS-DYN……

t: Decomposes a step-like slope into two wedge domains and applies a path-based Uniform Theory of Diffraction (UTD) formulation combining geometrical optics, first-order corner diffraction, and second-order coupled diffraction with a slope-diffraction correction.
将阶梯边坡分解为双楔形域，结合几何光学、一阶绕射及含斜率修正的二阶耦合UTD求解波场。

Evaluated using infinite wedge and trapezoidal canyon analytical benchmarks, a 3D LS-DYNA finite-element model with a 75 Hz Ricker wavelet, synthetic 1.5 Hz IFFT wavefields, and the 1940 El Centro record.
采用楔形与梯形峡谷解析基准、LS-DYNA三维有限元模型、Ricker子波及El Centro强震记录验证。

Under grazing incidence, displacement amplitude on steep slopes (γ ≥ 45°) reaches ~4.5 (2.25 times free-field 2.0), while destructive interference behind the toe drops amplitudes to ~1.0; El Centro spectral ratios reach 2.2.
掠入射下陡坡位移幅值达4.5（自由场的2.25倍），坡脚后方降至1.0以下，反应谱比最高达2.2。
Asymptotic UTD representations lose accuracy at low dimensionless frequencies (e.g., ka < 1, η = 0.141) and at observation points very close to the crest or toe corners.
在低无量纲频率（ka<1，η=0.141）及紧邻坡顶或坡脚拐角处，UTD渐近精度下降。
Eliminates non-closed variable-elevation boundary bottlenecks by combining wedge decomposition with second-order coupled UTD and slope-diffraction corrections for two-way crest-toe scattering.
通过双楔分解与含斜率修正的二阶耦合UTD，攻克了变高程非闭合自由边界的高频解析难题。

kc: Develops a unified path-based semi-analytical UTD formulation for SH-wave scattering across step-like slopes with non-coplanar stress-free boundaries.
Incorporates two-way crest-toe interaction via second-order coupled diffraction and a slope-diffraction correction to account for wavefront angular gradients.
Demonstrates that maximum topographic amplification shifts sensitively with incident angle and does not always occur at the slope crest.
提出了适用于非共面自由边界阶梯状边坡SH波散射的基于路径的一致性绕射理论（UTD）半解析公式。
引入二阶耦合绕射与斜率绕射修正项，准确刻画了坡顶与坡脚之间的双向耦合散射及波前角度梯度。
揭示了边坡最大地形放大位置随入射角敏感转移的规律，证明最大放大并非总是发生在坡顶。
me: Uniform Theory of Diffraction (UTD) partitioning the step-like slope into two semi-infinite wedge domains at the crest and toe.
Generalized image method and global ray tracing to construct free-field multiple reflections and boundary-reflected diffraction fields.
Second-order coupled diffraction formulation with a slope-diffraction coefficient to handle non-uniform cylindrical wavefronts hitting the second corner.
3D finite-element modeling in LS-DYNA (constrained to 2D anti-plane deformation) and IFFT for transient wavefield verification.
利用一致性绕射理论（UTD）将阶梯状边坡分解为坡顶和坡脚两个共享坡面的半无限理想楔形域。
采用广义镜像法和全局射线追踪构建自由场多次反射及边界反射绕射场。
引入含斜率绕射系数的二阶耦合绕射公式，处理到达第二拐角的非均匀柱面波前。
使用LS-DYNA三维有限元模型（约束为二维反平面变形）和逆快速傅里叶变换（IFFT）进行瞬态波场验证。
de: Degenerate analytical benchmarks against Macdonald's exact infinite wedge solution and classical wave-function expansion for a semi-infinite trapezoidal canyon.
LS-DYNA finite-element transient verification using a 75 Hz Ricker wavelet vertically incident on a 45° slope (174,600 solid elements).
Parametric frequency-domain steady-state and time-domain IFFT synthetic analyses across varying dimensionless frequencies (0 to 5), slope angles (15°–60°), and incidence angles (0°–90°).
Acceleration response spectral ratio analysis using the 1940 El Centro earthquake strong-motion record as bedrock input.
与Macdonald无限楔精确解及半无限梯形峡谷波函数展开解进行退化基准对比验证。
基于75 Hz Ricker子波垂直入射45°边坡的LS-DYNA有限元瞬态数值验证（174,600个实体单元）。
针对不同无量纲频率（0–5）、坡角（15°–60°）和入射角（0°–90°）的频域稳态与时域IFFT合成参数化分析。
以1940年El Centro地震强震记录作为基岩输入的加速度反应谱比分析。
li: Asymptotic accuracy degrades at low frequencies (e.g., ka < 1 or η = 0.141) and in the near field very close to the diffraction corners (small kr).
Higher-order multiple diffraction series beyond second order are truncated, causing minor discrepancies in weak late-time oscillations.
The analytical model assumes a 2D homogeneous, isotropic, linear elastic bedrock under plane anti-plane SH wave excitation.
在低频段（如 ka < 1 或 η = 0.141）以及紧邻绕射拐角的近场区域（小 kr），渐近解精度下降。
截断了二阶以上的高阶多次绕射级数，导致微弱的晚期尾波振荡存在细微偏差。
模型假设基岩为二维均匀、各向同性、线弹性介质，且仅考虑平面反平面SH波激励。

tm.why: The paper investigates local seismic topographic amplification, acceleration response spectra, and site effects of rock slopes under SH waves and strong motion records.
The study formulates an analytical model for broad-band wave scattering, multiple reflections, and first- and second-order coupled corner diffraction by step-like slope topography.
The authors develop a path-based semi-analytical wave propagation solver using the Uniform Theory of Diffraction and verify it with 3D finite-element simulations in LS-DYNA.

ev.notes: Full 42-page manuscript PDF (GJI advance article ggag350) including all equations, 16 figures, benchmarks, and references was analyzed.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution 3D seismic velocity model of the lithosphere beneath southeastern Tibet using full-waveform tomography (FWT). By exploiting regional earthquake waveforms, the authors image the complex crustal and upper mantle structures. The key finding is the clear evidence of dual crustal low-velocity zones (LVZs) at different depths within the crust. These dual LVZs suggest that crustal deformation in southeastern Tibet is governed by hybrid tectonic processes, combining both channel flow in the middle-to-lower crust and block-bounding strike-slip faulting. This model provides crucial constraints on the geodynamics of the Tibetan Plateau's outward expansion.
本研究利用全波形断层成像构建了藏东南岩石圈高分辨率三维速度模型。通过反演区域地震波形，研究清晰揭示了地壳内不同深度存在的双地壳低速带。这一特征表明藏东南地壳变形受控于混合构造过程，即中下地壳通道流与块体边界走滑断裂共同作用。该成果为理解青藏高原向外扩展的动力学机制提供了关键约束。

t: Full-waveform tomography utilizing 3D numerical wave simulation and adjoint methods to invert regional earthquake waveforms.
利用三维数值波动模拟和伴随方法对区域地震波形进行反演的全波形断层成像方法。
Three-component broadband seismic waveforms from regional earthquakes in southeastern Tibet.
来自藏东南区域地震的三分量宽频带地震波形数据。
Discovery of dual crustal low-velocity zones, supporting a hybrid tectonic model of channel flow and faulting.
发现双地壳低速带，支持通道流与断裂作用相结合的混合构造模型。
Potential resolution limits in peripheral areas due to uneven station distribution.
由于台站分布不均，边缘区域可能存在分辨率限制。
First clear imaging of dual crustal low-velocity zones in SE Tibet using full-waveform tomography.
首次利用全波形断层成像清晰刻画出藏东南的双地壳低速带。

kc: Constructs a high-resolution 3D lithospheric velocity model of southeastern Tibet using full-waveform tomography.
Provides seismic evidence for dual crustal low-velocity zones (LVZs) at different crustal depths.
Proposes a hybrid tectonic model combining channel flow and block-bounding faulting to explain the deformation of SE Tibet.
利用全波形断层成像构建了藏东南岩石圈的高分辨率三维速度模型。
提供了地壳不同深度存在双地壳低速带（LVZ）的地震学证据。
提出了结合通道流与块体边界断裂的混合构造模型，用以解释藏东南的变形机制。
me: Full-waveform tomography (FWT) / adjoint tomography.
3D numerical wave propagation and sensitivity kernel calculation.
Iterative inversion using regional earthquake waveforms.
全波形断层成像（FWT）/ 伴随断层成像。
三维数值波传播及敏感性核函数计算。
利用区域地震波形进行迭代反演。
de: Seismic waveform data from regional earthquakes recorded by dense broadband networks in southeastern Tibet.
由藏东南密集宽频带地震台网记录的区域地震波形数据。
li: Resolution may be limited in areas with sparse station coverage or low seismicity.
Trade-offs between velocity anomalies and anisotropy or attenuation are not fully explored.
在台网覆盖稀疏或地震活动性低的区域，分辨率可能受到限制。
速度异常与各向异性或衰减之间的权衡折衷尚未得到充分探讨。

tm.why: The paper uses full-waveform tomography to image the lithosphere of southeastern Tibet.
The paper investigates the crustal low-velocity zones and tectonic processes of southeastern Tibet.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, authors, and publication metadata from EPSL (2026) indicating full-waveform tomography of SE Tibet and dual crustal low-velocity zones.

sum: This study presents an improved template-based detection method for acoustic emissions (AEs) in laboratory rock friction experiments. To overcome noise challenges, the method utilizes a two-stage metric: coherency to detect weak AEs in noisy waveforms, and kurtosis to identify events located away from the template hypocenters. Applying this framework to a large-scale rock friction experiment, the authors detected 2.1 times more AE events than the standard STA/LTA technique. The resulting high-resolution catalog reveals accelerating foreshock activity, low b-values, and distinct pre-mainshock foreshock migration in some sequences, while highlighting significant variability in nucleation behaviors across different sequences. This method is highly effective for environments with time-varying, unknown noise spectra.
本文提出了一种改进的模板匹配声发射（AE）检测方法，用于实验室岩石摩擦实验。该方法采用双阶段指标：相干性用于提取噪声中的微弱AE信号，峭度用于检测偏离模板震源的事件。将该方法应用于大规模岩石摩擦实验数据，检测到的AE事件数量是传统STA/LTA方法的2.1倍。高分辨率目录揭示了主震前震群的加速活动、……

t: A template-based detection method using a two-stage metric: coherency to enhance weak signal detection, and kurtosis to identify events located away from template hypocenters.
一种基于双阶段指标的模板检测方法：利用相干性增强微弱信号检测，利用峭度识别偏离模板震源的事件。
Continuous acoustic emission waveform data recorded during a large-scale laboratory rock friction experiment.
在大规模实验室岩石摩擦实验期间记录的连续声发射波形数据。
Detected 2.1 times more AE events than the STA/LTA technique, revealing accelerating foreshock activity, low b-values, and variable pre-mainshock migration patterns.
检测到的声发射事件数量是STA/LTA方法的2.1倍，揭示了前震加速活动、低b值及多样化的震前迁移模式。
Relies on template availability and exhibits high variability in pre-mainshock behaviors, making universal nucleation patterns difficult to establish.
依赖于模板的可用性，且主震前行为表现出高度变异性，难以建立统一的成核模式。
Integrates coherency and kurtosis into a template-matching framework to detect weak events under time-varying, unknown noise conditions without prior spectral knowledge.
将相干性和峭度整合到模板匹配框架中，在噪声背景未知且随时间变化的情况下检测微弱事件。

kc: Developed a novel two-stage template-based detection method integrating coherency and kurtosis metrics for acoustic emissions.
Constructed a high-resolution AE catalog for a large-scale rock friction experiment, detecting 2.1 times more events than STA/LTA.
Documented spatiotemporal foreshock migration and acceleration preceding laboratory mainshocks, highlighting variability in nucleation processes.

构建了大规模岩石摩擦实验的高分辨率声发射目录，检测到的事件数量是传统STA/LTA方法的2.1倍。

me: Template-based event detection using a two-stage metric.
Coherency metric to enhance weak signal detection in noisy environments.
Kurtosis metric to complement coherency by detecting events spatially offset from template hypocenters.
基于双阶段指标的模板事件检测技术。
利用相干性指标增强噪声环境中的微弱信号检测。
利用峭度指标补充相干性，以检测空间上偏离模板震源的事件。
de: Continuous acoustic emission (AE) waveform data recorded during a large-scale rock friction experiment.
在大规模岩石摩擦实验期间记录的连续声发射（AE）波形数据。
li: The method's performance depends on the availability of initial high-quality templates.
Variability in foreshock behavior across different sequences makes generalizing nucleation models challenging.
该方法的性能依赖于初始高质量模板的可用性。
不同序列间前震行为的多样性使得推广统一的成核模型具有挑战性。

The method is applied to a large-scale rock friction experiment to study foreshock migration and nucleation processes.

sum: This paper presents a novel method to invert for the seismic attenuation (Q) of fault zone trapped waves using spectral decay analysis of amplitude ratios from events at varying propagation distances. The method is theoretically developed by analogy with Love waves and validated synthetically. Applying this method to dense portable arrays (B2 and B4) across the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake rupture reveals distinct damage zone properties. The 'horse tail' termination segment (array B4) exhibits high attenuation (Q ~ 30-40) and significant velocity reduction (~20-30%), whereas the central fault segment (array B2) shows lower attenuation (Q ~ 50-70) and velocity reduction (~10-15%). These findings suggest that horse-tail structures are more fragmented, fluid-rich, and compliant than central fault segments, providing a generalized framework for high-resolution near-fault attenuation imaging.
本文提出一种利用断层带陷波谱衰减分析反演断层破碎带衰减（Q值）的新方法。该方法类比Love波建立陷波衰减理论，并通过合成数据验证。应用于2019年Ridgecrest地震破裂带密集台阵发现，“马尾”端部构造具有高衰减（Q~30-40）和显著速度降低（20-30%），而中部断层衰减较低（Q~50-70……

t: A new inversion method for fault zone trapped wave attenuation (Q) using spectral decay analysis of amplitude ratios from events with varying propagation distances.
基于沿断层不同传播距离事件的振幅比谱衰减分析，反演断层带陷波衰减（Q值）的新方法。
Synthetic waveforms for validation, and real aftershock waveforms from dense portable arrays B2 and B4 across the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake rupture.
用于验证的合成波形，以及跨2019年Ridgecrest地震破裂带B2 and B4密集台阵记录的余震波形。
The Ridgecrest 'horse tail' segment (B4) has Q ~ 30-40 and 20-30% velocity reduction; the central segment (B2) has Q ~ 50-70 and 10-15% velocity reduction.
Ridgecrest“马尾”段（B4）Q约为30-40且速度降低20-30%；中部段（B2）Q约为50-70且速度降低1…
Requires dense portable arrays and high-precision microseismic catalogs to record high-quality fault zone trapped waves along the fault.
高度依赖沿断层部署的密集流动台阵以及高质量断层带陷波的观测。
First to develop a trapped wave attenuation theory analogous to Love waves and invert for fine-scale Q using spectral decay of amplitude ratios.
首次类比Love波建立断层陷波衰减理论，并通过振幅比谱衰减反演精细Q值结构。

kc: Developed a new theoretical framework and inversion method for fault zone trapped wave attenuation (Q) based on spectral decay analysis of amplitude ratios.
Quantified the fine-scale attenuation and velocity reduction structures of the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake rupture zone using dense portable arrays.
Demonstrated that the 'horse tail' fault termination is significantly more fragmented, fluid-rich, and compliant compared to the central fault segment.
开发了基于振幅比谱衰减分析的断层带陷波衰减（Q值）反演新理论框架与方法。
利用密集流动台阵定量解析了2019年Ridgecrest地震破裂带的微细观衰减与速度降低结构。
证实了断层端部的“马尾”构造相比于中部断层段更为破碎、富含流体且介质更为柔性。
me: Analogy of fault zone trapped waves with Love wave attenuation theory.
Spectral decay analysis of amplitude ratios from microearthquakes at varying propagation distances along the fault.
Inversion of attenuation curves to extract Q values and velocity reduction percentages.
将断层带陷波与Love波衰减理论进行类比。
对沿断层不同传播距离的微震事件进行振幅比谱衰减分析。
反演衰减曲线以提取Q值和波速降低百分比。
de: Theoretical analysis and synthetic modeling to validate the inversion feasibility.
Seismic waveform data from two dense portable arrays (B2 and B4) deployed across the ruptured fault segments of the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake.
High-precision microseismic catalogs of aftershocks.
用于验证反演可行性的理论分析与合成数据模拟。
跨2019年Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest地震破裂段部署的两个密集流动台阵（B2和B4）的地震波形数据。
高精度余震微震目录。
li: The method relies on the presence of high-quality fault zone trapped waves and dense array coverage along the fault.
Simplifications in the Love-wave analogy might not capture all 3D geometric complexities of real fault zones.
该方法依赖于高质量断层带陷波的存在以及沿断层的密集台阵覆盖。
类比Love波的简化模型可能无法完全捕获真实断层带的所有三维几何复杂性。

tm.why: The paper proposes a new method to invert for the attenuation parameter (Q) of fault zone trapped waves using spectral decay analysis.
The study applies the Q inversion method to investigate the physical properties and fragmentation of fault damage zones and horse-tail structures.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenALEX, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar.

sum: Standard full-waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from cycle skipping due to the oscillatory forward map. Data-driven reduced-order modeling (ROM) mitigates this by mapping back-scattering array measurements to an algebraic operator ROM matrix, but inverting this ROM for wave speed requires computationally expensive iterative wave-equation solves. This paper introduces ROMNet, a hybrid method that trains a causal temporal convolutional neural network to map the input operator ROM to a nearby matrix constructed on a fixed reference basis. This target matrix has an explicit, quadratic dependence on wave speed, allowing subsequent Gauss-Newton velocity estimation via simple numerical quadrature without solving the wave equation. Evaluated on random Gaussian media and the GeoFWI benchmark dataset (folds, faults, salt bodies), ROMNet outperforms end-to-end deep learning baselines (Fourier-DeepONet, InversionNet), reduces per-iteration optimization time from 19.4 s to 0.26 s on an A100 GPU, and provides effective initial models for out-of-distribution targets.
针对全波形反演（FWI）的周波跳跃及传统数据驱动降阶模型（ROM）反演计算昂贵的问题，本文提出混合反演方法ROMNet。该方法利用因果时间卷积神经网络，将由阵列后向散射数据直接构建的算子ROM矩阵映射为固定参考基下的目标矩阵。目标矩阵对波速呈显式二次依赖，使高斯-牛顿反演仅需数值积分而无需在每次迭代……

t: ROMNet trains a neural network to map the data-driven operator ROM matrix to a modified matrix evaluated on a fixed reference orthonormal basis, enabling fast Gauss-Newton velocity inversion via numerical quadrature without solving the wave equation.
训练神经网络将算子ROM映射至固定参考正交基下的矩阵，仅需数值积分即可通过高斯-牛顿法反演波速，无需正演求解波动方程。

Evaluated using 2D finite-difference acoustic simulations on 10,000 random Gaussian models, 49,476 shallow-water GeoFWI geological models (folds, faults, salt bodies), and out-of-distribution Camembert and BP-2004 salt benchmark models.
采用二维声波模拟测试了1万个随机高斯模型、49,476个GeoFWI地质模型（褶皱、断层、盐丘）及BP-2004分布外模…

ROMNet achieves lower L2 relative error than Fourier-DeepONet and InversionNet (0.0297 on Random Gaussians; 0.0358 overall on GeoFWI) while cutting optimization time per iteration from 19.4 s to 0.26 s on an NVIDIA A100 GPU.
L2相对误差低于对比深度学习方法（高斯0.0297，GeoFWI 0.0358），单次迭代时间从19.4秒降至0.26秒…
ROMNet cannot accurately reconstruct wave speeds far outside the training distribution on its own, though its predictions serve as effective initial guesses for full ROM inversion.
难以独立准确重建严重偏离训练分布的模型，但可作为传统ROM反演的优质初始模型。
Instead of learning the direct oscillatory data-to-velocity inverse map, ROMNet learns a transformation between ROM matrices that decouples the projection basis from the unknown wave speed.
不直接学习数据到速度的映射，而是学习ROM矩阵间的转换以解耦投影基对未知波速的隐式依赖。

kc: Introduces ROMNet, mapping a data-driven operator ROM to a matrix with explicit quadratic dependence on wave speed using a causal temporal convolutional network.
Eliminates PDE wave-equation solves during iterative Gauss-Newton inversion, reducing per-iteration wall time from 19.4 s to 0.26 s (~75x speedup).
Provides an analytical 3D asymptotic resolution analysis demonstrating that the target matrix resolves velocity perturbations down to the Abbe-Rayleigh wavelength limit.
Proposes a zero-time data-boosting regularization scheme that preserves the Toeplitz+Hankel block structure and positive definiteness of the mass matrix under 1% additive noise.
Demonstrates superior reconstruction accuracy over Fourier-DeepONet and InversionNet on both Random-Gaussian and GeoFWI benchmark datasets.
提出ROMNet方法，利用因果时间卷积网络将数据驱动算子ROM映射为对波速具有显式二次依赖的矩阵。
在迭代高斯-牛顿反演中消除了波动方程正演求解，将单次迭代时间从19.4秒降至0.26秒（加速约75倍）。
给出三维渐近分辨率解析分析，证明目标矩阵能以阿贝-瑞利波长极限分辨率恢复速度扰动。
提出零时刻数据增强正则化策略，在1%加性噪声下保持质量矩阵的Toeplitz+Hankel分块结构与正定性。
在随机高斯和GeoFWI基准数据集上证明了其反演精度优于Fourier-DeepONet和InversionNet。
me: Data-driven operator ROM computation via block-Cholesky factorization of the Toeplitz+Hankel mass matrix and stiffness matrix from array back-scattering data.
Causal temporal convolutional neural network (8 residual blocks, kernel size 3) with gating to map the upper-triangular ROM residual to windowed diagonals of the target matrix.
Two-stage inversion: Stage 1 single forward pass through the network, followed by Stage 2 matrix-free Gauss-Newton optimization with automatic differentiation and layer-peeling time windowing.
Zero-time diagonal boosting regularization of the mass and stiffness matrices to handle noisy waveform measurements.
基于阵列后向散射数据构建Toeplitz+Hankel质量矩阵与刚度矩阵，通过分块Cholesky分解计算数据驱动算子ROM。
采用带门控机制的因果时间卷积神经网络（8个残差块，核大小3），将ROM残差映射至目标矩阵的加窗对角块。
两阶段反演：第一阶段神经网络单次前向预测，第二阶段结合自动微分与剥层时间窗进行无矩阵高斯-牛顿优化。
通过对质量矩阵和刚度矩阵进行零时刻对角块增强正则化，处理含噪波形测量数据。
de: 2D finite-difference acoustic wave simulations with a 10-sensor linear surface array and a 6 Hz central frequency (4 Hz bandwidth) probing pulse.
Random Gaussians dataset: 10,000 synthetic 2D velocity models (7,000 train, 1,500 val, 1,500 test) plus out-of-distribution Camembert disk and bar inclusions.
GeoFWI shallow-water dataset: 49,476 2D geological models containing folds, faults, and salt bodies (36,000 train, 4,000 val, 9,476 test).
Out-of-distribution tests on two heavy-salt crops of the BP-2004 benchmark velocity model, using ROMNet output to initialize standard ROM inversion.
Noise robustness experiment on GeoFWI test media with 1% additive Gaussian noise.
二维有限差分声波数值模拟，采用顶部10传感器线性阵列及中心频率6 Hz（带宽4 Hz）的探测脉冲。
随机高斯数据集：10,000个二维合成速度模型（7,000训练、1,500验证、1,500测试）及分布外Camembert圆盘和条状异常体。
GeoFWI浅水数据集：49,476个包含褶皱、断层和盐丘的二维地质模型（36,000训练、4,000验证、9,476测试）。
BP-2004基准速度模型的两个高盐丘分布外切片测试，利用ROMNet输出作为传统ROM反演的初始模型。
在含1%加性高斯噪声的GeoFWI测试介质上进行抗噪稳健性实验。
li: Like other learning-based methods, ROMNet alone cannot accurately reconstruct velocity models that lie far outside the training distribution (e.g., BP-2004 heavy salt crops).
Mathematical analysis of the orthonormal projection basis V(x) in multi-dimensional heterogeneous media remains an unproven conjecture beyond 1D.
Strict convexity of the learned ROMNet objective function cannot be proved theoretically.
Block-Cholesky factorization of the mass matrix scales as O((nm)^3), requiring time-windowing and sub-aperture segmentation for large arrays or long durations.
与其他机器学习方法类似，单独使用ROMNet无法准确重建远离训练分布的速度模型（如BP-2004复杂盐丘）。
多维非均匀介质中正交投影基V(x)的数学性质在理论上尚未严格证明（仅有一维证明和数值验证）。
无法从理论上严格证明ROMNet目标函数的凸性。
质量矩阵分块Cholesky分解的计算复杂度为O((nm)^3)，对大阵列或长记录需进行时间加窗和子孔径分割。

tm.why: The paper develops an alternative approach to acoustic waveform inversion to mitigate cycle skipping in FWI and benchmarks against FWI datasets.
It uses a causal temporal convolutional neural network to map a data-driven reduced-order model matrix to a matrix with explicit quadratic dependence on wave speed.
The paper investigates the mathematical structure, Galerkin projection operators, and resolution limits of the acoustic wave inverse problem.

ev.notes: Full 34-page arXiv manuscript PDF was read and analyzed, including mathematical derivations, resolution analysis in Section 3.4.2, numerical benchmarks in Section 4, and implementation appendices.

sum: To investigate the interplay between magmatism, faulting, and hydrothermal circulation at ultraslow-spreading ridges, the authors deployed the first network of 15 broadband ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) around the Jøtul hydrothermal vent field on the Knipovich Ridge from July 2023 to August 2024. The network combined a 7-station long-term array (20 km aperture) and an 8-station short-term array (50 km aperture), achieving >83% data recovery. Nonlinear clock drifts (up to 1 s deviation from linearity) were corrected via polynomial fitting of daily ambient noise cross-correlation time shifts relative to a low-skew master OBS. Horizontal sensor orientations were determined for 14 stations using teleseismic Rayleigh-wave polarization analysis. Probabilistic power spectral densities reveal a seasonal double-frequency microseism peak at 2–3 s, sediment resonance noise at 0.2–0.4 s, and antenna vibrations at 0.16 s, while clear earthquake and air-gun waveforms demonstrate high utility for future imaging.
为研究超慢速扩张洋中脊的岩浆、断层与热液循环关系，作者于2023年7月至2024年8月在Knipovich洋中脊Jøtul热液场周围首次布设了由15台宽频带海底地震仪（OBS）组成的长期（7台）与短期（8台）观测网，数据回收率超83%。研究利用背景噪声互相关函数（CCF）结合多项式拟合校正了非线性钟……

t: Nonlinear clock drift is corrected in two steps using ambient noise cross-correlations (1–10 s) relative to master station JOT07, fitting residual deviations with polynomials. Horizontal orientations are estimated via Rayleigh-wave polarization analysis (10–40 mHz) using DLOPy.
以JOT07为主站计算1–10 s噪声互相关，分两步多项式拟合校正非线性钟差；用DLOPy分析瑞利波偏振估算水平方位。

Continuous passive seismic and hydrophone data from 15 broadband OBSs (7 long-term at 100 Hz for ~13 months; 8 short-term at 250 Hz for ~2.5 months) deployed at 1965–3598 m depth around Jøtul vent field, plus air-gun shots.
Jøtul热液区水深1965–3598 m处15台宽频带OBS（7台长期13个月，8台短期2.5个月）连续记录及气枪数据…

Data recovery reached 83.33% (seismometer) and 85.22% (hydrophone). Clock skews ranged from -0.103 s to -14.232 s with up to ~1 s nonlinear deviation, successfully reduced to ~0 s. Orientations were constrained for 14 stations with 4°–17° uncertainties.
地震计和水听器数据回收率达83.33%和85.22%；高达1 s的非线性钟差被校正至约0 s；测定了14台方位角。
No acoustic ranging was performed; onshore stations (170–230 km away) were too distant for clock calibration; JOT07's vertical channel failed; and several hydrophones malfunctioned during deployment.
未做声学定位；陆地台过远无法标定钟差；JOT07垂直分量损坏；部分水听器工作异常。

Provides the first broadband ocean-bottom seismometer dataset (both 20 km and 50 km aperture arrays) directly monitoring the newly discovered Jøtul hydrothermal vent field on the ultraslow-spreading Knipovich Ridge.
首次在超慢速扩张Knipovich洋中脊新发现的Jøtul热液场布设宽频带OBS观测网并提供经校正的数据集。

kc: Deployed and recovered the first 15-station broadband OBS network (long-term ~13 months, short-term ~2.5 months) centered on the Jøtul hydrothermal vent field, Knipovich Ridge.
Performed two-step linear and polynomial nonlinear clock drift corrections using daily ambient noise cross-correlations between OBS pairs.
Determined horizontal seismometer orientations and uncertainties for 14 OBS stations using teleseismic Rayleigh-wave polarization analysis (DLOPy).

Characterized the Arctic seafloor noise environment, identifying seasonal 2–3 s double-frequency microseisms, 0.2–0.4 s sediment layer resonances, a 10–30 s noise notch, and 0.16 s current-induced antenna vibrations.
在Knipovich洋中脊Jøtul热液喷口区首次布设并成功回收15台宽频带海底地震仪网络（长期约13个月，短期约2.5个月）。
利用OBS台站对的每日背景噪声互相关函数，实施了线性与多项式拟合两步法非线性钟差校正。
采用远震瑞利波偏振分析（DLOPy）测定了14个OBS台站的水平分量方位角及不确定度。
表征了研究区海底背景噪声特征，识别出2–3 s季节性双频微震、0.2–0.4 s沉积层共振噪声、10–30 s噪声凹槽及0.16 s洋流诱发的天线振动。
me: Seafloor position estimation assuming 2/3 of horizontal drift occurs during free-fall descent (0.5 m/s) vs. ascent (1.0 m/s).
Ambient noise cross-correlation functions (CCFs) calculated in 1–10 s band (250 s windows) to track daily clock drift relative to master station JOT07.
Two-step clock calibration: linear GPS skew removal followed by polynomial curve fitting of residual nonlinear time shifts.
Horizontal orientation estimation via Rayleigh-wave polarization cross-correlation (10–40 mHz) between vertical and Hilbert-transformed radial components using DLOPy.
Probabilistic power spectral density (PPSD) and spectrogram analysis using 1,800 s segments with 50% overlap.
假设2/3的水平漂移发生在自由落体下沉阶段（0.5 m/s，上浮速度为1.0 m/s），以此估算OBS海底位置。
在1–10 s频带（250 s时窗）计算背景噪声互相关函数（CCF），追踪相对于主台站JOT07的每日钟差。
两步法时钟校准：先基于GPS总偏差做线性校正，再对残余非线性时移进行多项式曲线拟合校正。
使用DLOPy软件包，通过10–40 mHz远震瑞利波垂直分量与希尔伯特变换径向分量的偏振互相关估算水平方位角。
利用50%重叠的1800 s时间段计算概率功率谱密度（PPSD）和时频谱以评估噪声水平。
de: Continuous passive seismic and hydrophone recordings from 7 long-term OBSs (JOT01–JOT07, 100 Hz, July 2023–August 2024) and 8 short-term OBSs (JOT08–JOT15, 250 Hz, June–August 2024) at depths of 1965–3598 m.
Continuous recordings from 2 onshore seismic stations on Svalbard (KBS, HSPB) tested as GPS-synchronized reference stations.
135 teleseismic earthquakes (Mw > 6.0) used for horizontal sensor orientation analysis.
Multi-channel active-source air-gun profiling lines (two 30 in3 GI guns fired every 6–7 s) acquired in June 2024.
水深1965–3598 m处7台长期OBS（JOT01–JOT07，100 Hz，2023年7月–2024年8月）和8台短期OBS（JOT08–JOT15，250 Hz，2024年6–8月）的连续三分量地震与水听器记录。
斯瓦尔巴群岛西岸2个陆地台站（KBS、HSPB）的连续记录，用于测试作为GPS同步主台站的可行性。
用于水平传感器方位角分析的135个Mw > 6.0远震事件。
2024年6月采集的多道主动源气枪测线信号（两支30立方英寸GI气枪，每6–7 s激发一次）。
li: Acoustic ranging of OBS seafloor locations was not conducted due to ship noise (>1000 m depth) and rough topography multipath, leaving seafloor coordinates as drift-based estimates.
Distance of 170–230 km to onshore Svalbard stations prevented reliable land-OBS noise cross-correlations, requiring an internal OBS (JOT07) with minor skew (-0.452 s) to serve as the reference clock.

Hardware issues reduced data completeness: JOT03 failed after 58 days, JOT05 battery died after 308 days, JOT07 vertical channel failed completely (precluding its orientation), and several hydrophones malfunctioned.
Low air-gun source volume (30 in3) and short shot intervals (6–7 s) limited active-source phase visibility (Pw, Pg, Pr) to short offsets only.
受限于科考船噪声（水深>1000 m）和崎岖地形多路径效应，未进行声学定位，OBS海底位置仅为基于漂移假设的估算值。
OBS网络距斯瓦尔巴陆地台站达170–230 km，互相关信噪比不足，只能选内部钟差最小的JOT07（-0.452 s）作为主钟。
仪器故障降低了数据完整性：JOT03工作58天后失效，JOT05电池在308天后耗尽，JOT07垂直分量完全无信号（导致无法测定其方位角），且多个水听器出现异常。
气枪源容量较小（30立方英寸）且激发间隔短（6–7 s），导致主动源震相（Pw、Pg、Pr）仅在近偏移距可见。

tm.why: The paper reports the deployment, data quality, nonlinear clock drift correction, and orientation estimation of a 15-station ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) network.
Ambient noise cross-correlation functions are calculated between station pairs to correct nonlinear clock drift and assess empirical Green's functions.
The OBS network was deployed to investigate hydrothermalism, magmatism, and faulting at the Jøtul vent field on the ultraslow-spreading Knipovich Ridge.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF from Seismica (volume 5.2, 2026) analyzed, including all 5 main sections, Table 1, and Figures 1–7.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution earthquake catalogue for the Tuscan Magmatic Province (Southern Tuscany, Italy) using data from the 1-year TEMPEST temporary deployment (30 stations) integrated with 30 permanent stations. Applying PhaseNet, Gaussian Mixture Model Association (GaMMA), NonLinLoc, EQcorrscan template matching, and scrtDD double-difference relocation, the authors detected and relocated 1944 high-quality events (Mw -0.2 to 2.8)—four times more than the regional INGV catalogue. Seismicity strongly clusters around the Larderello-Travale geothermal system and along a NW-SE belt toward Monte Amiata, originating near the roof of mid-crustal low-Vs magmatic zones (~10 km depth). Focal mechanisms indicate coexisting strike-slip and extensional regimes. A prominent 390-event swarm in Val d'Orcia exhibits upward migration at 200-600 m/h and hydraulic diffusivities of 10-20 m^2/s, interpreted via a fault-valve mechanism combining initial tectonic failure with subsequent fluid advection.
本研究整合了TEMPEST临时台网（30个台站）与30个固定台站的一年期连续波形数据，利用PhaseNet深度学习震相拾取、GaMMA关联、NonLinLoc定位、模板匹配（EQcorrscan）及双差重定位（scrtDD），构建了意大利托斯卡纳岩浆省的高分辨率地震目录。共精定位1944个高质量事件……

t: Combined PhaseNet picking, GaMMA phase association, NonLinLoc probabilistic location, EQcorrscan template matching, and scrtDD double-difference relocation, supplemented by SourceSpec magnitude estimation, DBSCAN clustering, and MTfit polarity focal mechanisms.
结合PhaseNet拾取、GaMMA关联、NonLinLoc定位、模板匹配及scrtDD双差重定位，辅以震级反演和震源机…

One year of continuous broadband waveforms (Sep 2020–Sep 2021) from 30 temporary TEMPEST stations and 30 permanent INGV stations (plus FR, Z3, GU networks), reducing interstation spacing from 40 to 25 km.
整合30个TEMPEST临时台站和30个固定台站的一年期连续宽频带波形，将台间距从40 km缩短至25 km。

Relocated 1944 earthquakes (Mw -0.2 to 2.8) with 420 m horizontal and 970 m vertical errors; the Val d'Orcia swarm (390 events) migrated upward at 200–600 m/h with hydraulic diffusivities of 10–20 m^2/s.
精定位1944个地震（Mw -0.2至2.8）；Val d'Orcia震群（390个事件）以200-600 m/h向上迁…

Catalogue resolution cannot fully quantify static stress transfer versus fluid diffusion, and low magnitudes with regional station spacing preclude full-waveform non-double-couple moment tensor inversions.
目录分辨率难以定量分离静态应力触发，且小震级和台站间距限制了非双力偶全波形矩张量反演。

First machine-learning-derived seismic catalogue for the Tuscan Magmatic Province, achieving a fourfold event increase and linking upward-migrating fault-valve swarms to mid-crustal low-velocity magmatic bodies.
首次构建托斯卡纳岩浆省机器学习地震目录，检测率提升四倍，揭示了中地壳岩浆体顶部的断层阀流体震群机制。

kc: Built a high-resolution catalogue of 1944 relocated earthquakes (Mw -0.2 to 2.8) in Southern Tuscany from Sep 2020 to Sep 2021, a fourfold increase over the routine INGV catalogue.
Identified 12 spatiotemporal seismic sequences using DBSCAN and retrieved 19 P-wave polarity focal mechanisms using Bayesian inversion (MTfit), showing mixed strike-slip and normal faulting.
Demonstrated a systematic underestimation of local magnitude (ML) relative to moment magnitude (Mw = 0.6 ML + 1.0) due to strong attenuation in low-Vs hydrothermal/magmatic crust.
Characterized the 390-event Val d'Orcia seismic swarm, estimating migration speeds of 200-600 m/h and hydraulic diffusivities of 10-20 m^2/s, proposing a three-phase fault-valve model.
构建了2020年9月至2021年9月南托斯卡纳1944个精定位地震（Mw -0.2至2.8）的高分辨率目录，事件数较INGV常规目录增加四倍。
利用DBSCAN识别出12个时空地震序列，并通过贝叶斯反演（MTfit）获得19个P波初动震源机制解，揭示了走滑与正断层作用的共存。
发现由于低速热液/岩浆地壳的强烈衰减，地方震级（ML）相对于矩震级存在系统性低估（Mw = 0.6 ML + 1.0）。
刻画了包含390个事件的Val d'Orcia震群，估算其迁移速度为200-600 m/h，水力扩散率为10-20 m²/s，提出了三阶段断层阀概念模型。
me: Deep-learning phase picking using PhaseNet trained on the Italian INSTANCE dataset via SeisBench.
Unsupervised probabilistic phase association using Gaussian Mixture Model Association (GaMMA).
Probabilistic absolute location using NonLinLoc with the equal-differential-time (EDT) formulation and station corrections.
Template matching with EQcorrscan and pick refinement via cross-correlation, followed by double-difference relocation using scrtDD.
Spectral moment magnitude (Mw) estimation using SourceSpec, spatiotemporal clustering with DBSCAN, Bayesian focal mechanism inversion with MTfit, and waveform similarity clustering with Clusty.
通过SeisBench调用在意大利INSTANCE数据集上训练的PhaseNet进行深度学习P/S波震相拾取。
使用高斯混合模型关联方法（GaMMA）进行无监督概率震相关联。
采用NonLinLoc结合等差时（EDT）方法和台站校正进行概率绝对定位。
利用EQcorrscan进行模板匹配和互相关震相微调，随后使用scrtDD进行双差相对重定位。
使用SourceSpec反演谱矩震级（Mw），结合DBSCAN时空聚类、MTfit贝叶斯震源机制反演及Clusty波形相似性聚类。
de: Continuous 100 Hz broadband seismic data from 30 temporary TEMPEST stations (network code 1K) deployed from September 2020 to September 2021.
Integrated waveform data from 30 permanent INGV stations (IV) and surrounding regional networks (FR, Z3, GU), reducing average interstation spacing from ~40 km to ~25 km.
Comparison against regional 3D ambient-noise shear-wave velocity (Vs) tomography models and surface heat-flow maps.
2020年9月至2021年9月期间部署的30个TEMPEST临时宽频带台站（台网代码1K）的100 Hz连续波形数据。
整合30个INGV固定台站（IV）及周边区域台网（FR、Z3、GU）数据，将平均台间距从约40 km缩小至25 km。
结合区域三维背景噪声剪切波速度（Vs）层析成像模型与地表热流分布图进行综合对比分析。
li: Despite temporary station densification (~25 km spacing), the regional network geometry and low event magnitudes prevent resolving non-double-couple (tensile) moment tensor components via full-waveform inversion.
Catalogue resolution is insufficient to quantitatively separate the contribution of static stress transfer from fluid pore-pressure diffusion during the initial swarm phases.
Relocation relied on a 1-D regional velocity model, although lateral velocity heterogeneities are prominent in the Tuscan Magmatic Province.
尽管加密了台网（间距约25 km），但区域台网几何结构和小震级限制了通过全波形反演解析非双力偶（张裂）矩张量分量的能力。
地震目录分辨率尚不足以定量区分震群初始阶段静态应力触发与流体孔隙压力扩散各自的贡献比例。
尽管托斯卡纳岩浆省存在显著的横向速度不均匀性，地震定位仍依赖于一维区域速度模型。

tm.why: The core contribution is a high-resolution seismic catalogue of 1944 relocated earthquakes in Southern Tuscany built using machine learning phase picking, probabilistic location, template matching, and double-difference relocation.
The study employs the deep-learning picker PhaseNet trained on INSTANCE and unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model phase association (GaMMA) to achieve a fourfold increase in event detections.
The paper investigates fluid-driven seismicity, calculating hydraulic diffusivities (10-20 m^2/s) and upward migration velocities (200-600 m/h) to propose a fault-valve mechanism.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF article from Geophysical Journal International (2026) was read and analyzed, including all 7 main-text figures, methodology, results, and discussion.

sum: This study investigates the 3-D isotropic shear-wave velocity and azimuthal anisotropy structure beneath Antarctica down to 600 km depth. The authors analyzed vertical-component recordings of 367 earthquakes at 120 seismic stations from 2005 to 2020. Using a reversible-jump Markov Chain Monte Carlo (rj-MCMC) waveform-fitting technique on fundamental and higher-mode Rayleigh waves (50–200 s), they obtained ~2,000 path-averaged 1-D VS profiles, which were then inverted via LSQR on a 2-D triangular grid. F-tests confirm that 2Ψ azimuthal anisotropy is statistically required only in the upper 300 km. The model reveals a sharp East-West dichotomy in both velocity and fast directions, estimating LAB depths of ~80 km in West Antarctica and 150–180 km in East Antarctica. Crucially, fast directions rotate between 75 km and 150 km depth within the East Antarctica craton, providing novel evidence for internal cratonic layering linked to its assembly history.
本研究利用2005至2020年间120个台站记录的367次地震垂直分量波形，构建了南极洲600公里深度内的三维SV波速度与方位各向异性模型。方法上采用跨维可逆跳马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（rj-MCMC）拟合50–200秒基阶和高阶瑞利波波形，获取约2000条路径平均一维速度剖面，再通过LSQR反演三维结构……

t: A transdimensional rj-MCMC waveform-fitting approach obtains path-averaged 1-D VS models from 50–200 s fundamental and higher-mode Rayleigh waves, which are then inverted via LSQR on a 2-D triangular grid for 3-D isotropic velocity and azimuthal anisotropy.
采用跨维rj-MCMC拟合基阶与高阶瑞利波波形获取路径一维VS模型，再用LSQR反演三维各向同性速度与方位各向异性。

Vertical-component Rayleigh waveforms (50–200 s) recorded between 2005 and 2020 across ~2,000 quality-controlled paths from 367 earthquakes (Mw 5.5–7.0, 30°–75° distance) at 120 seismic stations south of -40° latitude.

Isotropic anomalies range from +7% under EANT to -5% under WANT, yielding LAB depths of ~150–180 km and ~80 km, respectively. Significant 2Ψ azimuthal anisotropy exists only above 300 km, with fast axes rotating between 75 and 150 km in EANT.
东南极与西南极速度异常达+7%和-5%，LAB深约150–180 km和80 km；方位各向异性限于300 km内且东南…

Long surface-wave wavelengths limit horizontal resolution and deep sensitivity (>250–400 km), preventing confident interpretation of MTZ plume anomalies, while sparse stations degrade azimuthal coverage at EANT's edges.
长周期面波水平分辨率和深部（>250 km）灵敏度有限，难以确证地幔柱，且边缘区域方位覆盖较差。
First 3-D azimuthal anisotropy model of Antarctica down to 600 km using multimode Rayleigh waveform fitting, discovering vertical cratonic layering between 75 and 150 km depth in East Antarctica.
首次利用多阶瑞利波波形拟合建立南极600公里深三维方位各向异性模型，发现东南极克拉通内部分层。

kc: Constructed a new 3-D vertically polarized shear-wave velocity and azimuthal anisotropy model of Antarctica down to 600 km depth using fundamental and higher-mode Rayleigh waveforms.
Demonstrated via statistical F-tests that 2Ψ azimuthal anisotropy beneath Antarctica is required by the data only in the top 300 km, peaking at 100–200 km under East Antarctica.
Identified a vertical change in fast anisotropy directions between 75 km and 150 km depth within the East Antarctica craton, revealing lithospheric layering.
Estimated LAB depths (~80 km in WANT, 150–180 km in EANT) and showed that WANT shear-wave splitting is dominated by mantle anisotropy in the top 150 km.
利用基阶和高阶瑞利波波形构建了南极洲600公里深度内新的三维SV波速度和方位各向异性模型。
通过统计F检验固定2Ψ方位各向异性仅在300公里以上深度显著，并在东南极100–200公里处达到峰值。
发现在东南极克拉通内部75至150公里深度之间快波方向发生垂向变化，揭示了克拉通岩石圈分层结构。
估算了岩石圈-软流圈边界深度（西南极约80公里，东南极150–180公里），并证明西南极SKS分裂主要由顶部150公里地幔各向异性控制。
me: Transdimensional reversible-jump Markov Chain Monte Carlo (rj-MCMC) waveform fitting of fundamental and higher-mode Rayleigh waves in three frequency-time windows (5–20 mHz).
Linearized normal-mode perturbation theory using Mineos eigenfunctions and path-averaged CRUST1.0 + 3D2018_08Sv reference models.
Least-Squares (LSQR) tomographic inversion on a 300-km 2-D triangular grid for isotropic VS, 2Ψ, and 4Ψ azimuthal anisotropy terms.
L-curve regularization tuning and statistical F-tests using the resolution matrix trace to evaluate the significance of anisotropic parameters.
在三个时频窗口（5–20 mHz）内对基阶和高阶瑞利波应用跨维可逆跳马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（rj-MCMC）波形拟合。
基于Mineos本征函数以及CRUST1.0和3D2018_08Sv路径平均参考模型的线性化简正模微扰理论。
在300公里间距的二维三角形网格上进行最小二乘（LSQR）层析成像反演，求解各向同性VS及2Ψ、4Ψ方位各向异性项。
利用L曲线法选择正则化阻尼参数，并结合分辨率矩阵迹进行F检验以评估各向异性参数的统计显著性。
de: Vertical-component seismograms recorded between 2005 and 2020 from 120 permanent and temporary seismic stations south of -40° latitude (minimum interstation distance 75 km).
367 earthquakes (Mw 5.5–7.0, epicentral distance 30°–75°) from the GCMT catalog yielding ~2,000 quality-controlled source-receiver paths with ≥45% path length inside the Antarctic Circle.
Synthetic resolution experiments at 100, 150, 250, and 400 km depths, including isotropic checkerboard tests and isotropic-to-anisotropic trade-off inversions.
Comparison of model-predicted SKS splitting delay times and fast azimuths (integrated from 60 to 300 km depth) against compiled observed SKS splitting datasets.
2005至2020年间南纬40度以南120个永久和临时地震台站（最小台间距75公里）记录的垂直分量地震图。
GCMT目录中367个地震事件（Mw 5.5–7.0，震中距30°–75°），筛选出约2000条至少45%路径位于南极圈内的优质射线路径。
在100、150、250和400公里深度开展合成分辨率测试，包括各向同性检测板测试以及各向同性与各向异性参数折衷反演测试。
基于60至300公里深度各向异性模型预测SKS分裂延迟时间和快波方向，并与前人观测的SKS分裂数据集进行对比。
li: Long surface-wave wavelengths (periods 50–200 s) limit horizontal resolution (~1500 km spread for deep anomalies) and prevent constraining the top 50 km.
Uncertainties increase and resolution degrades below 250–400 km depth, preventing confident interpretation of mantle transition zone anomalies or a deep plume beneath Marie Byrd Land.
Azimuthal ray coverage is poor in the surrounding oceans and the northeastern edge of East Antarctica, reducing anisotropy reliability there.
长周期面波（50–200秒）限制了模型的水平分辨率，且无法有效约束浅部50公里内的结构。
250–400公里以下深度不确定性增大且分辨率下降，难以确切解释地幔转换带异常或玛丽伯德地下方的深部地幔柱。
周边海洋及东南极东北边缘的方位角射线覆盖较差，降低了这些区域方位各向异性结果的可靠性。

tm.why: The paper models 3-D variations in azimuthal seismic anisotropy beneath Antarctica down to 600 km depth and compares them with shear-wave splitting.
The study constructs a 3-D shear-wave velocity and azimuthal anisotropy tomographic model by inverting fundamental and higher-mode Rayleigh waveforms.
The results constrain the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary depth, East-West Antarctic dichotomy, and internal layering within the East Antarctica craton.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF from Seismica (2026) used, including all sections, equations, figures (Figs. 1-10), and tables (Tables 1-2).

sum: This study investigates the 4.5-year spatiotemporal evolution of postseismic deformation following the 2020 Mw 7.0 Samos earthquake using 15 campaign and 3 continuous GNSS stations across Western Anatolia. Pre-earthquake velocities are incorporated as Gaussian soft constraints, and coordinate time series are modeled using linear, logarithmic, exponential, and combined logarithmic–exponential functions over discrete relaxation-time grids. The preferred model for each station component is selected via the corrected Akaike Information Criterion (AICc), with robustness evaluated through 1000 Monte Carlo observation-perturbation simulations. Results reveal pronounced spatial heterogeneity: 18 linear, 9 logarithmic, 7 exponential, and 2 combined solutions. Passing nonlinear single-process models yield relaxation timescales of 182.6–730.5 days (median 438.3 days), while combined models include a 109.6-day logarithmic and 292.2–438.3-day exponential timescale. The study provides the first long-term geodetic constraints on the Samos postseismic field and demonstrates how objective statistical frameworks unlock sparse campaign GNSS data.
本研究利用西安纳托利亚15个流动站和3个连续GNSS站约4.5年的观测数据，刻画了2020年Mw 7.0萨摩斯地震的长期震后形变时空演化。方法上将震前速度作为高斯先验软约束，利用线性、对数、指数及组合函数在离散弛豫时间网格上进行拟合，结合修正赤池信息准则（AICc）优选模型，并通过1000次蒙特卡洛……

t: Postseismic GNSS time series are modeled using linear, logarithmic, exponential, and combined functions over discrete relaxation-time grids, incorporating Gaussian pre-earthquake velocity priors, AICc model selection, and 1000 Monte Carlo perturbation simulations.
结合震前速度高斯先验、离散弛豫时间网格、AICc模型优选及1000次蒙特卡洛模拟，拟合四种震后时间序列函数。

36 horizontal coordinate time series from 15 campaign (5–8 surveys each) and 3 continuous GNSS stations across Western Anatolia spanning ~4.5 years (2020–2025), processed with GAMIT/GLOBK in ITRF2014.
西安纳托利亚15个流动站（5-8期）和3个连续站约4.5年（2020-2025）的36条水平坐标时间序列。

AICc selected 18 linear, 9 logarithmic, 7 exponential, and 2 LOGEXP models. Seven filtered single-process solutions yielded relaxation times of 182.6–730.5 days (median 438.3 days); LOGEXP yielded 109.6-day logarithmic and 292.2–438.3-day exponential timescales.
优选出18个线性、9个对数、7个指数和2个组合模型；单过程弛豫时间为182.6–730.5天（中位数438.3天）。

Only one station (DIDI) lies south of the offshore rupture, and ~6-month campaign sampling cannot resolve rapid (<30-day) transients or uniquely separate physical mechanisms without physics-based modeling.
断层南侧仅1个站点，约6个月的流动采样无法解析30天内的快速瞬态信号或唯一区分物理机制。

First regional geodetic characterization of long-term (~4.5-year) postseismic deformation following the 2020 Mw 7.0 Samos earthquake by combining sparse campaign and continuous GNSS within a rigorous AICc/Monte Carlo framework.
首次融合流动与连续GNSS及AICc/蒙特卡洛统计框架，刻画2020年萨摩斯地震4.5年长期震后形变演化。

kc: Characterized the 4.5-year postseismic deformation field of the 2020 Mw 7.0 Samos earthquake using 15 campaign and 3 continuous GNSS stations.

Developed a conditioned statistical modeling framework integrating Gaussian pre-earthquake velocity priors, discrete relaxation-time grids, AICc model selection, and 1000 Monte Carlo perturbation simulations.
Constrained single-process postseismic relaxation times to 182.6–730.5 days (median 438.3 days) and dual-process timescales to ~110 days (logarithmic) and 292–438 days (exponential).
利用15个流动和3个连续GNSS站点刻画了2020年Mw 7.0萨摩斯地震后4.5年的震后形变场。
开发了结合震前速度高斯先验、离散弛豫时间网格、AICc模型优选和1000次蒙特卡洛扰动模拟的统计建模框架。
约束单过程震后弛豫时间为182.6–730.5天（中位数438.3天），双过程时间尺度约为110天（对数）和292–438天（指数）。
me: GAMIT/GLOBK processing of daily GNSS phase observations in ITRF2014 using 25 IGS reference stations.

Data conditioning with composite 7-day campaign epochs, minimum uncertainty floors (1.5 mm campaign, 0.5 mm cGNSS), conservative 5-sigma outlier down-weighting, and Gaussian pre-earthquake velocity priors.
Empirical time-series fitting of linear (LIN), logarithmic (LOG), exponential (EXP), and combined (LOGEXP) models over predefined discrete relaxation-time (τ) grids.
AICc-based model selection and parametric Monte Carlo simulation (1000 realizations) to evaluate model family stability.
结合25个IGS参考站，使用GAMIT/GLOBK处理日常GNSS相位观测数据并转换至ITRF2014框架。
数据预处理包括7天内流动观测合成、最小不确定度阈值（流动站1.5 mm，连续站0.5 mm）、保守5σ粗差降权及震前速度高斯先验约束。
在预定义离散弛豫时间（τ）网格上对线性（LIN）、对数（LOG）、指数（EXP）和组合（LOGEXP）经验模型进行时间序列拟合。
基于AICc准则进行模型优选，并利用参数化蒙特卡洛模拟（1000次实现）评估模型族稳定性。

每个流动站点进行了5至8期观测，其中18个站点中有17个在主震后前10天内获得了首次震后观测数据。
对3个连续GNSS站点（DIDI、IZMI、MNTS）进行周年和半周年谐波分析，以量化流动观测期次中的季节性混叠效应。
li: Severe network asymmetry due to the offshore rupture setting: 17 stations lie north of the epicenter on the hanging wall, and only one station (DIDI) is south on the footwall.
Sparse (~6-month) campaign temporal sampling suppresses rapidly decaying early transients (<30 days), causing 50% of time series to be favored by a simple linear model.
Empirical time-series models without physics-based forward modeling cannot uniquely separate afterslip, viscoelastic relaxation, and poroelastic rebound.
近海发震构造导致台网分布严重不对称：17个站点位于震中以北的上盘，仅1个站点（DIDI）位于南侧下盘。
稀疏的（约6个月）流动观测时间采样抑制了早期快速衰减的瞬态信号（<30天），导致50%的时间序列倾向于简单的线性模型。

tm.why: The study models long-term postseismic deformation, afterslip, and viscoelastic relaxation following the 2020 Mw 7.0 Samos earthquake using GNSS time series.
It characterizes regional crustal deformation, lithospheric relaxation timescales, and tectonic strain in the extensional Western Anatolia and Aegean region.
The modeling framework incorporates Gaussian velocity priors, AICc model selection, and 1000 Monte Carlo observation-perturbation simulations to quantify model stability and parameter uncertainties.

sum: This study reconstructs the source-to-sink system linking the southeastern Tibetan Plateau to the Yinggehai Basin using petrographic, heavy mineral, and zircon U-Pb geochronological data. The authors identify distinct provenance signatures for the Simao Block, Sichuan-Yunnan Block, and the Ailao Shan-Red River Fault Zone (ARRFZ). They show that detrital contribution from the Sichuan-Yunnan Block to the Red River increased significantly after 10.5 Ma, marking an eastward propagation of tectono-geomorphic uplift and constraining the ARRFZ's left-to-right strike-slip inversion to no later than 10.5 Ma.
本研究利用岩相学、重矿物和锆石U-Pb年代学数据，重建了连接青藏高原东南缘与莺歌海盆地的源-汇系统。研究识别了思茅地块、川滇地块和哀牢山-红河断裂带的特征物源标记。结果表明，10.5 Ma之后川滇地块向红河的碎屑输入显著增加，记录了构造地貌隆升向东的扩展，并将哀牢山-红河断裂带由左旋向右旋转变的时间……

t: Integration of petrographic thin-section analysis, heavy mineral assemblage characterization, and zircon U-Pb geochronology to characterize potential provenance regions.
结合岩相薄片分析、重矿物组合表征和锆石U-Pb年代学来表征潜在物源区。
Zircon age spectra and heavy mineral assemblages from the Simao Block, ARRFZ, and Sichuan-Yunnan Block, integrated with compiled datasets from Vietnam, Hainan, and Yinggehai Basin.
来自思茅地块、断裂带和川滇地块的锆石年龄与重矿物数据，及区域编译数据。
An increase in detrital contribution from the Sichuan-Yunnan Block after 10.5 Ma constrains the ARRFZ strike-slip inversion to no later than 10.5 Ma.
10.5 Ma后川滇地块碎屑输入增加，限制断裂带走滑反转不晚于10.5 Ma。
The temporal resolution of the strike-slip reversal constraint is limited by the availability and precision of sedimentary provenance records.
走滑反转的时间约束精度受限于沉积物源记录的时间分辨率。
Provides a tighter constraint (no later than 10.5 Ma) on the ARRFZ strike-slip reversal using a comprehensive source-to-sink provenance reconstruction.
通过全面的源-汇物源重建，为断裂带走滑反转提供了更精确的时间约束。

Constrained the timing of the Ailao Shan-Red River Fault Zone strike-slip reversal to no later than 10.5 Ma.
Characterized distinct zircon U-Pb age spectra and heavy mineral assemblages for three potential source areas.

将哀牢山-红河断裂带走滑反转的时间限制在不晚于10.5 Ma。

sum: This study investigates newly identified Rhyacian to Orosirian meta-igneous rocks (ca. 2.06–1.88 Ga) in the northwestern Gyeonggi Massif, South Korea, using zircon U-Pb-Hf isotopes and whole-rock geochemistry. The 2.06 Ga garnet-amphibole granite gneiss indicates an arc-related extensional regime. The 1.93 Ga tonalitic gneiss shows adakitic features and thickened crustal signatures (42–74 km), suggesting derivation from Archean mafic lower crust during syn-collisional thickening. The 1.88 Ga biotite granite gneiss reflects post-collisional extension. These successive magmatic events are geochemically and temporally comparable to the Liao-Ji Belt of the eastern North China Craton, suggesting a shared Paleoproterozoic tectonic history.
本研究利用锆石U-Pb-Hf同位素和全岩地球化学，对韩国京畿地块西北部新发现的古元古代（2.06-1.88 Ga）变质岩浆岩进行了研究。2.06 Ga的石榴石角闪花岗片麻岩指示弧后伸展背景；1.93 Ga的英云闪长片麻岩具有埃达克质特征和地壳增厚信号（42-74 km），源于碰撞阶段增厚的太古宙基性……

t: Zircon U-Pb-Hf isotopic analysis combined with whole-rock geochemistry to determine crystallization ages, source characteristics, and petrogenesis.
结合锆石U-Pb-Hf同位素分析与全岩地球化学，确定结晶年龄、源区特征及岩石成因。
Newly identified Paleoproterozoic meta-igneous rocks (garnet-bearing amphibole granite gneiss, biotite granite gneiss, and tonalite gneiss) from Soyeonpyeongdo and Ganghwado, South Korea.
来自韩国小延坪岛和江华岛新识别的古元古代变质岩浆岩（花岗片麻岩和英云闪长片麻岩）。
Identified magmatic events at 2.06 Ga (arc-related), 1.93 Ga (syn-collisional, 42-74 km crustal thickness), and 1.88 Ga (post-collisional), correlating the Gyeonggi Massif with the Liao-Ji Belt.
确定了2.06、1.93和1.88 Ga的岩浆事件，揭示了地壳增厚过程，并与华北克拉通辽吉带进行了对比。
Geochemical and isotopic data are restricted to the northwestern part of the Gyeonggi Massif, requiring broader regional validation.
地球化学和同位素数据局限于京畿地块西北部，需要更广泛的区域验证。
First identification of Rhyacian-Orosirian orthogneisses in this region, providing direct evidence for a Paleoproterozoic tectonic link to the North China Craton.
首次在该区域识别出古元古代正片麻岩，为与华北克拉通的构造联系提供了直接证据。

Reconstructed a three-stage Paleoproterozoic tectono-magmatic evolution (2.06 Ga, 1.93 Ga, and 1.88 Ga).
Correlated the tectonic evolution of the Gyeonggi Massif with the Liao-Ji Belt of the North China Craton.
识别并定年了京畿地块西北部的古元古代（Rhyacian至Orosirian期）正片麻岩。
重建了古元古代三阶段构造岩浆演化历史（2.06 Ga、1.93 Ga和1.88 Ga）。

sum: This study investigates the distribution of carbon within Mercury during its early evolution. Through high-pressure, high-temperature metal-silicate partitioning experiments under varying oxygen fugacities, the authors demonstrate that carbon becomes significantly less siderophile under the extremely reducing conditions relevant to Mercury. This behavior promotes carbon retention in the silicate magma ocean, leading to the flotation of a primary graphite crust. Thermodynamic modeling indicates that oxygen fugacities between IW-6 and IW-6.5 best match the graphite crust thickness observed by the MESSENGER spacecraft. Consequently, Mercury's core remains carbon-poor (<5000 µg/g), suggesting its density deficit is driven by other light elements like silicon and sulfur. The novelty lies in experimentally constraining carbon's redox-dependent behavior under Mercury-like reducing conditions to link its surface geology with its deep internal structure.
本研究通过高温高压实验与热力学模拟，探讨了水星早期演化中的碳分布。结果表明，在水星极度还原环境（IW-6至IW-6.5）下，碳的亲铁性显著降低，使其保留在岩浆洋中并结晶漂浮形成富石墨地壳。这导致水星地核贫碳（<5000 µg/g），其密度亏损主要由硅和硫控制。该研究首次将水星表面特征与深部化学结构相……

t: High-pressure, high-temperature metal-silicate partitioning experiments combined with thermodynamic modeling of carbon distribution.

Experimental partitioning data under varying oxygen fugacities and MESSENGER observations of Mercury's crust.
不同氧逸度下的实验分配数据以及MESSENGER探测器的水星地壳观测数据。
Oxygen fugacities of IW-6 to IW-6.5 explain the graphite crust thickness, leaving the core carbon-poor (<5000 µg/g).

Linking Mercury's extreme reduction to both its surface graphite crust and internal core-mantle chemical structure.

sum: Volcanic eruption forecasting typically emphasizes predictive accuracy while overlooking socio-economic utility. This study introduces a Potential Economic Value (PEV) framework to volcanology, evaluating forecast utility by balancing the short-term disruption costs of precautionary actions (false alarms) against avoidable catastrophic losses (missed eruptions). The authors apply PEV to out-of-sample eruption probability forecasts derived from machine-learning (ML) models and RSAM using continuous seismic data across five volcanoes: Whakaari, Ontake, Ruapehu, Copahue, and Bezymianny. Retrospective and scenario analyses reveal that avoidable human and economic losses could be reduced by 30–90% (saving 154–300 million USD), despite generating numerous false alarms. Furthermore, generalized multi-volcano transfer-learning models outperform volcano-tailored models and raw RSAM. The novelty lies in establishing a dimensionless cost–loss decision-support framework for volcano seismology, proving that precautionary thresholds that minimize missed eruptions yield robust net socio-economic benefits across orders-of-magnitude cost uncertainty.
本研究将潜在经济价值（PEV）框架引入火山学，通过权衡预防性措施（误报）的短期成本与可避免的灾难性损失（漏报）来评估火山喷发预测的实用性。研究利用五个火山（Whakaari、Ontake、Ruapehu、Copahue和Bezymianny）的连续地震数据，对基于机器学习和实时地震振幅（RSAM）的……

t: The Potential Economic Value (PEV) framework evaluates continuous seismic ML eruption probability forecasts by comparing expected costs of binary precautionary actions at threshold τ against no-forecast and perfect-forecast baselines using false-alarm costs and missed-eruption losses.
采用潜在经济价值（PEV）框架，通过对比二元预防措施与无预测和完美预测基线的期望成本，评估连续地震机器学习喷发概率预测。

Out-of-sample continuous eruption likelihood time series (10-minute sampling) derived from 96-hour seismic windows using a 24-volcano ML model and RSAM, tested across five volcanoes: Whakaari, Ontake, Ruapehu, Copahue, and Bezymianny.

Retrospective and scenario analyses show ML forecasts reduce preventable losses by 30–90% (saving 162–300 M USD). Generalized multi-volcano models achieve the highest PEV (0.38–0.75) and savings across Whakaari, Bezymianny, and Copahue.

The cost model simplifies outcomes as binary with time-invariant parameters, excluding long-term economic impacts, non-monetary psychological trauma, and unknown a priori optimal operational thresholds.

Introduces the dimensionless Potential Economic Value (PEV) cost-loss framework to volcano seismology, quantifying the socio-economic trade-off between frequent false alarms and catastrophic missed eruptions across diverse volcanic settings.
首次将无量纲PEV成本-损失框架引入火山地震学，量化评估不同火山背景下频繁误报与灾难性漏报间的社会经济权衡。

kc: Introduces the dimensionless Potential Economic Value (PEV) cost-loss framework to evaluate volcanic eruption forecasts based on socio-economic utility rather than pure predictive accuracy.
Demonstrates through retrospective analysis of Whakaari (2019) and Ontake (2014) that seismic ML forecasts could have reduced catastrophic losses by 30–90% despite frequent false alarms.
Shows that generalized multi-volcano transfer-learning seismic models achieve higher PEV and economic savings (189–300 M USD) than volcano-tailored ML models or RSAM benchmarks.
Proposes a practical threshold-and-hold post-processing scheme that reduces active warning time to 7.2% at Whakaari while preserving early warning capability to mitigate alert fatigue.
引入无量纲的潜在经济价值（PEV）成本-损失框架，从社会经济效用而非单纯预测准确性的角度评估火山喷发预测。
通过对Whakaari（2019）和Ontake（2014）的回顾性分析证明，尽管存在频繁误报，地震机器学习预测仍可将灾难性损失降低30–90%。
证明通用多火山迁移学习地震模型比单火山定制模型或RSAM基准具有更高的PEV和经济节省（1.89亿–3亿美元）。
提出了一种实用的“阈值保持”后处理方案，将Whakaari的有效预警时间比例降至7.2%，在保留早期预警能力的同时缓解了警报疲劳。
me: Potential Economic Value (PEV) cost-loss formulation comparing forecast-driven binary precautionary actions against no-forecast and perfect-forecast baselines.

Out-of-sample (pseudo-prospective) evaluation of continuous eruption likelihood time series generated by tailored and transfer-learning ML models trained on 96-hour seismic windows to predict eruptions within 48 hours.
Monte Carlo ensemble sensitivity analysis varying false-alarm costs (C) and missed-eruption losses (L) across several orders of magnitude.
Threshold-and-hold alert smoothing post-processing to convert high-frequency seismic ML probability fluctuations into actionable operational warning periods.
潜在经济价值（PEV）成本-损失公式，将预测驱动的二元预防行动与无预测和完美预测基线进行比较。
对基于96小时地震窗口训练的定制和迁移学习机器学习模型生成的连续喷发可能性时间序列进行样本外（伪前瞻性）评估，以预测48小时内的喷发。
蒙特卡洛集合敏感性分析，在几个数量级上改变误报成本（C）和漏报损失（L）。
阈值保持警报平滑后处理，将高频地震机器学习概率波动转化为可操作的业务预警期。

Retrospective loss evaluation using documented casualties and economic impacts from the 2019 Whakaari (New Zealand) and 2014 Ontake (Japan) fatal eruptions.
Hypothetical high-impact stress-test scenarios at Ruapehu (ski-field lahar exposure), Copahue (community evacuation logistics), and Bezymianny (aviation ash routing).
来自五个火山（Whakaari、Ontake、Ruapehu、Copahue和Bezymianny）的连续地震监测数据（以10分钟间隔采样的RSAM和提取的时间序列特征）。
利用2019年新西兰Whakaari和2014年日本Ontake致命喷发的记录伤亡和经济影响数据进行回顾性损失评估。
在Ruapehu（滑雪场火山泥流暴露）、Copahue（社区疏散后勤）和Bezymianny（航空火山灰航线调整）开展的假设性高影响压力测试情景。
