Focuses solely on direct, short-term preventable economic impacts, excluding long-term infrastructure reconstruction, equilibrium effects, and non-monetary psychological trauma.
Uses simplified binary outcomes and time-invariant scalar loss parameters rather than dynamic real-time or seasonal exposure weighting.
最大化期望价值的决策阈值只能通过事后回顾确定，在业务化场景中无法事先得知。
仅关注可直接预防的短期经济影响，未包含长期基础设施重建、均衡效应以及非货币性的心理创伤。
采用简化的二元结果和时不变标量损失参数，而非动态实时或季节性暴露加权。

The forecasts evaluated are generated by tailored and transfer-learning machine-learning models trained on continuous seismic time series features.

sum: This study investigates how rupture dynamics are influenced by the aspect ratio of rectangular PMMA velocity-weakening (VW) asperities and their confinement by Teflon velocity-strengthening (VS) patches. Using laboratory earthquake experiments, the authors found that increasing confinement (by reducing free surfaces) or increasing the VW asperity aspect ratio stabilizes fault slip, requiring higher normal stress to transition from aseismic to seismic slip. These geometric and boundary conditions also reduce seismic moment (M0) and increase corner frequency (fc), both controlled primarily by the shorter dimension of the VW asperity. High-aspect-ratio asperities exhibit more unidirectional rupture propagation and are more prone to erosion by surrounding VS regions, whereas square asperities show more complex ruptures. This work highlights the critical role of asperity geometry and surrounding stability in controlling earthquake nucleation, propagation, and source characteristics.
本文通过实验室地震实验，研究了速度弱化微凸体的长宽比及边界约束对破裂动力学的影响。结果表明，增加约束或提高长宽比会稳定断层滑动，提高无震-有震转变所需的法向应力。高约束和高长宽比还会降低地震矩并提高拐角频率，两者主要受微凸体较短维度控制。该研究揭示了微凸体几何与边界条件对震源特性的控制作用。

t: Laboratory friction experiments using PMMA velocity-weakening asperities surrounded by Teflon velocity-strengthening patches, combined with acoustic emission analysis to estimate seismic source parameters.
采用特氟龙速度强化斑块包围PMMA速度弱化微凸体的实验室摩擦实验，结合声发射分析估算震源参数。
Acoustic emission waveforms and mechanical slip data recorded during laboratory shear experiments under varying normal stresses and asperity aspect ratios.

Increased confinement and high aspect ratios reduced seismic moment and increased corner frequency, with both parameters primarily controlled by the shorter dimension of the velocity-weakening asperity.

Simplified laboratory materials (PMMA and Teflon) and planar fault geometries may not fully represent complex natural fault zones.

Systematically isolating the effects of asperity aspect ratio and free-surface confinement on rupture dynamics and radiated seismic wave characteristics in a controlled laboratory setting.

sum: Using 19 years of land and ocean-bottom (S-net) waveform data along the Tohoku-Hokkaido megathrust, this study applies a network correlation coefficient (NCC) hypocenter-centroid relative relocation method to 45 repeating earthquake sequences (2,435 events). The authors introduce a quantitative Rupture Similarity Index (RSI) to evaluate rupture repeatability across azimuth, dimension, hypocenter, and centroid locations. Results show ~80% of sequences have statistically significant spatial clustering of hypocenters and centroids, 60% host colocated large-small earthquake pairs (<100 m separation), and ~45% of events exhibit strong downdip rupture directivity. Crucially, while rupture directivity often repeats, full repeatability across all four attributes is exceedingly rare. To explain these observations, the authors propose a hierarchical patch model unifying 'hypocenter repeaters' (similar initiation) and 'centroid repeaters' (similar termination), highlighting multiscale geometric controls and intrinsic limits on earthquake predictability.

19 years (2004–2022) of seismic waveforms from dense land-based networks (Hi-net) and 150 ocean-bottom seismometers (S-net) along the Tohoku-Hokkaido megathrust, resolving 45 sequences with 2,435 earthquakes.
东北-北海道俯冲带19年的陆地（Hi-net）和150个海底（S-net）台站波形，解析45个序列共2435个地震。

Proposed a unifying conceptual framework of 'hierarchical repeaters' linking hypocenter repeaters and centroid repeaters via multiscale fault geometry and fracture energy.

证实了普遍存在的层级破裂增长（60%序列存在共位置大小地震对）、强烈的下倾方向性（约45%事件）以及极少见的完全破裂重复。

me: HypoDD double-difference relocation using cross-correlation differential travel times with PhaseNet and JMA picks.
Network Correlation Coefficient (NCC) joint hypocenter-centroid relative relocation using M < 3.2 events as single hypocentroid anchors.
Physics-based repeater identification using magnitude difference (MD <= 0.3) and horizontal centroid separation (<= 0.8 times source radius assuming 38 MPa stress drop).
Nearest-Neighbor Test (NNT), circular statistics (Rayleigh test), Rupture Similarity Index (RSI), and Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.

Dense land-based borehole stations (NIED Hi-net, JMA, universities) combined with 150 cabled ocean-bottom seismometers (S-net).

It proposes a multiscale hierarchical fault patch model with variable fracture energy embedded in a creeping background to explain repeater behavior.

sum: Predicting whether injection-triggered ruptures arrest or cascade across multiple faults is vital for managing induced seismicity. In the 2011 Prague, Oklahoma sequence, how rupture transferred to the unfavorably oriented third fault remained unresolved. This study develops a 2D coupled hydromechanical model combining adaptive finite-volume pore-pressure diffusion along high-diffusivity fault corridors, rate-and-state friction, Galerkin boundary-element elastic interactions, and local undrained fault-zone poroelastic feedback. Constrained by observations from the Wilzetta fault system, the model reproduces nearly 18 years of hydraulic preparation and the three-event cascade (Mw 4.9, 5.7, 4.8). While the second event loads the third fault favorably in shear, it also increases normal compression; dynamic rupture occurs only when undrained poroelastic feedback (effective coupling >= 0.75) buffers this clamping. Operational tests show source-fault distance and net injection rate govern initiation timing, while surrounding fault prestress and geometry dictate post-sequence network escalation.
本研究针对2011年俄克拉荷马州布拉格注水诱发地震序列中破裂如何传递至第三条断层的难题，构建了耦合自适应有限体积孔隙压力扩散、速率-状态摩擦、Galerkin边界元弹性相互作用及局部不排水断层带孔隙弹性反馈的二维水力-力学模型。模型重现了近18年的水力积累及完整三次主震序列（Mw 4.9、5.7、4……

t: Couples 2D adaptive finite-volume pore-pressure diffusion along high-diffusivity fault corridors with rate-and-state friction, Galerkin boundary-element stress interactions, and a local undrained fault-zone poroelastic response buffering slip-induced normal stress.
耦合自适应有限体积孔隙压力扩散、速率-状态摩擦、Galerkin边界元应力核与不排水断层带孔隙弹性响应。
Observation-constrained 3-fault and 27-fault networks of the Wilzetta fault system in Prague, Oklahoma, forced by 18 years of historical wastewater injection records from nearby disposal wells.
受观测约束的Wilzetta断层系3断层和27断层网络，输入近18年历史注水井记录数据。

Reproduces the three-event cascade (Mw 4.9, 5.7, 4.8) after 17.96 years of injection, with interevent delays of 0.96 and 1.95 days; Fault 3 ruptures dynamically only when poroelastic coupling beta_eff >= 0.75.
重现注水17.96年后的三次地震（Mw 4.9、5.7、4.8）及发震间隔；仅当孔隙弹性耦合≥0.75时断层3发生动态破…

Uses a 2D plane-strain model with fixed hydraulic diffusivities and local undrained poroelasticity without modeling subsequent diffusion of slip-induced pore pressure or coseismic permeability evolution.
采用固定水力扩散率的二维模型，未模拟滑动诱发孔隙压力的后续扩散或同震渗透率动态演化。

Identifies undrained fault-zone poroelastic feedback as the missing physical mechanism enabling rupture transfer to the third fault in the 2011 Prague sequence, establishing two-way hydromechanical coupling.
揭示不排水断层带孔隙弹性反馈是促成2011年布拉格序列第三条断层破裂的关键双向水力力学耦合机制。

kc: Reproduced the complete 18-year hydraulic buildup and three-event 2011 Prague earthquake cascade (timing, magnitudes, rupture lengths) in a physics-based fault-network model.
Demonstrated that undrained fault-zone poroelastic feedback (beta_eff >= 0.75) is required to buffer coseismic normal-stress clamping from Fault 2 and trigger dynamic rupture on Fault 3.
Quantified operational mitigation controls, showing that increasing well-fault separation and reducing net injection rate substantially delay rupture initiation.
Evaluated post-sequence escalation across a 27-fault Wilzetta network, identifying a +0.3 MPa prestress threshold for secondary dynamic ruptures on Faults 5 and 6.
在基于物理的断层网络模型中重现了近18年的水力积累以及完整的2011年布拉格三震级联序列（发震时间、震级和破裂长度）。
证明了局部不排水断层带孔隙弹性反馈（beta_eff ≥ 0.75）对于缓冲断层2造成的同震法向应力夹紧并触发断层3动态破裂至关重要。
量化了注水工程缓解策略的控制作用，表明增加注水井与断层距离以及降低净注水速率可显著推迟破裂起始时间。
评估了包含27条断层的Wilzetta断层网络在序列后的扩展响应，发现+0.3 MPa的预应力偏移阈值会触发断层5和6的次生动态破裂。
me: 2D adaptive quadtree finite-volume solver with implicit Crank-Nicolson integration for pore-pressure diffusion across host rock and 200-m-wide high-diffusivity fault corridors.
Quasi-dynamic rate-and-state friction solver coupled with analytical 2D Galerkin boundary-element elastic stress interaction kernels (Ks and Kn).
Subgrid undrained fault-zone poroelastic closure (Cocco and Rice formulation) parameterizing pore-pressure buffering of slip-induced normal stress via beta_eff.
Multi-millennia earthquake-cycle spin-up without injection under regional tectonic stress (SHmax at N73E) to generate self-consistent heterogeneous prestress templates.
采用二维自适应四叉树有限体积求解器与隐式Crank-Nicolson时间积分，模拟围岩及200米宽的高扩散率断层破碎带走廊中的孔隙压力扩散。
结合解析二维Galerkin边界元弹性应力相互作用核函数（Ks与Kn）与准动态速率-状态摩擦定律求解断层滑动演化。
引入亚网格不排水断层带孔隙弹性闭合关系（Cocco and Rice公式），通过参数beta_eff表征孔隙压力对滑动诱发法向应力变化的缓冲作用。
在区域构造应力场（SHmax为N73°E）下进行数千年无注水地震周期演化，生成自洽的非均匀断层预应力模板。

Historical wastewater injection rates from Keranen et al. converted to a 2D source rate (q_ref = 1.7e-7 m^2/s) assuming a 1.78 km effective flow thickness.
Parameter sweeps over effective poroelastic coupling (beta_eff from 0 to 1) and host-rock vs. damage-zone hydraulic diffusivities.
Operational mitigation experiments testing source-fault distances (0.07 to 9.15 km), steady injection rates, intermittent shut-in schedules, and co-extraction.
Code verification benchmarks against Fourier-domain spectral solutions, 600-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature, and DemystiFicatioN_DFN software.
基于断层迹线测绘、重定位地震目录和震源机制约束构建的3断层主模型（165个单元）和27断层扩展Wilzetta断层网络模型（426个单元）。
采用Keranen等人的历史废水注入记录，假设1.78 km有效流动厚度，转换为二维源注入速率（q_ref = 1.7e-7 m^2/s）。
针对有效孔隙弹性耦合系数（beta_eff从0到1）以及围岩与断层破碎带水力扩散率的参数扫描实验。
测试注水点至断层距离（0.07至9.15 km）、稳态注水速率、间歇关井方案以及注采结合策略的工程缓解实验。
与傅里叶域谱方法解、600点Gauss-Legendre数值积分以及DemystiFicatioN_DFN软件进行的全面基准验证对比。
li: Two-dimensional horizontal plane-strain approximation with an effective flow thickness (1.78 km) and seismogenic width (3.5 km) rather than full 3D geometry.
Slip-induced pore-pressure changes act instantaneously in the local undrained limit without subsequent fluid diffusion or relaxation.
Host-rock and fault-zone hydraulic diffusivities are fixed in time, omitting dynamic permeability evolution, dilation, or fault-valve behavior during slip.

围岩与断层带的水力扩散率在时间上保持固定，忽略了滑动过程中的动态渗透率演化、剪胀及断层阀行为。
绝对断层预应力无法由观测唯一确定，需要对各断层施加整体的均匀剪应力微调。

sum: This study investigates the stress interaction between the 2026 Mw 6.8 Kumamoto earthquake and the 2016 Mw 7.1 Kumamoto earthquake sequence. Using waveform inversion of strong-motion records, the authors estimate the 2026 earthquake's source process and calculate the Coulomb failure stress changes (ΔCFS) from both events. The 2026 hypocenter was located in a positive ΔCFS region from the 2016 sequence, indicating stress-triggered rupture initiation. The main slip region of the 2026 event was adjacent to the 2016 rupture, with southwestward growth likely limited by complex fault geometry. Finally, the 2026 coseismic slip increased ΔCFS on the southwestern extension of the Hinagu fault, highlighting elevated seismic hazard in that region.

sum: This study models shape preferred orientation (SPO) versus akimotoite fabric-induced (lattice preferred orientation) azimuthal anisotropy to investigate the subslab lower-mantle transition zone (520-660 km) beneath subduction zones. The authors demonstrate that the widespread azimuthal anisotropy observed in this region can be explained by unresolved small-scale heterogeneities. This suggests that the lower transition zone is compositionally heterogeneous, providing an alternative explanation to purely deformation-induced mineral alignment.
本研究通过模拟形状优选方位（SPO）与秋本石组构引起的方位各向异性，探讨了俯冲带下方下地幔过渡带（520-660 km）的结构。研究表明，该区域广泛观测到的方位各向异性可以由未解析的微尺度非均匀性来解释，揭示了过渡带存在化学成分上的非均匀性，而非单纯的变形诱导晶格优选方位。

t: Modeling and comparing shape preferred orientation (SPO) and akimotoite fabric-induced azimuthal anisotropy.
模拟并对比形状优选方位（SPO）与秋本石组构引起的方位各向异性。
Synthetic modeling of seismic anisotropy parameters in the 520-660 km transition zone.
对俯冲带下方520-660 km过渡带地震各向异性参数进行合成模拟。
Widespread azimuthal anisotropy in the subslab transition zone can be explained by unresolved small-scale composition heterogeneities.

sum: This study evaluates the application of Ambient Noise Tomography (ANT) for district-scale (tens of kilometers) mineral exploration using a network of 30 Sercel WiNG Micro-ElectroMechanical System (MEMS) accelerometers deployed along a 50 km profile across the Kansanshi Cu-Au mine in Zambia. The ANT method successfully imaged a significant body of metal source sediments multiple kilometers thick beneath the mine, as well as structures associated with mineralizing fluid expulsion. The novelty lies in proving that cost-effective, nodal MEMS accelerometers can be scaled up from local, shallow imaging to district-scale exploration, providing a valuable and affordable tool for greenfield mineral exploration.
本研究利用赞比亚Kansanshi铜金矿50公里剖面上的30个MEMS加速度计，评估了背景噪声成像在区域尺度矿产勘探中的应用。结果成功重建了矿区下方数公里厚的金属源沉积体及成矿流体通道。该研究首次证明了低成本MEMS加速度计可从局部浅层成像扩展至区域尺度勘探，为绿地矿产勘探提供了一种高效经济的新工具……

Nodal seismic array deployment using MEMS accelerometers.

sum: This study presents a novel framework for thermochemical full-waveform inversion (TCFWI) that directly integrates mineral physics calculations with seismic waveform tomography to recover mantle temperature and chemical composition (basalt fraction). Forward modeling interpolates pre-computed thermodynamic look-up tables (computed via Perple_X) using B-splines to obtain density and elastic moduli, followed by 2-D P-SV finite-difference wave propagation. For the inverse problem, the objective function gradient is split via the chain rule into a seismic part—computed with the adjoint method without modifying existing FWI solvers—and a thermodynamic Jacobian derived analytically from B-spline derivatives while accounting for recursive hydrostatic pressure-density coupling. To mitigate strong trade-offs and gradient scaling disparities between temperature and composition during L-BFGS optimization, a metric-based linear parameter transformation is applied. Proof-of-concept 2-D synthetic experiments (800 km deep) demonstrate successful recovery of thermal and compositional anomalies and phase-transition topography, especially under plane-wave illumination.
本研究提出了热化学全波形反演（TCFWI）新框架，将矿物物理计算与地震全波形反演直接结合，从波形直接反演地幔温度与化学成分（玄武岩比例）。正演通过B样条插值Perple_X预计算的物性表获取密度与弹性模量，并利用有限差分模拟二维P-SV波传播。反演利用链式法则将梯度分为伴随法计算的地震部分，以及包含……

t: Combines adjoint seismic waveform gradients with analytical B-spline derivatives of pre-computed Perple_X mineral physics tables via the chain rule, accounting for hydrostatic pressure-density coupling and optimizing via L-BFGS in a linearly transformed parameter space.
通过链式法则将伴随波形梯度与预计算Perple_X表的B样条解析导数及静水压力耦合相结合，并在变换空间进行L-BFGS优…

Six 2-D synthetic upper-mantle P-SV models (1600 km wide, 800 km deep, 50 km fixed crust) with ±200 K thermal and 0–40% basalt anomalies, illuminated by 10 s Ricker plane waves or sub-crustal point sources.
6组宽1600 km、深800 km的二维上地幔P-SV合成模型，含±200 K热异常与0-40%玄武岩异常。

100 L-BFGS iterations successfully reconstruct thermal and compositional anomaly locations, shapes, and 410/660 km discontinuity displacements; incoming plane-wave illumination resolves internal anomalies significantly better than sub-crustal reflective point sources.
经100次L-BFGS迭代成功重建了热-化学异常及410/660 km间断面起伏，透射平面波照明效果显著优于地壳下点源。

Strong non-uniqueness between temperature and composition requires subjective metric scaling; model neglects attenuation, anisotropy, minor phases (water/melt), and 3-D non-hydrostatic pressure variations.
温-化强非唯一性依赖主观缩放矩阵；忽略了衰减、各向异性、水/熔体及三维非静水压力效应。
First direct one-step integration of full-waveform inversion with self-consistent thermodynamic phase equilibria calculations, requiring zero modification to existing seismic adjoint solvers.
首次实现全波形反演与自洽热力学相平衡计算的单步直接耦合，且无需修改现有地震伴随求解器。

kc: Formulated a one-step thermochemical full-waveform inversion (TCFWI) framework linking temperature and composition directly to seismic waveforms via the chain rule.
Derived analytical thermodynamic Jacobians using B-spline interpolation of pre-calculated Perple_X tables, explicitly accounting for non-diagonal hydrostatic pressure-density coupling.

Introduced a metric-based linear coordinate transformation within L-BFGS optimization to balance gradient norms and mitigate temperature-composition trade-offs without requiring a reference prior model.
Demonstrated the methodology on six 2-D P-SV synthetic upper-mantle experiments comparing transmitted plane-wave and sub-crustal reflective point-source geometries.
提出了单步热化学全波形反演（TCFWI）框架，利用链式法则将地幔温度和成分直接与地震波形关联。
基于预计算Perple_X表的B样条插值推导了解析热力学雅可比矩阵，显式计入了非对角的静水压力-密度耦合效应。
在L-BFGS优化中引入基于度量的线性坐标变换以平衡梯度范数并缓解温-化折衷，且无需参考先验模型。
通过6组二维P-SV上地幔合成数值实验（对比透射平面波与地壳下反射点源几何）验证了算法的有效性。
me: Pre-calculation of thermodynamic look-up tables (density and Lamé parameters) in the NaCFMAS basalt-harzburgite system using Perple_X and Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni (2021) database.
Cubic B-spline interpolation of thermodynamic tables and analytical derivation of spline derivatives (degree N-1).
Recursive spherical-shell hydrostatic loading formulation and full off-diagonal Jacobian derivation for pressure-density coupling.
2-D P-SV finite-difference elastodynamic modeling and adjoint sensitivity kernel computation using SeismicWaves.jl.
L-BFGS optimization in a transformed Euclidean parameter space defined by a diagonal metric scaling matrix M.
利用Perple_X和Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni (2021)数据库预计算NaCFMAS玄武岩-方辉橄榄岩体系的热力学查找表（密度与拉梅参数）。
热力学表的三次B样条插值及样条导数（N-1阶）的解析求导。
递归球壳静水载荷公式推导及考虑压力-密度耦合的完整非对角雅可比矩阵计算。
使用SeismicWaves.jl进行二维P-SV有限差分弹性波正演及伴随灵敏度核计算。
在对角度量缩放矩阵M定义的变换欧氏参数空间中执行L-BFGS优化。
de: Six 2-D synthetic upper-mantle models (1600 km wide by 800 km deep, with a fixed 50 km crust) containing circular thermal (±200 K) and/or compositional (0–40% basalt fraction) anomalies.
Two source geometries: coherent deep point sources mimicking an incoming teleseismic plane wave, and 8 sub-crustal earthquake point sources at 90 km depth.
20 surface receivers recording 2-component (x, z) displacements with 10 s dominant period Ricker wavelets and correlated Gaussian noise.
6组二维合成上地幔模型（宽1600 km、深800 km，含固定的50 km地壳），包含圆形热异常（±200 K）和/或成分异常（0–40%玄武岩比例）。
两种震源几何：模拟远震入射平面波的深部相干点源阵列，以及位于90 km深度的8个地壳下独立地震点源。
20个地表台站记录双分量（x, z）位移，采用主频周期10 s的雷克子波并叠加相关高斯噪声。
li: Strong inherent non-uniqueness and trade-offs between temperature and composition require user-defined scaling matrices (M) that can bias results if misspecified.

sum: This dataset contains vertical deformation data from 2020-2021 InSAR observations at Lake Mead, alongside elastic, viscoelastic (Maxwell), and poroelastic simulation results. These models are designed to decouple multiscale lithospheric responses to intense drought. The viscoelastic simulation utilizes a two-layer Maxwell model with an elastic layer thickness of 32 km and a viscous layer viscosity of 3×10^19 Pa·s. The dataset serves as a key resource for studying hydrological loading, poroelastic effects, and crustal rheology.
该数据集包含2020-2021年米德湖的InSAR垂直形变观测数据，以及相应的弹性、粘弹性（Maxwell模型）和孔隙弹性数值模拟结果。这些数据用于解耦岩石圈对严重干旱的多尺度响应。其中，双层Maxwell粘弹性模型基于32 km厚的弹性层和3.0×10^19 Pa·s的粘性层粘度进行模拟。该数据集……

t: Multi-physical modeling including elastic, two-layer Maxwell viscoelastic, and poroelastic simulations to model lithospheric deformation.
结合弹性、双层Maxwell粘弹性及孔隙弹性模拟的多物理场形变建模方法。
2020-2021 InSAR vertical deformation observations and corresponding simulation outputs for Lake Mead in three-column text format.
2020-2021年米德湖InSAR垂直形变观测及相应模拟结果的三列文本数据。
Successful simulation of viscoelastic response using a 32 km elastic layer and a viscous layer viscosity of 3×10^19 Pa·s.

sum: This study investigates the thermal and structural signatures of subducted seamounts beneath the forearc slopes of Hyuga-nada and off Cape Muroto in the Nankai Trough. Using dense multi-channel seismic reflection profiles, the authors identify Bottom Simulating Reflectors (BSRs) to estimate heat flow (ranging from 20 to >140 mW/m2) and complement this with 3D finite-element thermal modeling. Results show a regional heat flow contrast across the subducting Kyushu-Palau Ridge (>50 mW/m2 east vs. <40 mW/m2 west), which 3D simulations attribute to the age difference between the younger Shikoku Basin and older West Philippine Basin. However, localized low heat flow anomalies (~20-30 mW/m2) directly over and near subducted seamounts cannot be explained by conductive plate-age models or velocity/conductivity uncertainties. Instead, seismic imaging of reverse/extensional faults and diapirs suggests these local anomalies arise from rapid sedimentation, faulting, or pre-subduction hydrothermal cooling, offering new constraints on forearc deformation and shallow slow earthquakes.
本研究利用密集多道地震反射剖面识别似海底反射层（BSR），结合三维有限元热演化模拟，估算了日本西南南海海槽日向滩和室户岬外弧前斜坡的热流分布（20至>140 mW/m2）。研究发现，俯冲九州-帕劳海脊两侧存在显著的区域热流差异（东侧>50，西侧<40 mW/m2），三维模拟表明这源于年轻的四国海盆与……

t: Heat flow is derived from BSR depths picked on PreSDM seismic reflection profiles using a depth-dependent thermal resistance formulation, complemented by 3D time-dependent conductive finite-element thermal modeling in COMSOL.
基于叠前深度偏移地震剖面拾取BSR深度并利用热阻法计算热流，结合COMSOL三维瞬态热传导有限元模拟。

Densely spaced multichannel seismic reflection profiles acquired across Hyuga-nada and off Cape Muroto from multiple research cruises (Table 1), alongside historical geothermal probe and IODP borehole conductivity measurements.
日向滩和室户岬外多个航次采集的密集多道地震反射剖面，以及海底热探针和IODP钻孔热导率数据。

Heat flow across the subducting Kyushu-Palau Ridge drops from 50–100 mW/m2 (east) to 25–40 mW/m2 (west) with local minima of ~20–25 mW/m2 near the seamount, and drops from ~80 to ~30 mW/m2 off Muroto.
九州-帕劳海脊东侧热流为50-100 mW/m2，西侧降至25-40 mW/m2（海山附近最低约20），室户岬外从80骤…
BSR-derived heat flow carries up to 20% uncertainty, and limited sedimentation rate constraints and lack of direct fluid flow evidence prevent definitive determination of local anomaly causes.
BSR热流不确定性达20%，且缺乏沉积速率约束与流体排放直接证据，难以最终确认局部异常成因。

First high-resolution BSR heat flow mapping and 3D thermal modeling across subducted seamounts in Hyuga-nada and Muroto, distinguishing regional plate-age effects from local seamount-induced deformation and thermal anomalies.
首次给出日向滩与室户岬俯冲海山上方高分辨率BSR热流图与三维热模型，区分了板块年龄区域效应与海山局部扰动。

kc: Mapped high-resolution spatial heat flow (20 to >140 mW/m2) across Hyuga-nada and off Cape Muroto using BSRs from dense seismic reflection profiles.
Demonstrated via 3D finite-element thermal modeling that the regional heat flow offset across the Kyushu-Palau Ridge is explained by the age contrast between the Shikoku and West Philippine Basins.
Identified localized low heat flow anomalies (~20-30 mW/m2) and associated faulting/diapiric structures around subducted seamounts that spatially correlate with shallow slow earthquakes.
利用密集地震反射剖面中的BSR，绘制了日向滩和室户岬外高分辨率热流分布图（20至>140 mW/m2）。
通过三维有限元热模拟证明，横跨九州-帕劳海脊的区域热流差异源于四国海盆与西菲律宾海盆的板块年龄差。
识别出俯冲海山周围与浅部慢地震空间相关的局部低热流异常（~20-30 mW/m2）及伴生的断层和底辟构造。
me: Bottom Simulating Reflector (BSR) picking on pre-stack depth migrated (PreSDM) and time-migrated multichannel seismic (MCS) reflection profiles.
Heat flow derivation using thermal resistance formulation with a depth-dependent linear thermal conductivity profile calibrated to IODP Site C0002 and methane hydrate stability curves.
3D time-dependent conductive finite-element thermal modeling (COMSOL Multiphysics) incorporating plate age history, GDH1 boundary conditions, and frictional heating.
2D numerical thermal diffusion modeling to test sensitivity to seafloor topography and local thermal conductivity variations.
在叠前深度偏移（PreSDM）和时间偏移多道地震（MCS）反射剖面上拾取似海底反射层（BSR）。
结合IODP C0002站位标定的深度相关线性热导率剖面与甲烷水合物相平衡曲线，利用热阻法计算热流。
利用COMSOL Multiphysics开展包含板块年龄演化历史、GDH1边界条件和摩擦生热的三维瞬态热传导有限元模拟。
开展二维数值热扩散模拟，测试海底地形及局部热导率变化对温度梯度的敏感性。
de: Multi-channel seismic reflection profiles from multiple JAMSTEC, ERI, and Japan Coast Guard cruises (YK16-13, KR01-14, KM20-05, KM21-7, KM18-10, KR19-E03).
Existing seafloor geothermal probe measurements and ODP/IODP borehole temperature and thermal conductivity data (e.g., Site C0002, Site C0023).
Regional catalogs of low-frequency tremors (LFTs), very-low-frequency earthquakes (VLFEs), and magnetic anomaly contours.
来自JAMSTEC、东京大学地震研究所及日本海上保安厅多个航次（YK16-13、KR01-14、KM20-05等）的多道地震反射剖面。
已有的海底热流探针测量数据以及ODP/IODP钻孔温度与热导率数据（如C0002和C0023站位）。
低频颤动（LFTs）、甚低频地震（VLFEs）区域目录及磁异常等值线数据。
li: BSR-derived heat flow estimates carry uncertainties of up to 20% due to P-wave velocity model errors, lack of direct drilling calibration in Hyuga-nada, and hydrate stability assumptions.
The 3D thermal model is purely conductive and simplified, neglecting pore-fluid advection, surface roughness, and sedimentation effects.

No direct observations of seafloor fluid discharge or sedimentation rate constraints are available in Hyuga-nada to definitively separate transient sedimentation/faulting effects from pre-subduction seamount cooling.
由于P波速度模型误差、日向滩缺乏钻井直接标定以及水合物稳定性假设，BSR推导的热流存在高达20%的不确定性。
三维热模型为简化的纯传导模型，忽略了孔隙流体平流、地表粗糙度和沉积效应。
日向滩缺乏海底流体排放的直接观测和沉积速率约束，无法确切区分快速沉积/断层瞬态效应与海山俯冲前冷却。

tm.why: The paper maps the thermal and structural signatures of the Nankai Trough forearc above subducted seamounts using seismic reflection profiles and 3D finite-element thermal modeling.
The study connects spatial heat flow anomalies, faulting, and pore-fluid dynamics around subducted seamounts to the generation and distribution of shallow slow earthquakes (LFTs and VLFEs).

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF analyzed, including all sections, equations, tables (Tables 1-2), and figures (Figures 1-11).

sum: Conventional masked autoencoders (MAEs) treat 3D axes equivalently, ignoring the distinction between lateral reflector continuity and vertical waveform variations in seismic volumes. This paper proposes a direction-aware masked autoencoder (DA-MAE) for self-supervised representation learning on 3D post-stack seismic data. DA-MAE integrates anisotropic patching, factorized lateral-then-vertical token embedding, direction-aware positional encoding, trace-aligned tube masking, and a four-term seismic reconstruction objective (amplitude, structural continuity, spectral consistency, trace correlation). Pretrained on 35,718 blocks from 33 field surveys, the model is evaluated on an external reconstruction dataset and cross-area acoustic impedance inversion between two field surveys. Experiments reveal that reconstruction is much more sensitive to lateral token resolution than vertical length, and increasing encoder capacity cannot compensate for coarse tokenization. Furthermore, tube masking and finer lateral tokens improve downstream cross-area inversion (reducing NRMSE by 20.8% over standard MAE across eight test wells), proving reconstruction accuracy alone does not dictate transferability.
针对传统掩码自编码器忽略三维地震横向同相轴与纵向波形差异的问题，本文提出方向感知掩码自编码器（DA-MAE）。该方法融合各向异性分块、分解式嵌入、方向位置编码、沿道管状掩码及多约束重建目标。基于33个三维工区预训练后，在跨工区波阻抗反演中验证了迁移能力。结果表明重建对横向分辨率更敏感，且重建精度并非……

t: DA-MAE combines anisotropic 3D patching, factorized lateral-then-vertical convolutional token embedding, direction-aware positional encoding, trace-aligned tube masking, a 3D CNN refiner, and a four-term seismic reconstruction loss before fine-tuning a trace-oriented head for impedance inversion.
融合各向异性分块、横向-纵向分解卷积嵌入、方向位置编码、沿道管状掩码及多约束重建损失，微调单道预测头反演波阻抗。

Pretrained on 35,718 120×120×120 blocks from 33 3D post-stack field surveys, tested for reconstruction on 380 blocks from an independent survey, and evaluated for cross-area inversion from Area C (20 wells) to Area L (10 wells).
基于全球33个三维叠后工区35,718个数据块预训练，在独立工区测试重建，并在C工区（20井）至L工区（10井）验证跨区…

Under 4×4×8 tokenization and tube masking, full DA-MAE reduces cross-area impedance NRMSE by 20.8% relative to the pretrained 3D MAE backbone (from 0.0615 to 0.0487, average PCC 0.979 across eight blind test wells).
在4×4×8分块与管状掩码下，DA-MAE在8口盲井上的跨工区反演NRMSE较传统预训练MAE基线降低20.8%（达0.…
Restricted to 3D post-stack data without pre-stack angle/azimuth variations, and patch dimensions are defined in discrete traces and samples rather than physical seismic wavelength and bandwidth.
仅适用于三维叠后数据，未考虑叠前道集随角度和方位角的变化，且分块尺寸未与物理波长和频带绑定。

Explicitly distinguishes lateral reflector structure from vertical waveform characteristics across tokenization, positional encoding, tube masking, and loss design, while demonstrating that reconstruction fidelity does not reliably predict inversion transferability.
在分词、掩码和损失中显式解耦横向反射结构与纵向波形特征，并证实预训练重建精度不能直接决定下游反演迁移能力。

kc: Proposes DA-MAE, explicitly separating lateral reflector structure from vertical waveform characteristics via anisotropic patching, factorized token embedding, and trace-aligned tube masking.

Demonstrates through controlled ablations that seismic reconstruction is far more sensitive to lateral token resolution than moderate vertical length variations, and encoder capacity cannot offset coarse tokenization.
Shows that pretext reconstruction fidelity and downstream inversion transferability are not strictly aligned, achieving a 20.8% NRMSE reduction in cross-area acoustic impedance inversion.
提出DA-MAE框架，通过各向异性分块、分解式嵌入和沿道管状掩码显式区分横向反射结构与纵向波形特征。
通过受控消融实验证明地震重建对横向分块分辨率高度敏感，且增加编码器容量无法弥补粗粒度分词带来的信息损失。
揭示预训练重建保真度与下游反演迁移能力并不完全一致，在跨工区波阻抗反演中将NRMSE降低20.8%。
me: Anisotropic 3D patching and factorized 3D convolutional token embedding (lateral spatial aggregation followed by vertical waveform integration).
Concatenated trainable direction-aware positional encodings for inline, crossline, and vertical time coordinates.
Trace-aligned tube masking (75% masking ratio) with a Transformer encoder-decoder and a lightweight 3D CNN boundary refiner.
Multi-term seismic pretraining loss combining masked Huber amplitude fidelity, directional 3D gradient continuity, 3D FFT log-spectral consistency, and trace-wise Pearson correlation.
Downstream trace-oriented Transformer prediction head fine-tuned with multiscale log-impedance, phase, gradient, band-pass, and wavelet forward-modeling losses.
各向异性三维分块与分解式三维卷积词元嵌入（先横向空间聚合，后纵向波形积分）。
针对主测线、联络测线和垂向时间坐标的独立可训练方向感知位置编码拼接。
75%掩码率的沿道管状掩码，配合Transformer编解码器及轻量级3D CNN块边界细化器。
结合掩码区Huber振幅损失、三维方向梯度连续性、三维傅里叶对数谱一致性及单道波形相关性的地震重建目标函数。
面向单道的下游Transformer预测头，联合多尺度波阻抗、相位、垂向梯度、带通保真度及褶积正演一致性损失进行微调。
de: Self-supervised pretraining dataset of 35,718 blocks (120×120×120 samples at 1 ms) compiled from 33 3D post-stack field seismic surveys worldwide.
External generalization test dataset of 380 blocks from an independent field survey in eastern China.

Cross-area acoustic impedance inversion transfer from source Area C (577×1441×765 samples, 20 training wells) to target Area L (481×385×1046 samples, 2 validation/control wells and 8 blind test wells).
自监督预训练数据集包含来自全球33个三维叠后地震工区的35,718个数据块（120×120×120采样点，1 ms采样率）。
外部重建泛化测试集包含中国东部某独立三维工区的380个数据块。
跨工区波阻抗反演迁移实验：源工区C（577×1441×765采样点，20口训练井）微调后直接迁移至目标工区L（481×385×1046采样点，2口控制井、8口盲测井）。
li: Designed specifically for 3D post-stack seismic volumes; extending to pre-stack data requires handling incident angle and azimuth variations.
Token patch dimensions are defined in discrete trace and time-sample counts rather than physical seismic wavelength and bandwidth.
Target-area seismic volumes (without well labels) were included in self-supervised pretraining, and two target wells were used to build the 8-Hz background model and wavelet.
目前仅针对三维叠后地震数据设计，扩展至叠前数据需额外考虑入射角和方位角引起的振幅变化。
词元分块尺寸以离散道数和时间采样点定义，尚未与地震物理波长、空间采样间隔及频带宽度直接挂钩。
目标工区的无标签地震数据参与了自监督预训练，且使用了目标工区2口井构建8 Hz低频背景模型和提取子波。

tm.why: The paper develops a self-supervised direction-aware masked autoencoder (DA-MAE) based on Vision Transformers for 3D seismic representation learning and acoustic impedance inversion.
The downstream task is 3D post-stack acoustic impedance inversion constrained by sparse well logs and seismic forward consistency.

ev.notes: Full 42-page PDF (including main text, 9 figures, 8 main tables, and Appendix A with Table A1 and mathematical formulations) was read and analyzed.

sum: Understanding the distinct roles of seismic and aseismic slip in crustal permeability evolution is critical for subsurface energy reservoirs. This study conducts triaxial pore-pressure-stepping fault reactivation experiments on saw-cut granite cores (Utah FORGE granitoid and Westerly granite) while monitoring steady-state permeability and calibrated acoustic emissions (AE). Seismic moment is derived from ball-drop-calibrated AE waveforms, and aseismic moment is obtained by subtracting seismic moment from total moment calculated via fault shear stress drop. Results show a non-monotonic permeability evolution: an initial decrease dominated by aseismic slip (accounting for up to ~90% of total moment), followed by permeability enhancement as the seismic moment fraction rises by 10%–20%. The authors adapt the Chen-Niemeijer-Spiers (CNS) microphysical model, constrained by optical profilometry, demonstrating that permeability evolution is governed by the competition between aseismic creep-induced asperity compaction and seismic shear dilation.
本研究通过花岗岩岩芯的三轴孔隙压力阶跃断层活化实验，同步监测稳态渗透率与标定声发射（AE），探究有震与无震滑动对渗透率演化的独立控制作用。研究利用落球标定的AE波形计算地震矩，并结合剪应力降计算的总体矩分离出无震矩。结果显示渗透率呈非单调演化：初期无震滑动占主导（最高占总矩约90%），渗透率下降；随……

t: Pore-pressure-stepped triaxial fault reactivation experiments measure steady-state permeability while partitioning total stress-drop moment into ball-drop-calibrated AE seismic moment and aseismic moment, modeled via an adapted CNS microphysical framework.
开展孔隙压力阶跃三轴断层活化实验，测量稳态渗透率，利用标定AE和应力降分离有震与无震矩，并构建改进CNS模型。
Four experiments (PL02, PL03 on Utah FORGE granitoid; PL16-1, PL16-3 on Westerly granite) on 30°-inclined roughened fractures in 25x50 mm cores at 10 MPa confining pressure with 10 MHz AE monitoring.
在10 MPa围压下对Utah FORGE和Westerly花岗岩含30°粗糙裂隙岩芯开展4组实验，配合10 MHz声发…

Permeability initially decreases when aseismic slip dominates (up to ~90% of total moment), then transitions to net enhancement as the aseismic moment fraction drops by ~10%–20% (or from 30%–50% down to 20%).
初期无震滑动主导（最高占总矩约90%）导致渗透率下降；随后无震矩占比下降10%–20%，渗透率转为净增长。
Conventional models struggle to quantitatively link porosity to permeability in complex fracture networks, and aseismic moment remains difficult to measure at field reservoir scales.
复杂裂隙网络中孔隙度与渗透率的定量关系尚难精确表征，且场地尺度储层中难以直接量化无震矩。

Separately quantifies concurrent seismic and aseismic moments during laboratory fault reactivation and formulates a competing creep-compaction versus shear-dilation physical model for non-monotonic permeability evolution.
首次在断层活化中同步分离有震与无震矩，并建立蠕变压实与剪胀竞争的微观物理模型解释非单调渗透率演化。

kc: Quantified concurrent seismic and aseismic moments alongside steady-state permeability during pore-pressure-stepped laboratory fault reactivation.
Demonstrated that aseismic slip dominates early reactivation (up to ~90% of total moment) and drives initial permeability reduction via contact creep.

Developed an asperity-scale mechanistic model based on the Chen-Niemeijer-Spiers (CNS) framework linking seismic shear dilation and aseismic creep compaction to fracture porosity and permeability changes.
在孔隙压力阶跃驱动的实验室断层活化过程中，同步量化了有震矩、无震矩及稳态渗透率。
证实无震滑动在断层活化早期占主导地位（高达总矩的约90%），并通过接触蠕变导致初期渗透率下降。
基于CNS框架建立了粗糙体尺度的力学模型，将有震剪胀和无震蠕变压实与裂隙孔隙度及渗透率变化定量关联。
me: Triaxial pore-pressure-stepping shear reactivation experiments under zero-displacement axial boundary conditions with steady-state Darcy flow permeability measurements.
Absolute acoustic emission (AE) seismic moment calibration via steel ball impact tests and STA/LTA event detection at 10 MHz sampling.
Optical profilometry of bare fracture surfaces to constrain asperity height, wavelength, layer thickness, and contact area for microphysical modeling based on the CNS framework.
在零位移轴向边界条件下开展三轴孔隙压力阶跃剪切活化实验，并基于达西定律测量稳态渗透率。
利用钢球撞击实验标定绝对声发射（AE）地震矩，结合10 MHz采样率的STA/LTA算法检测事件。
利用光学轮廓仪扫描裸露裂隙面以约束粗糙体高度、波长、层厚和接触面积，构建基于CNS框架的微观物理模型。
de: Four triaxial reactivation experiments on 25 mm x 50 mm cylindrical cores with 30° saw-cut fractures roughened with #60 grit SiC: two on Utah FORGE granitoid (PL02, PL03) and two on Westerly granite (PL16-1, PL16-3).
Continuous 10 MHz ultrasonic AE recordings from platen-embedded PZT transducers, LVDT axial displacement (±0.1 μm resolution), and syringe pump pressure/flow logs.
3D optical surface profilometry scans over 37 mm x 13 mm rectangular fracture regions.
对含30°预制粗糙裂隙（#60碳化硅打磨）的圆柱形岩芯（25 mm × 50 mm）开展四组三轴活化实验：两组为Utah FORGE花岗岩类（PL02、PL03），两组为Westerly花岗岩（PL16-1、PL16-3）。
压头内置PZT传感器的10 MHz连续超声AE记录、LVDT轴向位移记录（±0.1 μm分辨率）以及注射泵压力与流量记录。
裂隙面37 mm × 13 mm矩形区域的三维光学表面轮廓扫描数据。
li: Experiments were conducted on bare saw-cut fractures without an added fault gouge layer or significant surface cracking, limiting mechanisms like clay lubrication or extensive grain crushing.
The quantitative relationship between fracture porosity and permeability in complex pore networks remains simplified and requires explicit fluid flow modeling (e.g., Lattice Boltzmann methods).
Aseismic moment is difficult to quantify directly in most field-scale geoenergy reservoirs.
实验在无断层泥层的裸露锯切裂隙上进行，且未见明显碎屑，限制了黏土润滑或颗粒破碎等机制的作用。
复杂裂隙网络中孔隙度与渗透率之间的定量转换关系仍较简化，未来需结合格子玻尔兹曼等显式流体模拟方法。
在实际场地尺度的地热或能源储层中，无震矩分量难以直接定量观测。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates the competition between seismic and aseismic slip on reactivated laboratory faults and how asperity creep vs. shear dilation governs fault permeability evolution.
The experiments simulate fluid-injection-driven fault reactivation (using Utah FORGE granitoid and Westerly granite) relevant to hydraulic stimulation and geoenergy reservoirs.
The study quantifies absolute seismic moments from calibrated acoustic emissions and partitions total shear stress drop moment into seismic and aseismic components.

ev.notes: Full 12-page GRL PDF analyzed, including equations, experimental parameters, and all 4 main figures.

sum: This study models the coupled formation of early oceans and felsic crust on Earth following magma-ocean solidification. Under high atmospheric pressure, water release from the primary crust is modulated, leading to the formation of a hydrated primary crust, shallow oceans, and felsic magmatism. This process facilitated the rapid emergence of land and prebiotic environments like lakes and lagoons. The findings suggest that a planet's initial water content and atmosphere-geosphere interactions are key to the emergence of habitable environments on early Earth and rocky exoplanets.
本研究模拟了岩浆洋固结后早期地球海洋与长英质地壳的耦合形成。在高大气压下，初生地壳的水分释放受到调节，形成水化初生壳与浅海，并引发长英质岩浆作用。这促进了陆地快速涌现，并创造了湖泊等有利于生命起源前化学的环境。研究表明，行星初始水含量及大气-地质圈相互作用决定了早期地球与岩石系外行星的宜居性。

t: Coupled numerical modeling of atmosphere-geosphere interactions, focusing on water release, crustal hydration, and felsic magmatism during and after magma-ocean solidification.
耦合大气-地质圈相互作用的数值模拟，研究岩浆洋固结后的水分释放与地壳水化。
Synthetic planetary parameters representing early Earth conditions, including initial water content, atmospheric pressure, and primary crustal compositions.
代表早期地球条件的合成行星参数，包括初始水含量、大气压力和初生地壳成分。
High atmospheric pressure modulated water release, forming a hydrated primary crust, shallow oceans, and felsic magmatism, which rapidly established prebiotic environments like lakes.
高气压促进了水化初生壳、浅海与长英质岩浆作用，快速建立了湖泊等生命起源前环境。
The study is limited by simplified atmospheric and geodynamical assumptions and the lack of direct Hadean geological samples for validation.
该研究受限于简化的大气和地球动力学假设，且缺乏直接的冥古期地质样品进行验证。
Coupling atmosphere-geosphere interactions to show that early Hadean conditions naturally and rapidly produced shallow oceans, felsic crust, and subaerial prebiotic environments.
耦合大气地质圈作用，揭示冥古期快速产生浅海与陆上生命起源环境

kc: Models the coupled evolution of early Earth's atmosphere, oceans, and primary crust.
Demonstrates that high atmospheric pressure leads to a hydrated primary crust and shallow oceans.
Shows how these conditions enabled felsic magmatism and the rapid emergence of prebiotic environments like lakes and lagoons.
模拟了早期地球大气、海洋与初生地壳的耦合演化。
证明了高大气压会导致水化初生地壳和浅海的形成。
展示了这些条件如何促进长英质岩浆作用以及湖泊和潟湖等生命起源前环境的快速涌现。
me: Numerical modeling of coupled atmosphere-geosphere interactions.
Thermodynamic and geodynamical modeling of magma-ocean solidification and crustal hydration.
大气-地质圈相互作用的耦合数值模拟。
岩浆洋固结和地壳水化的热力学与地球动力学模拟。
de: Synthetic modeling based on early Earth parameters (initial water content, atmospheric pressure, and crustal composition).
基于早期地球参数（初始水含量、大气压和地壳成分）的合成模拟。
li: The model relies on simplified assumptions of early Earth's atmospheric composition and mantle dynamics.
Lack of direct geological samples from the early Hadean to validate the specific modeling parameters.
该模型依赖于对早期地球大气成分和地幔动力学的简化假设。
缺乏来自早冥古期的直接地质样品来验证具体的模拟参数。

tm.why: The paper models the coupled formation of early oceans and felsic crust, focusing on atmosphere-geosphere interactions and geodynamical evolution.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the metadata and abstract provided via OpenAlex and Crossref since no PDF was available.

sum: This study applies the normalized inner product (NIP) method to analyze single-station three-component seismic data from the August 2026 slope collapse north of Langtang Lirung, Nepal. By measuring the dominance of retrograde Rayleigh waves from the collapse direction at stations 57 and 132 km away, the author demonstrates that NIP values significantly increased during the pre-collapse amplitude rise, distinguishing the signal from background noise and earthquake arrivals. Post-collapse, NIP successfully tracked the debris-flow front propagation. This work highlights the utility of single-station polarization analysis for monitoring slope instability and hazards in sparse seismic networks.
本研究利用归一化内积（NIP）方法，分析了2026年尼泊尔蓝塘里弄山体滑坡期间的单台三分量地震数据。结果显示，在滑坡前振幅上升阶段，NIP值显著升高，呈现出指向滑坡方向的逆行瑞利波偏振特征。滑坡后，NIP成功追踪了泥石流前锋的运移。该研究展示了单台偏振分析在稀疏台网下监测山体失稳与灾害预警的独特价值……

sum: This study evaluates seismoacoustic source localization using the 10 October 2025 Accurate Energetic Systems accidental chemical explosion (ML 1.6) in Tennessee. Two complementary approaches are compared: the pick-based Seismoacoustic Bayesian Event Locator (SABEL) and waveform-envelope Reverse Time Migration (RTM). For SABEL, three infrasound celerity priors are tested alongside ak135 seismic travel times: a simple 340 m/s Gaussian tropospheric prior, an empirical stratospheric-dominated global prior, and a propagation-model-informed celerity–range prior derived from InfraGA raytracing through perturbed Ground-to-Space atmospheric ensembles. Joint seismoacoustic SABEL localization reduces the 90% spatial confidence area by 49.7% (simple prior) and 94.7% (celerity–range prior) relative to seismic-only, maintaining ~1.6–1.85 km accuracy, whereas a mismatched empirical prior biases the location. Extending RTM to joint seismoacoustic envelopes eliminates the 115.9 s infrasound-only origin-time lag (reducing misfit to 3.70 s) and provides automated event association and effective celerity constraints for Bayesian localization.
本研究以2025年10月田纳西州AES化工厂意外爆炸（ML 1.6）为例，评估了两种地震-次声联合定位方法：基于到时拾取的贝叶斯事件定位器（SABEL）和基于波形包络的逆时偏移（RTM）。SABEL结合ak135地震走时并测试了三种次声波速先验（简单对流层高斯先验、经验全球先验及基于大气集合射线追踪……

t: Compares pick-based Bayesian grid search (SABEL) using ak135 seismic travel times and three infrasound celerity priors against waveform-envelope Reverse Time Migration (RTM) backpropagating Rg seismic and constant-celerity acoustic waves.
对比基于拾取到时的贝叶斯网格搜索（SABEL，测试三种次声波速先验）与反向传播Rg面波和次声包络的逆时偏移（RTM）。
Uses regional seismic and USArray/CEUSN infrasound recordings (up to ~550 km) from the 10 October 2025 ML 1.6 Accurate Energetic Systems chemical explosion (10.4 metric tons) in Tennessee.
使用2025年10月10日田纳西州AES化工厂ML 1.6意外爆炸（10.4吨炸药）的区域地震与次声台网记录。

Joint SABEL reduces 90% spatial confidence area by 49.7% (simple prior) and 94.7% (celerity–range prior) relative to seismic-only (~1.6–1.85 km misfit), while joint RTM reduces infrasound origin-time misfit from 115.9 s to 3.70 s.
联合SABEL将纯地震90%空间置信区缩小49.7%至94.7%（误差1.58–1.85 km）；联合RTM将发震时刻误…

Applying a stratospheric peak-amplitude empirical celerity prior to tropospheric onset picks biases the joint Bayesian solution (10.58 km misfit) and excludes the true source from the 90% confidence region.
将平流层峰值经验先验用于对流层初至拾取会导致联合贝叶斯定位偏移（误差10.58 km）且偏离90%置信区。

Extends the open-source RTM package to joint seismoacoustic migration and demonstrates a hybrid workflow where RTM provides association and celerity constraints for Bayesian localization with ensemble-raytraced celerity–range priors.
将RTM扩展至地震-次声联合偏移，并提出利用RTM提供信号关联与波速约束以辅助集合射线追踪贝叶斯定位的混合流程。

kc: Evaluates pick-based Bayesian localization (SABEL) and waveform-envelope Reverse Time Migration (RTM) on the 2025 Accurate Energetic Systems ground-truth explosion.
Develops an event-specific, range-dependent celerity–range prior using stochastic Ground-to-Space atmospheric ensembles, InfraGA raytracing, and a Bayesian Gaussian mixture model.

Demonstrates up to 94.7% reduction in 90% spatial confidence area for joint seismoacoustic Bayesian location compared to seismic-only, while highlighting bias risks from mismatched empirical celerity priors.
Extends the RTM Python package to jointly migrate seismic Rg surface waves and infrasound envelopes, proposing a hybrid workflow where RTM guides association and celerity prior selection for SABEL.
利用2025年AES地面真值爆炸事件，系统对比了基于到时的贝叶斯定位（SABEL）与基于波形包络的逆时偏移（RTM）。
结合随机大气集合规范、InfraGA射线追踪与贝叶斯高斯混合模型，构建了距离相关的次声波速-距离先验模型。
证明联合地震-次声贝叶斯定位可将纯地震90%空间置信区缩小达94.7%，同时揭示了失配经验先验导致的定位偏差。
扩展RTM软件包以联合偏移地震Rg面波与次声包络，提出了用RTM辅助事件关联并约束SABEL先验的混合监测流程。
me: Seismoacoustic Bayesian Event Locator (SABEL) grid search combining ak135 1D seismic travel-time likelihoods (Pg, Pn, Sg) with probabilistic infrasound celerity priors.
Propagation-model-informed celerity–range prior generation via EOF-based stochprop reduction of 438 G2S atmospheric profiles, InfraGA raytracing, and Bayesian Gaussian mixture modeling.

Seismoacoustic Reverse Time Migration (RTM) backpropagating normalized, smoothed waveform envelopes (3 s seismic window, 30 s infrasound window) using ak135 Rg travel times and constant infrasound celerity.
地震-次声贝叶斯事件定位（SABEL）网格搜索，结合ak135一维地震走时似然（Pg、Pn、Sg）与次声波速先验概率。
基于438个G2S大气剖面的EOF随机降维（stochprop）、InfraGA射线追踪及贝叶斯高斯混合模型构建波速-距离先验。

de: Regional seismic and infrasound recordings (up to ~550 km) from the Central and Eastern U.S. Network (N4) and Cooperative New Madrid Seismic Network for the 10 October 2025 AES explosion (ML 1.6, ~10.4 metric tons explosive).
USGS catalog seismic arrival-time picks (Pg, Pn, Sg) and manual earliest-onset infrasound picks showing tropospheric (~340 m/s) and stratospheric (~300 m/s) branches.
438 Ground-to-Space (G2S) atmospheric specifications spanning 2010–2025 around 8–12 October reduced to 100 perturbed profiles around the event time.
2025年10月10日田纳西州AES爆炸事件（ML 1.6，约10.4吨炸药）的区域地震与次声记录（震中距达550 km，主要来自N4和新马德里台网）。
USGS目录中的地震相到时拾取（Pg、Pn、Sg）以及显示对流层（~340 m/s）和平流层（~300 m/s）分支的人工次声初至拾取。
2010–2025年间10月8日至12日时段的438个地面至空间（G2S）大气模型剖面，降维生成围绕发震时刻的100个扰动剖面。
li: Mismatched infrasound priors (e.g., stratospheric peak-amplitude empirical prior applied to tropospheric onset picks) degrade joint Bayesian accuracy and exclude the true source from the 90% confidence region.
Infrasound-only RTM suffers from severe late origin-time bias (+115.9 s) because envelope stacking aligns peak waveform coherence rather than emergent signal onsets.
Atmospheric raytracing may not capture all fine-scale tropospheric arrivals, potentially causing the celerity–range prior to underestimate true spatial uncertainty.
次声先验模型失配（如将平流层峰值经验先验用于对流层初至拾取）会降低联合定位精度，使90%置信区偏离真实震源。
纯次声RTM存在严重的发震时刻滞后偏差（+115.9秒），因为包络叠加对齐的是最大相干能量而非初至波。
大气射线追踪难以完全捕捉对流层到达波细节，可能导致波速-距离先验低估真实的不确定性。

sum: This paper presents a deep-learning phase picker designed for seismo-acoustic conflict monitoring. Combining a U-net architecture for waveform feature extraction with a graph convolution module for network geometry, the model discriminates between seismic (P, S) and acoustic (IS) phases. Trained on manually labeled data from the Malyn array in Ukraine (2022), the method uses migration stacking on phase probabilities. It achieves a 54% increase in seismic event detections compared to traditional STA/LTA methods and identifies 557 previously undetected purely acoustic events, demonstrating the power of deep learning for real-time, high-resolution peace-keeping and conflict monitoring.

sum: This study investigates typhoon-driven near-surface groundwater dynamics (NSGD) in Taiwan's Liwu River watershed using 8 months of ambient seismic noise from four broadband stations Alongside hydrological and meteorological records. Applying single-station cross-component correlations and the stretching method at 4–8 Hz, the authors track relative seismic velocity changes (dv/v) caused by Typhoon Kompasu. Results reveal strong spatial variability in post-typhoon recovery, ranging from ~10 days at the upstream divide to over 3 months downstream. This prolonged downstream recovery is attributed to thicker colluvium (up to 20 m) and fractured metamorphic bedrock enhancing water retention, as well as delayed lateral inflow from upstream. Co-variations between dv/v and groundwater levels demonstrate transient vertical coupling between shallow and deep groundwater for ~96 days, followed by decoupling as storage declines. The novelty lies in demonstrating how a single extreme storm reorganizes watershed-scale subsurface storage and hydrological connectivity.
本研究利用台湾立雾溪流域4个宽频带台站8个月的背景地震噪声及水文气象记录，探究了台风驱动的近地表地下水动态（NSGD）。通过计算4–8 Hz单台跨分量互相关并应用拉伸法，追踪了“圆规”台风引起的相对波速变化（dv/v）。结果显示台风后恢复时间存在显著空间差异：上游分水岭约10天，而下游超过3个月。下……

t: Single-station cross-component correlations of 4–8 Hz ambient seismic noise and the stretching method over a 1–4 s coda window were combined with three linear bucket storage-drainage hydrological models.
采用4–8 Hz背景噪声单台跨分量互相关与1–4秒尾波窗拉伸法，结合三种水桶储水-排水模型。

Eight months of three-component broadband seismic recordings (July 2021–February 2022) from four TQ network stations in Taiwan's Liwu watershed, paired with daily precipitation, groundwater well, and river stage data.
台湾立雾溪流域4个TQ宽频带台站8个月的三分量地震记录，以及降水、地下水井和河流水位数据。

During Typhoon Kompasu, dv/v dropped by ~0.016–0.106 across stations; recovery took ~10 days at the upstream divide (TQ07), 68 days at sub-divide (TQ05), and exceeded 3 months downstream (TQ02) with a ~96-day shallow-deep coupled phase.
台风期间dv/v下降0.016–0.106；上游10天恢复，中游68天，下游超3个月且存在96天浅-深耦合期。

Rainfall varied across stations during the typhoon, making it difficult to attribute spatial differences in NSGD recovery solely to local subsurface properties; station TQ03 also suffered post-typhoon decorrelation.
各台站台风降雨量不同，难以将恢复差异完全归因于局部地下条件；TQ03台风后失相干。
Reveals that a single 5-day extreme typhoon event can induce multi-month watershed-scale reorganization of near-surface groundwater storage and trigger threshold-like vertical connectivity switching.
揭示单次极端台风即可引发流域尺度长达数月的浅表储水重组及垂向连通性阈值转换。

kc: Demonstrated spatial variability in post-typhoon seismic velocity (dv/v) recovery across a mountain watershed, from ~10 days upstream to >3 months downstream.
Linked prolonged downstream hydrological memory to thicker colluvial deposits (up to 20 m), fractured bedrock, and sustained lateral inflow from upstream.
Identified threshold-like switching between vertically coupled and decoupled states of near-surface and deep groundwater lasting ~96 days after a single typhoon.
揭示了山区流域台风后地震波速（dv/v）恢复的空间变异性，从上游约10天到下游超过3个月。
将下游长期的水文记忆归因于更厚的崩积物（厚达20米）、裂隙基岩以及来自上游的持续侧向流入。
识别出单次台风后近地表与深层地下水之间持续约96天的垂向耦合与解耦状态的阈值转换。
me: Single-station cross-component correlation (SC) of three-component broadband ambient seismic noise bandpass filtered at 4–8 Hz.
Coda wave interferometry using the stretching technique over a 1–4 s coda lapse time window stacked across six component combinations.
Linear bucket storage-drainage hydrological modeling (Models A, B, and C) incorporating baseline adjustments and temporal shifts to simulate dv/v.
对4–8 Hz带通滤波的三分量宽频带背景地震噪声进行单台跨分量互相关（SC）分析。
在1–4秒尾波流逝时间窗内使用拉伸技术进行尾波干涉测量，并叠加六个分量组合的相似性矩阵。
建立包含基线调整和时间延迟的线性水桶储水-排水水文模型（模型A、B和C）以模拟dv/v变化。

Hydrometeorological records during Typhoon Kompasu (October 2021), including 4 weather stations, 4 groundwater monitoring wells, and 1 river water level station.

台风期间各台站降雨量存在差异，难以将NSGD恢复的空间差异完全归因于局部地下地质条件。
