sum: Higher-order ambient seismic noise interferometry, specifically the re-correlation of reconstructed direct waves (C2), enables imaging across asynchronous station deployments. Using a 4,907-station dense array in the Vienna basin alongside analytical 2D acoustic simulations, this study investigates how non-isotropic noise source distributions affect C2 wavefields. The authors demonstrate theoretically and observationally that C2 processing amplifies isolated noise source contributions relative to homogeneous boundary sources because the isolated source phase is stationary with respect to auxiliary stations. Testing three auxiliary station selection strategies—all directions, endfire lobes, and fixed-angle cones—shows that none eliminates this directional bias, instead altering the wavefield anatomy in ways incompatible with standard Spatial Auto-Correlation (SPAC) models. Consequently, local focal-spot phase velocity regressions suffer errors up to 15%, and far-field group velocity measurements exhibit amplified interference biases, proving C2 is not an all-purpose wavefield enhancement tool.
高阶背景地震噪声干涉（特别是重建直接波的再相关C2）可实现异步台站成像。本研究利用维也纳盆地4907个密集台站数据及二维声波解析模拟，探究了非各向同性噪声源分布对C2波场的影响。理论与观测表明，由于孤立源相位相对于辅助台站是稳相的，对辅助台站叠加会相长干涉并放大孤立噪声源的贡献。测试全方向、端射瓣和……

t: Higher-order C2 correlations are constructed by separately re-correlating causal and anti-causal C1 wavefields between master, receiver, and auxiliary stations, evaluated using all-direction, endfire-lobe, and fixed-angle auxiliary station selections.
分别对C1因果与非因果部分在辅助台站间进行再相关构建C2波场，并评估全方向、端射瓣和固定角锥策略。

Four weeks of vertical-component ambient noise from a 4,907-station dense array in the Vienna basin (1,990 receivers, 304 auxiliary stations, 1 master station) and 2D analytical acoustic wavefield simulations.
奥地利维也纳盆地4907个台站密集台阵四周背景噪声数据（1990接收台、304辅助台）及二维解析声波模拟。

C2 processing amplifies isolated noise source wavefields due to stationary phase across auxiliary stations, causing local focal-spot phase velocity estimation errors up to 15% and increasing far-field group velocity biases.
辅助台站叠加会放大孤立噪声源效应，导致C2焦斑相速度估计产生高达15%的误差，并加剧远场群速度偏差。
C2 focal spots are incompatible with both isotropic and anisotropic SPAC theory, and field array aperture limits far-field propagation tests to synthetic simulations.
C2焦斑与现有SPAC理论不兼容，且受野外观测孔径限制，远场传播分析仅基于合成模拟。

First comprehensive demonstration via dense-array focal spots and theory that C2 direct-wave re-correlation amplifies rather than mitigates non-isotropic noise source bias across auxiliary station geometries.
首次结合密集台阵焦斑与解析理论证明直接波C2再相关会放大而非削弱非各向同性噪声源偏差。

kc: Demonstrates analytically and observationally that higher-order C2 correlations of direct waves amplify isolated noise source contributions because their phase is stationary with respect to auxiliary stations.

Evaluates three auxiliary station selection strategies (all-direction, endfire lobes, fixed-angle cones) and shows none mitigates directional source bias, instead introducing wavefield distortions incompatible with SPAC theory.

Quantifies systematic velocity biases caused by C2 source amplification, revealing up to 15% phase velocity errors in local focal spot imaging and severe group velocity errors in far-field surface wave propagation.
从解析理论和观测上证明，由于孤立源相位对辅助台站具有稳相性，直接波高阶C2互相关会放大孤立噪声源效应。
评估了三种辅助台站选择策略（全方向、端射瓣、固定角锥），证明它们均无法消除定向源偏差，反而引入与SPAC理论不兼容的波场畸变。
量化了C2震源效应放大导致的速度系统偏差，发现局地焦斑成像相速度误差高达15%，远场表面波群速度测量也存在显著干涉误差。
me: Higher-order inter-receiver ambient noise cross-correlation (C2) computed by separately re-correlating causal and anti-causal parts of standard C1 cross-correlations across auxiliary stations.
Analytical 2D acoustic wavefield modeling combining homogeneous circular boundary sources and clustered isolated sources to synthesize directional illumination.

Spatial Auto-Correlation (SPAC) focal spot phase velocity regression using both isotropic (J0) and anisotropic Bessel function parameterizations, alongside far-field envelope group velocity estimation.
高阶台站间背景噪声互相关（C2）：利用辅助台站分别对标准C1互相关的因果和非因果部分进行再相关与叠加。
二维声波解析波场模拟：结合均匀圆形边界源与孤立簇状噪声源以合成定向照明波场。
空间自相关（SPAC）焦斑相速度回归（采用各向同性J0和各向异性贝塞尔函数参数化）以及远场包络群速度估计。
de: Four weeks of continuous vertical-component ambient noise recorded in March 2019 by a large-N array (subset of 1,990 receiver stations, 304 auxiliary stations, 1 master station) in the Vienna basin, Austria, analyzed at 0.3 Hz.
Local-scale 2D synthetic wavefield experiments matching the Vienna array geometry with a 50 km radius circle of boundary sources and a Northwest cluster of isolated sources (c = 1.9 km/s).

Far-field 2D synthetic propagation experiments on a 70 x 70 kmreceiver grid (500 m spacing) with 180 boundary sources at 100 km radius, 180 auxiliary stations at 75 km radius, and a strong Northwest isolated source in the 0.2–0.4 Hz band.
2019年3月奥地利维也纳盆地密集台阵（选用1990个接收台、304个辅助台、1个主台）记录的四周垂直分量连续背景噪声数据，在0.3 Hz频段进行分析。
与维也纳台阵几何匹配的局地尺度二维合成波场实验，包含半径50公里的圆形边界源及西北方向的孤立源簇（介质速度1.9 km/s）。
70×70公里网格（间距500米）上的远场二维合成传播实验，包含100公里半径上的180个边界源、75公里半径上的180个辅助台及西北方向强孤立源（0.2–0.4 Hz）。
li: Analytical wavefield simulations assume a homogeneous 2D acoustic medium and neglect amplitude attenuation, geometrical spreading, and heterogeneous 3D Earth structure.
Field data aperture (~8 km) is small relative to the 0.3 Hz wavelength (~6.3 km), restricting far-field propagating surface-wave analysis strictly to synthetic waveforms.
Existing isotropic and anisotropic SPAC theoretical models cannot account for the energy redistribution introduced by auxiliary station selection in C2 focal spots.
解析波场模拟假设二维均匀声学介质，忽略了振幅衰减、几何扩散和三维非均匀地球结构响应。
野外观测台阵孔径（约8公里）相对于0.3 Hz波长（约6.3公里）较小，因此远场表面波传播分析仅限于合成波形。
现有的各向同性和各向异性SPAC理论模型无法描述C2焦斑中由辅助台站选择引起的能量重分布。

tm.why: The paper investigates source effects in higher-order ambient seismic noise cross-correlations (C2 wavefields) using dense array data and analytical wavefield simulations.
The study quantifies the impact of amplified source directivity in higher-order correlations on local focal spot phase velocity imaging and far-field surface-wave group velocity tomography.

ev.notes: Full 21-page PDF analyzed, including equations, Vienna basin large-N array processing, analytical 2D simulations, and all 9 figures.

sum: Detecting short-term precursory deformation in slow-straining intraplate regions is challenging. This study combines continuous 3D micrometric fault-displacement monitoring (TM-71 moiré extensometer) inside Altaquelle Cave, Austria, with Sentinel-1 InSAR time series and seismic focal mechanism analyses for the Spring 2021 Vienna Basin earthquake sequence (mainshock Mw 4.2). The authors detected two sub-millimetric fault-slip reversals (0.186 mm and 0.614 mm) occurring 15 and 4 days before the mainshock, exhibiting oblique reverse-dextral slip and upward dilation opposite to the fault's long-term normal-sinistral motion. Reduced stress tensors inverted from these precursory displacements match the compressional axes derived from subsequent earthquake moment tensors. Simultaneously, Getis-Ord hot-spot analysis of InSAR vertical velocities revealed basin-scale deformation evolving from butterfly-shaped lobes to a lenticular uplift centered on the epicentral zone, uncorrelated with groundwater or meteorological records. These multi-scale observations demonstrate that shallow fault-slip reversals capture deep-seated transient stress reorganization preceding intraplate ruptures.
本研究结合奥地利洞穴内TM-71三维引伸计微米级断层监测、Sentinel-1 InSAR时间序列及震源机制解，分析了2021年春季维也纳盆地Mw 4.2板内地震序列。在主震前15天和4天观测到两次亚毫米级断层滑动反转（0.186 mm和0.614 mm），表现为与长期左旋正断相反的右旋逆冲和垂向张……

t: A TM-71 mechanical moiré extensometer recorded daily 3D micrometric fault displacements in Altaquelle Cave, which were inverted for principal stress tensors using SMB2018 and compared with Getis-Ord hot-spot maps of EGMS Sentinel-1 InSAR vertical motions.
利用洞穴TM-71引伸计记录每日三维微米级位移，通过SMB2018反演主应力张量，并与Sentinel-1 InSAR垂…

Data include daily 3D fault displacements (2018–2021), 285 cataloged earthquakes within 20 km with moment tensors (February–May 2021), 100-m EGMS Sentinel-1 InSAR time series, and local rainfall and groundwater level records.
包含2018-2021年每日三维断层位移、20km内285次地震目录与矩张量、100m分辨率EGMS InSAR时间序列…

Two fault-slip reversals of 0.186 mm (oblique reverse-dextral) and 0.614 mm (vertical upward dilation) occurred 15 and 4 days before the Mw 4.2 mainshock, yielding inverted stress states consistent with earthquake focal mechanisms and regional InSAR uplift.
Mw 4.2主震前15天和4天发生0.186 mm和0.614 mm滑动反转，反演应力与震源机制及区域InSAR隆起演化…

The authors did not perform quantitative dislocation modeling, the extensometer's daily sampling limits causal dynamic triggering analysis, and InSAR hot-spot analysis operates at the method's resolution limit without formal absolute quantification.
未开展定量位错模拟，引伸计每日采样限制了动态触发分析，且InSAR热点分析处于分辨率极限缺乏绝对量化。

Provides rare multi-scale documentation of short-term precursory fault-slip reversals and coherent basin-scale InSAR deformation with independent stress constraints preceding an intraplate earthquake sequence.
首次结合独立应力约束与跨尺度InSAR观测，直接记录了板内地震序列前的短期断层滑动反转前兆。

kc: Documented two sub-millimetric fault-slip reversals (0.186 mm and 0.614 mm) 15 and 4 days prior to the 2021 Mw 4.2 Vienna Basin intraplate mainshock using a 3D cave extensometer.
Demonstrated that principal stress orientations inverted from precursory 3D fault displacements match the stress regimes of subsequent earthquake focal mechanisms.
Identified contemporaneous basin-scale vertical deformation patterns via PS-InSAR hot-spot analysis that evolved from butterfly lobes to a lenticular uplift, ruling out hydrological forcing.
利用三维洞穴引伸计记录了2021年维也纳盆地Mw 4.2板内主震前15天和4天的两次亚毫米级断层滑动反转（0.186 mm和0.614 mm）。
证实由前兆三维断层位移反演的主应力方向与后续地震震源机制推导的应力状态高度吻合。
通过PS-InSAR热点分析识别出同期盆地尺度垂直形变由蝶形演变为透镜状隆起，并排除了水文气象驱动因素。
me: Continuous 3D micrometric fault displacement monitoring using an optical-mechanical TM-71 moiré extensometer in a thermally stable cave.
Reduced stress tensor inversion (SMB2018 / StressCalc) from single-fault 3D hanging-wall displacement vectors assuming Andersonian zero surface horizontal shear stress.
Getis-Ord (Gi*) spatial hot-spot analysis applied to European Ground Motion Service (EGMS) Sentinel-1 L3 ortho-rectified vertical InSAR time series.
在热稳定洞穴内利用光机式TM-71莫尔条纹引伸计进行连续三维微米级断层位移监测。
基于Anderson地表零水平剪应力假设，由单一断层上盘三维位移矢量反演简化应力张量（SMB2018 / StressCalc）。
对欧洲地面运动服务（EGMS）Sentinel-1 L3垂直向InSAR时间序列应用Getis-Ord (Gi*)空间热点统计分析。
de: Daily 3D displacement records from the Altaquelle Fault in Altaquelle Cave (October 2018 to July 2021).
Catalog of 285 regional earthquakes within 20 km (February–May 2021), including relocated hypocenters and full moment tensor solutions.
EGMS Sentinel-1 InSAR vertical displacement grids (100-m resolution) alongside local rainfall, cave air temperature, and groundwater/hydrothermal lake level time series.
2018年10月至2021年7月Altaquelle洞穴断层的每日三维位移观测记录。
2021年2月至5月洞穴周边20 km内的285次区域地震目录、重定位震源及全矩张量解。
100米分辨率EGMS Sentinel-1 InSAR垂直位移网格数据，以及当地降雨量、洞穴气温和地下水/热液湖水位时间序列。
li: Daily sampling rate (once per day at 00:00 UTC) of the TM-71 extensometer precludes resolving sub-daily kinematics or definitive dynamic triggering links.
InSAR Getis-Ord hot-spot analysis operates near the resolution limit and yields spatial confidence clusters rather than formal absolute deformation quantification.
Lack of quantitative elastic dislocation modeling to mechanically couple deep preslip or stress perturbations with the observed shallow fault-slip reversals.
TM-71引伸计每日一次（00:00 UTC）的采样率无法分辨亚日尺度运动学特征或确立动态触发因果关系。
InSAR热点分析处于方法分辨率极限附近，仅提供空间置信度聚类而非严格的绝对形变量化。
缺乏定量的弹性位错数值模拟来建立深部震前滑动或应力扰动与浅表断层滑动反转之间的力学耦合。

tm.why: The paper documents sub-millimetric aseismic creep and precursory fault-slip reversals monitored by a 3D cave extensometer prior to an intraplate earthquake sequence.
It links precursory fault displacement stress inversions to earthquake focal mechanisms and preparation processes of the 2021 Mw 4.2 Vienna Basin sequence.
It investigates basin-scale surface deformation via InSAR and tectonic stress reorganization across the Vienna Basin Transfer Fault and Mur-Mürz fault systems.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF of Baroň et al. (2026) in Geophysical Research Letters was analyzed, including text, equations, references, and all three main figures.

sum: Inferring lowermost mantle (D'') seismic anisotropy from diffracted shear waves (Sdiff) is complicated by upper mantle anisotropy and apparent splitting caused by SVdiff energy in isotropic structures. This study uses global AxiSEM3D wavefield simulations through 1-D (PREM) and 3-D (S40RTS) isotropic models to design a fully automated quality-control workflow based on SplitRacerAUTO. By requiring null upper-mantle (*KS) splitting and introducing an amplitude ratio criterion (ampdiff >= 2, comparing transverse Sdiff to radial *KS peak amplitudes) alongside strict polarization filtering, the method isolates strongly SH-polarized Sdiff waves and suppresses false splitting to under 2%. Applied to ~20 million three-component seismograms from the ADEPT database, the workflow yields 4,320 high-confidence splitting and null measurements. Binned into H3 hexagonal cells and 15-degree propagation azimuth intervals, the dataset covers 237 bins (~28% of the CMB area), revealing clear splitting in 55 bins and tripling the previously sampled D'' footprint.
利用沿核幔边界衍射的横波（Sdiff）推断最下地幔（D''层）各向异性常受上地幔各向异性和SVdiff引起的假分裂干扰。本研究利用AxiSEM3D进行1D和3D全球波场数值模拟，结合SplitRacerAUTO开发了全自动测量与质控流程。通过筛选上地幔SKS/SKKS零分裂台站、限制偏振方向，并引入……

t: Automated radial-component energy minimization via SplitRacerAUTO combined with null-*KS upper-mantle filtering, ±10° SH polarization selection, and a transverse-Sdiff to radial-*KS amplitude ratio threshold (ampdiff ≥ 2).
利用SplitRacerAUTO最小化径向分量能量，结合*KS零分裂筛选、±10°偏振约束及振幅比阈值（ampdiff …
Over 20 million three-component seismograms from >6,300 earthquakes (Mw ≥ 5.8 since 1995) in the ADEPT database, plus 5-s global AxiSEM3D synthetic seismograms in PREM and S40RTS.
ADEPT数据库中6300余次Mw≥5.8地震的超2000万条三分量波形，以及PREM和S40RTS模型的AxiSEM3…
At ampdiff ≥ 2, false splitting in isotropic synthetics is <2%, and real data yield 4,320 robust Sdiff measurements covering 237 CMB hexagonal bins (~28% of D'' area), with 55 split bins.
当ampdiff ≥ 2时假分裂率低于2%，获得4320个可靠Sdiff测量，覆盖237个核幔边界网格（占D''面积28…
Explicit Sdiff waveform splitting measurements are insensitive to radial anisotropy end-members (fast axis near 0° or 90°), yielding null observations instead of splitting.
显式Sdiff分裂测量对纯径向各向异性端元（快轴接近0°或90°）不敏感，这些结构会表现为零分裂。
First uniform global automated analysis of explicit Sdiff waveform splitting, tripling the D'' area sampled by all previous Sdiff studies and systematically reporting nulls and azimuthal dependence.
首次实现全球Sdiff显式分裂统一自动分析，将D''采样面积扩大三倍，并系统报告零分裂与方位依赖性。

kc: Developed a fully automated, wavefield-simulation-informed Sdiff shear-wave splitting workflow that excludes SVdiff-contaminated waveforms via an amplitude ratio proxy (ampdiff >= 2) and polarization criteria.
Processed ~20 million three-component seismograms to produce a curated global catalog of 4,320 high-confidence Sdiff splitting and null measurements.

Geographically and directionally binned the measurements across 237 CMB hexagonal bins (~28% of D'' surface area) and 24 azimuth bins, tripling total D'' coverage compared to all prior studies combined.
Publicly released all individual and binned splitting measurements (including null observations) and reproducible processing codes.
开发了基于全球波场模拟指导的Sdiff横波分裂全自动测量流程，通过振幅比指标（ampdiff ≥ 2）和偏振准则有效剔除受SVdiff污染的假分裂波形。
处理了约2000万条三分量地震记录，生成了包含4320个高置信度Sdiff分裂和零分裂测量的全球精选数据集。
采用H3六边形网格和24个方位角区间对测量结果进行空间和方向分箱，覆盖237个核幔边界网格（占D''层面积约28%），将以往研究的采样总面积扩大了约三倍。
公开了所有单次测量与分箱数据产品（系统性包含零分裂观测）以及完整的可复现分析代码。
me: Automated radial-component energy minimization via SplitRacerAUTO (6-25 s bandpass filter across 30 time windows) to measure fast polarization direction (phi'), delay time (dt), and splitting intensity (SI).
Conservative upper-mantle correction by retaining only measurements at null *KS stations or within 3 degrees backazimuth of a null SKS/SKKS observation.
Global 3-D spectral-element wavefield simulations (AxiSEM3D down to 5 s period in PREM and S40RTS) to quantify apparent splitting from SV-polarized Sdiff waves.
Quality filtering requiring covariance-matrix polarization within +-10 degrees of SH and transverse-Sdiff to radial-*KS peak amplitude ratio (ampdiff) >= 2.
Spatial and directional binning on the CMB using H3 resolution-1 hexagons (~400 km edge length) and 15-degree propagation azimuth bins with fractional raypath weighting.
利用SplitRacerAUTO进行径向分量能量最小化自动测量（6–25 s带通滤波，30个时间窗），获取快波偏振方向（phi'）、延迟时间（dt）和分裂强度（SI）。
采用保守的上地幔各向异性剔除策略，仅保留全球*KS零分裂台站或后方位角3°以内存在SKS/SKKS零分裂观测的Sdiff记录。
利用AxiSEM3D在PREM和S40RTS模型中开展周期低至5秒的全球三维谱元波场模拟，量化SV偏振引起的假分裂效应。
实施严格质控：要求协方差矩阵主偏振方向偏离理论SH方向不超过±10°，且Sdiff切向与参考*KS径向峰值振幅比（ampdiff）≥ 2。
基于H3一级分辨率六边形网格（边长约400 km）和15°传播方位角区间进行核幔边界射线路径加权与多数投票分类。
de: ADEPT global seismic dataset aggregating >20 million three-component seismograms from >6,300 earthquakes (Mw >= 5.8) recorded since January 1, 1995 across 27 data centers.
Synthetic wavefield experiments using AxiSEM3D with a 500-km-deep strike-slip source at the North Pole and virtual stations at 105-135 degrees epicentral distance and 1-degree azimuthal spacing.
ADEPT全球地震数据集，汇集了27个数据中心自1995年1月1日以来记录的6300余次Mw ≥ 5.8地震的超过2000万条三分量波形。
AxiSEM3D合成波场数值实验，在北极设置500 km深走滑震源，在震中距105°–135°、方位角间隔1°布设虚拟台站。
li: Explicit Sdiff shear-wave splitting measurements are insensitive to end-member radial anisotropy geometries (phi' near 0 or 90 degrees where VSH > VSV or VSV > VSH), yielding null measurements.
Selecting only null *KS stations/backazimuths and requiring ampdiff >= 2 is highly conservative, substantially reducing geographical coverage to ~28% of the CMB.
A mild epicentral distance-dependent sampling bias remains in the hexagonal binning because longer diffracted raypaths at greater distances sample more hexagons.
显式Sdiff波形分裂测量对端元径向各向异性几何结构（phi'接近0°或90°，即纯VSH > VSV或VSV > VSH）不敏感，这些情况会产生零分裂测量。
仅保留上地幔*KS零分裂记录及要求ampdiff ≥ 2的策略较为保守，使核幔边界的有效覆盖率受限于约28%。
随震中距增加，核幔边界衍射路径变长并穿过更多六边形网格，尽管采用了分数权重，仍存在轻微的距离相关采样偏差。

tm.why: The paper develops an automated workflow to measure Sdiff shear-wave splitting to constrain seismic anisotropy in the lowermost mantle (D'' layer).
The curated global Sdiff splitting dataset directly constrains deformation and convective flow in the lowermost mantle (D'' layer) across 28% of the core-mantle boundary.
Global 3-D spectral-element wavefield simulations using AxiSEM3D down to 5 s period are used to evaluate apparent splitting artifacts and validate quality-control criteria.

ev.notes: Full 19-page GJI preprint PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology, synthetic AxiSEM3D experiments, H3 geographic/directional binning, results, discussion, data/code availability, and all 8 figures.

sum: This study investigates 2015–2024 seismicity (~17,000 events) in the south-eastern Alps and Western Dinarides (SEAWD) using a multiscale relocation and clustering workflow. Starting from the OGS bulletin, the authors apply multi-iterative NonLinLoc with Source-Specific Station Terms (NLL-SSST) at the regional scale, shifting hypocenters shallower and mitigating 1D velocity-model errors. Zaliapin nearest-neighbour clustering identifies 76 sequences, 71 of which are refined at the local scale using waveform-coherence-based NonLinLoc (NLL-SC), achieving sub-kilometer relative precision. Sequence classification shows a dominance of foreshock–mainshock–aftershock (65%) and mainshock–aftershock (32%) sequences, with rare swarms (3%). Principal component analysis coupled with coherence-weighted Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation demonstrates that 56% of sequences form robust planar geometries aligned with regional focal mechanisms, while 41% are unconstrained compact clusters. Notably, foreshock-bearing sequences exhibit smaller average mainshock magnitudes but larger preparatory volumes than pure mainshock–aftershock sequences.
本研究针对2015–2024年东南阿尔卑斯和西迪纳拉（SEAWD）地区的约17,000次地震，实施了多尺度重定位与聚类分析。首先利用多迭代NonLinLoc源特定台站校正（NLL-SSST）进行区域重定位，随后采用最近邻算法识别地震序列，并利用基于波形相干性的NonLinLoc（NLL-SC）对71……

t: A multiscale workflow combining iterative NonLinLoc Source-Specific Station Term (NLL-SSST) regional relocation, Zaliapin nearest-neighbour clustering, local waveform-coherence relocation (NLL-SC), and PCA with coherence-weighted Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.
结合NLL-SSST区域迭代重定位、最近邻聚类、NLL-SC局部波形相干重定位及相干加权蒙特卡洛PCA分析。

Approximately 17,000 earthquakes (Mc = 0.6, depths 0–45 km) recorded between 2015 and 2024 in the OGS bulletin across ~150 stations from 13 seismic networks in northeastern Italy and neighboring countries.
2015–2024年OGS目录中由13个台网约150个台站记录的约17,000次地震（Mc=0.6，深度0–45 km）…

Relocated 16,053 events and characterized 71 sequences (65% FMA, 32% MA, 3% SW) with horizontal errors <0.5 km; 56% exhibit planar geometries matching mainshock focal mechanisms within a mean angle of 35.5°.
重定位16,053个事件并表征71个序列（65%为FMA）；56%呈平面结构，与震源机制平均夹角35.5°。
Uncertainties persist due to using a single regional 1D velocity model across a heterogeneous 360 x 280 km2 domain and variable station coverage near network boundaries.
受限于360×280 km²区域内的一维速度模型以及台网边缘不均匀的台站覆盖。

Combines multiscale NLL-SC waveform-coherence relocation with a coherence-weighted Monte Carlo PCA volume analysis in SEAWD, revealing higher foreshock incidence (65%) and larger preparatory volumes for FMA sequences.
首次在SEAWD结合NLL-SC精定位与相干加权蒙特卡洛PCA体积分析，揭示高比例前震序列及更大准备体积。

kc: Relocated 16,053 earthquakes (2015–2024) in the SEAWD region using iterative NLL-SSST and refined 71 sequences using waveform-coherence NLL-SC to sub-kilometer precision.
Classified 71 sequences into 65% foreshock–mainshock–aftershock (FMA), 32% mainshock–aftershock (MA), and 3% swarm (SW), showing higher foreshock detection due to improved locations.
Developed a coherence-weighted Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation scheme for PCA and 3D Delaunay volume estimation that preserves pseudo-relative event clustering.

Demonstrated that 56% of sequences are planar (consistent with mainshock focal mechanisms within ~35.5° on average) and that FMA sequences occupy systematically larger volumes for a given mainshock magnitude than MA sequences.
利用迭代NLL-SSST重定位了SEAWD地区16,053次地震，并采用波形相干NLL-SC对71个地震序列进行了亚公里级精定位。
将71个序列分类为65%前震-主震-余震型（FMA）、32%主震-余震型（MA）和3%震群型（SW），证明精定位显著提升了前震识别率。
提出了保持伪相对聚类特征的相干加权蒙特卡洛不确定性传播方法，用于PCA几何分类与三维Delaunay序列体积估计。
证实56%的序列呈平面分布（与主震震源机制平均夹角约35.5°），且给定主震震级下FMA序列比MA序列具有更大的空间体积。
me: Iterative regional probabilistic relocation using NonLinLoc with Source-Specific Station Terms (NLL-SSST) across 6 smoothing scales (32 km down to 2 km).
Space-time-magnitude nearest-neighbour clustering (Zaliapin method with b=0, Dc=1.5, minimum 10 events) to separate clustered sequences from background seismicity.
Local-scale waveform-coherence relocation (NLL-SC) using 2–10 Hz bandpass-filtered waveforms from 4–8 nearby stations for event pairs within 5 km.
3D Delaunay convex hull volume estimation and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) with 100-realization coherence-weighted Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation.
采用带源特定台站校正的NonLinLoc（NLL-SSST）进行6级平滑尺度（32 km至2 km）的区域迭代概率重定位。
利用时空震级最近邻聚类算法（Zaliapin方法，b=0，Dc=1.5，最少10个事件）分离背景地震与丛集序列。
基于序列附近4–8个台站2–10 Hz滤波波形，对间距5 km以内的事件对进行局部波形相干重定位（NLL-SC）。
结合100次相干加权蒙特卡洛不确定性传播，开展三维Delaunay凸包体积估计与主成分分析（PCA）几何分类。
de: OGS seismic bulletin catalogue (2015–2024) containing ~17,000 events (0–45 km depth, Mc = 0.6) in the south-eastern Alps and Western Dinarides.
Phase picks and waveform data from ~150 stations across 13 Italian and European seismic networks (OX, NI, IV, EV, RF, ST, SI, MN, HA, OE, SL, CR, CH).
Comparison against mapped faults from the Database of Individual Seismogenic Sources (DISS v3.3.1) and regional mainshock focal mechanism catalogues.
东南阿尔卑斯和西迪纳拉地区2015–2024年OGS地震目录，包含约17,000个事件（深度0–45 km，完备震级Mc = 0.6）。
来自意大利及欧洲13个地震台网（OX、NI、IV等）约150个台站的震相走时拾取与波形数据。
与意大利潜在震源数据库（DISS v3.3.1）断层迹线及区域主震震源机制目录进行对比验证。
li: Relies on a regional 1D velocity model across a 360 x 280 km2 heterogeneous area rather than a 3D velocity model.
Sparse and heterogeneous station coverage near the southwestern and southeastern network borders degrades vertical location accuracy and forced exclusion of 5 sequences.
Statistical distinction between FMA and MA volume-magnitude scaling intercepts is weak due to large scatter within the FMA population.
在360 × 280 km²的复杂非均质区域内依赖区域一维速度模型，尚未使用三维速度模型。
研究区西南和东南边界附近台站覆盖稀疏且不均，降低了垂向定位精度并导致5个序列被剔除。
由于FMA序列体积变异性较大，FMA与MA序列在体积-震级标度关系截距上的差异尚不具备强统计显著性。

tm.why: The core workflow relocates ~17,000 catalogue earthquakes using multi-iterative NLL-SSST and waveform-coherence NLL-SC, combined with nearest-neighbour clustering.
The study characterizes 3D fault-zone geometry, sequence volumes, and foreshock-mainshock-aftershock vs. swarm triggering mechanisms across active Alpine-Dinaric fault structures.
The paper links relocated sequence geometries, seismogenic depths, and focal mechanisms to the tectonic deformation of the south-eastern Alps and Western Dinarides.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF article in Scientific Reports used, including all 8 main text figures, equations, and references to supplementary material.

sum: Reliable snow avalanche detection is critical for alpine hazard mitigation, but single-sensor-type systems face limitations, such as infrasound missing wet-snow avalanches and seismic data suffering from high noise. This study presents a modular, physics- and threshold-based workflow combining data from a co-located seismo-acoustic array (five seismometers and five infrasound sensors) in the Dischma Valley, Switzerland, recorded over five winters. The two-step detection method uses sliding-window pairwise cross-correlations to identify candidate seismo-acoustic events, followed by threshold filters based on duration, peak seismic amplitude, and beamforming backazimuths. In a development dataset of three winters (89 avalanches), the workflow reduced false positives from 5,329 to 356 while missing only 4 avalanches. Notably, seismic amplitude filtering retains wet-snow avalanches that infrasound-only thresholds miss. Furthermore, cross-correlating co-located seismic and infrasound sensors quantifies seismo-acoustic coupling, successfully classifying dry- versus wet-snow avalanches with only 9 misclassifications out of 83 single-regime events.
本研究提出了一种结合同址地震和次声台阵数据的模块化雪崩自动检测与分类工作流。利用瑞士Dischma山谷5个地震仪和5个次声传感器连续五个冬季的数据，首先通过滑动窗互相关识别候选事件，随后利用持续时间、峰值地震振幅和波束形成反方位角等阈值滤除噪声。在三个冬季的开发集（89次雪崩）上，该方法将误报从53……

t: A two-step Python workflow merges pairwise cross-correlation detection clusters from seismic and infrasound arrays, filters false positives using duration, amplitude, and beamforming backazimuth thresholds, and classifies avalanche type via co-located seismo-acoustic cross-correlation.
两步式Python工作流：合并地震和次声互相关检测簇，利用时长、振幅和反方位角阈值滤除误报，并通过同址震声互相关对雪崩类…

Continuous 200 Hz data from five co-located seismometers and five infrasound sensors in a 110 m triangular array in Dischma Valley, Switzerland, across five winters (2020–2025), validated by cameras, Doppler radar, and SNOWPACK simulations.
瑞士Dischma山谷110米孔径三角形台阵（5组同址地震与次声传感器）5个冬季的200 Hz连续数据，辅以相机、雷达和…

Across three winters (89 avalanches), filtering reduced false positives from 5,329 to 356 while missing only 4 avalanches. A seismo-acoustic correlation threshold of 0.38 correctly classified 28/31 dry-snow and 46/52 wet-snow avalanches.
在三个冬季（89次雪崩）中将误报从5329次降至356次（仅漏报4次）；0.38的震声互相关阈值正确分类了28/31次干…
The workflow still yields 356 false positives over three winters, seismic beamforming exhibits up to 90° backazimuth scatter, and testing on the reserved two-winter dataset is still pending.
三个冬季仍有356次误报，地震波束形成存在高达90°的反方位角散射，且尚未在预留的两个冬季测试集上评估。

Jointly exploits co-located seismic and infrasound arrays in a unified threshold-based detector and introduces seismo-acoustic cross-correlation to automatically classify dry- versus wet-snow avalanches.
在统一阈值检测器中联合利用同址地震与次声台阵，并首次引入同址震声互相关自动区分干雪与湿雪雪崩。

kc: Developed a two-step automatic seismo-acoustic avalanche detection and filtering framework using array cross-correlation and beamforming.
Demonstrated that incorporating seismic amplitude thresholds retains small wet-snow avalanches that are missed by standard infrasound-only thresholds.
Introduced a post-processing avalanche classifier using cross-correlation between co-located seismic and infrasound sensors to distinguish dry- from wet-snow avalanches.
开发了利用台阵互相关和波束形成的两步式地震-次声雪崩自动检测与滤波框架。
证明了引入地震振幅阈值可以保留标准纯次声阈值容易漏检的小型湿雪雪崩。
提出了利用同址地震与次声传感器互相关的后处理雪崩分类器，成功区分干雪与湿雪雪崩。
me: Bandpass filtering (2–10 Hz) and bandstop filtering (5–7 Hz on seismic data) to suppress local persistent noise.
Pairwise sliding-window (5 s) cross-correlations within each array to form and merge seismic and infrasound detection clusters.
Fast plane-wave beamforming to extract apparent velocity and backazimuth for threshold-based false-positive filtering.
Zero-lag/sliding-window cross-correlation between co-located seismic and infrasound sensors with threshold optimization (0.38) for dry/wet classification.
采用带通滤波（2–10 Hz）和带阻滤波（地震数据5–7 Hz）抑制局地持续噪声。
计算各台阵内5秒滑动窗成对互相关，生成并合并地震与次声检测簇。
利用快速平面波波束形成提取视速度和反方位角，用于基于阈值的误报滤除。
计算同址地震和次声传感器的滑动窗互相关并优化阈值（0.38），实现干/湿雪崩分类。
de: Continuous 200 Hz recordings from a 110 m aperture triangular array of 5 seismometers and 5 infrasound sensors in Dischma Valley, Switzerland, across 5 winters (2020–2025).
Expert-labeled catalog validated with 12 automatic time-lapse cameras and a Doppler avalanche radar (134 avalanches and 1,654 noise events).
Ground-truth snowpack liquid water content simulated using the physical SNOWPACK model to categorize events into dry (54), wet (66), and mixed (14) avalanches.
瑞士Dischma山谷110米孔径三角形台阵（5个地震仪和5个次声传感器）连续5个冬季（2020–2025）的200 Hz记录。
结合12台自动延时相机和多普勒雪崩雷达验证的专家标注目录（包含134次雪崩和1654次噪声事件）。
利用SNOWPACK物理模型模拟积雪液态水含量作为真值，将事件分为干雪（54次）、湿雪（66次）和混合型（14次）雪崩。
li: The workflow still produces 356 false positives over three winter seasons and requires further optimization.
Evaluation is currently limited to the 3-winter development dataset; the 2-winter test set and transferability to other sites remain to be evaluated.
Greater scattering in seismic beamforming causes up to 90 degrees discrepancy between seismic and infrasound backazimuths.
该工作流在三个冬季内仍产生356次误报，需要进一步优化。
目前评估仅限于3个冬季的开发集，预留的2个冬季测试集及向其他场地的可迁移性尚待评估。
地震波束形成中较大的散射导致地震与次声反方位角之间存在高达90度的差异。

tm.why: The study focuses on environmental/cryosphere seismology by automatically detecting and characterizing snow avalanches using seismic and infrasound arrays.
The workflow relies on a co-located seismo-acoustic array of five seismometers and five infrasound sensors using beamforming and cross-correlation.
The paper develops an automatic event detection, filtering, and classification pipeline to build and evaluate an avalanche event catalog from continuous waveform data.

ev.notes: Full 7-page conference paper PDF from ISSW 2026 used, including all text, 5 figures, and 1 table.

sum: This study presents the first time-resolved 4D (3D space + time) experimental velocity measurements of multiple interacting laminar thermal plumes in a high-Prandtl-number, temperature-dependent viscosity Rayleigh-Bénard system. Using 3D Scanning Stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (SSPIV) on heated corn syrup, alongside Lagrangian Coherent Structures (backward Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent, FTLE) and cluster analysis, the authors track tens of coexisting plumes over 60 epochs (~8000 s). They identify diverse dynamical behaviors including bottom-up merging, superplume aggregation, downwelling- or boundary-layer-induced splitting, wide-angle branching, pulsing, and head detachment. Scaled to Earth's mantle, the results indicate narrow plume stems (~65 km), minimum spacings (~800 km for free-slip CMB) matching seismic anomalies in LLSVPs, and Péclet-scaled rising speeds of 4.9–16.4 cm/yr. Notably, textbook isolated plumes account for only 0–60% of plumes at any time. This unified framework of plume evolutionary pathways provides a vital laboratory benchmark for geodynamic simulations and deep-mantle seismic tomography.
本研究利用三维扫描立体粒子图像测速技术（SSPIV）与拉格朗日相干结构（FTLE）聚类分析，首次对高普朗特数、温度依赖粘度的瑞利-贝纳德对流系统进行了时间分辨的4D（三维空间+时间）流速测量。通过对加热玉米糖浆中数十个共存热羽流的追踪，识别出合并、超地幔柱聚集、分裂、宽角分叉、脉动和头部脱离等丰富动……

t: 3D Scanning Stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (SSPIV) combined with backward Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent (FTLE) ridges, K-D tree, and minimum spanning tree cluster analysis to track 3D plume geometry and velocities over time.
结合三维扫描立体粒子图像测速（SSPIV）、后向有限时间李雅普诺夫指数（FTLE）脊与最小生成树聚类分析。
60 epochs of 4D velocity scans across 69 planes (5 mm spacing) over ~8000 s in a basally heated corn-syrup tank (405×275×405 mm, Ra = 1.9×10^6 to 1.2×10^8, Pr > 3000).
底部加热玉米糖浆水箱在约8000秒内跨越69个平面的60个纪元4D速度场数据（Ra达1.2×10^8）。
Quasi-stable Stage 3 has 13–19 plumes, 83.6±5.3 mm mean spacing (38.3±6.1 mm minimum), 6±1 mm stem width, 0.5 mm/s rising speed, and PSD peaks at 300 s, 500 s, and 1000 s; isolated plumes are 0–60%.
准稳定阶段有13–19个羽流，平均间距83.6 mm，茎宽6 mm，特征周期为300、500和1000秒，孤立羽流占0–…
Limited temporal resolution (~130 s per epoch) and near-boundary coverage, absence of direct fluid temperature measurements, and lack of tectonic plate boundaries.
时间分辨率（~130秒）和近边界覆盖有限，未直接测量流体温度，缺乏板块边界。

First quantitative time-resolved 4D velocity measurements of multiple interacting laminar thermal plumes in a high-Prandtl-number temperature-dependent viscosity fluid, establishing a unified evolutionary pathway network.
首次获得高粘度流体中多个相互作用层流热羽流的4D速度场，建立了统一的羽流演化路径网络。

kc: First time-resolved 4D volumetric velocity measurements of multiple interacting laminar plumes in high-Prandtl-number viscous convection.
Identification and synthesis of a unified network of plume evolutionary pathways: merging, superplume formation, splitting, branching, pulsing, and detachment.
Quantitative determination of characteristic plume lengthscales (stem width, head size, spacing) and timescales (300 s interaction, 500 s initiation/travel, 1000 s cycle).
Geophysical scaling to Earth's mantle explaining tree-like seismic anomalies near LLSVPs, hotspot longevity (50–100 Myr), and volcanic pulsing (20–30 Myr).
首次实现了高普朗特数粘性对流中多个相互作用层流热羽流的时间分辨4D体积流速测量。
识别并综合了统一的羽流演化路径网络：合并、超地幔柱形成、分裂、分叉、脉动和头部脱离。
定量测定了特征羽流长度尺度（茎宽、头部尺寸、间距）和时间尺度（300秒相互作用、500秒萌发/上升、1000秒完整周期）。
尺度缩放到地球地幔，解释了LLSVP附近的树状地震异常结构、热点寿命（50–100 Myr）和火山活动脉动（20–30 Myr）。
me: 3D Scanning Stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (SSPIV) across 69 planes over 60 epochs (~130 s per epoch).
Lagrangian frame transformation computing backward Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent (FTLE) ridges to isolate plume material interfaces.
K-D tree and Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) cluster analysis to track plume velocity centers, inter-plume spacing, and characteristic rising speeds.
Optical distortion and raw tracer image analysis to constrain narrow plume stem widths and head diameters.
在69个平面上进行60个纪元（每个纪元约130秒）的三维扫描立体粒子图像测速（SSPIV）。
拉格朗日框架转换，计算后向有限时间李雅普诺夫指数（FTLE）脊以分离羽流物质界面。
利用K-D树和最小生成树（MST）聚类分析追踪羽流速度中心、羽流间距和特征上升速度。
结合光学畸变和原始示踪粒子图像分析，约束狭窄的羽流茎宽度和头部直径。
de: Basally heated plexiglass tank (405 mm × 275 mm × 405 mm) filled with tracer-laden corn syrup heated from 25°C to 80°C over ~8000 s.
Dimensionless convective regime with global Ra = 1.9 × 10^6, local basal Ra_delta = 1.2 × 10^8, Pr = 3.4 × 10^3 to 2.2 × 10^5, and viscosity contrast up to 65.
60 epochs of synchronized 4D velocity fields covering 68% of the fluid volume at 3.53 × 3.53 × 5 mm spatial resolution.
底部加热的有机玻璃水箱（405 mm × 275 mm × 405 mm），装有含示踪粒子的玉米糖浆，从25°C加热至80°C，持续约8000秒。
无量纲对流状态：全局瑞利数 Ra = 1.9 × 10^6，局部底部 Ra_delta = 1.2 × 10^8，普朗特数 Pr = 3.4 × 10^3 至 2.2 × 10^5，粘度对比度高达65。
60个纪元的同步4D速度场数据，以 3.53 × 3.53 × 5 mm 的空间分辨率覆盖68%的流体体积。
li: Limited temporal resolution (~130 s per epoch) broadens FTLE ridges and prevents resolving timescales above 1000 s.
No direct temperature or heat flux measurements were acquired inside the fluid tank.
Fixed rectangular geometry with no-slip boundaries lacks plate-like surface boundaries, plate-driven lateral shear, and thermochemical stratification.
有限的时间分辨率（每纪元约130秒）使FTLE脊变宽，且无法稳健解析1000秒以上的时间尺度。
未在流体水箱内部直接测量温度场或热通量。
固定矩形几何形状和无滑移边界缺乏类板块表面边界、板块驱动的横向剪切以及热化学分层。

tm.why: The paper conducts 4D fluid dynamics experiments of Rayleigh-Bénard convection to study thermal plume morphology, interaction, and evolution with direct application to Earth's mantle geodynamics and LLSVPs.

ev.notes: Full 48-page manuscript PDF (including Appendices A and B, 15 figures, and 3 tables) was analyzed.

sum: This study utilizes the DETECT experiment, deploying 200 seismic stations in 20 sub-kilometric arrays in the Southern Apennines, Italy, to monitor low-magnitude seismicity (-1.5 < M < 2.8). By integrating machine learning and similarity-based detection, the authors identified ~3,600 earthquakes, lowering the completeness magnitude to near M0. Accurate hypocenter locations revealed a 50–60 km long fault structure with a right-stepping offset, capable of hosting up to M7 events according to dynamic rupture simulations. Focal mechanisms for 289 events were determined using a CNN for P-wave polarities and FPFIT inversion, revealing a spatially homogeneous extensional stress field with a near-vertical maximum compressive stress. This demonstrates that short-term dense array deployments can successfully resolve fine-scale fault geometry and stress fields in complex tectonic environments.
本研究利用意大利南亚平宁山脉DETECT实验部署的200个台站（20个子台阵），对低震级地震（-1.5 < M < 2.8）进行高精度监测。结合机器学习与相似性技术检测出约3600个地震，将完整性震级降至M0附近。精确定位揭示了一条长50-60 km、具右阶阶区的复杂断层结构，动力学破裂模拟表明其具……

t: Combines machine learning and similarity-based detection with CNN-based P-wave polarity classification and FPFIT inversion to resolve hypocenters and focal mechanisms.
结合机器学习与相似性检测，并利用CNN识别P波极性进行FPFIT震源机制反演。
Seismic waveform data from 200 stations in 20 sub-kilometric arrays deployed for one year (DETECT experiment) in the Southern Apennines, Italy.
意大利南亚平宁山脉DETECT实验为期一年的200个台站（20个子台阵）连续地震波形数据。
Detected ~3.6k events down to M0, revealing a 50-60 km long fault with a right-stepping offset capable of hosting M7 earthquakes, and resolved a homogeneous extensional stress field.
检测出约3600个地震，揭示了一条长50-60km的右阶断层（具M7潜力）及均匀的伸展应力场。
The monitoring duration is limited to one year, which may not capture long-term seismicity cycles or transient stress changes.
观测时间仅为一年，可能无法捕捉长期的地震活动周期或瞬态应力变化。
Demonstrates that short-term, dense sub-kilometric array deployments can resolve fine-scale fault geometry and stress fields comparable to decadal routine monitoring.
证明了短期密集子台阵部署能够解析出与数十年常规监测相当的精细断层几何与应力场。

kc: Successfully deployed the DETECT experiment with 200 stations in 20 sub-kilometric arrays in the Southern Apennines.
Detected ~3.6k low-magnitude earthquakes (-1.5 < M < 2.8), lowering the completeness magnitude close to M0.
Identified a previously unresolved 50–60 km long fault structure with a right-stepping offset.
Determined 289 focal mechanisms using a CNN-based polarity classifier and constrained a spatially homogeneous extensional stress field.
在南亚平宁山脉成功部署了包含20个子台阵、共200个台站的DETECT密集台阵观测实验。
检测出约3600个低震级地震（-1.5 < M < 2.8），将震级完整性下限降低至接近M0。
识别出一条以前未被发现的、长50-60公里且具有右阶阶区的复杂断层结构。
利用基于CNN的极性分类器确定了289个震源机制解，并约束了空间均匀的伸展应力场。
me: Machine learning and similarity-based earthquake detection.
High-precision hypocentral relocation.
Dynamic rupture simulations to assess maximum earthquake magnitude.
Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for P-wave polarity identification combined with FPFIT inversion.

sum: This study applies advanced machine learning and similarity-based (template matching) detection techniques to seismic data from the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory in Southern Italy. By integrating the kilometric-scale permanent seismic network (ISNet) with decametric-resolution Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) systems, the authors reconcile earthquake detection across different monitoring scales. The combined workflow increases the detected microseismicity catalog by up to an order of magnitude compared to conventional manual catalogs. This multi-scale integration demonstrates how dense infrastructures and fiber-optic technologies can be combined with automated algorithms to lower detection thresholds and improve our understanding of fault zone dynamics and background seismicity.
本研究将先进的机器学习与基于相似性的模板匹配检测技术应用于意大利南部伊尔皮尼亚近断层观测站。通过整合千米级常规地震台网（ISNet）与十米级高分辨率分布式光纤声学传感（DAS）系统，实现了跨尺度地震监测。该集成工作流将微震检测编目数量较传统人工编目提升了近一个数量级。该研究展示了如何结合密集观测基础……

sum: This study presents the first inclination shallowing-corrected paleomagnetic pole from Lower Permian limestones in the Qaidam Basin. The pole passes both fold and reversal tests, indicating a post-Early Permian Qaidam-Eurasia latitudinal convergence of approximately 20 degrees (over 2000 km), mostly occurring after the Triassic. To explain this massive convergence without a clear surface geological record, the authors propose a missing oceanic suture zone between the Qaidam and Tarim Blocks, which is likely buried beneath the sedimentary cover of the Tarim Basin. This finding is crucial for reconstructing the final amalgamation of the Eurasian continent.
本研究首次报道了柴达木盆地下二叠统灰岩经倾角浅化校正后的古地磁极点。该极点通过了褶皱和倒转检验，表明二叠纪早期以来柴达木与欧亚大陆之间存在约20°（逾2000公里）的纬度收敛，且主要发生于三叠纪之后。为解释这一巨大收敛量及地表地质记录的缺失，研究提出柴达木与塔里木板块之间存在一条隐伏于塔里木盆地沉积……

t: Paleomagnetic analysis of Lower Permian limestones from the Qaidam Basin, incorporating inclination shallowing correction and fold/reversal tests to establish a reliable paleomagnetic pole.

Paleomagnetic measurements from 113 limestone samples of the Lower Permian in the Qaidam Basin, yielding a pole at λ = 18.2°S and φ = 246.4°E.

The proposed suture zone lacks surface outcrop and is inferred to be buried beneath the sedimentary cover of the Tarim Basin.

Provides the first inclination-corrected Permian paleomagnetic pole for Qaidam, identifying a major missing plate boundary and suture zone connecting major Paleo-oceans.

sum: This study presents the first stable tungsten (W) isotope data from Cenozoic intraplate basalts in eastern China to constrain deep mantle recycling of subducted slabs. The basalts exhibit light W isotopic compositions relative to MORB, correlating with trace element ratios. These signatures rule out slab-fluid contributions, pointing instead to silicic melts from dehydrated oceanic crust after rutile breakdown. The results suggest the basalts originate from an upper mantle asthenosphere metasomatized by melts from the deeply subducted Pacific plate, with residual light W stagnating in the mantle transition zone.
本研究首次提供了中国东部新生代陆内玄武岩的稳定钨（W）同位素数据，以约束俯冲板块在深部地幔中的循环。研究表明，这些玄武岩具有比洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）更轻的W同位素组成，且与微量元素比值具有显著相关性。这排除了板块流体的贡献，指向金红石崩解后脱水洋壳产生的硅质熔体。结合地球物理观测，研究认为这些玄武……

sum: This study investigates the seismotectonics of the Bolivian Orocline in the Central Andes using a high-resolution microseismicity catalog and focal mechanisms. By analyzing the spatial distribution and faulting styles of microearthquakes, the authors characterize the active deformation of the subduction interface (deep thrusting) and its coupling with the upper-plate crustal structures. The results provide new insights into how deep plate convergence is accommodated by shallow crustal faulting and folding in this highly curved segment of the Andean margin, highlighting the complex 3D strain distribution and tectonic evolution of the Bolivian Orocline.
本研究利用高分辨率微震目录和震源机制解，对安第斯中部玻利维亚弯角的地震构造进行了深入研究。通过分析微震的空间分布和断层破裂类型，作者刻画了俯冲界面深部逆冲作用及其与上盘地壳结构变形的耦合特征。研究结果为理解该高度弯曲的安第斯边缘带中，深部板块汇聚如何被浅部地壳断裂和褶皱所吸收提供了新见解，强调了玻利……

sum: This study investigates the lithospheric thermal and mechanical structure of the amagmatic Southwestern Branch (SWB) of the East African Rift using 2D radially averaged power spectrum analysis of WGM2012 Bouguer gravity and merged aeromagnetic/EMAG2-v3 data, calibrated against seismic receiver-function Moho depths and borehole heat flow. Results show thin crust (28–34 km) in mobile belts/rifts vs thicker cratons (35–42 km), shallow Curie Point Depths (16–24 km), and elevated heat flow (65–92 mW/m²) along the SWB. Crucially, the northern SWB beneath the Central African Plateau exhibits thick crust (~35 km) but strongly thinned lithosphere (~148–175 km; mantle stretching factor βlm ~1.35–1.7), whereas the younger southern SWB (Okavango Rift Zone) shows thin crust (~30.4 km; crustal stretching factor βc ~1.3–1.7) over thick lithosphere (~185 km). The key novelty is identifying an along-strike southward transition from mantle-driven thermal erosion to crustal-focused extension along inherited sutures.

以三个参考宽频带地震台站（NE219、SA52、SA57）的接收函数莫霍面深度为锚点，校准重力频谱斜率的波数区间。

假设裂谷前地壳和岩石圈地幔初始厚度分别为40 km和195 km，计算无量纲地壳拉伸因子（βc）和岩石圈地幔拉伸因子（βlm）。

Potential-field spectral analysis averages bulk density and magnetization over 1°×1° (~110×110 km) windows, smoothing out localized upper-crustal fault geometries and point-scale Moho topography.

Stretching factor (β) calculations assume uniform pre-rift thicknesses (40 km crust, 195 km lithospheric mantle) across both cratons and mobile belts, and cannot uniquely separate steady-state mechanical decoupling from inherited Proterozoic thickness variations or transient propagation lag.

sum: Traditional seismic tomography struggles to independently constrain mass density and chemical composition in the deep Earth. Atmospheric neutrino oscillation tomography of the Earth (NOTE) offers a complementary probe sensitive to electron density, which combines mass density and composition (especially hydrogen). This paper lays the mathematical groundwork for future joint neutrino-seismic inversions by formulating the NOTE forward problem and deriving its linearized Fréchet derivatives using a 64-shell Earth model (PREM density plus reference geochemical compositions). Using the EarthProbe framework, the authors evaluate synthetic sensitivity for an idealized detector and three next-generation detectors: KM3NeT/ORCA, Hyper-Kamiokande, and DUNE. They confirm that perturbations up to ±3% remain in the linear regime. While intrinsic sensitivity peaks in the outer core due to ~3 GeV MSW resonances, realistic detector resolution and efficiency limitations at low energies shift practical sensitivity toward the mantle, including the mantle transition zone.
传统地震层析成像难以独立约束地球深部的质量密度与化学成分。大气中微子振荡地球层析成像（NOTE）对电子密度敏感，提供了互补探测手段。本文通过建立NOTE正演问题并推导其线性化Fréchet导数，为未来的中微子-地震联合反演奠定了数学基础。作者采用64层地球模型和EarthProbe框架，模拟评估了理……

Synthetic neutrino event counts are simulated over 20 years using the Honda atmospheric flux, PREM densities, McDonough/Wedepohl compositions, and parameterized responses for DUNE-like, HK-like, KM3NeT/ORCA-like, and idealized detectors across 100 energy and 800 angle bins.
基于Honda大气通量、PREM密度、地球化学成分及四类探测器响应参数，模拟20年曝光下100个能量和800个角度分箱的…

Fréchet derivatives scale linearly up to ±3% electron density perturbations. While an idealized detector is most sensitive to the outer core (~3 GeV MSW resonance), realistic detector resolutions shift peak sensitivity to the mantle (~7 GeV).
Fréchet导数在±3%电子密度扰动内呈线性；理想探测器对外核最敏感（约3 GeV共振），而实际探测器灵敏度峰值移向地…

The 1D radial shell perturbations do not distinguish between hemispheres along a ray and neglect systematic uncertainties, total Earth mass, moment of inertia, and hydrostatic equilibrium constraints.

First formal derivation and linearity verification of Fréchet sensitivity kernels for atmospheric neutrino oscillation tomography across realistic next-generation detectors to enable joint inversion with seismic data.
首次针对下一代探测器推导并验证了大气中微子振荡层析成像的Fréchet灵敏度核及其线性度，为与地震数据联合反演奠定基础。

kc: Establishes the mathematical forward formulation and linearized Fréchet derivatives for Neutrino Oscillation Tomography of the Earth (NOTE).
Demonstrates that Fréchet derivatives scale linearly for electron density perturbations up to ±3% across 100-km-thick radial shells.
Quantifies and compares depth-dependent sensitivity profiles for an idealized detector versus next-generation detectors (KM3NeT/ORCA, Hyper-Kamiokande, and DUNE).
Reveals that finite detector energy/angular resolution at low energies (~3 GeV) shifts practical sensitivity from the outer core toward the mantle (~7 GeV MSW resonance).
建立了地球中微子振荡层析成像（NOTE）的数学正演公式和线性化Fréchet导数。
证明了在100公里厚的径向球壳内，高达±3%的电子密度扰动的Fréchet导数呈线性比例缩放。

揭示了实际探测器在低能区（约3 GeV）有限的能量/角度分辨率会将实际灵敏度从外核向地幔（约7 GeV MSW共振）转移。

sum: Paired negative seismic discontinuities in the continental upper mantle are conventionally interpreted as a mid-lithospheric discontinuity (MLD) above a deeper lithosphere–asthenosphere boundary (LAB). However, this cratonic model fails to reconcile conflicting observations in thinned, tectonically active regions. Here, the authors integrate thermal LAB depths from Bayesian multi-observable probabilistic inversions (jointly inverting Rayleigh-wave dispersion, heat flow, geoid, and elevation), S-wave receiver functions (SRFs), and basaltic Y/Yb melt extraction depths across Eastern China and global volcanic provinces. While stable cratons match the conventional MLD-LAB framework, thinned intraplate volcanic regions show the shallow discontinuity (~80 km) aligning with both the thermal and geochemical LAB. The deeper discontinuity (~130 km) lies within the asthenosphere. The authors propose a novel dual-melt-layer model: a shallow melt accumulation zone at the LAB and a deeper, FeO-rich, gravitationally stabilized asthenospheric melt layer, reconciling long-standing conflicts over lithospheric thickness.
大陆上地幔成对的负地震间断面通常被解释为岩石圈内部间断面（MLD）和更深的岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）。然而，这一克拉通模型难以解释构造活动减薄区的矛盾观测。本文综合了多观测概率反演（联合瑞利波频散、热流、大地水准面和高程）获得的热LAB深度、S波接收函数（SRF）以及年轻玄武岩Y/Yb熔体萃取深度……

t: Integrates 1D Bayesian MCMC multi-observable thermochemical inversions (Rayleigh-wave dispersion, heat flow, geoid, elevation) with compiled S-wave receiver functions and basaltic Y/Yb melt-extraction barometry.
将一维贝叶斯多观测热化学概率反演与汇编的S波接收函数及玄武岩Y/Yb熔体萃取压力计相结合。
Uses regional Rayleigh-wave dispersion (10–145 s), heat flow, geoid, topography, compiled teleseismic SRFs across Eastern China, and ~300 primitive young basalt samples (≤5 Ma) from GEOROC.

In cratons, the thermal LAB matches the deep SRF (~150 km). In active volcanic regions, the thermal LAB matches the shallow SRF (~80 km) and shallowest melt depths, while the deep SRF (~130 km) lies in the asthenosphere.

Identifies that paired upper-mantle seismic discontinuities in thinned volcanic regions represent a dual asthenospheric melt structure (LAB melt plus deep FeO-rich melt) rather than a cratonic MLD-LAB pair.
揭示减薄火山区上地幔成对间断面代表软流圈双层熔体结构（LAB熔体层与深部富铁稳定熔体层），而非克拉通MLD-LAB。

Establishes a global framework linking upper-mantle dual seismic discontinuities to tectonic-thermal regimes in Eifel, East African Rift, and Southern Rocky Mountains.
调和了构造活动板内火山区在地震、热学和地球化学岩石圈厚度估计上的长期矛盾。
证明中国东北及类似活动区下方的浅部SRF负间断面（约80 km）代表真正的LAB而非MLD。
识别出活动火山区深部SRF间断面（约130 km）为软流圈内富FeO、重力稳定的深部熔体聚集带。
建立了将上地幔双地震间断面与构造-热体制相联系的全球框架，并推广至埃菲尔、东非大裂谷和南落基山脉。

Compilation and comparative synthesis of migrated S-wave receiver function (SRF) profiles from time-domain maximum entropy and spiking deconvolutions.
Geochemical estimation of basaltic melt extraction depths using empirical rare-earth-element Y/Yb barometry (Depth = 7.933 * Y/Yb - 15.987) and melt density/mobility analysis.
热力学自洽的贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（DRAM）多观测联合反演，结合瑞利波频散、地表热流、大地水准面和绝对高程。
汇编与对比综合基于时间域最大熵反褶积和脉冲反褶积的偏移S波接收函数（SRF）剖面。

~300 filtered primitive young basalt samples (age <= 5 Ma, MgO >= 7 wt.%, SiO2 <= 53 wt.%) selected from ~6000 mainland China samples in the GEOROC database.
Global comparative datasets from the Eifel volcanic field, East African Rift (EAR), and Southern Rocky Mountains (SRM).

汇编覆盖中国东北、华北克拉通和华南块体的远震S波接收函数图像（震级>5.5，震中距50°–90°）。

来自欧洲埃菲尔火山区、东非大裂谷（EAR）和北美南落基山脉（SRM）的全球对比数据集。

SRFs suffer from lower vertical resolution than PRFs due to longer S-wave wavelengths and lower signal-to-noise ratios from limited teleseismic events.

sum: This study investigates the postseismic deformation following the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence in Turkey to constrain the regional rheological structure. By analyzing geodetic observations (such as GNSS and InSAR), the authors model afterslip and viscoelastic relaxation. They resolve significant lateral heterogeneities in the rheology of the lower crust and upper mantle across the East Anatolian Fault zone. The findings highlight the importance of considering lateral variations in rheology for accurately assessing postseismic stress evolution and regional seismic hazards.
本研究利用2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什地震序列的震后形变观测数据（如GNSS和InSAR），约束了区域流变学结构。通过模拟余滑和粘弹性松弛过程，研究揭示了东安纳托利亚断裂带两侧中下地壳和上地幔流变性质的显著横向非均匀性。该成果强调了在评估震后应力演化和区域地震危险性时考虑流变学横向变化的重要性。

sum: This paper outlines the achievements and strategic goals of the TRANSFORM2 Horizon Europe project, which aims to upgrade European Near-Fault Observatories (NFOs). By evaluating and deploying cutting-edge sensors, developing machine learning-powered workflows for real-time seismic event detection and characterization, and validating next-generation Earthquake Early Warning (EEW) paradigms, the project enhances our understanding of complex seismogenic faults. It also focuses on stakeholder engagement and establishing sustainable funding pathways to support these critical research infrastructures.

sum: This operational report provides explanatory remarks for the dataset collected during the International Continental Scientific Drilling Program (ICDP) Project 5008 ('Drilling the Eger Rift: Magmatic fluids driving the earthquake swarms and the deep biosphere'). The expedition drilled five completely cored boreholes across four sites (Landwüst, Hartoušov, Studenec, and Bažina) to depths between 150.6 m and 402 m. The document introduces ICDP naming conventions (Combined ID), International Generic Sample Numbers (IGSN), depth definitions (driller's depth vs. meter corrected depth), and the mobile Drilling Information System (mDIS v2.1.0) hierarchical schema. It catalogs all available files, including daily drilling reports, core/section/split/sample metadata tables, lithology logs, downhole geophysical logs (acoustic image, full-wave sonic, caliper, density, gamma-ray, resistivity), corebox photos, and unrolled core scans, alongside data from the first three sampling parties.

Operational dataset from five fully cored boreholes across four sites in the Eger Rift (150.6–402 m depth), including core scans, lithology profiles, and downhole sonic/acoustic logs.

Drilling achieved high core recovery across all five holes: 368.47/402 m (Landwüst), 204.58/239.3 m (Hartoušov), 401/401 m (Studenec), 390.75/400 m (Bažina S4), and 150.6/150.6 m (Bažina S4b).

No post-drilling depth corrections (meter corrected depth) have been applied, daily reports exist only for hole 1_A, and mDIS sample/lithology entries are incomplete for hole 3_A.

sum: This study presents an automated Bayesian processing pipeline for InSAR-based source parameter estimation, generating an independent ground-truth dataset of 42 shallow, Mw 5.5–6.5 earthquakes. The authors use this dataset to evaluate the impacts of 3D velocity models, station distribution, and arrival-time pick errors on seismic hypocentre locations. The results show that 3D velocity model corrections do not yield an average improvement toward the InSAR-derived locations for this dataset, whereas manual picking with proper error handling significantly improves alignment with InSAR-derived fault planes. This demonstrates the utility of automated InSAR catalogs as independent benchmarks for seismic location validation.
本研究开发了自动贝叶斯InSAR反演管线，构建了42个浅源地震的独立地面真值数据集。利用该数据集评估了三维速度模型和到时拾取误差对震源定位的影响。结果表明，三维速度模型校正未见平均定位改善，而带误差处理的手工拾取显著提升了与InSAR断层面的吻合度，证明了该数据集验证地震定位的实用性。

42个浅源Mw 5.5-6.5地震的InSAR形变与地震到时数据。

sum: This study investigates how the elasticity and density of the forearc mantle wedge corner (MWC) and its serpentinization affect long-term forearc stress distributions. Using quasi-2D finite-element models in SimScale, the authors simulate four subduction zones—Cascadia, Nankai, NE Japan, and Costa Rica—incorporating an elastic MWC alongside viscoelastic asthenospheric relaxation, surface topography, effective friction coefficient (μ), and downdip coupling extent (DoC). Results demonstrate that reduced density and elastic stiffness from serpentinization promote buoyancy and reduce horizontal compression transmitted into the inner forearc. In weakly coupled systems with shallow DoC (Cascadia and Nankai), serpentinization shifts the inner forearc toward neutral or horizontal deviatoric tensile stress, matching focal mechanism stress inversions. Conversely, in strongly coupled systems with deeper DoC (NE Japan and Costa Rica), plate coupling forces dominate, maintaining horizontal deviatoric compression regardless of serpentinization. This provides new mechanical insights into feedback between background stress and ongoing MWC hydration.
本研究利用SimScale准二维有限元岩石圈变形模型，探究了俯冲带前弧地幔楔角（MWC）的弹性、密度及蛇纹石化对前弧应力分布的影响。模型针对卡斯卡迪亚、南海海槽、日本东北和哥斯达黎加四个俯冲带，结合了板间有效摩擦系数（μ）和摩擦耦合深度（DoC）。结果表明，蛇纹石化引起的密度和弹性刚度降低会产生浮力……

t: Quasi-2D finite-element models in SimScale simulate an elastic crust and mantle wedge corner over a linear Maxwell viscoelastic asthenosphere, subjected to gravity, topography, and frictional Coulomb shear tractions along the megathrust.
利用SimScale准二维有限元模型，模拟重力、地形和断层库仑剪切力作用下的弹性地壳、地幔楔角及粘弹性软流圈。

Models use Slab2.0 geometries, SRTM15+ topography, and literature-derived ranges of frictional coupling (μ, DoC) and serpentinization for Cascadia, Nankai, NE Japan, and Costa Rica, interpolating peridotite and antigorite properties.
采用Slab2.0几何形态、SRTM15+地形，结合四个俯冲带的摩擦耦合参数及橄榄岩与叶蛇纹石插值物性。

In Nankai (DoC = 15 km, μ = 0.03), increasing serpentinization from 0% to 50% shifts inner forearc stress (σx–σz at Point P) from -3.3 MPa to -17.5 MPa, whereas Costa Rica remains strongly compressive (26.8 to 34.1 MPa).
南海海槽蛇纹石化从0%增至50%使P点应力差从-3.3降至-17.5 MPa（拉张），而哥斯达黎加保持强挤压。
The mantle wedge corner is modeled as purely elastic, neglecting viscous or brittle deformation, and model parameters (μ, DoC, and serpentinization) trade off without independent constraints.
将地幔楔角简化为纯弹性体，忽略了粘脆性变形，且摩擦与蛇纹石化参数间存在折衷。
First study to incorporate the forearc mantle wedge corner as an elastic domain with varying degrees of serpentinization to quantify its effect on long-term forearc stress states.
首次将地幔楔角作为可变蛇纹石化程度的独立弹性域纳入模型，量化其对前弧长期应力场的控制。

kc: Incorporates the cold forearc mantle wedge corner (MWC) as a distinct elastic load-bearing domain within quasi-2D lithospheric deformation models.
Quantifies how serpentinization-induced reductions in MWC density and Young's modulus shift inner forearc stresses toward lesser compression or tension.
Demonstrates that MWC buoyancy and elasticity strongly impact weakly coupled margins (Cascadia, Nankai) but are overwhelmed by plate coupling in strongly coupled margins (NE Japan, Costa Rica).
在准二维岩石圈变形模型中，将冷前弧地幔楔角（MWC）作为独立的弹性承载域纳入计算。
量化了蛇纹石化引起的MWC密度和杨氏模量降低如何使内前弧应力向弱挤压或拉张状态转变。
证明了MWC浮力和弹性在弱耦合边缘（卡斯卡迪亚、南海海槽）影响显著，但在强耦合边缘（日本东北、哥斯达黎加）则被板块耦合力掩盖。
me: Quasi-2D finite-element numerical modeling (using SimScale) of an elastic overriding crust and MWC over a linear Maxwell viscoelastic asthenosphere.
Parametric exploration of bulk serpentinization degree (ξ), effective coefficient of friction (μ), and downdip extent of frictional coupling (DoC).
Evaluation of stress tensors after 10 Maxwell relaxation times (~70 years) under gravitational body forces, surface topography, seawater loading, and Coulomb shear tractions.
利用SimScale建立包含弹性上覆地壳、弹性地幔楔角和线性麦克斯韦粘弹性软流圈的准二维有限元数值模型。
对体蛇纹石化程度（ξ）、有效摩擦系数（μ）和摩擦耦合下倾深度（DoC）进行参数化敏感性测试。
在重力体积力、地表地形、海水载荷及库仑剪切牵引力作用下，计算10倍麦克斯韦弛豫时间（约70年）后的长期应力张量分布。
de: Region-specific slab geometries from Slab2.0 and surface topography/bathymetry from SRTM15+ for Cascadia, Nankai, NE Japan, and Costa Rica.
Material properties interpolated between peridotite (E = 140 GPa, ρ = 3,300 kg/m³) and antigorite (E = 50 GPa, ρ = 2,600 kg/m³).
Comparison of modeled stress orientations and regimes with published earthquake focal mechanism stress inversions.
采用Slab2.0板片几何形态和SRTM15+地形数据，构建卡斯卡迪亚、南海海槽、日本东北和哥斯达黎加四个区域的模型。
在橄榄岩（E = 140 GPa, ρ = 3,300 kg/m³）和叶蛇纹石（E = 50 GPa, ρ = 2,600 kg/m³）端元之间线性插值设定岩石物理属性。
将模型预测的主应力方向和应力机制与已发表的地震震源机制应力反演结果进行对比验证。
li: Parameters controlling plate coupling (μ and DoC) and serpentinization (density and Young's modulus) trade off and are not uniquely constrained.
The MWC is treated as purely elastic, neglecting viscous or brittle deformation and thus providing upper bounds on differential stress.
Models neglect 3D along-strike variations and dynamic feedback between background stress and reaction-induced fracturing during hydration.
控制板块耦合的参数（μ和DoC）与蛇纹石化参数之间存在折衷，无法唯一独立约束。
将地幔楔角视为纯弹性体，忽略了粘性或脆性变形，因此预测的差应力仅代表上限。
忽略了沿走向的三维参数变化以及背景应力场与水化反应致裂之间的动态演化反馈。

tm.why: The paper develops numerical lithospheric deformation models to investigate the long-term forearc stress state controlled by the mantle wedge corner, serpentinization, and plate coupling.
The models explicitly evaluate the role of the effective friction coefficient and the downdip extent of frictional coupling along subduction megathrust faults.

sum: This paper introduces the CLIMBS seismic array, a 35-station dense deployment in the Jackson Purchase Region (JPR), Kentucky, designed to monitor groundwater fluctuations using ambient noise interferometry. The authors evaluate cost-effective instruments and present preliminary two-month velocity-change (dv/v) estimations from cross-correlation functions (CCFs). The initial results show stable seasonal variations in coda waves and suggest that groundwater level variations influence seismic velocity in the unconfined aquifer, whereas the relationship in confined aquifers remains complex. This study demonstrates the potential of dense, cost-effective seismic arrays for regional-scale, high-resolution hydrological monitoring.
本文介绍了部署在肯塔基州杰克逊购地地区（JPR）的CLIMBS密集地震台阵（35个台站），旨在利用环境噪声干涉法监测地下水波动。作者评估了高性价比仪器，并展示了基于互相关函数（CCF）计算的两个月初步波速变化（dv/v）。初步结果显示，尾波具有稳定的季节性变化，且波速变化与潜水含水层水位存在相关性，……

t: Ambient noise interferometry is used to compute cross-correlation functions and estimate short-term seismic velocity changes (dv/v) from coda waves.
利用环境噪声干涉法计算互相关函数，并利用尾波估算短期地震波速变化（dv/v）。
Continuous ambient noise data from the 35-station CLIMBS array in Kentucky, combined with local groundwater and meteorological monitoring data.

Preliminary two-month dv/v measurements show stable seasonal coda variations and suggest a correlation with groundwater levels in the unconfined aquifer.

sum: This paper presents a large-scale, real-world case study applying a supervised deep neural network (U-Net) workflow to attenuate seismic interference (SI) across a 345 km² 3D marine towed-streamer survey in the Camie Field of Angola. To construct training pairs, 6% of the SI-contaminated data were processed using a conventional algorithm (dip separation, rank-reduction, and sparse tau-p inversion) to extract SI noise models, which were then augmented and blended with naturally SI-free shot gathers (3% of the survey). Uniform random noise injection and adjacent shot channels were utilized to ensure high signal fidelity. Evaluated on the remaining 91% of the survey (~400,000 total shot/cable combinations), the DNN workflow achieved more complete and continuous SI removal with minimal signal leakage compared to the conventional algorithm, while reducing total computation time from 143.5 hours to 54 hours. This is the first published full-block industrial-scale validation of DNN-based SI attenuation.
本文展示了在安哥拉Camie油田超345平方公里的三维海洋拖缆地震调查中，应用监督式深度神经网络（U-Net）压制地震干扰（SI）的大型实例研究。通过传统地球物理算法（倾角分离、降秩及稀疏tau-p反演）处理6%受污染数据以提取SI噪声模型，并与调查中3%天然无SI炮集进行数据增强与混合来构建训练集……

t: A modified U-Net is trained in the common-shot domain by blending conventional-derived SI models (from 6% data) with SI-free field gathers (3% data), utilizing random noise injection and adjacent shots as extra input channels to preserve signal fidelity.
利用传统算法从6%数据提取SI模型并与3%无污染炮集混合训练改进U-Net，结合随机噪声注入与相邻炮多通道输入保幅。

A 3D broadband marine towed-streamer survey from the Camie Field offshore Angola (1700 m water depth), covering over 345 km² with 41 sail lines, 12 cables per line, and ~400,000 shot/cable combinations.
安哥拉近海Camie油田345平方公里三维海洋拖缆数据，水深1700米，含41条测线、12根缆，约40万个炮/缆组合。

The DNN workflow achieved more complete SI extraction and less signal leakage across the unseen 91% of the survey while reducing total computation time from 143.5 hours to 54 hours on a single Nvidia Quadro RTX 6000 GPU.
在91%未见数据上实现了更完整的SI压制且几乎无信号泄漏，单GPU总耗时从传统方法的143.5小时降至54小时。
The workflow depends on conventional algorithms for training noise labels, struggles with very weak SI, and lacks cross-survey generalizability without retraining due to domain shift.

First published large-scale, full-block (345 km²) real-world industrial case study comprehensively benchmarking DNN-based SI attenuation against a field-tested geophysical algorithm in quality and runtime.
首个全区块（345平方公里）工业级规模深度学习地震干扰压制实例，全面对比了处理质量与计算耗时。

kc: Demonstrated the first full-block, industrial-scale (345 km², ~400,000 shot/cable combinations) application of deep learning for marine seismic interference (SI) attenuation.
Showed superior SI removal completeness and significantly reduced signal leakage compared to a state-of-the-art conventional geophysical algorithm in both shot and CMP stack domains.
Achieved a roughly two-thirds reduction in total processing time (54 hours vs. 143.5 hours on a single GPU), demonstrating scalability for massive 3D surveys.
展示了首个全区块、工业级规模（345平方公里，约40万个炮/缆组合）的海洋地震干扰（SI）深度学习压制应用。
在炮集域和CMP叠加域中，相比先进的传统地球物理算法，实现了更完整的SI去除并显著减少了有效信号泄漏。

me: Conventional benchmark workflow: dip separation, rank-reduction filtering, sparse tau-p inversion, and complex Morlet wavelet frame adaptation with unary Wiener filters.
Supervised U-Net architecture with 1.5x gradual channel scaling per downsampling layer, trained on 6% conventional-derived SI models blended with 3% SI-free field shots.
Signal fidelity enhancement via uniform random noise injection (RMS 8,000–30,000) and multi-channel input incorporating two adjacent shots on each side.
传统基准算法：倾角分离、降秩滤波、稀疏tau-p反演，以及结合复Morlet小波框架与一元Wiener滤波器的复小波自适应减去。
监督式U-Net架构：每次下采样通道数按1.5倍渐进增加，利用6%数据提取的SI模型与3%无污染实测炮集混合生成训练集。
信号保真度提升策略：注入均匀随机噪声（均方根振幅8000–30000），并引入目标炮两侧各两个相邻炮集作为多通道输入。

Dataset comprises 41 sail lines with 12 streamer cables each and ~800 shots per line (~400,000 shot/cable combinations), contaminated by diverse linear, curved, flat, and conflicting-dip SI.
Evaluation performed on the 91% unseen SI-contaminated data using shot gathers, CMP stacks, and late-time (8.0–10.0 s) high-frequency (>20 Hz) RMS amplitude maps.
安哥拉近海21区块Camie油田（水深约1700米）的三维宽频海洋地震调查数据，覆盖面积超345平方公里。

在91%未参与训练的受污染数据上进行评估，对比了炮集、CMP叠加剖面以及深部（8.0–10.0秒）高频（>20 Hz）均方根（RMS）振幅图。

Purely data-driven and survey-specific; suffers from domain shift and requires retraining or fine-tuning when applied to different seismic surveys.

sum: This study investigates whether crystallization-driven volatile exsolution (second boiling) in shallow magmatic sills can generate eruption-triggering overpressure and whether the resulting surface deformation is geodetically detectable. The authors couple rhyolite-MELTS phase equilibria for basaltic and rhyolitic compositions (Askja and Puyehue-Cordón Caulle) with 2.5D axisymmetric conductive heat transfer models (20 m and 200 m thick sills) and a temperature-dependent Maxwell viscoelastic wall-rock relaxation model. Results show that hydrous sills reach 20–30 MPa overpressures, whereas dry basalt contracts before modestly re-pressurizing. While thin and thick sills reach similar peak overpressures, thick sills cool over centuries, yielding volume-change rates an order of magnitude smaller and below routine InSAR resolution thresholds. Furthermore, felsic crustal rheology rapidly relaxes overpressure compared to intermediate/mafic crust. This defines a 'stealth' pressurization regime explaining explosive eruptions lacking short-term precursory geodetic unrest.
本研究探讨浅部岩床结晶驱动的挥发分出溶（二次沸腾）能否产生触发喷发的超压及其大地测量可检测性。作者将玄武质和流纹质岩浆（Askja和Puyehue火山）的rhyolite-MELTS相平衡计算与2.5D轴对称热传导模型（20米和200米厚岩床）及温度相关的Maxwell粘弹性围岩松弛模型耦合。结果表……

t: Couples rhyolite-MELTS phase equilibria with 2.5D axisymmetric finite-difference conductive thermal models and a reduced-order, temperature-dependent Maxwell viscoelastic relaxation scheme weighted by penny-shaped crack strain-energy density.
将rhyolite-MELTS相平衡与2.5D有限差分热传导模型及降阶Maxwell粘弹性松弛模型相耦合。
Simulated basaltic and rhyolitic magma compositions from Askja (60 MPa) and Puyehue-Cordón Caulle (100 MPa) emplaced as 20 m and 200 m thick sills under contrasting crustal geotherms and rheologies.
模拟Askja和Puyehue火山玄武质与流纹质岩浆在不同地温与流变地壳中形成20米和200米厚岩床。

Hydrous sills generate 20–30 MPa overpressures; thin sills solidify in 2–5 years with detectable dV/dt (up to 0.005 km³/yr), whereas thick sills cool over 200–500 years with dV/dt (±0.0005 km³/yr) below InSAR thresholds.
含水岩床产生20–30 MPa超压；薄岩床体积变化率可被InSAR检测，厚岩床冷却慢且低于检测限。

The reduced-order Maxwell viscoelastic model simplifies non-linear polyphase crustal deformation, omits spatial stress redistribution or mechanical feedback, and provides an upper bound on viscous relaxation.
降阶Maxwell模型未解析空间应力重分布或力学反馈，且给出了粘性松弛的上限。

Quantifies a 'stealth' pressurization regime by coupling composition-specific phase equilibria, spatial cooling gradients, and viscoelastic relaxation to evaluate geodetic detectability of second boiling in shallow sills.

Demonstrated that hydrous sills develop 20–30 MPa overpressures regardless of thickness, whereas dry basalts experience initial contraction (-25 to -35 MPa) before modest recovery.

Identified that sill thickness controls cooling timescales and volume-change rates (dV/dt), making thick sills (200 m) fall below routine short-baseline InSAR detection limits despite reaching critical overpressure.
Showed that felsic host rocks efficiently dissipate overpressure via viscoelastic relaxation, explaining globally muted deformation at arc volcanoes compared to ocean islands.
将特定成分的相平衡（rhyolite-MELTS）与2.5D热传导及温度相关的地壳粘弹性松弛模型相耦合。
证明含水岩床无论厚度如何均可产生20–30 MPa的超压，而干玄武岩在微弱恢复前会经历初始收缩（-25至-35 MPa）。
发现岩床厚度控制冷却时间尺度和体积变化率（dV/dt），导致厚岩床（200米）虽达到临界超压但仍低于常规短基线InSAR检测极限。
表明长英质围岩通过粘弹性松弛有效耗散超压，解释了岛弧火山相比洋岛火山形变信号普遍较弱的全球观测现象。

2.5D axisymmetric explicit finite-difference conductive heat transfer modeling with non-linear latent heat iteration.
Analytical chamber compressibility and Savitzky-Golay smoothed phase-change volume differencing to track elastic overpressure evolution.
Reduced-order temperature-dependent Maxwell viscoelastic relaxation weighting wall-rock elements by Fialko penny-shaped crack elastic strain-energy density.
使用rhyolite-MELTS (v1.1) 进行等压平衡结晶模拟，参数化熔体分数、岩浆压缩性和体积变化。
采用含非线性潜热迭代的2.5D轴对称显式有限差分热传导模拟。
结合解析腔体压缩性与Savitzky-Golay平滑的相变体积差分，追踪弹性超压演化。

Thermal and pressure evolution simulations for thin (20 m, 0.14 km³) and thick (200 m, 1.41 km³) cylindrical sills under fast-cooling and slow-cooling crustal geotherms.
Sensitivity experiments varying crustal Arrhenius parameters (Dorn factor and activation energy) from felsic to intermediate rheologies and shear modulus from 2 to 40 GPa.
针对四种端元成分的热力学模拟：Askja玄武岩与流纹岩（60 MPa）以及Puyehue-Cordón Caulle玄武岩与流纹岩（100 MPa）。
在快速冷却和慢速冷却地温梯度下，模拟薄（20米，0.14 km³）和厚（200米，1.41 km³）圆柱形岩床的热演化和压力演化。
改变地壳Arrhenius参数（从长英质到中性流变学）及剪切模量（2至40 GPa）的敏感性实验。

Assumes instantaneous sill emplacement rather than incremental accretion and relies primarily on conductive cooling.

采用降阶粘弹性方法，未解析空间应力重分布或完整的力学反馈。

sum: This study presents a reference catalog of point-source, double-couple moment tensors for 123 seismic events (Mw 0.9 to 3.0) recorded between February 2024 and March 2025 at the Cape and Utah FORGE Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS) sites. By inverting low-frequency waveforms (0.1–1.5 Hz) from local stations using path-averaged 1D velocity models, the authors achieve reasonable waveform fits (median variance reduction ~53%). The results show that strike-slip faulting is the dominant mechanism (~40% to 50%), with possible fault planes striking NNW (right-lateral) or WSW (left-lateral). The NNW-striking plane aligns with seismicity trends and natural fractures identified in reservoir image logs. This catalog provides critical constraints on subsurface stress and induced seismicity hazards.
