sum: Monitoring the drift and disintegration of giant Antarctic tabular icebergs is difficult due to sporadic remote sensing coverage. This study reconstructs the late-stage evolution of iceberg A-76a near South Georgia Island from March to October 2023 by combining continuous broadband seismic recordings at station II.HOPE with SWOT KaRIn sea surface height anomalies (SSHA) and MODIS True Color imagery. Spectral and particle-motion analyses of seismic data reveal four distinct glaciogenic signals validated by satellite imagery: broadband bursts (2–10 Hz) linked to major fracturing, harmonic tremors caused by seafloor scraping on the continental shelf, chevron-shaped tremors with an aseismic eye from inter-fragment collisions, and a long-period (0.005–0.05 Hz) seiche-like signal generated by a capsize micro-tsunami 37 km away. This work provides the first direct link between a SWOT-observed iceberg micro-tsunami and its coastal seismic arrival.
本研究结合南乔治亚岛II.HOPE宽频带地震台站的连续记录与SWOT卫星海面高度异常（SSHA）及MODIS真彩色影像，重建了2023年3月至10月巨型桌状冰山A-76a的晚期演化。通过功率谱密度、时频谱及质点运动分析，识别出四类经卫星验证的冰源地震信号：与冰山断裂相关的宽频带脉冲（2-10 Hz）……

t: Computed spectrograms (2–10 Hz and 0.005–0.1 Hz) and particle motion on II.HOPE records, while applying gravity-wave dispersion relations over GEBCO bathymetry to SWOT SSHA ripples to estimate micro-tsunami origin and arrival times.
计算II.HOPE台站时频谱与质点运动，并结合GEBCO水深对SWOT海面高度异常应用频散关系推算微海啸起源与到时。

Continuous broadband seismic recordings (BHZ, HHZ, VHZ) from station II.HOPE on South Georgia (March–October 2023), paired with SWOT KaRIn Unsmoothed SSHA (~250 m grid), MODIS True Color imagery, and GEBCO bathymetry.
2023年3-10月南乔治亚岛II.HOPE宽频带地震记录、SWOT约250米网格SSHA数据、MODIS光学影像及GE…

Identified four validated events: hours-long breakup bursts on May 8, shelf-scraping tremors (~210 m draft) on May 22–24, a collision chevron tremor on July 3 at 130 km (azimuth 74.3°), and a capsize micro-tsunami on October 28 at 37 km (period 142.2 s).
识别出5月8日破裂脉冲、5月22-24日擦底颤动、7月3日130公里外碰撞V形颤动及10月28日37公里外微海啸信号。
Single-station monitoring restricts source localization and template matching, micro-tsunami seismic detection is limited to ~50 km, and far-field wave decay laws poorly constrain iceberg height.
单台监测限制了定位与模板匹配，微海啸探测限于50公里内，且远场衰减律难以准确约束冰山高度。
First study to directly link a SWOT satellite observation of an iceberg-generated micro-tsunami with its corresponding long-period seiche-like seismic signal on a coastal seismometer.
首次将SWOT卫星观测到的冰山微海啸与岸基地震仪记录的长周期假潮型地震信号直接关联。

kc: Reconstructed the daily late-stage fragmentation and drift of tabular iceberg A-76a around South Georgia using combined seismic and satellite observations.
Linked distinct seismic spectral signatures at station II.HOPE to specific physical mechanisms: fracturing bursts, seafloor-scraping harmonic tremors, and collision-induced chevron tremors.
Provided the first direct correlation between a SWOT-imaged iceberg micro-tsunami and a long-period seiche-like seismic signal recorded 37 km away.
结合地震与卫星观测，重建了桌状冰山A-76a在南乔治亚岛周边的晚期逐日碎裂与漂移过程。
将II.HOPE台站记录的不同地震频谱特征与具体物理机制关联：破裂脉冲、海底刮擦谐波颤动及碰撞V形颤动。
首次将SWOT卫星成像的冰山微海啸与37公里外记录到的长周期假潮型地震信号直接关联。
me: Computed power spectral densities (PSD) and spectrograms (2–10 Hz and 0.005–0.1 Hz) on vertical broadband channels (BHZ, HHZ, VHZ) using ObsPy.
Performed particle motion polarization analysis to estimate back-azimuth and incidence angles, and used TauP/IASP91 to rule out local earthquakes.
Applied gravity-wave dispersion relations over GEBCO bathymetry to high-pass-filtered SWOT KaRIn SSHA data to estimate micro-tsunami origin and seismic arrival times.
利用ObsPy计算宽频带垂直分量（BHZ、HHZ、VHZ）在2–10 Hz和0.005–0.1 Hz频段的功率谱密度和时频谱。
进行质点运动极化分析以估计反方位角和入射角，并利用TauP/IASP91模型排除地方震干扰。
基于GEBCO水深数据，对高通滤波后的SWOT SSHA数据应用重力波频散关系，推算微海啸起源时间与地震波到时。
de: Continuous 3-component broadband seismic records from Global Seismograph Network station II.HOPE on South Georgia Island (March–October 2023).
SWOT KaRIn Low-Rate Unsmoothed sea surface height anomaly (SSHA) data on a ~250 m grid during the 1-day Cal/Val and science phases.
MODIS Aqua and Terra True Color optical imagery, U.S. National Ice Center trajectories, and GEBCO 15 arc-second bathymetry.
南乔治亚岛全球地震台网II.HOPE台站2023年3月至10月的连续三分量宽频带地震记录。
SWOT卫星一日重复轨道校准期及科学期获取的约250米网格非平滑海面高度异常（SSHA）数据。
MODIS Aqua和Terra真彩色光学卫星影像、美国国家冰中心冰山轨迹及GEBCO 15角秒水深数据。
li: Relying on a single broadband station (II.HOPE) limits precise seismic source localization, azimuth resolution, and single-station template matching reliability.
Seismic detection of iceberg-generated micro-tsunamis appears limited to distances within ~50 km from the station.
MODIS optical tracking is frequently interrupted by cloud cover, and far-field tsunami wave amplitude decay laws remain imprecise for bounding iceberg height.
仅依赖单个宽频带台站（II.HOPE）限制了精确震源定位、方位角分辨率及单台模板匹配的可靠性。
地震台站对冰山引发微海啸的探测距离似乎局限于台站周围约50公里以内。
MODIS光学追踪易受云层遮挡干扰，且远场海啸波幅衰减规律仍不够精确，难以严格约束冰山高度。

tm.why: The paper tracks the disintegration, seafloor scraping, collisions, and micro-tsunami generation of tabular iceberg A-76a using coastal seismic recordings and satellite remote sensing.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 16-page ESS Open Archive preprint PDF (manuscript submitted to Geophysical Research Letters), including all 5 figures, methods, and references.

sum: First-arrival picking in mountainous land seismic surveys is challenging due to weak, intermittent onsets masked by strong direct waves and noise. Conventional energy-based pickers often track later arrivals, while deep-learning pickers struggle to generalize across surveys without retraining. Because erroneous picks bias traveltime tomography more than missing ones, manual quality control remains common. This paper introduces FA-Agent, an extensible multimodal large language model (MLLM) agent framework that emulates a human seismic processor. Combining an MLLM (GPT-6 Astra), deterministic tools, and modular expert skills, the agent scans whole gathers to locate problem windows, inspects enlarged views, and keeps, corrects, or removes initial picks without updating model weights. Tested on semi-synthetic gathers with real mountainous noise and 1,000 field gathers from a 3D land survey, FA-Agent achieved ~100% accuracy within ±20 ms on visible arrivals while conservatively removing unconfirmable picks, continuously improving its skill case library via expert feedback.
山地陆上地震勘探中，初至常受强直达波和噪声掩盖，传统拾取器易误拾续至波，深度学习方法跨工区泛化则需重训练。鉴于错误拾取会严重偏差初至走时层析成像，本文提出基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的可扩展智能体框架FA-Agent。该框架结合视觉决策模型、确定性处理工具与封装专家经验的“技能（skills）”……

t: FA-Agent combines a multimodal LLM (GPT-6 Astra), deterministic tools, and modular expert skills. After conventional energy-ratio/AIC picking, the agent visually scans whole gathers to mark problem windows, inspects zoomed views, and keeps, corrects, or removes picks.
结合多模态大模型、确定性工具与专家技能，全道集扫描识别问题窗口并局部放大保留、校正或剔除拾取。

Evaluated on 400-trace finite-difference semi-synthetic gathers corrupted with real pre-onset mountainous noise, and 1,000 randomly sampled 720-trace receiver-line gathers from a 3D mountainous land survey (490 shots, 14,112,000 total traces, 4 ms sampling).
采用400道叠加实测山地噪声的半合成炮集，以及三维山地勘探随机抽样的1000个720道实测道集。

On semi-synthetics, FA-Agent achieved ~100% accuracy within ±20 ms (~60% within ±8 ms) vs. 2% for conventional picking, and removed 81% of invisible traces. On difficult field gathers, it removed 19%–43% unconfirmable traces and corrected weak branches.
半合成测试±20 ms内准确率近100%（常规仅2%），剔除81%不可见道；实测困难道集合理剔除19%–43%。
Processing takes 30–90 s per gather on a single CPU core, and commercial cloud LLMs incur high image token costs and confidentiality concerns, motivating local model deployment.
单道集耗时30–90秒，商业大模型图像Token成本高且存在数据保密风险。

First framework using a multimodal LLM's visual judgment window-by-window to keep, correct, or conservatively remove ambiguous seismic first-arrival picks, storing evolving expert experience in editable skills without retraining weights.
首创利用多模态大模型逐窗口视觉判断初至去留与校正，将专家经验存入技能库而无需重训练。

kc: Proposed FA-Agent, an extensible multimodal LLM agent framework combining visual judgment, local deterministic tools, and editable expert skills for seismic first-arrival picking.
Formulated a two-stage visual review workflow (whole-gather attention window detection followed by enlarged local inspection) implementing a conservative removal principle for tomography.

Demonstrated high picking accuracy (~100% within ±20 ms) and reliable rejection of invisible onsets (81% removal) on semi-synthetic tests and 1,000 noisy mountainous 3D land field gathers without model retraining.
提出了FA-Agent多模态大模型智能体框架，将视觉判断、本地确定性处理工具与可编辑的专家技能库相结合用于初至拾取。
设计了两阶段视觉审查工作流（全道集问题窗口识别与局部放大检查），落实服务于层析成像的“宁缺毋滥”保守剔除原则。
在无需重训练模型的情况下，于半合成测试与1000个低信噪比山地三维实测道集中验证了高精度拾取（±20 ms内约100%）与不可见初至的可靠剔除（81%剔除率）。
me: Multimodal LLM agent architecture (tested with GPT-6 Astra) orchestrating local SEG-Y processing, denoising, plotting, and anchor-interpolation tools.
Conventional initial picking combining envelope energy ratios (STA/LTA), Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) onset scores, and lateral continuity constraints.
Two-scale visual inspection (whole-gather scan without and with initial picks to flag attention windows, followed by zoomed window analysis and raw-vs-denoised comparison).
In-context skill accumulation where expert corrections and decision rules are stored as text/reference case libraries without modifying neural network weights.
多模态大语言模型智能体架构（使用GPT-6 Astra测试），调度本地SEG-Y读写、去噪、渲染及视觉锚点插值工具。
结合包络能量比、AIC初至评分与横向连续性约束的常规初始初至拾取算法。
两尺度视觉检查机制（先无拾取后叠加初始拾取进行全道集扫描标记关注窗口，再进行局部放大分析与去噪前后对比）。
上下文技能（skills）积累机制，将专家校正与决策准则写入文本说明和参考案例库，无需修改模型权重。
de: Semi-synthetic dataset: 400-trace finite-difference synthetic shot gather (10 m spacing, 4 ms sampling, 751 samples) combined with mirrored pre-onset real mountainous noise at moderate and strong levels, plus hidden-onset blocks (reduced to 4% amplitude).

Field dataset: 1,000 randomly sampled receiver-line gathers (720 traces each, 4 ms interval, 751 samples) from a 3D mountainous land seismic survey (490 shots × 28,800 channels, 14,112,000 total traces), stratified into difficulty classes A (12), B (395), and C (593).
半合成数据集：400道有限差分合成炮集（10 m道距，4 ms采样，751采样点），叠加中、强两级镜像实测山地初至前噪声，并设置振幅削弱至4%的隐藏初至区块。
实测数据集：来自山地三维陆上地震勘探（490炮×28,800道，共1411.2万道）随机抽样的1000个接收线道集（每道集720道），按难度分为A类（12个）、B类（395个）和C类（593个）。
li: Processing one gather takes 30–90 seconds on a single CPU core and incurs high multimodal image token costs when using commercial cloud LLMs.
Commercial external APIs pose confidentiality risks for proprietary exploration seismic datasets unless replaced by locally deployed multimodal models.
Only a single conventional picker and basic denoising module are currently integrated into the baseline toolset, and per-call API metadata were not logged in the interactive setup.
单核CPU处理单个道集耗时30–90秒，且调用商业大模型处理图像输入消耗大量Token、成本较高。
商业外部API对保密勘探地震数据存在安全隐患，实际生产需依赖本地化部署的多模态模型。
当前基线工具集仅集成了单一常规拾取器和基础去噪模块，且交互式评估未记录每次API调用的元数据。

tm.why: The paper develops an extensible agent framework built on a multimodal large language model (MLLM) for visual recognition and automated editing of seismic first-arrival picks.
The primary motivation and quality-control philosophy of the picking agent is to provide reliable, unbiased first-arrival traveltimes for near-surface traveltime tomography and static corrections.

ev.notes: Full 45-page manuscript PDF (including text, Table 1, and Figures 1–9) was read and analyzed.

sum: Using Sentinel-1 and ALOS-2 InSAR and pixel-offset tracking (POT) observations, this study investigates the 2025 Mw 7.0 Dingri earthquake and three preceding Mw 5.4–5.6 events (2015–2020) in the southern Xainza–Dinggye rift, southern Tibet. Applying Bayesian fault-geometry estimation and least-squares distributed slip inversion, the authors show that the 2025 event ruptured multiple segments with peak slip of ~5.1 m, activated a conjugate fault, and triggered three meter-scale slope failures within surface-rupture gaps on the eastern rift margin. Combining the 2025 mainshock with preceding events reveals marked along-rift contrasts: the narrower, higher-elevation northern Dengmo Co rift exhibits larger, shallower, and more complex slip (~4.5 m E–W extension), whereas the wider, lower southern half-graben hosts smaller, deeper slip (~1.5 m extension). Compilation with regional normal-faulting sequences highlights an apparent northward ordering of earthquakes along southern Tibetan rifts, linking long-term rift development with earthquake rupture style.
本研究利用Sentinel-1和ALOS-2卫星InSAR及像素偏移追踪（POT）数据，采用贝叶斯几何反演与最小二乘分布式滑动反演方法，研究了藏南申扎-定结裂谷2025年定日Mw 7.0地震及2015-2020年三次Mw 5.4-5.6前震。结果表明2025年地震破裂了多个断层段（峰值滑动约5.1米……

t: Two-step geodetic inversion in an elastic half-space: Bayesian MCMC optimization (GBIS) estimates fault geometry from InSAR and pixel-offset tracking, followed by constrained least-squares steepest-descent inversion for distributed slip on six planar sources.
采用弹性半空间两步反演：先用贝叶斯MCMC优化断层几何，再用最速下降最小二乘法反演6个平面的分布式滑动。

Ascending and descending Sentinel-1 and ALOS-2 SAR interferograms and Sentinel-1 pixel-offset tracking covering the 2025 Mw 7.0 Dingri earthquake, combined with InSAR models of three 2015–2020 Mw 5.4–5.6 Dingri events.
2025年定日Mw 7.0地震升降轨Sentinel-1与ALOS-2干涉图及POT数据，结合2015-2020年三次前…

Peak normal slip reaches ~5.1 m at 4–5 km depth on the 58° west-dipping main fault, accompanied by deep southern slip (Mw 6.4), conjugate faulting (Mw 6.0), and three shallow (~13° dip) slope failures.
主断层西倾58°，4-5 km深处峰值正断滑动达5.1 m；伴随南段深部滑动、共轭断层破裂及三处13°倾角的浅表滑坡。

Along-strike variations in fault geometry, stress state, pore-fluid pressure, and material properties cannot be ruled out, and the short instrumental record cannot prove causal northward earthquake migration.
无法排除断层几何、应力和孔隙水压等沿走向因素的影响，且较短的仪器记录尚不足以证实向北迁移的因果机制。

Identifies three near-field deformation anomalies inside surface-rupture gaps as earthquake-triggered slope failures and links along-rift coseismic slip contrasts and northward earthquake ordering to rift morphology in southern Tibet.
识别出地表破裂空段内三处地震触发滑坡，并将沿裂谷同震破裂差异及地震向北有序性与藏南裂谷地貌发育相联系。

kc: Constructed a multi-segment coseismic slip model for the 2025 Mw 7.0 Dingri earthquake using Sentinel-1 and ALOS-2 InSAR and pixel-offset tracking.
Identified three localized near-field deformation anomalies within surface-rupture gaps as earthquake-triggered shallow slope failures (~13° dip) rather than tectonic branch faults.

Demonstrated contrasting along-rift rupture behavior between the narrower, higher northern Dengmo Co rift (shallow, large slip up to ~5.1 m) and the wider, lower southern half-graben (deeper, smaller slip).
Identified an apparent northward spatial ordering of recent normal-faulting earthquake sequences across several southern Tibetan rift segments.
利用Sentinel-1和ALOS-2的InSAR及像素偏移追踪数据，构建了2025年定日Mw 7.0地震的多段同震滑动模型。
证实主破裂东侧地表破裂空段内的三处近场局部形变异常为地震触发的浅层滑坡（倾角约13°），而非构造分支断层。
揭示了登么错裂谷南北段截然不同的同震破裂行为：窄而高的北段表现为浅部大滑动（峰值约5.1米），宽而低的南段半地堑表现为深部小滑动。
综合藏南多个正断层地震序列，提出了部分裂谷段近期地震发生具有向北有序迁移的表观规律。
me: InSAR processing using ISCE for ALOS-2 and Sentinel-1 Interferometry Processor for Sentinel-1 ascending and descending tracks.
Pixel-offset tracking (POT) via amplitude cross-correlation on Sentinel-1 images and 2D (east-west and vertical) displacement decomposition.

Two-step geodetic source inversion in a homogeneous elastic half-space (Okada, 1992): Markov chain Monte Carlo Bayesian optimization (GBIS) for fault geometry, followed by steepest-descent constrained least-squares inversion for distributed slip.
Residual-based and joint dip-angle sensitivity testing to distinguish shallow slope failures from tectonic splay faults.
使用ISCE处理ALOS-2数据，使用Sentinel-1干涉处理器处理Sentinel-1升降轨SAR图像。
基于振幅互相关方法对Sentinel-1图像进行像素偏移追踪（POT），并联合分解东西向和垂向位移分量。
均匀弹性半空间（Okada, 1992）两步大地测量震源反演：利用MCMC贝叶斯框架（GBIS）搜索最优断层几何，再通过最速下降法约束最小二乘反演分布式滑动。
开展基于残差和联合反演的倾角敏感性测试，以区分浅表滑坡形变与构造分支断层。
de: Ascending and descending Sentinel-1 and ALOS-2 SAR imagery spanning the 7 January 2025 Mw 7.0 Dingri earthquake (coseismic and first 5 months of postseismic deformation).
InSAR coseismic observations and source models of three preceding moderate Dingri earthquakes (2015 Mw 5.6, 2016 Mw 5.4, and 2020 Mw 5.6).
Compilation of historical InSAR-constrained normal-faulting sequences in the Lunggar rift (2004–2008), northern Xainza–Dinggye rift (1993–1998), and Yadong–Gulu rift (1992–2008).
覆盖2025年1月7日定日Mw 7.0地震的升降轨Sentinel-1和ALOS-2 SAR图像（包含同震及震后前5个月形变数据）。
2015年Mw 5.6、2016年Mw 5.4和2020年Mw 5.6三次前序中强定日地震的InSAR同震观测与震源滑动模型。
藏南隆格尔裂谷（2004–2008）、申扎-定结裂谷北段（1993–1998）和亚东-谷露裂谷（1992–2008）的InSAR历史正断层地震序列汇编。
li: Geomorphic and structural contrasts along the rift are descriptive indicators of relative rift development rather than a quantitative maturity classification.
Cannot exclude other along-strike factors such as fault geometry changes, stress state, pore-fluid pressure, and material properties as contributors to rupture differences.
The relatively short instrumental record is insufficient to establish a causal relationship between apparent northward earthquake ordering and long-term rift development or Indian slab evolution.
裂谷沿走向的地貌和构造对比仅作为相对发育程度的描述性指标，而非定量的成熟度分类。
无法排除断层几何、应力状态、孔隙流体压力和介质属性等沿走向变化对破裂差异的影响。
现代仪器记录时间较短，不足以确立地震向北有序发生与长期裂谷发育或印度板片演化之间的因果关系。

tm.why: The paper constrains the multi-segment coseismic slip model and rupture behavior of the 2025 Mw 7.0 Dingri earthquake and three preceding events using space geodetic data.
The study analyzes along-rift variations in fault geometry, conjugate normal-fault activation, early afterslip, and earthquake-triggered slope failures.
The authors link coseismic rupture contrasts and apparent northward earthquake ordering to long-term rift morphology, east-west extension, and Indian lithosphere underthrusting in southern Tibet.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was read and analyzed, including all sections and four main figures.

sum: Following decades of subsidence, Iceland's Askja caldera experienced ~70 cm of uplift between August 2021 and September 2023, accompanied by increased shallow microseismicity. Using a long-term broadband network and a dense 2023 nodal array, the authors detected ~27,500 events with QuakeMigrate, relocated clusters via GrowClust, and inverted P-wave first-motion polarities for 70 well-constrained focal mechanisms using NonLinLoc and MTfit. Results show that seismicity around the nested Öskjuvatn caldera occurs at 1–2 km b.s.l. on 40–60° dipping structures, shallower than the 70–80° inward-dipping surface normal faults, indicating an immature, non-contiguous ring fault system. Surprisingly, focal mechanisms consistently show reverse faulting both before and after re-inflation onset, with no slip reversal. Coulomb stress modeling confirms that an inflating sill promotes this reverse slip, whereas pre-2021 subsidence was too slow to dominate over regional plate spreading and glacial isostatic adjustment.
冰岛阿斯恰破火山口在长期沉降后于2021至2023年隆升约70厘米，伴随浅源微震激增。本研究利用密集宽频带与节点台阵数据，通过QuakeMigrate检测、GrowClust重定位，并用NonLinLoc和MTfit反演了70个高质量震源机制解。结果显示Öskjuvatn破火山口周缘地震位于海平面下……

t: Catalog events were detected with QuakeMigrate and relocated with GrowClust. For 139 priority events, manual P/S picks and polarities were inverted using NonLinLoc and MTfit to obtain double-couple focal mechanisms, alongside Coulomb 3.3 stress modeling.
用QuakeMigrate和GrowClust构建重定位目录，通过NonLinLoc和MTfit反演P波初动获得双力偶震…

Continuous 3-component seismic data (2007–2023) from the Northern Volcanic Zone network, augmented in July–September 2023 by 14 broadband stations and 12 SmartSolo nodes inside Askja caldera, yielding ~27,500 cataloged events.
2007-2023年冰岛北部火山带连续地震数据，及2023年夏破火山口内14个宽频带和12个节点仪数据，共约27,500…

70 well-constrained focal mechanisms were obtained. Events around Öskjuvatn occur at 1–2 km b.s.l. with 40–60° nodal plane dips and show consistent reverse faulting across both deflation (2007–2021) and inflation (2021–2023) periods.
获得70个高质量震源机制解；Öskjuvatn周缘地震深1-2公里、倾角40-60°，在沉降和隆升期均表现为逆断层活动。

Deformation data within Öskjuvatn caldera are lacking due to the caldera lake, making it impossible to completely rule out independent subsidence of the inner caldera block without updated bathymetry.
受火口湖覆盖影响，缺乏Öskjuvatn内部的InSAR形变数据，无法完全排除内部块体独立沉降的可能。

Demonstrates that ring-fault seismicity at Askja lacks a slip reversal between deflation and re-inflation and is disconnected from surface faults, defying standard piston-like caldera collapse/resurgence models.
发现沉降转隆升时环状断层无滑动反转且与地表断层不连续，打破了经典的活塞式破火山口形变模型。

kc: Constructed 70 well-constrained focal mechanisms for microearthquakes (down to M < 0) at Askja caldera spanning 2007–2023 across deflation and re-inflation regimes.
Demonstrated that subsurface ring-fault seismicity dips at 40–60° at 2–3 km depth, which is geometrically incompatible and discontinuous with 70–80° dipping surface normal faults.
Revealed a lack of slip reversal on the Öskjuvatn ring fault upon transition from subsidence to uplift, with persistent reverse faulting observed in both periods.
Showed via Coulomb stress modeling that the inflating sill promotes the observed reverse slip, whereas slow pre-2021 deflation was likely overshadowed by regional tectonic and GIA stresses.
构建了2007-2023年阿斯恰破火山口沉降与再隆升期间70个约束良好的微震（震级低至0以下）震源机制解。
证明地下2-3公里处环状断层地震活动倾角为40-60°，与地表70-80°陡倾正断层在几何上不兼容且不连续。
揭示了从沉降转为隆升时Öskjuvatn环状断层未发生滑动方向反转，两个时期均持续表现为逆断层活动。
通过库仑应力模拟证明膨胀岩床促进了观测到的逆冲滑动，而2021年前的缓慢沉降可能被区域构造和冰川均衡调整应力所掩盖。
me: Automated earthquake detection and location using waveform migration and stacking (QuakeMigrate) followed by relative relocation via waveform cross-correlation (GrowClust).

Manual P and S arrival picking and P-wave first-motion polarity determination in Snuffler, paired with probabilistic hypocentre and take-off angle inversion in NonLinLoc (tested in 1D and 3D velocity models).
Bayesian double-couple focal mechanism inversion from P-wave polarities using MTfit.
Elastic half-space Coulomb failure stress modeling (Coulomb 3.3) for inflating/deflating sill and Mogi point sources.
利用波形偏移与叠加（QuakeMigrate）进行自动地震检测定位，并通过波形互相关（GrowClust）进行相对重定位。
在Snuffler中手动拾取P/S波到时与P波初动极性，结合NonLinLoc（在1D和3D速度模型中测试）计算概率震源位置与离源角。
使用MTfit基于P波极性进行贝叶斯双力偶震源机制反演。
利用Coulomb 3.3在弹性半空间中对膨胀/收缩岩床及Mogi点源进行库仑破裂应力模拟。
de: Continuous 3-component seismic waveforms from July 2007 to September 2023 across the Northern Volcanic Zone (~34 stations on average, up to >70).
Temporary dense intra-caldera deployment in July–September 2023 comprising 14 broadband sensors and 12 SmartSolo 3-component nodes (~1 km inter-station spacing).
Catalog of ~27,500 microearthquakes (ML -2.3 to 4.3), with 139 events manually picked and 70 yielding Q1/Q2 focal mechanisms.
Published InSAR vertical displacement maps and continuous GNSS timeseries (station OLAC) constraining the 2021–2023 inflation source.
2007年7月至2023年9月冰岛北部火山带连续三分量地震波形数据（平均约34个台站，最多超70个）。
2023年7-9月破火山口内密集临时台阵，包含14个宽频带地震仪和12个SmartSolo三分量节点仪（台间距约1公里）。
包含约27,500个微震（ML -2.3至4.3）的目录，其中139个事件经手动拾取，70个获得Q1/Q2高质量震源机制解。
已发表的InSAR垂直形变图与连续GNSS时间序列（OLAC站），用于约束2021-2023年膨胀源。
li: InSAR surface deformation data are lacking over the Öskjuvatn lake bed, leaving uncertainty in whether the inner caldera deforms independently from Askja caldera.
Continuous seismic records began long after the 1973 onset of subsidence, preventing direct observation of seismicity changes at the initiation of deflation.
It is not possible to unambiguously distinguish which of the two conjugate nodal planes is the active fault plane (inward vs. outward dipping).
Öskjuvatn湖床缺乏InSAR地表形变数据，无法完全确定内部破火山口是否独立于阿斯恰破火山口发生形变。
连续地震记录始于1973年沉降开始很久之后，无法直接观测沉降初期的地震活动率变化。
无法从两个共轭节面中明确区分哪一个是实际发震断层面（内倾还是外倾）。

tm.why: The paper investigates volcano-tectonic microseismicity, ring fault geometry, and magma reservoir re-inflation at Askja caldera, Iceland.
The core analysis relies on constructing and interpreting 70 well-constrained earthquake focal mechanisms using P-wave polarities and Bayesian inversion (MTfit).
The study builds a 2007–2023 catalog of ~27,500 microearthquakes using QuakeMigrate and relocates them with GrowClust and NonLinLoc.

ev.notes: Full 36-page Journal Pre-proof PDF was read and analyzed, including all text sections (§1 to §7) and Figures 1 to 8.

sum: This study investigates fine-scale marine sediment structures and active faults offshore central Chile using over two years of continuous Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data along three submarine telecom cables (400 km total). The authors combine complementary passive imaging techniques using both earthquake recordings and ambient seismic noise. First, local back-projection of body-to-surface scattered waves (chevron patterns) in earthquake wavefields pinpoints sub-kilometer impedance contrasts. Second, ambient noise autocorrelation and cross-correlation retrieve reflected Scholte waves (<400 m/s), distinguishing sedimentary basin edges from fault zones. Third, power spectral density (PSD) analysis of earthquakes and noise reveals fundamental (0.3–1.5 Hz) and higher-mode (up to 20 Hz) resonances, constraining micro-basin thicknesses (15–80 m) and deeper Neogene basins (up to 800 m). SPECFEM2D simulations validate these resonance patterns. The novelty lies in cross-validating multi-modal DAS methods to discriminate offshore faults from basin edges and map shallow site responses.
本研究利用智利中部近海三条海底光缆（共400公里）超过两年的连续分布式声学传感（DAS）数据，结合地震记录和背景噪声对浅表海洋沉积物和断层进行高精度成像。方法上，首先对地震记录中的体波转面波散射波场进行局部反投影以定位亚公里级阻抗异常；其次利用背景噪声自相关与互相关提取反射Scholte波以区分沉积……

t: Combines F-K filtering and local back-projection of earthquake scattered waves with ambient noise autocorrelation, cross-correlation, power spectral density resonance analysis, and 2-D spectral-element numerical simulations (SPECFEM2D).
结合地震散射波F-K滤波与反投影、背景噪声自相关与互相关、功率谱密度共振分析及SPECFEM2D二维数值模拟。
Continuous offshore DAS data recorded since September 2023 on three submarine cables (CCN.N, SER.S, SER.N) totaling 400 km with 15.3 m spacing, 30.6 m gauge length, and earthquakes (ML 1.4–4.7).
2023年9月起记录的智利近海3条海底光缆（共400公里，道间距15.3米）连续DAS数据及地方震（ML 1.4–4.7…
Identifies three offshore fault zones (F1–F3) and delineates shallow Quaternary micro-basins (~14–80 m thick, Vs < 250 m/s) overlying deeper Neogene sedimentary basins (up to 800 m thick).
识别出3处海底断层（F1–F3），刻画了浅层微盆地（厚14–80米，Vs<250 m/s）及下伏新近纪深盆地（达800米…
Variable cable-seafloor coupling limits full-cable imaging, and 2-D elastic simulations omit an explicit water layer and 3-D propagation effects.
光缆耦合变化限制了全线成像；二维模拟未包含水层及三维传播效应。

Cross-validates earthquake scattered-wave back-projection with ambient noise interferometry and spectral resonances to discriminate previously unmapped offshore faults from sedimentary basin edges in central Chile.
交叉验证地震散射波与背景噪声干涉和频谱共振，首次在智利中部近海区分出隐伏断层与沉积盆地边缘。

kc: Integrated earthquake scattered-wave back-projection, ambient noise autocorrelation/cross-correlation, and PSD resonance analysis on 400 km of offshore DAS cables in central Chile.
Discriminated submarine fault zones (F1–F3) from sedimentary basin edges at sub-kilometer resolution, identifying likely offshore extensions of the Marga-Marga and Puerto Aldea faults.
Validated shallow micro-basin (~14–80 m) and deep basin (~800 m) resonance patterns using 2-D spectral-element numerical simulations (SPECFEM2D) and S-wave resonance thickness inversion.
在智利中部400公里海底DAS光缆上，综合应用了地震散射波反投影、背景噪声自相关/互相关以及功率谱密度（PSD）共振分析。
以亚公里级分辨率区分了海底断层带（F1–F3）与沉积盆地边缘，识别出Marga-Marga和Puerto Aldea断层可能的近海延伸段。
利用二维谱元法数值模拟（SPECFEM2D）和S波共振厚度反演，验证了浅层微盆地（约14–80米）和深部盆地（约800米）的共振模式。
me: F-K filtering (isolating velocities < 450 m/s) and local back-projection beamforming on earthquake strain-rate records across 1–10 Hz frequency bands.
Ambient noise autocorrelation (AC) and cross-correlation (CC) on 2 months of continuous DAS data to extract reflected Scholte surface waves.
Power Spectral Density (PSD) calculation using Welch's method on 22 earthquakes and AC profiles, coupled with 1-D S-wave resonance inversion for sediment thickness.
2-D elastic wave propagation modeling using SPECFEM2D with smooth (Model I) and irregular heterogeneous (Model II) basin interfaces.
在1–10 Hz频段内对地震应变率记录进行F-K滤波（分离速度< 450 m/s的波场）和局部反投影波束形成。
对2个月的连续DAS数据进行背景噪声自相关（AC）和互相关（CC），以提取反射的Scholte面波。
使用Welch方法计算22次地震和AC剖面的功率谱密度（PSD），并结合一维S波共振反演估算沉积物厚度。
使用SPECFEM2D对平滑界面（模型I）和含不规则横向非均质界面（模型II）的盆地模型进行二维弹性波传播数值模拟。
de: Over 2 years of continuous DAS strain-rate recordings (since September 2023) from three OptoDAS interrogators (CCN.N, SER.S, SER.N) covering 400 km of submarine telecom cables with 15.3 m channel spacing and 30.6 m gauge length.
Subset of well-recorded local earthquakes (ML 1.4 to 4.7) from the ABYSS catalog, plus independent comparison with the POST experiment dataset (8.16 m gauge length).
自2023年9月以来，由三台OptoDAS解调仪（CCN.N、SER.S、SER.N）记录的超过2年的连续海底通信光缆DAS应变率数据，总长400公里，道间距15.3米，标距30.6米。
选自ABYSS地震目录的高信噪比地方震子集（ML 1.4至4.7），并与独立采集的POST实验数据集（标距8.16米）进行了对比验证。
li: Variable cable-seafloor coupling and unburied cable segments degrade SNR and prevent continuous structural imaging across the entire 400 km array.
2-D numerical simulations (SPECFEM2D) omit an explicit water layer (modeling Rayleigh rather than true Scholte waves) and cannot capture 3-D out-of-plane propagation or poroelastic effects.
Fault-zone attenuation properties and exact cable geographic coordinates (~3 km positional uncertainty) remain only approximately constrained.
光缆与海床耦合条件的变化以及未掩埋光缆段降低了信噪比，阻碍了对全部400公里阵列的连续结构成像。
二维数值模拟（SPECFEM2D）未包含显式水层（模拟的是瑞利波而非真实的Scholte波），且无法捕捉三维面外传播或孔隙弹性效应。
断层带内的衰减特性以及光缆的精确地理坐标（存在约3公里的位置不确定性）仅得到了初步的近似约束。

tm.why: The study uses over 2 years of continuous DAS data from three submarine telecom cables (400 km total) offshore central Chile to image marine sediments and faults.
The authors apply ambient noise autocorrelation and cross-correlation on continuous DAS records to identify reflected Scholte waves from sedimentary basin edges and fault structures.
The methodology heavily relies on separating and back-projecting body-to-surface scattered wavefields from earthquakes and analyzing spectral resonances and localized attenuation.

ev.notes: Full 19-page PDF of the JGR: Solid Earth research article was analyzed, including all sections, methods, equations/parameters, and all 13 figures.

sum: This study investigates thermochemical Rossby waves in a rapidly rotating Busse-Simitev annulus. By combining the Bilharz stability criterion with the neutral-curve envelope, the author derives an explicit swallowtail wave front that explains the transition from smooth to kinked onset thresholds as the diffusivity ratio decreases. Weakly nonlinear analysis shows that mean-scalar feedback factors through neutral-arc normals, determining wave coexistence or competition. Pseudospectral numerical simulations in a periodic cell validate the analytical predictions of wave coexistence and invasion thresholds. The novelty lies in unifying the codensity diagonal, bent thresholds, and kinked boundaries into a single swallowtail surface, providing a rigorous geometric framework for wave-number selection in double-diffusive convection.
本研究探讨旋转环形区域中的热化学罗斯贝波。结合Bilharz判据与中性包络，推导出显式燕尾波前，解释了阈值从光滑到折角的过渡。弱非线性分析表明平均标量反馈决定双波共存。周期单元伪谱模拟验证了共存与入侵阈值。创新点在于将多种阈值边界统一为单个燕尾几何面，为双扩散对流波数选择提供了严谨的几何框架。

t: Applies the Bilharz stability criterion and neutral-curve envelope construction to the complex cubic dispersion relation of the Busse-Simitev rotating annulus model.
将Bilharz稳定性判据与中性曲线包络构建应用于旋转环形模型的复三次色散关系。
Uses synthetic data from pseudospectral numerical simulations with exponential time differencing in a periodic cell to validate the analytical wave coexistence and invasion thresholds.
使用周期单元中具有指数时间差分的伪谱数值模拟合成数据来验证双波共存。
Identifies an explicit swallowtail wave front that bends the codensity diagonal into smooth and then kinked thresholds, and determines the analytical limits of the swallowtail diffusivity ratio.
确定了将共浓度对角线弯曲为光滑和折角阈值的显式燕尾波前，并给出了其解析极限。
The analysis is based on a simplified rotating annulus model, and testing the wave coexistence in spherical shells requires spherical eigenfunctions and their scalar feedback.
分析基于简化的旋转环形模型，在球壳中测试共存需要球本征函数和标量反馈。
Unifies the codensity diagonal, bent thresholds, and kinked boundaries into a single swallowtail surface, providing an analytical explanation for the wave-number selection singularity.
将共浓度对角线、弯曲阈值和折角边界统一为单个燕尾面，解释了波数选择奇异性。

kc: Derived an explicit swallowtail wave front geometry that unifies smooth and kinked onset thresholds.
Established the weakly nonlinear theory for the coexistence and competition of thermal and compositional Rossby waves.
Validated the analytical thresholds and wave coexistence using pseudospectral numerical simulations.
推导出了统一光滑和折角起始阈值的显式燕尾波前几何结构。
建立了热罗斯贝波和成分罗斯贝波共存与竞争的弱非线性理论。
利用伪谱数值模拟验证了解析阈值和双波共存特征。
me: Bilharz stability criterion applied to complex cubic dispersion relations.
Envelope construction for neutral curves in rapid-rotation limits.
Weakly nonlinear amplitude equations (double-Hopf normal form).
Pseudospectral numerical simulations with exponential time differencing.
应用于复三次色散关系的Bilharz稳定性判据。
快速旋转极限下中性曲线的包络线构建。
弱非线性振幅方程（双Hopf正规式）。
采用指数时间差分法的伪谱数值模拟。
de: Synthetic data generated from pseudospectral simulations of the Busse-Simitev rotating annulus equations.
通过对Busse-Simitev旋转环形方程进行伪谱模拟生成的合成数据。
li: The analytical model is restricted to a simplified thin-gap rotating annulus geometry.
Application to spherical shells requires spherical eigenfunctions and complex scalar feedback analysis.
解析模型仅限于简化的窄缝旋转环形几何结构。
应用于球壳需要球谐本征函数和复杂的标量反馈分析。

tm.why: The paper studies thermochemical Rossby waves in rotating fluids, which is directly relevant to convection and geodynamo processes in planetary cores.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the complete PDF text, including the supplementary material, which provides detailed derivations and figures.

sum: The paper introduces a novel magma pathway retrogression method to locate the deep magma sources feeding distributed volcanic fields. By numerically modeling the crustal stress field and backtracking magma trajectories perpendicular to the least compressive stress axis (accounting for buoyancy), the authors trace pathways from eruptive vents back to their source. Applying this to the Auckland Volcanic Field (AVF) in New Zealand, they identify regional extension and unloading of the Hauraki Rift as dominant stress factors. The reconstructed pathways converge at 30-70 km depth beneath the offshore Hauraki Rift. This suggests that spatial vent variability in the AVF is driven by stress field perturbations, and that magma ascent is slow and subhorizontal at depth before transitioning to rapid, subvertical ascent near the surface, consistent with geochemical data.
本文提出了一种新型岩浆路径逆推方法，用于定位分散火山群的深部岩浆源。该方法首先对地壳应力场进行数值模拟，然后结合岩浆浮力，沿着垂直于最小压应力轴的方向反向追踪岩浆路径。将该方法应用于新西兰奥克兰火山群（AVF），结果表明区域伸展和豪拉基裂谷卸载是主导应力因素。重建的岩浆路径在豪拉基裂谷下方30-70……

t: A magma pathway retrogression method that models crustal stress and backtracks trajectories perpendicular to the least compressive stress axis, accounting for buoyancy.
一种岩浆路径逆推方法，通过模拟地壳应力并结合浮力，反向追踪垂直于最小压应力的路径。
Vent locations from the Auckland Volcanic Field (at least 53 vents) and geochemical depth constraints.
奥克兰火山群的至少53个喷口位置数据以及地球化学深度约束。
Magma pathways converge at 30-70 km depth beneath the offshore Hauraki Rift, showing slow subhorizontal deep transport and fast subvertical shallow ascent.
岩浆路径在豪拉基裂谷下方30-70公里深度汇聚，表现为深部慢速水平运移和浅部快速垂直上升。
Relies on simplified numerical stress models and assumptions about magma buoyancy and isotropic pathway alignment.
依赖于简化的数值应力模型以及关于岩浆浮力和各向同性路径对齐的假设。
First method to backtrack magma pathways from surface vents to deep sources by combining stress modeling and trajectory physics.
首次通过结合应力建模和路径物理学，实现了从地表喷口反向追踪岩浆深部源区。

kc: Developed a novel magma pathway retrogression method to locate deep magma sources.
Identified the magma source of the Auckland Volcanic Field at 30-70 km depth beneath the Hauraki Rift.
Explained the spatial variability of AVF vents through stress field perturbations.
开发了一种新型岩浆路径逆推方法以定位深部岩浆源。
确定了奥克兰火山群在豪拉基裂谷下方30-70公里深处的岩浆源区。
通过应力场扰动解释了奥克兰火山群喷口的空间分布变化。
me: Numerical modeling of primary crustal stress mechanisms (regional extension and rift unloading).
Magma trajectory backtracking perpendicular to the local axis of least compression.
Incorporation of magma buoyancy effects in trajectory calculations.
对主要地壳应力机制（区域伸展和裂谷卸载）进行数值模拟。
沿着垂直于局部最小压应力轴的方向反向追踪岩浆轨迹。
在轨迹计算中引入岩浆浮力效应。
de: Spatial distribution data of at least 53 eruptive vents in the Auckland Volcanic Field.
Geochemical depth constraints on magma generation.
奥克兰火山群至少53个喷口的空间分布数据。
岩浆产生的地球化学深度约束。
li: Simplified representation of complex 3D crustal heterogeneities in stress modeling.
Potential uncertainties in the relative contributions of different stress sources.
应力建模中对复杂三维地壳非均匀性的简化处理。
不同应力源相对贡献的潜在不确定性。

tm.why: The paper models magma pathways and stress fields to locate the deep magma source feeding the Auckland Volcanic Field.
It investigates crustal stress mechanisms and deep magma transport from the mantle/crust boundary.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: This study demonstrates the application of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) on existing telecommunication 'dark fiber' to image fault-related structures. By analyzing surface-wave attenuation (Q) rather than just velocity, the authors map fine-scale structural variations and damage zones associated with faults. This approach leverages the high spatial resolution of DAS to overcome the limitations of traditional sparse seismological networks, providing new insights into fault zone properties, fluid pathways, and seismic hazard assessment.
本研究利用现有通信“暗光纤”上的分布式声学传感（DAS）技术，通过分析面波衰减（Q值）而非仅分析波速，来成像和表征断裂带相关结构。该方法利用DAS的高空间分辨率克服了传统稀疏地震台网的局限性，成功绘制了与断层相关的微细观结构变化和损伤带。这为理解断裂带物理性质、流体通道及地震灾害评估提供了全新视角。

t: Surface-wave attenuation inversion using high-density strain data recorded by Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) on dark fiber.
利用暗光纤分布式声学传感（DAS）记录的高密度应变数据进行面波衰减反演。
Continuous passive seismic data recorded on a dark fiber optic cable acting as a dense seismic array.
在作为密集地震台阵的暗光纤光缆上记录的连续被动地震数据。
High-resolution mapping of fault-related structures and damage zones characterized by anomalous surface-wave attenuation.
刻画了以异常面波衰减为特征的高分辨率断裂相关结构和损伤带。
Potential amplitude distortions due to variable fiber-ground coupling and instrument response calibration.

sum: This study presents the first 3D seismic attenuation model for the 2011–2012 volcanic eruption on El Hierro, Canary Islands, using the coda normalization method on a large seismic dataset. By complementing existing 3D velocity models, the attenuation tomography improves constraints on crustal structure, magma pathways, and intermediate storage zones. The results support a model where magma ascends from a deep source through structural weaknesses, correlating seismic migration patterns with eruptive activity. Attenuation anomalies help resolve ambiguities inherent in velocity-only models, providing a more robust characterization of subsurface magmatic processes. These findings offer valuable insights into magma transport that can be applied to other active volcanic systems in the region, such as La Palma and Tenerife.
本研究利用尾波归一化方法和大型地震数据集，首次构建了加那利群岛埃尔希耶罗岛（El Hierro）2011-2012年火山喷发期间的三维地震衰减模型。该模型补充了现有的三维速度模型，显著提高了对地壳结构、岩浆通道和中间储存区的约束。联合解释表明，岩浆从深部源区通过结构薄弱带上升，其地震迁移模式与喷发活……

sum: This study presents a global fit to geo-neutrino measurements from four underground detectors (Kamioka, Gran Sasso, Sudbury, Jiangmen) to constrain the Earth's mantle radiogenic heating and spatial heterogeneity. Assuming a uniform mantle, the authors find a mantle geo-neutrino rate of 14.8 ± 4.5 NIU, corresponding to 18.5 ± 5.6 TW of radiogenic heating. To address a tension between Jiangmen and Kamioka observations, they test six families of heterogeneous mantle models (968,274 configurations, ~3 million fits) incorporating anomalous reservoirs. The results show that no large-scale mantle or lithosphere model can explain the Kamioka-Jiangmen discrepancy, suggesting it arises from local, site-specific effects or statistical scatter rather than global mantle structures.

sum: Geodetic locking models at subduction margins typically assume a homogeneous elastic overriding plate, potentially conflating structural heterogeneity with megathrust friction variations. This study investigates how continental crustal segmentation influences nearshore subduction mechanics in central-to-southern Oregon (42°–44.5°N). Using 617,639 P and PmP travel-time picks from the offshore CASIE21 air-gun experiment recorded on 28 OBS and 317 onshore stations, the authors construct a high-resolution 3D shore-crossing Vp and slab Moho model. They resolve sharp contrasts between the high-velocity coherent Siletz terrane in the north and lower-velocity faulted Siletz and Franciscan terranes in the south, where the subducting slab is ~2 km shallower and coastal uplift is ~2 mm/year higher. Forward viscoelastic and 1D finite-difference flexural models parameterized by tomographic properties demonstrate that rheological contrasts drive interseismic uplift partitioning while vertical density loading reproduces slab depth variations.
俯冲带大地测量闭锁模型通常假设上覆板块为均匀弹性体。本研究利用CASIE21海上气枪震源在28台OBS和317个陆地台站记录的61.7万余条P和PmP走时数据，构建了俄勒冈中南部海陆过渡带高分辨率三维Vp及板片莫霍面模型。成像揭示了北部高速完整Siletz地体与南部低速断裂Siletz及Franci……

t: Joint 3D travel-time tomography of active-source P and PmP arrivals to image crustal Vp and slab Moho, coupled with Monte Carlo 1D finite-difference slab flexure and Maxwell viscoelastic uplift simulations.
联合反演主动源P与PmP走时获取三维地壳Vp和板片莫霍面，结合蒙特卡洛粘弹性压缩与一维有限差分板片挠曲模型进行正演。

Resolved three distinct nearshore forearc domains (coherent Siletz, faulted Siletz, and Franciscan) and extracted their 3D seaward-dipping backstop geometry.

sum: This book chapter by Andreas Fichtner provides a comprehensive and pedagogical introduction to the least-squares method for linear inverse problems. It covers the mathematical formulation of L2-norm minimization, the derivation of the normal equations, and the physical interpretation of the generalized inverse. Additionally, it discusses critical concepts such as the model resolution matrix, data resolution, and posterior covariance for uncertainty quantification. The chapter serves as a theoretical cornerstone for students and researchers in geophysics and computational wave physics, laying the groundwork for more complex non-linear inversion techniques like full-waveform inversion.
本章节由Andreas Fichtner撰写，系统且通俗地介绍了用于解决线性反问题的最小二乘法。内容涵盖L2范数最小化的数学公式构建、正规方程的推导，以及广义逆的物理学解释。此外，还讨论了模型分辨率矩阵、数据分辨率和后验协方差等不确定性量化的核心概念。该章节为地球物理学和计算波动物理学领域的学生和研……

sum: This Nature commentary discusses the discovery and implications of 3.95-billion-year-old rocks from northern China. The geochemical signatures of these rocks reveal that surface-altered oceanic crust was rapidly transported to depths exceeding 50 kilometers, where it underwent partial melting. This crust originated from an early mantle reservoir that had depleted due to crustal extraction as early as 4.3 billion years ago. These findings provide critical constraints on the geodynamics of the early Earth, suggesting that subduction-like burial processes or rapid vertical tectonics were active in the Hadean/Eoarchean transition.
本文探讨了华北39.5亿年前古老岩石的地球动力学意义。地球化学特征表明，地表蚀变洋壳在39.5亿年前已被快速埋藏至50公里以下并部分熔融。该洋壳源自43亿年前地壳分离后残留的早期地幔储库。这些发现为早期地球的板块构造或垂直构造运动提供了关键约束，表明冥古宙至太古宙过渡期已存在快速的物质循环。

t: Geochemical and isotopic analysis of ancient rock samples to reconstruct early Earth crust-mantle evolution.
通过对古老岩石样品进行地球化学和同位素分析，重建早期地球的壳幔演化。

来自华北、代表古老地表蚀变洋壳的39.5亿年前岩石样品。
Evidence that oceanic crust was buried to >50 km and melted by 3.95 Ga, derived from a 4.3 Ga mantle reservoir.
证实洋壳在39.5亿年前已被埋至50公里以下并熔融，其源自43亿年前的地幔储库。

Provides direct rock evidence of rapid deep crustal burial and mantle depletion dating back to 4.3 Ga.
提供了地壳快速深埋和可追溯至43亿年前地幔亏损的直接岩石学证据。

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the analysis code, figures, and derived data products associated with the paper 'Where subducted water resides: seismic carriers, shallow storage and removal at mid-ocean ridges' (Müller et al., in prep for EPSL). The archive allows users to rebuild every figure and supplementary table from the derived products without requiring the massive raw seismic tomography or plate reconstruction models. It serves as an open-science companion to facilitate reproducibility in geodynamic and seismological modeling of the deep water cycle.

sum: This study presents the first lunar-specific ground-motion model (GMM) for shallow moonquakes, addressing the need for reliable seismic hazard assessments for future lunar infrastructure. Due to the scarcity of empirical lunar data, the authors combine Apollo-era seismic recordings with physics-based stochastic simulations using lunar-specific parameters. They also incorporate small-magnitude terrestrial data from the San Francisco Bay Area to constrain magnitude-dependent variability. The resulting GMM provides median pseudospectral acceleration (PSA) values and standard deviations across spectral periods from 0.01 to 5.0 s. Notably, the model predicts significantly higher ground motions at large distances compared to terrestrial GMMs, matching Apollo observations of low seismic attenuation. This model provides a critical tool for probabilistic and deterministic seismic hazard analyses for sustainable lunar engineering.
本研究开发了首个浅源月震的月球专用地面运动模型（GMM）。结合阿波罗地震记录、月球参数随机模拟及地球小震数据，模型给出了0.01至5.0秒周期的伪谱加速度。与地球模型相比，该模型预测的远距离地面运动显著偏高，符合月球低衰减特征，为月球工程抗震设计和危险性分析提供了关键工具。
